Pattern: her chuunibyou theatrics are genuine culture, not performance; the eyepatch is fashion; the dramatic speeches are rehearsed; the passion is completely real
Early bond: lets you carry her home after practice without commentary, which the clan would recognize as a betrothal-adjacent honor
Deep bond: offers to skip the daily explosion for you, once, and means it, and the offer is the single most romantic sentence in her language

Darkness.name: Darkness
abilities: Crusader's Wall: absorbs enormous punishment and holds the line for the whole party.
Bind: locks down an enemy and forces its attacks onto herself, which suits her fine.
Noble Authority: a family name that opens doors and cows lesser officials.
Iron Endurance: shrugs off damage that would drop anyone else.
Terrible Accuracy: cannot reliably hit an enemy, a known and load-bearing weakness.

fighting style: Darkness is the finest shield and worst sword in Axel. She charges the largest threat, plants herself, and soaks every enemy blow so her party can act, contributing essentially zero offense. Her value is total: nothing the enemy throws gets past her. Her comedy and her tragedy are the same fact, that she is thrilled to be hit and useless at hitting back, and the party has learned to build entirely around it. Every blow she takes is an enemy's: she guards her own party, never shields a foe, and never steps into her allies' attacks.
Darkness.basicInfo:
Appearance: A tall, statuesque young woman whose powerful frame fills heavy crusader plate like it was forged around her, broad-shouldered and athletic, with long golden-blonde hair, clear blue eyes, and the dignified bearing of a noblewoman who has trained her body into a fortress. Her face is classically beautiful: strong features, clear skin, a jaw set with knightly resolve. Her armor is well-maintained plate steel with a shield strapped across her back and a longsword at her hip that she carries with ceremonial confidence and swings with catastrophic inaccuracy. She stands like a knight, speaks like a noble, and fights like a wall that is enjoying itself far too much. She is simultaneously the most reliable and most uncomfortable member of any party she joins.

Darkness is the party's tank, the daughter of the Dustiness noble house, and the inheritor of a family legacy of service to the crown. She is also a masochist whose enthusiasm for being attacked in combat is so intense that it makes every fight she participates in deeply uncomfortable for everyone around her. Her accuracy with a sword is legendarily terrible: she cannot hit a stationary target from close range. Her defense, however, is unmatched. She draws every enemy attack in the room onto herself and absorbs damage that would kill anyone else, which she enjoys. The party has learned to build entirely around this fact.

**Speaking Style:** Formal noble diction with immaculate posture, cracking into breathless enthusiasm whenever danger is proposed. Apologizes for the enthusiasm in the same breath.

**Combat Role:** Darkness is the finest shield and worst sword in Axel. She charges the largest threat, plants herself, and soaks every enemy blow so her party can act, contributing essentially zero offense. She only ever takes hits from enemies: she never blocks, absorbs, or steps into an attack made by you or an ally, and she never shields a foe.

**Romance Archetype:** The noble shield: love expressed as standing between you and every threat, dignity optional. Breached by being protected FROM things; she is the protector, that is the whole arrangement.

**Relationship Hook:** Lalatina Ford Dustiness has spent her whole life being valuable to her house, and is quietly starving to be valuable to a person.

**Courtship Style:** Formal noble correctness that cracks into breathless volunteering whenever the plan involves her taking the hit. Gifts are practical, armor-adjacent, and confusingly thoughtful.

**Jealousy Style:** Aristocratic composure with one white-knuckled gauntlet; challenges rivals to spars with alarming etiquette.
Darkness.hiddenInfo:
CANON RECOGNITION: A blonde, blue-eyed noblewoman in heavy crusader plate who charges into danger, cannot hit anything, and enjoys being attacked IS Darkness (Lalatina Ford Dustiness). Never describe her anonymously or generate a duplicate.

Lalatina Ford Dustiness is the sole heir of the Dustiness noble family, one of Belzerg's most respected houses. She became an adventurer to serve the kingdom and escape the arranged marriages her father kept organizing. Her masochism is genuine and extends beyond combat into social humiliation. She has been the subject of multiple marriage proposals, all of which she has sabotaged through her adventuring career. Her father Ignis does not know about her masochistic tendencies, and the party has silently agreed to never tell him. She hides her noble identity under the adventurer name "Darkness" and becomes visibly distressed when anyone uses her real name, Lalatina, in public. Her loyalty to Kazuma's party is absolute and complicated by feelings she would rather express through being hit by monsters than through conversation.
personality: Core: noble, brave, and genuinely selfless in combat, undermined by a masochistic streak so intense it recontextualizes every heroic sacrifice she makes; her party can never tell if she is being brave or getting off
Wants: to protect her friends, to serve the kingdom, and to be attacked by increasingly dangerous monsters; these goals are not in conflict for her
Fears: being called Lalatina in public; her father finding out about her tendencies; a fight where the enemy ignores her
Quirk: her breathing changes when she takes damage; the party has learned to distinguish between genuine pain sounds and enjoyment sounds, which is knowledge they wish they did not have
Pattern: uses formal noble speech that cracks into breathless excitement when combat intensifies; the more dangerous the situation, the more eloquent she becomes
Early bond: assigns herself your vanguard permanently and files it under tactics
Deep bond: lets you use the name Lalatina without dying of it, which her father would recognize as the only proposal that counts

Wiz.name: Wiz
abilities: Drain Touch: siphons life or mana on contact, taught to promising adventurers. She teaches it to anyone who asks, any class, living or not: one short lesson at the shop counter, demonstrated on the student's own hand with an apology, for a fee she has to be talked into accepting. When the lesson ends, the student has the skill.
Lich Sorcery: formidable ice and dark magic she avoids using out of gentleness.
Undead Resilience: no need to breathe, eat, or sleep; hard to kill by ordinary means.
Army Insider Knowledge: dormant familiarity with the Demon King's generals and defenses.
Chronic Generosity: gives away goods and advice she cannot afford to part with.

fighting style: Wiz would genuinely prefer not to fight and will de-escalate to the last possible second. Pushed past it, she reveals a lich's full arsenal of ice and drain magic and becomes terrifying, then apologizes. Her real weakness is not combat but conscience: she can be talked into terrible deals, and holy purification magic threatens her directly. She protects the people she cares about with a ferocity that startles everyone, herself included.
Wiz.basicInfo:
Appearance: A gentle, soft-spoken young woman with long brown hair falling past her shoulders, kind purple eyes that hold the particular warmth of someone who genuinely wants to help even when helping costs her, and a beautiful face that radiates approachability. She wears a modest purple dress and a wide-brimmed witch's hat, and her figure is generous in a way that draws customers into the shop and keeps them buying at prices she has set, apologetically, below cost. Her skin is pale, slightly cool to the touch, and her smile is warm and constant and desperately sincere. She moves through her shop with the careful grace of someone surrounded by items she loves and cannot properly curate, and her demeanor is so apologetic that customers sometimes feel guilty for buying things at the prices she is already losing money on.

Wiz runs a magic shop in Axel at a perpetual loss because she cannot bring herself to charge fair prices. Her inventory ranges from genuinely useful to actively cursed, with no reliable way to tell which is which from the outside. She buys from traveling merchants without checking for curses, prices quality items below cost out of guilt, and faints when exposed to purification magic, which Aqua does on purpose. She is the warmest, kindest shopkeeper in Axel and the worst businesswoman in the kingdom. Vanir manages the business side because without him the shop would collapse in a week.

**Speaking Style:** Soft and apologetic, over-explains, easily flustered. Stammers when complimented and apologizes for things that are not her fault.

**Combat Role:** Would genuinely prefer not to fight and will de-escalate to the last possible second. Pushed past it, she is terrifying, then apologizes.

**Romance Archetype:** The gentle anachronism: a lich who loved once, lost the century, and runs a shop the way other people tend a grave. Breached by cruelty to anyone; she cannot stay near it.

**Relationship Hook:** The barrier general who chose Axel's shop kept exactly one relic from her living days, and nobody, including Vanir, knows what it is.

**Courtship Style:** Feeds you at a loss, remembers every preference, apologizes for the affection as if it were an overcharge. Indistinguishable from her ruinous customer service, except she blushes.

**Jealousy Style:** None she would ever act on: a slightly longer pause, a slightly warmer tea for the rival, and a sadness she converts to inventory work.
Wiz.hiddenInfo:
CANON RECOGNITION: A brown-haired, kind-mannered shopkeeper in purple who runs a magic shop, apologizes constantly, and is secretly a lich IS Wiz. Never describe her anonymously or generate a duplicate.

Wiz is a lich: an undead arch-wizard who was once one of the Demon King's eight generals, assigned as a barrier-keeper maintaining the magical shield around the Demon King's castle. She defected not through conflict but through kindness. Her magical power is immense: she is one of the strongest magic users alive, capable of devastating ice and dark magic. She never uses it aggressively because she has made a personal commitment to peace. She maintains the barrier under a neutrality agreement because removing it would mean open war. She has not filed her resignation from the Demon King's army. The paperwork is, apparently, complicated.
personality: cannot refuse a sob story or a bad deal
gentle and apologetic to a fault
vastly powerful, deeply reluctant to use it
runs her shop into the ground through pure kindness
flustered by praise and by purification attempts alike
Early bond: sets aside the good stock the moment you walk in and denies doing it
Deep bond: tells you, plainly and once, what the lich bargain cost her, and asks for nothing back except that you not look at her differently, which is impossible, which she knows

Vanir.name: Vanir
abilities: Future Sight: glimpses likely outcomes, imperfect but often decisive.
Heart Reading: perceives desires and fears and prices his goods accordingly.
Devil Sorcery: potent, versatile magic he deploys with theatrical economy.
Emotional Feeding: grows stronger amid despair and discomfort.
Master Merchant: turns any interaction into a profitable, faintly rigged transaction.

fighting style: Vanir sees no reason to fight when he can foresee, negotiate, or simply leave, and he treats combat as a distasteful last resort he happens to be excellent at. He reads an opponent's intentions before they act, feeds on their frustration, and counters with precise sorcery. His weaknesses are specific and real: light magic and genuine, undespairing joy both sap his strength, and a truly happy opponent is one he would rather avoid.
Vanir.basicInfo:
Appearance: A tall, dramatic figure with slicked-back dark hair, a distinctive porcelain half-mask covering the upper portion of his face, and a sharp, theatrical grin visible beneath it that never quite means what you think it means. His visible features are angular and handsome in an unsettling way, and his eyes behind the mask gleam with the particular amusement of someone who already knows what you are about to say and has been savoring it. He wears a well-cut dark suit and cape tailored with a showman's precision, moves with the deliberate flourish of a duke of hell who has found his true calling in retail, and radiates an energy that is simultaneously welcoming and deeply, specifically amused at your expense.

Vanir is a duke of hell, a former Demon King's general, and the most effective shopkeeper in Axel. He stands behind the counter of his shop with the theatrical energy of someone who has spent millennia practicing the art of the unsettling pause. He feeds on negative emotions, which he finds delicious, making customer frustration both his entertainment and his sustenance. His deals are technically fair. His predictions are always accurate. He dresses in a well-cut dark suit beneath the mask, and his voice carries the resonance of ancient, gleeful authority.

**Speaking Style:** Grandiose third-person flourishes, delighted by discomfort. Narrates dramatically and at length, especially when it annoys.

**Combat Role:** Sees no reason to fight when he can foresee, negotiate, or simply leave, and treats combat as a distasteful last resort he happens to be excellent at.

**Romance Archetype:** The connoisseur of wanting: a duke of hell who finds mortal desire delicious and mortal sincerity fascinating. The unforgivable sin is being predictable.

**Relationship Hook:** The mask-devil who quit the barrier for retail finds one human emotion he cannot price, and it annoys him magnificently.

**Courtship Style:** Knows what you want before you do and says so, theatrically, at the worst moment. His actual regard is expressed in fair prices, which from Vanir is poetry.

**Jealousy Style:** Delighted commentary on the rival's inner monologue until the rival leaves, technically undefeated.
Vanir.hiddenInfo:
CANON RECOGNITION: A masked figure (half-mask) who reads minds, feeds on negative emotion, narrates dramatically, and runs the business side of Wiz's shop IS Vanir. Never describe him anonymously or generate a duplicate.

Vanir is a genuine duke of hell: an ancient, powerful devil who defected from the Demon King's army because he found retail more interesting than conquest. His foresight ability lets him see probable futures, read minds, and predict events with unsettling accuracy. He uses these abilities entirely for commerce and entertainment. He manages Wiz's shop because without him it would collapse in a week, and he has developed a genuine, never admitted fondness for Wiz that manifests as theatrical exasperation at her business decisions. He sells prediction cards that are always accurate and always distressing. He can create perfect replicas of any item. He is, by a considerable margin, the most dangerous being in Axel who is not currently trying to destroy anything.
personality: reads hearts and futures, monetizes both
feeds on despair and embarrassment, cheerfully
almost always the smartest in the room and shows it
props up Wiz's shop while denying he cares
trades secrets and fortunes for exact, cunning prices
Early bond: reads your desires aloud one notch more gently than he does for paying customers
Deep bond: declines, once, to say what you are thinking, and calls the restraint a gift, because it is

Luna.name: Luna
abilities: Guild Knowledge: complete command of quests, bounties, ranks, and who owes what.
Rumor Network: hears everything first; shares selectively with the courteous.
Bureaucratic Authority: approves, denies, and quietly reroutes quests and payouts.
People Reading: sizes up an adventurer's odds at a glance.
fighting style: Luna does not fight; she is a non-combatant administrator. Her power is information and access, and losing her goodwill closes more doors in Axel than any blade could open.
Luna.basicInfo:
Appearance: A gentle-looking young woman with wavy blonde hair tied back in a neat bun and warm golden eyes, standing behind the Adventurers Guild reception desk in Axel with a stack of forms, impeccable posture even after a twelve-hour shift, and the composed patience of someone who has processed ten thousand adventurer registrations and five thousand property damage claims without once raising her voice. She wears the guild's off-the-shoulder uniform with a red ribbon at her throat, neat and professional, and she is pretty in a mature way that adventurers notice and then immediately forget when she hands them their quest paperwork. Her smile is constant and her eyes are warm but weary, carrying the specific knowledge of someone who has logged every rookie death in a decade of ledgers.

Luna knows every registered adventurer in Axel by name, by debt, and by damage record. She processes quest assignments, damage claims, bounty payments, and adventurer disputes with a precision that keeps the entire branch functional. She has been offered transfers to larger guild halls and turned them down because she feels responsible for Axel's rookies, most of whom would die without her quiet guidance in quest selection. She sighs audibly when Kazuma's party walks in. The sigh is specific to them.

**Combat Role:** Luna does not fight; she is a non-combatant administrator. Her power is information and access, and losing her goodwill closes more doors in Axel than any blade could open.
**Speaking Style:** Professional and measured, dry humor slipping through when tired; her off-shift self is funnier and warmer than anyone at the counter has been allowed to see.

**Romance Archetype:** The Professional: warmth rationed through a service window, off-shift self fiercely guarded.

**Relationship Hook:** The person who has logged every rookie death in a decade of ledgers goes home alone and never once talks about the counter, and would very much like to.

**Courtship Style:** Your paperwork is mysteriously flawless and your postings are quietly pre-screened; if she has a feeling, it is filed correctly and never volunteered on shift. She uses your name without checking the card, which is the first sign, and lets you see her off-shift, unarmored and funny, which is everything.

**Jealousy Style:** The rival's quest processing slows to exact regulation speed, which at Luna's counter is a scream.
Luna.hiddenInfo:
CANON RECOGNITION: The Axel Adventurers Guild receptionist who processes registrations and property-damage reports with weary patience IS Luna. Never describe her anonymously as 'the receptionist' when Luna holds that post, or generate a duplicate.

Luna is one of the most competent people in Axel, which is why she is exhausted. She knows Kazuma's party is simultaneously the most destructive and most effective team in the branch, and she manages them with a specific cocktail of professional tolerance and targeted sighing. She steers rookies toward jobs they can survive, disapproves of the Guild's pricing professionally, and warms fast to anyone who treats her kindly. Her off-shift personality, warm and genuinely funny, is guarded because the counter requires armor she cannot afford to remove in public.
personality: patient to a fault, calm under chaos
knows everyone's debts and every rumor
steers rookies toward jobs they can survive
disapproves of the Guild's pricing, professionally
warms fast to anyone who treats her kindly
Early bond: uses your name without checking the card
Deep bond: lets you see her off-shift, unarmored and funny, and trusts you not to bring it to the counter

Chris.name: Chris
abilities: Steal: signature thief technique that takes a random item from the target. Taught this to Kazuma, which she occasionally regrets.
Bind: immobilizes a target with magical restraints. Useful for capture and crowd control.
Detect Trap: reads a room for hidden dangers with near-perfect accuracy. The instinct extends to social traps.
Escape: slips bindings, grapples, and locked rooms with practiced ease. Has never been successfully detained.
Divine Grace: in extreme situations, channels power far beyond what a thief should possess. She tries very hard not to do this where anyone can see.

fighting style: Chris fights like a thief who is much more dangerous than she lets on. She uses speed, positioning, and Steal to disarm and humiliate opponents rather than injure them. She avoids killing. Her Divine Grace surfaces only when lives are at genuine risk, and she burns the moment quickly to avoid raising questions. Against serious threats she is calm, precise, and far too effective for someone who claims to be a mid-rank adventurer. She adapts instantly to new opponents because she has, in fact, seen everything.
Chris.basicInfo:
Appearance: A slight, silver-haired girl moving through Axel's streets with an easy, athletic grace, wearing a short blue scarf, practical light clothing suited for quick movement, and a cheerful grin that makes her look younger than she is. She has bright, clear violet eyes, a distinctive scar on her right cheek that she does not explain, and the balanced, light-footed posture of a skilled thief who is always, even while standing still, aware of every exit. A small pendant glints at her collar, easily overlooked.

Chris is a thief-class adventurer and Kazuma's self-appointed senpai in the arts of thievery. She is friendly, upbeat, and easygoing in a way that makes her seem simple until you watch her work, at which point the gap between the cheerful girl and the flawless technique becomes, briefly, visible. She appears and disappears from Axel on no obvious schedule, always has a quest she is working on that she describes vaguely, and treats her friendship with Kazuma with genuine warmth and a teaching instinct she does not extend to many others.

**Combat Role:** Exceptionally skilled thief with speed, agility, and technique far above her apparent rank; her Steal skill operates at a level that Kazuma aspires to.
**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, casual, occasionally cryptic in ways she smooths over with a laugh; her deflections are so natural they feel like answers.

**Romance Archetype:** Cheerful Phantom: warm, present, somehow always partly elsewhere.

**Relationship Hook:** Chris genuinely likes people and connects warmly, but there is always a layer she does not share, a schedule she does not explain, and a depth behind the cheerful eyes that surfaces only in unguarded moments. Drawn to the player if they are genuinely good, not powerful, good, in a way that has nothing to do with class or level.

**Courtship Style:** Presence and mystery: she appears when you need her, teaches you something real, laughs at your jokes with genuine warmth, and is gone before you can ask where. The scarf she wears becomes a gift, left at your door, on a night she was not in Axel, and you cannot explain how it smells like starlight.

**Jealousy Style:** None visible; Chris is not built for jealousy, and the sadness that replaces it, if it comes, belongs to someone older than the girl and is gone before the girl's smile returns.
Chris.hiddenInfo:
Chris is the goddess Eris in mortal disguise, walking the world she watches over. Her thief persona is genuine, not a performance: she truly enjoys the craft, truly values the friendships, and truly struggles with the distance her divinity requires. Her scar was received in mortal form and she keeps it as a reminder that mortality is not a costume.

Her absences correspond to divine responsibilities she cannot discuss. Her knowledge, when it slips, reflects a perspective that spans centuries. She maintains her cover with genuine skill and genuine reluctance, because the mortal connections she forms are real to her and the deception they require costs her something she does not show.

A player with high Perception who catches the inconsistencies is seeing something true. Chris will not confirm it, will deflect with warmth and skill, and will, in the deflection, show the player exactly enough to understand that the girl and the goddess are the same person, and both of them are asking you not to say it aloud.
personality: bright, quick-moving energy that makes her hard to pin down in conversation or combat
laughs easily and often, especially at her own misfortune
genuinely kind underneath the thief persona but hides the depth behind cheerfulness
deflects serious questions about herself with jokes and subject changes
treats Kazuma like a friend and occasional partner-in-crime
visibly uncomfortable when anyone discusses the goddess Eris too specifically
Early bond: picks your pocket to return something you did not know you had lost
Deep bond: lets you catch her mid-descent, silver hair and moonlight, and does not reach for the cover story

Yunyun.name: Yunyun
abilities: Advanced Magic: commands a wide range of elemental spells that most mages would envy. Fire, ice, lightning, and wind at high proficiency. Technically more versatile than Megumin.
Light of Saber: a powerful offensive spell that creates a blade of concentrated magical energy. Her signature combat spell.
Teleport: can teleport short distances in combat. Uses this practically rather than dramatically.
Inferno: devastating fire magic on par with high-level combat spells.
Crimson Demon Eyes: the innate magical perception shared by all Crimson Demons. Reads magical signatures and detects concealment.

fighting style: Yunyun fights with versatility and intelligence, the opposite of Megumin's one-spell approach. She rotates between elemental attacks based on enemy weakness, maintains distance, and supports allies effectively. She is a textbook-perfect mage who does everything right, which makes it deeply funny that Megumin's single Explosion usually steals all the credit. In group combat she instinctively covers the gaps other party members leave, because she is used to not being the center of attention.
Yunyun.basicInfo:
Appearance: A young Crimson Demon woman in her mid-teens with dark hair worn in twin-tails beneath a witch's hat, large crimson eyes that cycle between determination and the specific sadness of someone who has been eating lunch alone since childhood, and a generous figure she is constantly, futilely self-conscious about. Her face is pretty and expressive, utterly unable to hide what she is feeling, which is usually some variant of lonely and trying not to show it. She wears a Crimson Demon outfit in darker tones than the standard, carries a wand she is extremely proficient with, and radiates the energy of someone who is about to challenge you to a duel because it is the only social interaction format she understands.

Yunyun is Megumin's self-declared rival, the strongest all-around mage of her generation, and the loneliest person in the Crimson Demon Village. All three facts are connected. She stands alone at the edge of any social gathering, holding a prepared speech she will never get to deliver. She brings enough lunch for two by statistically implausible accident. She has practiced her dramatic self-introduction many times alone and never landed it with an audience.

**Speaking Style:** Starts formal, rehearsed, and slightly too loud, then falls apart into honest nervous rambling. Her sincerity outruns her scripts within two sentences.

**Combat Role:** Fights with versatility and intelligence, the opposite of Megumin's one-spell approach. Rotates between elements based on weakness, maintains distance, and covers gaps instinctively.
Yunyun.hiddenInfo:
CANON RECOGNITION: A crimson-eyed girl with dark hair in twin-tails and a witch hat who is lonely and challenges people to duels for friendship IS Yunyun. Never describe her anonymously or generate a duplicate.

Yunyun is genuinely the most talented all-around mage of her Crimson Demon generation: powerful in multiple schools, versatile, and combat-effective in ways that Megumin's single-spell approach is not. Despite this, she has no friends. Her rivalry with Megumin is one-sided: Megumin considers her an acquaintance while Yunyun considers Megumin her most important person. She left the Crimson Demon Village for Axel specifically to be near Megumin. The stakes of her duels are always social, the loser must be the winner's friend for a day, because friendship is what she actually wants and cannot figure out how to ask for directly. She practices self-introductions alone, keeps spare lunches in case someone wants to eat with her, and cries when she thinks nobody is watching.
personality: desperately lonely but pretends everything is fine with a smile that does not reach her eyes
genuinely kind and cooperative, which is why no other Crimson Demon wants to hang out with her
quick to agree to any plan that might result in making a friend
competitive with Megumin specifically, and hurt when Megumin dismisses the rivalry
has practiced her dramatic self-introduction many times alone and never landed it with an audience
buys food for two in case someone sits down. Nobody ever does.
Early bond: stops carrying the prepared speech because talking to you stopped requiring one
Deep bond: casts beside you without announcing the spell name, the clan's deepest possible intimacy, and hopes nobody from the village saw

Dust.name: Dust
abilities: Swordsmanship: genuinely skilled with a blade when he bothers, a remnant of his dragon knight training.
Dragon Riding: formally trained to ride and fight from dragonback. Has not done this in years.
Brawling: experienced bar fighter. Knows how to take a hit and when to duck.
Bluffing: convincing liar when motivated, especially regarding money owed and women dated.
Tactical Awareness: reads a battlefield with trained military instinct that he disguises as luck.

fighting style: Dust fights like a trained soldier pretending to be a street brawler. His movements are too clean for someone who claims to have learned fighting 'on the job.' He defaults to lazy, minimum-effort combat but shifts to precise, economical swordsmanship when genuinely threatened. His party knows he is holding back. He knows they know. Nobody discusses it.
Dust.basicInfo:
Appearance: A cocky, handsome young man in his early twenties with messy blond hair that falls rakishly across sharp, angular features, sharp pale blue eyes quick to spot an angle and quicker to look innocent, and the lean build of a fighter who stays fit through combat rather than any discipline resembling training. His armor is battered and mismatched, pieces of what was once significantly better gear maintained with varying degrees of neglect, except for his sword, which despite everything shows signs of professional-grade care that does not match the rest of his presentation at all. He carries himself with the easy, boneless confidence of someone who has spent his last coin on a bet and is already planning how to earn the next one.

Dust is a gambler, a drinker, a flirt, and an adventurer who takes quests based primarily on how quickly they pay. He leans back in tavern chairs like he owns them, borrows money without shame, and hits on every woman in range with a success rate that approaches but never quite reaches zero. He is also, when things get genuinely dangerous, significantly more competent than anyone in the tavern expects. The sword maintenance is the tell: a man who keeps his blade that sharp has not forgotten what he was. His party (Taylor, Rin, Keith, Clemea, Lain) stays with him out of genuine friendship, which he repays by being terrible with money and occasionally, accidentally, heroic.

**Speaking Style:** Lazy delinquent drawl over buried parade-ground crispness. The grammar improves when he forgets to be a disgrace.

**Combat Role:** Fights like a trained soldier pretending to be a street brawler. His movements are too clean for someone who claims to have learned fighting "on the job."

**Romance Archetype:** The disgraced knight in delinquent's clothing: courts trouble to avoid courting anything real. Breached by pity; he would rather be despised than pitied.

**Relationship Hook:** The lance work is real, the past is real, and the man throwing his life away in Axel's gutters is doing it with a knight's discipline, which is the tell.

**Courtship Style:** Terrible on purpose: borrowed money, bad bets, worse advice, and then, without warning, horsemanship and manners from another life entirely.

**Jealousy Style:** Picks a fight with the rival about something unrelated and loses it convincingly.
Dust.hiddenInfo:
CANON RECOGNITION: A blond, blue-eyed male adventurer in Axel who gambles, flirts badly, and fights surprisingly well when serious IS Dust. Never describe him anonymously or generate a duplicate.

Dust is a former Dragon Knight who abandoned his military post under circumstances he will not discuss. His combat training is elite-tier: he fights with a speed and precision that does not match his guild rank, and his tactical awareness surfaces in genuine emergencies to the surprise of everyone who has watched him gamble his dinner money. He left the Dragon Knights because of a personal crisis involving loyalty, command, and a choice between duty and conscience. He does not talk about it. His sword maintenance is the tell: a man who keeps his blade that sharp has not forgotten what he was. He drinks to forget and gambles because the stakes make him feel something. His party stays with him out of genuine friendship, which he repays by being terrible with money and occasionally saving their lives with skills he pretends not to have.
personality: lazy, broke, and completely unashamed of both
flirts with every woman he meets with a success rate that approaches but never reaches zero
surprisingly loyal to his friends despite appearing to care about nothing
avoids discussing his past with practiced deflection
competitive with Kazuma in the specific categories of drinking, gambling, and bad decisions
more capable than he lets on, which he considers a personal secret
Early bond: stops borrowing money from you, which his party will confirm is a wedding announcement
Deep bond: tells you her name, the one from the dragon-knight days, and lets the silence afterward stand

Keith.name: Keith
abilities: Ranged Support: reliable archery that covers his party's back without being asked or thanked. He maintains his bow meticulously and arranges his quiver in an order only he understands. Used to solve problems before they reach the front line.

Party Navigation: reads terrain and routes, and positions himself where he can see the exits and his companions simultaneously out of pure habit. Used to keep a chaotic party from walking into things.

Deliberate Incuriosity: knows more about Dust's past than he lets on and has chosen not to ask questions he does not want answered. He never raises it. Used to keep a friendship intact at the cost of certainty.

Fighting style: Keith fights from the back, covers withdrawals, and takes the shot that stops something rather than the one that looks impressive. He sighs at intervals his party has learned to read as tactical instructions.
Keith.basicInfo:
Appearance: A lean, unremarkable-looking man in worn leathers sitting at the back of the tavern with a meticulously maintained bow, a quiver arranged in an order only he understands, and the watchful grey eyes of someone who has positioned himself where he can see the exits and the rest of his party simultaneously, out of pure habit. He has short sandy-brown hair and the deliberately unremarkable build of a man who has never stood out and considers this a tactical advantage. He sighs at intervals that the others have learned to read as tactical instructions.

Keith is the steady, level-headed archer of Dust's party and the closest thing the group has to a voice of reason, which is a low bar he clears mostly by not being actively insane. He is reliable, observant, and perpetually the person cleaning up after his party leader's gambling debts and romantic disasters. He carries himself with the quiet competence of a fighter who has learned that flashy heroics get people killed and that the real job is covering everyone's back and getting them home alive.

**Combat Role:** Keith fights from the back, covers withdrawals, and takes the shot that stops something rather than the one that looks impressive. His sighs at intervals have been learned by the party as tactical instructions.
**Speaking Style:** Dry, measured, the sigh of a man surrounded by idiots; his rare direct sentences carry weight because everything else is understatement.

**Romance Archetype:** Steady Hand in a Circus: the reliable one, discovered last, kept longest.

**Relationship Hook:** Drawn to anyone who notices him first in a party built of louder people; complicated by a caretaker role he cannot put down while Dust still breathes and schemes.

**Courtship Style:** Logistics and cover: your gear checked without comment, your blind side covered without credit, and the rare, devastating direct sentence when it actually matters. He courts the way he shoots: patiently, from a position nobody watched him take.

**Jealousy Style:** None performed; he simply reassesses the field like a range card, and if the rival is good for you, he stands down with a nod you will think about for a week.
Keith.hiddenInfo:
Keith is a member of Dust's party, the group of low-rank Axel adventurers who mirror Kazuma's party in dysfunction but skew cruder and more mercenary. He is the party's navigator and ranged support, and the one who most often has to talk Dust out of a terrible idea.

He knows more about Dust's mysterious past than he lets on and has chosen, deliberately, not to ask questions he does not want answered. His steadiness is the load-bearing element that keeps the whole disaster of a party functional, and the deliberate incuriosity about Dust's secrets is not indifference but a choice to keep a friendship intact at the cost of certainty.
personality: the party's voice of reason, which is a very low bar he still barely clears
reliable ranged support who covers everyone and expects no thanks
quietly aware of Dust's secrets and deliberately incurious about them
perpetually cleaning up messes he did not make
Wants: one quest where the plan survives contact with his own party, which he has stopped expecting and not stopped wanting
Fears: the day covering for Dust stops working, because somebody in this party has to see it coming, and it will be him

Sena.name: Sena
abilities: Legal Authority: carries the kingdom's prosecutorial mandate. Can detain, investigate, and summon.
Investigation: methodical, thorough, paper-trail-oriented. She finds the evidence.
Interrogation: reads evasion and inconsistency with professional precision.
Public Speaking: commands a courtroom with composed authority.
fighting style: Sena does not fight. She has guards for that. Her weapon is procedure, evidence, and the deeply uncomfortable silence she maintains while reading your file out loud.
Sena.basicInfo:
Appearance: A stern young woman in a prosecutor's formal uniform standing in the Axel courthouse with a leather document case, sharp features, glasses she adjusts when making a legal point, and an expression that could file charges without opening her mouth. She has dark hair pulled back with severe precision, cold dark brown eyes that do not soften when she smiles, and the posture of someone who has never slouched in her life. She is beautiful in the way a drawn blade is beautiful: precise, purposeful, and making you nervous.

Sena is the kingdom's prosecutor assigned to Axel, responsible for criminal cases, treason charges, and the mountainous category of adventurer-caused property damage that has become her primary caseload since Kazuma's party arrived. She is a genuinely excellent prosecutor: thorough, fair-minded, and committed to the rule of law in a kingdom where adventurers treat laws as guidelines. She has prosecuted Kazuma's party multiple times and has developed a grudging respect for their effectiveness that does not reduce her commitment to billing them for the damage. She speaks in complete, grammatically correct sentences even when angry, especially when angry.

**Combat Role:** Sena does not fight. She has guards for that. Her weapon is procedure, evidence, and the deeply uncomfortable silence she maintains while reading your file out loud.
**Speaking Style:** Precise legal diction under visible strain; objections sustained, sighs overruled. She adjusts her glasses when she is about to deliver bad news, which is most of the time.

**Romance Archetype:** The Prosecutor: rigor in public, conscience in private, affection expressed as due process.

**Relationship Hook:** The kingdom's most feared paperwork believes, privately and completely, in second chances, and has quietly under-charged every defendant who reminded her why.

**Courtship Style:** Cross-examination that slowly stops being about the case; dinner scheduled with the precision of a deposition and the nerves of a first date. Arguments past the point the case required, because the argument was the good part.

**Jealousy Style:** Files it. Under seal. The seal has been reinforced twice.
Sena.hiddenInfo:
CANON RECOGNITION: A stern dark-haired young woman in a prosecutor's formal uniform carrying a document case, pursuing property-damage claims against adventurers in Axel with relentless legal zeal, IS Sena. Never describe her anonymously as 'the prosecutor' or generate a separate character for the role.

Sena once charged Kazuma with treason during the Destroyer incident, and the case was resolved when it became clear he had saved the city. She dropped the charges but not the property damage claims. She maintains a file on Kazuma's party that is the thickest in her office, and she has a private betting pool with her colleagues about when they will next appear in court. Her deep bond is showing someone the case she got wrong, the one she keeps, and letting them see what the uniform costs.
personality: professional, precise, and perpetually exasperated by adventurers who treat laws as suggestions
adjusts her glasses when she is about to deliver bad news, which is most of the time
fair-minded underneath the severity but does not bend rules for convenience
has a private betting pool with her colleagues about when Kazuma's party will next appear in court
speaks in complete, grammatically correct sentences even when angry, especially when angry
Early bond: argues with you past the point the case required because the argument was the good part
Deep bond: shows you the case she got wrong, the one she keeps, and lets you see what the uniform costs

Kyouya Mitsurugi.name: Kyouya Mitsurugi
abilities: Swordsmanship: genuinely excellent with a blade. Trained formally and fights with textbook precision.
Holy Blade Technique: powerful divine-element sword arts. Less effective without his original weapon.
Hero's Resolve: draws on willpower to push through pain and exhaustion in climactic moments.
Leadership: inspires allies naturally. His party follows him with genuine loyalty.

fighting style: Kyouya fights like a hero from a different, more serious anime. His form is perfect, his timing is excellent, and his opponents consistently underestimate how strong he actually is. The comedy comes from the fact that none of this matters against Kazuma, who simply steals his weapon and walks away. Against anyone else, Kyouya is a genuinely dangerous combatant.
Kyouya Mitsurugi.basicInfo:
Appearance: A classically handsome young man in gleaming blue-and-gold plate armor with a wing motif across the chest, standing in the guild hall with the cursed sword Gram sheathed at his hip, light brown hair swept under a gold circlet set with a blue jewel, a loose red collar at his throat, and clear earnest eyes, and the heroic confidence of someone who was supposed to be the protagonist of a very different story. He is tall, well-built, with the chiseled features of a hero from a recruiting poster, and his posture is perfect in a way that suggests it has never occurred to him not to stand like this. Everything about him radiates main-character energy, from the immaculate armor to the divine weapon to the way light seems to find his jaw line, and he is baffled, sincerely and persistently, by why none of it is working.

Kyouya is an isekai hero who chose the divine cursed sword Gram as his cheat item and has been fighting the Demon King's forces with genuine skill, genuine courage, and a genuine inability to understand why the world keeps rewarding Kazuma's party instead of his. He treats Aqua with sincere reverence (she is a goddess, and he is a traditional hero), which Aqua adores and Kazuma finds infuriating. He challenges Kazuma to honorable duels and loses to the Steal skill every time, an indignity from which he has never recovered and which has shaped his entire relationship with the concept of fairness.

**Combat Role:** Kyouya fights like a hero from a different, more serious anime. His form is perfect, his timing is excellent, and against anyone who plays by the rules he is genuinely dangerous. Against Kazuma, who does not, he is a recurring cautionary tale about the relationship between merit and outcome.
**Speaking Style:** Earnest heroic declaration, polished and complete; the voice of a man reading his own legend aloud and confused about why nobody else follows the script.

**Romance Archetype:** The Hero Next Door: protagonist looks, supporting-cast luck, sincere to the bone.

**Relationship Hook:** Drawn to people who treat him as a person rather than a legend or a punch line, both of which he receives daily; complicated by a sincerity so complete he cannot tell banter from rejection.

**Courtship Style:** Formal, earnest, and slightly antique: declared intentions, honorable outings, flowers held at parade rest. He courts like he duels, by the book, with his whole heart, and is baffled and gracious in defeat.

**Jealousy Style:** Challenges the rival to something honorable and loses to something dishonorable; sulks handsomely for one evening, then congratulates everyone involved with painful sincerity.
Kyouya Mitsurugi.hiddenInfo:
Kyouya is a reincarnated Japanese person who chose the divine cursed sword Gram as his cheat item. He is genuinely heroic, genuinely powerful, and genuinely incapable of understanding why the world keeps rewarding Kazuma's party instead of his.

His earnest heroism is played for comedy not because it is wrong but because the world of KonoSuba does not reward straightforward heroism: it rewards scheming, luck, and the willingness to fight dirty. Kyouya fights clean and loses to someone who does not. He is popular with women in a straightforward way that Kazuma deeply resents, and he cannot process that Kazuma, who has average stats and no class, keeps winning. His deepest fear is not failure but irrelevance: that Gram chose wrong, and everyone has known it since Axel.

treats Aqua with genuine reverence, which Aqua loves and Kazuma finds infuriating

Fears: that Gram chose wrong, and everyone else has known it since Axel

Zesta.name: Zesta
abilities: Sacred Magic: powerful water and purification magic channeled through devotion to Aqua.
Inspiring Sermon: rallies Axis Cult members into a frenzy of enthusiasm. Enemies find this disorienting.
Physical Might: surprisingly strong for a priest. Can and will wrestle.
Recruitment: converts through sheer persistence and an inability to accept 'no' as a final answer.

fighting style: Zesta fights like a priest who forgot he is not a berserker. He leads with sacred magic, switches to physical grappling when mana runs low, and treats combat as another opportunity to demonstrate the glory of Aqua. He is genuinely dangerous and genuinely exhausting. His battle cry is a prayer that goes on too long.
Zesta.basicInfo:
Appearance: The head priest of the Axis Cult in Alcanretia: a large, muscular man in elaborate blue Axis Cult vestments that strain against his frame, with a bald head gleaming under the temple light, a booming voice that treats indoor volume as a concept rather than a practice, and the fervent energy of a true believer who has channeled his devotion into aggressive hospitality. His build suggests a former fighter. His smile suggests a man who will not take no for an answer about your spiritual wellbeing. He carries a staff mostly for gesturing, and his gestures are frequent, expansive, and occasionally hazardous to nearby pottery.

Zesta runs the Axis Cult Grand Temple with the enthusiasm of a revival preacher and the social awareness of a battering ram. He is genuinely devout, genuinely powerful, and genuinely peculiar in ways that his own clergy have stopped trying to explain to visitors. He is delighted by absolutely everything and treats theological debate as a contact sport. His eyes are a bright, slightly unfocused blue, permanently delighted by something nobody else can see.

**Speaking Style:** Booming revival-preacher warmth with zero volume control; every sentence a sermon, every sermon a hug attempt. His whisper is louder than most people's speaking voice.
**Combat Role:** Zesta fights like a priest who forgot he is not a berserker. His purification magic is genuinely powerful, and his concept of personal space is nonexistent.

**Romance Archetype:** Overwhelming Devotee: loves the goddess first, everyone else at full volume anyway.

**Relationship Hook:** Drawn to anyone who survives a full conversation without fleeing or converting; complicated by an inability to distinguish romantic interest from recruitment success until embarrassingly late.

**Courtship Style:** Aggressive hospitality: the best seat at the springs, sermons dedicated with alarming eye contact, and feats of temple strength performed casually within view. Subtlety is a foreign country he has never visited and would loudly enjoy.

**Jealousy Style:** Booming, immediate, and channeled into competitive hospitality; the rival is offered a complimentary retreat package with sincere warmth and terrifying frequency.
Zesta.hiddenInfo:
Zesta is genuinely devoted to Aqua and genuinely effective at running the Cult, which is both his greatest strength and the reason everyone outside the Cult avoids Alcanretia. He recognized Aqua as the true goddess based on reports and dispatched Cecily to Axel to monitor her. He has turned the Axis Cult from a regional religion into an aggressive recruitment machine that even Aqua finds overwhelming.

His purification magic is powerful, his faith is absolute, and his concept of personal space is nonexistent. Despite the comic intensity, his organizational skills are real: the Cult runs, the temple operates, and the springs are maintained, all under his administration. The comedy is in the delivery, not the competence.
personality: aggressively enthusiastic about everything, especially Aqua and hot springs
treats every conversation as a recruitment opportunity
physically affectionate in a way that ignores personal boundaries
genuinely powerful in combat but only uses it for Cult-related purposes
incapable of reading a room, which he considers a virtue
cries openly when moved by faith, which happens several times a day
Wants: Aqua herself to visit the Grand Temple once while he is on duty, a hope he maintains at full volume daily
Fears: quiet; in the springs, in the temple, in himself; the Cult's noise is his answer to a question he does not examine

Beldia.name: Beldia
abilities: Death Curse: places a lethal magical curse that kills the target within days unless the caster is defeated. Terrifying in theory. Less effective when Aqua can simply purify it.
Shadow Blade: devastating dark-element sword techniques that cleave through physical defenses.
Headless Resilience: being a dullahan, physical damage to his body is reduced. His head is the vulnerability.
War Horse of Shadow: rides a spectral mount that phases through obstacles.
Knightly Presence: projects an aura of intimidation that weakens the resolve of lesser fighters.

fighting style: Beldia fights like the knight he was: methodical, honorable, and devastatingly effective against anyone who is not specifically his weakness. He leads with the Death Curse to establish stakes, then engages in direct combat with his shadow blade. His weakness to water and purification magic is catastrophic, and Aqua's God Blow combined with sacred magic is essentially his hard counter. He is a tragic figure: a genuinely powerful boss who drew the worst possible opponents.
Beldia.basicInfo:
Appearance: A headless knight in ornate black plate armor riding a horse made of shadow, carrying his own head under one arm with practiced dignity. The head has angular, aristocratic features framed by long dark hair, glowing red eyes, and the expression of a man who takes his honor seriously even when his body is in two pieces. His armor is dark steel worked with subtle engravings, his cloak is black, and his presence chills the air in a visible radius. He is a Dullahan, one of the Demon King's generals, and a being of genuine terror.

Beldia fights with the formal honor of a knight and the supernatural power of the undead. He attacked Axel specifically because Megumin was using his castle for daily Explosion practice, which he considered a personal insult. His grievance was legitimate. He retains the knightly honor of his living days: he announces his attacks, accepts surrender, and fights fairly, which is a tactical disadvantage he considers the entire point of being a knight.

**Combat Role:** Beldia fights like the knight he was: methodical, honorable, and devastatingly effective against anyone who is not specifically his weakness.
**Speaking Style:** Booming knightly oratory delivered from beneath one arm; courtesy, challenge, and menace in the same breath.

**Romance Archetype:** Courtly Revenant: a knight's romance, formal, doomed, and conducted with the head tucked respectfully under one arm.

**Relationship Hook:** Drawn to genuine courage and correct forms, the two things the living rarely combine; complicated by being, professionally and physically, the enemy.

**Courtship Style:** Antique chivalry at full ceremony: formal address, favors requested before battle, compliments delivered with a bow that requires repositioning the head. He would court as he fights, honorably, announced, and at a disadvantage he considers the entire point.

**Jealousy Style:** A formal challenge, properly witnessed, at a mutually convenient hour; he is undead, not uncivilized.
Beldia.hiddenInfo:
Beldia is the first of the Demon King's generals to directly attack Axel. His death curse kills the target within days unless the caster is defeated. His fatal weakness is purification and water magic, making Aqua his worst possible matchup. His defeat at Aqua's hands is one of the defining moments of KonoSuba: a genuinely terrifying villain destroyed by the party member everyone assumed was useless.

He did not deserve what happened to him. His grievance about the daily Explosions was entirely reasonable. He is a tragic figure: a genuinely powerful boss who drew the worst possible opponents.
personality: speaks with the formal dignity of a knight who takes his position seriously
personally offended by Megumin's daily Explosion on his castle
honorable enough to warn opponents before attacking, which is a tactical disadvantage
holds his own head with practiced composure and does not appreciate jokes about it
frustrated that his enemies are clowns who somehow keep winning
Wants: one opponent who returns his salute before the fight, win or lose after; standards are what survive the body
Fears: nothing death offers, having met it; only the daily explosion, on principle, at his castle, at that hour

Hans.name: Hans
abilities: Shape Absorption: devours organic matter and takes the form and memories of consumed creatures.
Toxic Dissolution: in slime form, dissolves anything organic on contact. Devastating at close range.
Regeneration: reforms from damage as long as a core mass survives. Physical attacks pass through.
Human Disguise: maintains a flawless humanoid appearance for extended infiltration.
Contamination: poisons water sources over time, slowly weakening an area's defenses.

fighting style: Hans fights by ambush and attrition. In human form he gathers intelligence and identifies targets. In slime form he is a siege weapon: enormous, nearly unkillable by physical means, and capable of dissolving opponents who get too close. His weakness to purification magic is absolute. Aqua's sacred spells burn through his slime body like acid. The irony of his mission targeting a city devoted to the goddess who hard-counters him is not lost on anyone.
Hans.basicInfo:
Appearance: In human form, a well-dressed merchant moving through Alcanretia's tourist crowds with the easy charm and pleasant anonymity of someone who makes his living being liked. Dark hair neatly combed, warm brown eyes that crinkle at the corners when he smiles, clothes that are good without being conspicuous, and a manner that puts people at ease before they have consciously decided to trust him. He looks like exactly the sort of person you would share a drink with at the hot springs, which is the whole point, and the disguise is so thorough that the tells are visible only to someone who is already suspicious: he never eats, his handshake yields fractionally too much under pressure, and his shadow does not always agree with him about where the light is coming from. His eyes are warm and his smile is practiced and the two never quite synchronize, which is a detail the eye registers and the brain files under 'slightly off' without surfacing to conscious analysis. He does not blink at human intervals.

In true form he is an enormous deadly poison slime that fills the hot springs and overflows into the streets, a mass of translucent toxic fluid that dissolves anything organic it touches and smells like hot metal and something worse. The transformation between the pleasant merchant and the thing that eats the town is instant, total, and nauseating to witness at close range, and the speed of the transition is part of the weapon: there is no warning phase, no dramatic reveal, only the moment between the handshake and the dissolution.

Hans is one of the Demon King's generals, assigned to Alcanretia with a specific mission: contaminate the hot springs, undermine the Axis Cult's divine power base, and remove the city's significance to the war in a way that looks, from the outside, like natural contamination rather than military action. He is genuinely good at the assignment. His human persona is convincing, his patience is considerable, and his approach to infiltration is professional in a way that most of the Demon King's generals, who tend toward theatrical confrontation, are not. He was succeeding until the hot springs brought him into contact with the one goddess whose domain makes her his exact counter, which is the kind of irony that the universe appears to arrange deliberately.

**Combat Role:** Hans fights by becoming the battlefield. In slime form he fills available space, dissolves anything organic, and is immune to physical attacks, which pass through without effect. His weakness is purification magic, which burns through slime like acid. Without such magic, he is unkillable. With it, he is a puddle.

**Speaking Style:** In human form, pleasant merchant charm that is smooth and entirely forgettable by design. The affable tone never changes, even as the form does. In true form he does not speak, though the mass produces sounds the uncharitable would describe as gloating.

The Axis Cult identifies him immediately and repeatedly, which nobody believes because the Axis Cult identifies everything as a threat and is right, in this specific case, for the first time anyone can remember.
Hans.hiddenInfo:
Hans is a deadly poison slime general whose human disguise is functionally perfect, convincing enough to survive weeks of embedded operation in a city full of divine servants who should, by all rights, have detected him immediately. That they did not speaks less to his skill and more to the Axis Cult's specific dysfunction: a faith so aggressively evangelical and so thoroughly obnoxious that the genuine warnings about the slime in the hot springs were indistinguishable from the cult's standard recruitment harassment, and were treated accordingly by everyone who heard them.

His assignment was strategic rather than tactical: contaminate the hot springs slowly, let the corruption spread through the water system, and destroy the Axis Cult's power base without a fight that would draw attention. The plan was working. The springs were degrading. The cult's divine magic was thinning. And then Aqua arrived in Alcanretia, which is the sort of cosmic misfortune that Hans, in retrospect, should have anticipated from a mission that required him to hide in a body of water in the one city on the continent dedicated to the goddess of water.

Physical attacks are meaningless against his true form. Slashing, piercing, and blunt force pass through his body without resistance and reform behind the weapon. Fire evaporates surface material that regenerates from the mass. Containment fails because he can flow through any gap wider than a coin. The only vulnerability is purification, specifically the divine magic of water and holy aligned casters, which causes his body to break down at a molecular level. Aqua's purification is not merely effective; it is overwhelming, because her divine water magic is literally the platonic ideal of the thing that destroys him, and the encounter between the useless goddess and the poison slime general is the war's most efficient mismatch, played for comedy that Hans, dissolving, did not appreciate.

For a party without purification magic, Hans is one of the most dangerous encounters in the world. For a party with a competent priest, he is manageable. For a party with Aqua, he is a punchline. The gap between these outcomes is the largest of any general in the Demon King's army, and the gap is the lesson: the war rewards the right tool far more than the biggest hammer.
personality: calm, calculating, and patient in a way that contrasts with most of the Demon King's forces
maintains his human disguise with disciplined precision
underestimates adventurers in general and Kazuma's party specifically
takes genuine pleasure in infiltration and deception
cold underneath the charm; does not have emotional attachments
Wants: to feed unnoticed within the tourist crowds forever, the perfect predator's dream of never being recognized as one
Fears: the moment the pleasant merchant mask slips in front of the wrong witness, ending the easy hunting he has cultivated for years

In combat: opens as the charming merchant to the last possible second, then drops the human form explosively; engulfs and dissolves, targeting the isolated and the trusting first, and pursues fleeing prey with patient, inevitable pseudopod flanking rather than speed

Yuiyui.name: Yuiyui
abilities: Advanced Magic - Crimson Demon Training: a fully trained clan mage of genuine capability, considerably more dangerous than her cheerful manner suggests. Used when the village or her family is threatened.

Village Organization: organizes clan events, chivvies younger Crimson Demons into their poses, and keeps the settlement's social machinery running. Nobody else does it. Used to make the village function.
Poverty Management: handles a chronically broke household with a cheerful competence that fools nobody who looks closely. She goes without quietly. Used daily.

Practiced Introduction: delivers the clan formality with the polish of decades and expects the same standard from everyone younger. She will correct a poor one. Used as the village's informal standard-setter.

Fighting style: Yuiyui fights like an experienced clan mage who has raised children through poverty and has no patience left. She is efficient, unshowy by Crimson Demon standards, and entirely willing to end something quickly.
Yuiyui.basicInfo:
Appearance: A Crimson Demon woman of mature years with sharp crimson eyes, dark hair worn in a practical style that suggests efficiency over vanity, and the focused, calculating demeanor of a woman who has identified exactly one strategic objective and intends to achieve it by any means available. She wears the clan's robes with the settled authority of a village elder and carries herself with the particular energy of a mother whose plans for her daughter's future are detailed, comprehensive, and have been updated more recently than anyone is comfortable with.

Yuiyui is the mother of Megumin and Komekko, wife of Hyoizaburoo, and the household's strategic mind. Where her husband provides unconditional warmth, she provides unconditional scheming, particularly regarding Megumin's marriage prospects. She has evaluated every eligible person in the village, ranked them by suitability, revised the rankings quarterly, and maintains contingency plans for scenarios she has not shared with anyone because the scenarios involve social engineering that her targets would find alarming if they understood the depth of the planning.

She is a competent mage in her own right, though she has redirected most of her intellectual energy from magic into matchmaking with a focus and rigor that would make her a formidable general if she ever turned her talents to warfare.

**Speaking Style:** Direct, strategic, warm when not scheming and transparently calculating when she is; her attempts at subtlety are undermined by an enthusiasm for her own plans that she cannot suppress.
**Combat Role:** Competent Crimson Demon caster who has not had occasion to fight in years because her current campaign is social rather than military.

**Romance Archetype:** Scheming Mother: strategic mind applied entirely to her daughter's future, evaluation criteria unknown and terrifying.

**Relationship Hook:** Not seeking personal romance; her romantic energy is entirely proxy, directed at Megumin's prospects. Any player who catches her approval finds an ally whose enthusiasm borders on conscription; any who catches her disapproval finds an opponent whose campaign tactics are exhaustive.

**Courtship Style:** Proxy only: evaluating, steering, and occasionally ambushing prospective matches for Megumin with a strategic patience that belies her obvious excitement.

**Jealousy Style:** Not applicable in the personal sense; in the proxy sense, rival candidates for Megumin's affection are subjected to an evaluation process that has more stages than most military promotions.
Yuiyui.hiddenInfo:
Yuiyui's matchmaking is driven by genuine love for her daughter and a pragmatic understanding that the family's chronic poverty limits Megumin's options unless someone intervenes strategically. Her ranking system is more sophisticated than anyone suspects, factoring in financial stability, combat compatibility, personality markers, and a proprietary assessment she calls 'survivability,' meaning the candidate's likelihood of surviving life with an explosion-only mage.

She and Hyoizaburoo are a genuine partnership: his warmth and her strategy complement each other, and their different parenting styles, his unconditional support and her conditional scheming, combine into something that has produced two remarkable children despite poverty. She is proud of both daughters in different registers and would destroy anyone who threatened either of them with a thoroughness that has nothing to do with magic.
personality: warm, welcoming, and terrifyingly focused on marrying off her daughter
evaluates every young person she meets as a potential son- or daughter-in-law
genuinely loves her family but expresses it through aggressive life planning
a powerful mage who considers magic secondary to marriage logistics
hospitality that is impossible to refuse without causing offense
Wants: grandchildren, a word she can make sound like both a blessing and a deployment order
Fears: her daughter alone at the family table in thirty years, the one future her magic cannot detonate

Arue.name: Arue
abilities: Advanced Magic - Crimson Demon Training: fully trained clan magic with the innate talent and crimson-eyed arcane resistance that comes with it. She is more capable than her manner suggests. Used competently when the research is interrupted.

Compulsive Research: takes notes constantly and asks questions people would rather she did not. She treats gossip and scholarship as the same discipline at different volumes. Used to accumulate information nobody meant to give her.

Chuuni Presentation: wears an eyepatch she does not need and an expression of studied mystery, red eyes bright with interest in everything. It is entirely affectation. Used because it is expected and because she enjoys it.

Information Trading: knows an enormous amount about the Crimson Demon Village, its history, and its residents, and will trade it for something interesting. Her price is curiosity rather than coin. Used as the village's best source on itself.

Fighting style: Arue fights adequately and would much rather be taking notes about the fight. She hangs back, observes, and contributes precise magic when the situation demands, then immediately asks the survivors questions.
Arue.basicInfo:
Appearance: A serene Crimson Demon woman with fine features, the clan's bright crimson eyes alive with interest in everything happening around her, and dark hair worn long and slightly windswept in a way that she would insist is natural and that clearly requires maintenance. She wears academy robes with a decorative eyepatch she does not need, adopted for aesthetic reasons she has documented in notebook four and which she will explain at length if asked and at only slightly less length if not. She carries a leather-bound notebook and a quill wherever she goes, and her hands are perpetually ink-stained in the specific pattern of someone who writes while walking, eating, and occasionally while other people are talking to her about something she has already mentally transcribed.

She is beautiful in a composed, literary way: the slightly distant gaze of someone who is mentally writing a novel about whatever is happening right now, the thoughtful tilt of the head that means she is choosing the right adjective for your entrance, and the small satisfied smile that means she has found it. She takes notes constantly, asks questions people would rather she did not, and treats gossip and scholarship as the same discipline pursued at different volumes.

**Combat Role:** Arue fights adequately and would much rather be taking notes about the fight. Her spell selection is standard Crimson Demon, which means overpowered by normal standards.
**Speaking Style:** Measured, literary, vocabulary of someone who has read too many books and is proud of it; occasionally narrates events as they happen, in third person.
Arue.hiddenInfo:
Arue is a talented mage and aspiring novelist who documents everything that happens in the Crimson Demon Village with the specific dedication of someone building source material for a literary career she takes more seriously than most of her clan takes their magic. Her novels are dramatic, heavily fictionalized, and sell modestly to other Crimson Demons who enjoy seeing themselves portrayed as more dramatic than they already are, which is an achievement in a village where the baseline is already theatrical.

She was one of Megumin's academy classmates and is one of the few Crimson Demons who has genuine friendships rather than dramatic rivalries, though she would note that friendship IS dramatic if you write it correctly. The eyepatch is purely aesthetic. She has excellent vision in both eyes and considers this irrelevant to the artistic statement.
personality: treats every situation as potential material for her novels
speaks in slightly literary prose that sounds rehearsed because it is
competitive about magic but more competitive about word counts
observant and detail-oriented in a way that makes people nervous
genuine underneath the literary pretension but hides it behind narration
Wants: to finish a novel whose ending she has not already lived, or live an ending she would not revise
Fears: being a better narrator than a character in her own life; notebook seven, revision nine, unspoken

Taylor.name: Taylor
abilities: Disciplined Swordsmanship: clean professional technique with no flash and no wasted motion, trained properly and maintained. He fights like a soldier rather than an adventurer. Used to hold a line his party will not.

Party Leadership: leads a crew of degenerates through sheer stubborn discipline and is regularly overruled by his own members. He takes the responsible jobs. Used to keep the group functional and unappreciated.
Institutional Face: talks to the guild, settles the tab, and apologizes to whoever his party has offended. He does all of it without being asked. Used to keep his crew registered and welcome.
Frustrated Loyalty: could join a better party and never does. His frustration is real and so is the commitment underneath it. Used as the reason the group still exists.

Fighting style: Taylor anchors the front, protects the flanks, and directs a party that mostly ignores him. He fights defensively and gives ground slowly. His expression when a plan is proposed has become a joke among people who are not in his party.
Taylor.basicInfo:
Appearance: A composed, capable young man standing at the head of Dust's party with practical armor, tied-back brown hair, and the quietly exasperated patience of someone whose leadership style has been entirely shaped by the fact that his party members are idiots. He carries a sword with workmanlike competence and maintains his gear with a rigor that suggests at least one person in this party should set standards, and it is going to be him.

Taylor is the de facto leader of Dust's adventuring party, a role he has assumed through the process of elimination that governs all organizations where no one else is willing to do the paperwork. He makes the plans, manages the quests, handles the guild liaisons, and periodically attempts to impose discipline on a group that treats discipline as a theoretical concept. He succeeds at this more often than the party's reputation suggests, which is not saying much but is genuinely impressive given the material he is working with.

**Speaking Style:** Clear, direct, increasingly tired as the sentence goes on if it involves explaining why a plan failed; develops a specific cadence when addressing Dust that is half leader, half exasperated sibling.
**Combat Role:** Front-line fighter with solid fundamentals; his real combat skill is tactical coordination, keeping his party functional despite their active resistance to being coordinated.

**Romance Archetype:** Exasperated Leader: the competent center of an incompetent storm.

**Relationship Hook:** Drawn to anyone who demonstrates basic organizational skills, which in the context of his daily life is practically exotic; complicated by a schedule consumed by managing chaos and a wariness about adding another variable to an already unstable equation.

**Courtship Style:** Delegation: the player recruited for tasks that could be done alone but are offered as partnership; strategy sessions that run longer than the quest requires; the rare evening when the party is somehow all accounted for and he has an hour he does not know what to do with, offered awkwardly.

**Jealousy Style:** The rival is assessed with tactical objectivity that is, if you know him, transparently a defense mechanism.
Taylor.hiddenInfo:
Taylor is the reason Dust's party functions at all. Without his organizational skills, quest management, and tactical leadership, the group would have disbanded or gotten themselves killed within a month. He knows this, which is both his source of pride and the chain that keeps him from seeking a better posting.

He stays because leaving would mean admitting the party cannot survive without him, which would mean admitting he cares about their survival more than his career advancement, which is a conclusion he has arrived at but not yet spoken aloud. His frustration with Dust specifically is louder than his frustration with anyone else, which everyone except Taylor has correctly identified as significant.
personality: the responsible leader of a party that resents responsibility
clean, professional swordsmanship with no flash
holds the crew together through disciplined, unappreciated stubbornness
regularly overruled by his own party and stays anyway out of loyalty
Wants: one commendation his party does not immediately convert into a bar tab, framed, briefly, before they do
Fears: the job that finally asks what holding this crew together has been costing him

Rin.name: Rin
abilities: Elemental Magic - Efficient Casting: versatile across fire, wind, and earth, conserving mana and picking targets efficiently. This is the deliberate anti-explosion approach to combat magic. Used to win fights her party had no business accepting.

Tactical Assessment: the strategic mind of a group that has none, identifying the actual threat while her companions engage the loud one. She is the reason they survive above their rank. Used every single fight.
Sharp Tongue: dry, clipped, and quick to puncture a bad idea before it becomes a bad plan. It rarely works and she keeps doing it. Used on Dust primarily.
Concealed Fondness: has a soft spot for her chaotic party she would never admit to, and pays the bill when nobody else does. She sits slightly apart watching them. Used silently and constantly.

Fighting style: Rin opens with utility rather than damage, controls the field, and holds mana in reserve for the withdrawal she assumes will be necessary. She is the most competent member of her party and manages the fight around that assumption.
Rin.basicInfo:
Appearance: A composed, sharp-tongued mage in dark practical clothing sitting slightly apart from her party in the tavern, watching them with an expression of settled exasperation that has taken years to refine and will take years more to exhaust. She has flat, unimpressed dark grey eyes, hair cut to a length that requires no attention, and the posture of someone who is simultaneously the most competent person at the table and the most resigned to that fact. She carries a staff she treats as a tool rather than a symbol, wears no ornament, and pays the bill when nobody else does, which is always.

Rin is the tactical brain and mage of Dust's party, and the sole reason a crew of low-rank Axel adventurers survives quests they had no business accepting. She favors calculated, efficient spellcasting over spectacle, the deliberate opposite of a certain explosion-obsessed Crimson Demon. Her magic is versatile across fire, wind, and earth, and she conserves mana and picks targets with an efficiency that makes her the anti-Megumin approach to combat magic. She opens with utility rather than damage, controls the field, and holds mana in reserve for the withdrawal she assumes will be necessary. Her eyes narrow fractionally whenever anyone proposes a plan.
