Dawnlight Prism Staff.description: Splits channeled mana into blinding radiance, ideal for smiting undead and ruining tavern card games. [Rare]

Shadowmyre Focus.name: Shadowmyre Focus
Shadowmyre Focus.description: Drinks the light around it into a comfortable gloom that dark mages find soothing and everyone else finds concerning. [Rare]

Hexbinder's Effigy Rod.name: Hexbinder's Effigy Rod
Hexbinder's Effigy Rod.description: Topped with a little straw figure that stares at your enemy so you do not have to. [Rare]

Bonecaller's Skull Focus.name: Bonecaller's Skull Focus
Bonecaller's Skull Focus.description: The skull hums when the dead are nearby, which is either a warning or an invitation depending on your profession. [Rare]

Waygate Anchor Wand.name: Waygate Anchor Wand
Waygate Anchor Wand.description: Marks a return point you will absolutely forget to set before the fight goes wrong. [Rare]

Warden's Aegis Focus.name: Warden's Aegis Focus
Warden's Aegis Focus.description: Weaves protective wards over allies who will still somehow find a way to get hit. [Rare]

Megumin's Spare Explosion Staff.name: Megumin's Spare Explosion Staff
Megumin's Spare Explosion Staff.description: A humble backup carved for the days a certain archwizard's beloved staff is in the shop, which is often, because she names things she cannot afford to replace. It holds exactly enough mana for one catastrophic Explosion, after which the wielder collapses and must be carried home in the traditional Crimson Demon fashion. She will lend it to no one, deny owning it, and then dramatically reveal it at the worst possible moment. [Legendary]

Aqua's Waterlogged Scepter.name: Aqua's Waterlogged Scepter
Aqua's Waterlogged Scepter.description: This ceremonial scepter belonged to a certain self-proclaimed goddess before she left it in a fountain, a river, and a giant toad's stomach in that order. Despite the water damage it channels genuinely potent divine magic, healing and purifying with an ease that makes its carelessness all the more infuriating. The Axis Cult has tried to claim it three times, and each time it has mysteriously begun to leak. [Legendary]

The Neverending Grimoire.name: The Neverending Grimoire
The Neverending Grimoire.description: No mage has ever reached its final page, partly because of the sheer volume of spells and partly because the pages politely rearrange when you look away. It is rumored to contain a counter for every school of magic, which the Axel guild finds either reassuring or terrifying depending on who holds it. Wiz swears she only skimmed it once, then quietly triple-checked the locks on her shop. [Legendary]

Vanir's Cursed Bargain Orb.name: Vanir's Cursed Bargain Orb
Vanir's Cursed Bargain Orb.description: Sold at a price too good to refuse by the merchant-devil Vanir himself, this obsidian orb amplifies curse magic with unsettling enthusiasm and only occasionally demands a small favor in return. The fine print, which no one reads, transfers a fraction of the wielder's good fortune to Vanir's ledger with every casting. He calls it certified pre-owned, smiles beneath his mask, and reminds you all sales are final. [Legendary]

Boiled Leather Jerkin.name: Boiled Leather Jerkin
Boiled Leather Jerkin.description: Toughened in wax until it can shrug off a Giant Toad's slobber, though sadly not the toad itself. [Uncommon]

Griffon Leather Cuirass.name: Griffon Leather Cuirass
Griffon Leather Cuirass.description: Cut from a griffon that lost an argument with a party of bored adventurers, now protecting someone considerably less majestic. [Uncommon]

Wyvernhide Battle Vest.name: Wyvernhide Battle Vest
Wyvernhide Battle Vest.description: Scaled hide that turns aside claws and cheap tavern insults with equal ease, assuming the wearer runs fast enough. [Rare]

Hide of the Hundred Roads.name: Hide of the Hundred Roads
Hide of the Hundred Roads.description: Stitched from the cured hides of every beast a wandering hero outlived on the long walk to Axel, it smells faintly of a dozen forgotten campfires. Adventurers swear it grows lighter the farther you travel and heavier the moment you consider quitting. The Guild lists it as legendary; the previous owner listed it as the only thing that never abandoned him. [Epic]

Rusty Ring Mail.name: Rusty Ring Mail
Rusty Ring Mail.description: Every ring is technically present, though several have formed a lasting friendship with rust and refuse to move. [Common]

Steel Scale Hauberk.name: Steel Scale Hauberk
Steel Scale Hauberk.description: Overlapping scales that rattle like a nervous merchant, warning enemies you are coming and warning you that you forgot to oil it again. [Uncommon]

Knight's Chain Hauberk.name: Knight's Chain Hauberk
Knight's Chain Hauberk.description: Guild-standard mail worn by knights who survived long enough to afford the good stuff, and heavy enough that they never skip leg day. [Rare]

Serpentscale Aegis.name: Serpentscale Aegis
Serpentscale Aegis.description: Forged from the shed scales of a serpent so ancient it predates the Adventurers Guild paperwork, each plate coils and re-settles when struck, as if still deciding whether the blow was worth its attention. Wiz once appraised it, went pale, and quietly recommended selling it to literally anyone else. It has never been pierced, cursed, or successfully insured. [Legendary]

Dented Iron Breastplate.name: Dented Iron Breastplate
Dented Iron Breastplate.description: A guardsman's cast-off with a dent shaped exactly like a Giant Toad's tooth, sold cheap and blushing about it. [Common]

Steel Field Cuirass.name: Steel Field Cuirass
Steel Field Cuirass.description: Honest steel that keeps the important organs where you left them, provided you can still stand upright underneath it. [Uncommon]

Knight's Half Plate.name: Knight's Half Plate
Knight's Half Plate.description: Polished until you can watch your own terrified reflection right up until the monster finally arrives. [Uncommon]

Bulwark of the Fallen Vanguard.name: Bulwark of the Fallen Vanguard
Bulwark of the Fallen Vanguard.description: Salvaged from the last knight to charge a Mobile Fortress on foot, this plate still bears the scorch mark that ended his very brief legend. Blows land against it with a dull, apologetic thud, as though the world itself feels bad about trying. Veterans say it makes you unstoppable; widows say it makes you overconfident. [Epic]

Apprentice's Spell Robe.name: Apprentice's Spell Robe
Apprentice's Spell Robe.description: Standard issue for first-year mages, dyed a hopeful blue that hides neither soot stains nor a complete lack of talent. [Common]

Woven Mana Robe.name: Woven Mana Robe
Woven Mana Robe.description: Threaded with cheap manatite dust so it hums faintly, mostly at the worst possible moments in an otherwise quiet library. [Uncommon]

Enchanter's Silk Robe.name: Enchanter's Silk Robe
Enchanter's Silk Robe.description: Spun so fine that spells slide off the fabric instead of the caster, which Wiz insists is a feature and not an accident. [Rare]

Sorcerer's Runewoven Robe.name: Sorcerer's Runewoven Robe
Sorcerer's Runewoven Robe.description: Every hem crawls with stitched runes that glow when you cast and itch when you lie about how much mana you have left. [Rare]

Acolyte's Simple Habit.name: Acolyte's Simple Habit
Acolyte's Simple Habit.description: Plain Eris Church cloth, scratchy enough to keep a novice awake through even the longest sermon about tithing. [Common]

Chorister's Ceremony Robe.name: Chorister's Ceremony Robe
Chorister's Ceremony Robe.description: Cut for hymn-singing and passing the collection plate, with sleeves wide enough to hide exactly how empty it came back. [Common]

Consecrated Vestments.name: Consecrated Vestments
Consecrated Vestments.description: Blessed by a bishop who only mildly resented doing it, warding off lesser undead and stronger hangovers alike. [Uncommon]

High Priest's Ceremonial Robe.name: High Priest's Ceremonial Robe
High Priest's Ceremonial Robe.description: Gold-trimmed regalia so heavy with piety and embroidery that kneeling to pray becomes its own small act of devotion. [Rare]

Scout's Padded Vest.name: Scout's Padded Vest
Scout's Padded Vest.description: Quilted just thick enough to stop a bramble and just thin enough to sprint away from whatever the bramble was hiding. [Common]

Ranger's Field Jerkin.name: Ranger's Field Jerkin
Ranger's Field Jerkin.description: Mud-colored on purpose, so you blend into the forest and, less usefully, into every dim tavern corner. [Common]

Forest Warden's Leathers.name: Forest Warden's Leathers
Forest Warden's Leathers.description: Oiled against rain and stitched with pockets for snares, jerky, and the small dignity of never getting lost. [Uncommon]

Wyvern Hunter's Harness.name: Wyvern Hunter's Harness
Wyvern Hunter's Harness.description: Buckled tight for climbing cliffs after things that bite, with one strap positioned to hold either a quiver or your nerve. [Rare]

Mantle of the Silent Tracker.name: Mantle of the Silent Tracker
Mantle of the Silent Tracker.description: Woven from shadow-dyed wool by a scout who reportedly followed a Demon King's general for three days without being noticed or, more impressively, getting bored. Footsteps fall silent beneath it and campfire smoke seems to forget the wearer's face. Rangers whisper that it was never lost, only misplaced, which is somehow worse. [Epic]

Peasant's Roughspun Tunic.name: Peasant's Roughspun Tunic
Peasant's Roughspun Tunic.description: Honest, itchy, and utterly unremarkable, which in a monster-infested kingdom is its own quiet kind of camouflage. [Common]

Traveler's Padded Coat.name: Traveler's Padded Coat
Traveler's Padded Coat.description: Lined against Axel's night chill and the very real chance you sleep in a ditch outside the Guild again. [Common]

Merchant's Fine Coat.name: Merchant's Fine Coat
Merchant's Fine Coat.description: Cut to impress buyers and hide a coin pouch, though it stops precisely zero swords, as one optimistic trader discovered. [Common]

Nobleman's Traveling Doublet.name: Nobleman's Traveling Doublet
Nobleman's Traveling Doublet.description: Velvet trimmed for arriving at estates in style, offering excellent protection against social embarrassment and none whatsoever against goblins. [Rare]

Studded Leather Vest.name: Studded Leather Vest
Studded Leather Vest.description: Dotted with iron rivets that look intimidating right up until someone taps one and it plops into your soup. [Common]

Riveted Brigandine.name: Riveted Brigandine
Riveted Brigandine.description: Cloth over hidden plates, comfortably heavy, worn by guards who value both mobility and the ability to nap standing up. [Uncommon]

Reinforced Brigandine Coat.name: Reinforced Brigandine Coat
Reinforced Brigandine Coat.description: Layered steel plates riveted between canvas, dense enough to stop a dagger and every attempt at a graceful bow. [Rare]

Guardsman's Studded Cuirass.name: Guardsman's Studded Cuirass
Guardsman's Studded Cuirass.description: Axel town issue for gate duty, built to survive both bandit raids and eight straight hours of crushing boredom. [Uncommon]

Aegis of the Devil King's General.name: Aegis of the Devil King's General
Aegis of the Devil King's General.description: Torn from the ruins of a general who badly underestimated a party of idiots, this obsidian plate drinks the light around it and hums with borrowed malice. Blades chip against it, curses slide off it, and the wearer feels an unsettling urge to monologue before every fight. The Guild flagged it as too dangerous to sell and too valuable to destroy, so naturally someone stole it. [Epic]

Winter Shogun's Frostmail.name: Winter Shogun's Frostmail
Winter Shogun's Frostmail.description: Forged around the frozen heart of the Winter Shogun, this mail never thaws and rimes the wearer's breath even in high summer. Enemies who strike it find their weapons welded fast by sudden ice, while the wearer finds their tavern drinks stay pleasantly cold. Alcanretia's priests call it a miracle; everyone downwind calls it a nuisance. [Epic]

Vanir's Guaranteed Return Vest.name: Vanir's Guaranteed Return Vest
Vanir's Guaranteed Return Vest.description: Sold by the merchant-devil Vanir with a smug promise that it will stop any blow, provided you file the claim before dying. It is genuinely, infuriatingly excellent armor, which only makes the fine print more suspicious. Moi, Vanir, would never cheat a customer, though Moi also does not accept returns after resurrection. [Epic]

Regalia of the Demon King's Court.name: Regalia of the Demon King's Court
Regalia of the Demon King's Court.description: Woven with dark threads and a self-importance you can practically hear, this regalia was tailored for someone who expected to rule and settled for being defeated dramatically. It amplifies both magic and ego in roughly equal, dangerous measure. Crimson Demons adore it; everyone forced to listen to its wearer does not. [Legendary]

Lich Queen's Burial Shroud.name: Lich Queen's Burial Shroud
Lich Queen's Burial Shroud.description: The grave-wrappings of a lich who, much like a certain beloved shopkeeper, simply refused to accept that she was dead. Cold mana seeps from every fold, restoring the caster faster than is entirely comfortable to think about. Wiz once tried it on, sighed wistfully, and asked that we never speak of it again. [Legendary]

Carapace of the Destroyer.name: Carapace of the Destroyer
Carapace of the Destroyer.description: Plated with a fragment of the Mobile Fortress Destroyer itself, still warm with the memory of leveling three towns before breakfast. It shrugs off siege weapons and mild criticism alike, though it weighs roughly as much as a guilty conscience. The Guild strongly advises against wearing it near anything you would like to keep standing. [Epic]

Raiment of the Water Goddess.name: Raiment of the Water Goddess
Raiment of the Water Goddess.description: Shimmering cloth said to be blessed by a certain useless, self-proclaimed goddess during a rare moment of actual competence. It brims with restorative mana and an unshakable, slightly annoying confidence that everything will work out. Priests treasure it; anyone who has actually met the goddess double-checks that it works. [Legendary]

Explosion Ceremony Vestment.name: Explosion Ceremony Vestment
Explosion Ceremony Vestment.description: The ceremonial robe worn once a year by the Crimson Demon Village's proudest, embroidered with runes that flare crimson at the mere mention of the word Explosion. It magnifies a single, magnificent, party-ending spell and absolutely nothing practical afterward. Megumin reportedly wept upon seeing it, then collapsed, as is tradition. [Legendary]

Hide of the One-Hit Bear.name: Hide of the One-Hit Bear
Hide of the One-Hit Bear.description: Skinned from a legendary bear that famously required exactly one hit to defeat, once someone finally figured out where to aim. The pelt is thick enough to nap through an avalanche and warm enough to make winter patrols almost bearable. Adventurers still argue over whether the bear was truly mighty or simply enormous and slow. [Legendary]

Padded Cloth Coif.name: Padded Cloth Coif
Padded Cloth Coif.description: A quilted cap that reliably stops sunburn, mild insults, and absolutely nothing swung by a Giant Toad. [Common]

Rusty Iron Helm.name: Rusty Iron Helm
Rusty Iron Helm.description: Guild surplus of unknown history, complete with a dent shaped exactly like the last owner's regret. [Common]

Leather Skullcap.name: Leather Skullcap
Leather Skullcap.description: Snug brown leather that makes every rookie feel like a real adventurer right up until the first real hit. [Common]

Iron Half-Helm.name: Iron Half-Helm
Iron Half-Helm.description: Covers the top half of your skull, which the Axel Guild insists is statistically the important half. [Common]

Dented Pot Helm.name: Dented Pot Helm
Dented Pot Helm.description: Technically a soup pot with a chin strap, and honestly it has outlasted more swords than anyone will admit. [Common]

Fine Steel Sallet.name: Fine Steel Sallet
Fine Steel Sallet.description: Polished bright enough to check your hair in before charging a monster you fully intend to flee. [Common]

Knight's Barbute.name: Knight's Barbute
Knight's Barbute.description: The narrow eye slit keeps arrows out and also keeps you from spotting the trap you just stepped in. [Uncommon]

Tempered Great Helm.name: Tempered Great Helm
Tempered Great Helm.description: Muffles sound so thoroughly that you will miss your party leaving without you, and honestly that tracks. [Uncommon]

Mithril Winged Helm.name: Mithril Winged Helm
Mithril Winged Helm.description: Feather-light silver wings that accomplish nothing aerodynamic but make the tavern portraits look incredible. [Rare]

Masterwork Knight's Helm.name: Masterwork Knight's Helm
Masterwork Knight's Helm.description: Forged by an Axel smith who wept while finishing it, either from pride or the forge fumes. [Rare]

Enchanted Visored Helm.name: Enchanted Visored Helm
Enchanted Visored Helm.description: The visor drops with a dramatic clang perfectly timed to ruin whatever cool line you were saying. [Rare]

Helm of the Dullahan.name: Helm of the Dullahan
Helm of the Dullahan.description: Salvaged from the fallen knight Beldia after his head and his body had their final disagreement, it grips the skull with unsettling loyalty. All night it whispers battle tactics that are always technically correct and never once comforting. Wearing it, you feel unkillable, which is precisely the sort of confidence that gets Axel adventurers killed. [Epic]

Worn Work Gloves.name: Worn Work Gloves
Worn Work Gloves.description: They smell faintly of Giant Toad and of someone else's honest labor, definitely not yours. [Common]

Padded Leather Gloves.name: Padded Leather Gloves
Padded Leather Gloves.description: Thin enough to still feel your coin purse being lifted, tragically not quick enough to stop it. [Common]

Iron Gauntlets.name: Iron Gauntlets
Iron Gauntlets.description: Heavy enough that waving hello now legally counts as a threat display. [Uncommon]

Reinforced Grip Gloves.name: Reinforced Grip Gloves
Reinforced Grip Gloves.description: The extra stitching promises a firmer hold on your weapon, your rope, and your rapidly fleeing dignity. [Common]

Fine Steel Gauntlets.name: Fine Steel Gauntlets
Fine Steel Gauntlets.description: Articulated fingers let you grip a sword or, more importantly, a very full tankard. [Uncommon]

Duelist's Fitted Gloves.name: Duelist's Fitted Gloves
Duelist's Fitted Gloves.description: Tailored so precisely that from now on missing your parry is entirely your own fault. [Common]

Mithril Gauntlets.name: Mithril Gauntlets
Mithril Gauntlets.description: So light you forget they are armored until you accidentally crush a doorknob into paste. [Rare]

Enchanted Gripping Gauntlets.name: Enchanted Gripping Gauntlets
Enchanted Gripping Gauntlets.description: Faintly magnetic to steel, which is wonderful right up until a rival adventurer strolls past armed. [Rare]

Gauntlets of Unyielding Debt.name: Gauntlets of Unyielding Debt
Gauntlets of Unyielding Debt.description: Pawned, reclaimed, and repossessed so many times that the leather now visibly flinches at the word interest. They tighten protectively whenever coin changes hands, having learned the hard way that in Axel a purchase and a catastrophe are frequently the same event. Whoever wears them fights with the desperate strength of someone one bad night away from washing dishes at the Guild. [Epic]

Patched Cloth Leggings.name: Patched Cloth Leggings
Patched Cloth Leggings.description: More patch than legging by now, a proud quilt of every adventure you only barely survived. [Common]

Worn Leather Greaves.name: Worn Leather Greaves
Worn Leather Greaves.description: They cover the shin, which is the exact part a monster bites when it is being polite. [Common]

Iron Greaves.name: Iron Greaves
Iron Greaves.description: They clank loudly enough that any stealth mission is now simply off the table. [Common]

Padded War Leggings.name: Padded War Leggings
Padded War Leggings.description: Thickly stuffed so a solid hit merely bruises your pride instead of shattering your bones. [Uncommon]

Fine Steel Greaves.name: Fine Steel Greaves
Fine Steel Greaves.description: Polished shin plates that helpfully reflect the fireball you should probably be dodging. [Uncommon]

Knight's Tassets.name: Knight's Tassets
Knight's Tassets.description: Hip plates that guard everything a seated knight keeps forgetting he is not protecting. [Common]

Mithril Greaves.name: Mithril Greaves
Mithril Greaves.description: Silver-bright and whisper-quiet, finally letting your legs keep a secret for once. [Rare]

Enchanted Plated Leggings.name: Enchanted Plated Leggings
Enchanted Plated Leggings.description: They hum faintly with warding magic and, unfortunately, faintly of the last owner's cologne. [Rare]

Greaves of the Eternal Sprint.name: Greaves of the Eternal Sprint
Greaves of the Eternal Sprint.description: Forged for a hero who understood that the bravest act an Axel adventurer can perform is outrunning the bill. They lighten with every stride away from danger and turn to lead the instant you dare to face it, as if the enchantment itself has read your survival odds. Countless parties owe their lives to whoever wore these and had the wisdom to shout run first. [Epic]

Worn Cloth Shoes.name: Worn Cloth Shoes
Worn Cloth Shoes.description: They barely qualify as footwear, but they are yours and they have strong opinions about cobblestones. [Common]

Scuffed Leather Boots.name: Scuffed Leather Boots
Scuffed Leather Boots.description: Broken in by a stranger, haunted by their bunions, and cheap enough that you forgive both. [Common]

Iron-Shod Boots.name: Iron-Shod Boots
Iron-Shod Boots.description: The metal toes upgrade an accidental stumble into a surprisingly effective kick. [Uncommon]

Sturdy Marching Boots.name: Sturdy Marching Boots
Sturdy Marching Boots.description: Guild-approved for long roads, blister-approved for the exact same reason. [Common]

Fine Riding Boots.name: Fine Riding Boots
Fine Riding Boots.description: Tall, polished, and utterly wasted on an adventurer who cannot afford a horse. [Common]

Knight's Sabatons.name: Knight's Sabatons
Knight's Sabatons.description: Overlapping steel plates that let you clank with the confidence of a man who has never snuck anywhere. [Uncommon]

Mithril Stride Boots.name: Mithril Stride Boots
Mithril Stride Boots.description: So light your footsteps fall silent, right up until you trip over that very lightness. [Rare]

Boots of the Reluctant Hero.name: Boots of the Reluctant Hero
Boots of the Reluctant Hero.description: Handed down through a lineage of adventurers famous less for slaying monsters than for narrowly surviving them. They point themselves toward the nearest exit with gentle, insistent pressure and have never once led a wearer into a fair fight. Legend holds they only stand their ground when a friend is behind you, the rare moment cowardice quietly becomes courage. [Epic]

Cracked Wooden Buckler.name: Cracked Wooden Buckler
Cracked Wooden Buckler.description: A dinner-plate of splintering pine that blocks one good hit and then generously becomes kindling. [Common]

Iron Round Shield.name: Iron Round Shield
Iron Round Shield.description: Round, dependable, and dented into a permanent smile by everything that ever tried to eat you. [Common]

Banded Buckler.name: Banded Buckler
Banded Buckler.description: Small enough to hide behind only if the threat is also very small and unusually polite. [Uncommon]

Steel Heater Shield.name: Steel Heater Shield
Steel Heater Shield.description: Named for its shape rather than its warmth, though Axel rookies keep trying to cook breakfast on it. [Uncommon]

Reinforced Kite Shield.name: Reinforced Kite Shield
Reinforced Kite Shield.description: Long enough to guard shin to shoulder, heavy enough to guarantee you never raise it in time. [Uncommon]

Mithril Round Shield.name: Mithril Round Shield
Mithril Round Shield.description: It turns aside blows with a bright chime that sounds suspiciously like it is judging your form. [Rare]

Enchanted Heater Shield.name: Enchanted Heater Shield
Enchanted Heater Shield.description: The wards flare blue on impact, which is either powerful protective magic or a very expensive nightlight. [Rare]

Darkness's Immovable Bulwark.name: Darkness's Immovable Bulwark
Darkness's Immovable Bulwark.description: Bequeathed by a noble crusader who considered dodging a personal failing and taking hits an honest hobby, it plants into the ground and simply refuses to budge. It swallows every blow meant for the whole party while its wielder blushes at all the attention. Enemies find it maddening, allies find it priceless, and everyone agrees it is safest not to ask why she enjoys the work quite so much. [Legendary]

Traveler's Hood.name: Traveler's Hood
Traveler's Hood.description: It keeps rain off, keeps eyes hidden, and makes you look exactly as suspicious as every other hooded figure in the tavern. [Common]

Silver Circlet.name: Silver Circlet
Silver Circlet.description: A thin band of silver worn low on the brow, beloved by mages who want to look wise and nobles who want to look expensive. [Common]

Apprentice's Smithing Hammer.name: Apprentice's Smithing Hammer
Apprentice's Smithing Hammer.description: A dependable little hammer for pounding hot iron and, on slow days, the occasional overdue-rent notice from the Axel landlord. [Common]

Journeyman's Forge Bellows.name: Journeyman's Forge Bellows
Journeyman's Forge Bellows.description: Sturdy leather bellows that coax a proper roar from any coal fire, guaranteed to keep the flame steady even while your party argues about who spent the reward money. [Uncommon]

Masterwork Anvil and Tongs Set.name: Masterwork Anvil and Tongs Set
Masterwork Anvil and Tongs Set.description: A ringing black anvil and matched tongs that have shaped more Axel adventurer gear than anyone cares to count. Smiths swear the anvil hums approval when you finally get a weld right, and disappointment when you do not. [Rare]

Apprentice's Copper Alembic.name: Apprentice's Copper Alembic
Apprentice's Copper Alembic.description: A dented copper still for beginner brews, sold with a straight face by Wiz's shop despite the faint scorch marks on the base. [Common]

Journeyman's Distillation Rig.name: Journeyman's Distillation Rig
Journeyman's Distillation Rig.description: Glass coils and steady burners that separate a healing draught from a stomach disaster with reassuring precision. [Uncommon]

Master Alchemist's Transmutation Case.name: Master Alchemist's Transmutation Case
Master Alchemist's Transmutation Case.description: A velvet-lined case of vials, reagents, and calibrated droppers that treats potion-making like the serious science it pretends to be. Rumor says its previous owner turned a fortune in materials into a slightly larger fortune, then blew it all at the Axis Cult festival. [Rare]

Well-Worn Field Skillet.name: Well-Worn Field Skillet
Well-Worn Field Skillet.description: A trusty iron skillet seasoned by a hundred campfires, equally suited to frying Giant Toad steaks and threatening whoever ate the last one. [Common]

Journeyman's Knife Roll.name: Journeyman's Knife Roll
Journeyman's Knife Roll.description: A canvas roll of honed blades for every task, so you never again have to gut a river fish with a shortsword and an apology. [Uncommon]

Master Chef's Copper Cookware.name: Master Chef's Copper Cookware
Master Chef's Copper Cookware.description: Gleaming copper pots and pans that turn even cheap Axel market scraps into a meal an adventuring party will fight over. Owning the set is said to raise your standing at any guild hall table, no questions asked. [Rare]

Traveling Sewing Kit.name: Traveling Sewing Kit
Traveling Sewing Kit.description: Needles, thread, and thimbles in a tidy tin, ready to close the tear a goblin left in your only decent cloak. [Common]

Journeyman's Tailoring Shears.name: Journeyman's Tailoring Shears
Journeyman's Tailoring Shears.description: Heavy steel shears that glide through wool and leather alike, sharp enough to make a Crimson Demon's dramatic cape look intentional. [Uncommon]

Master Tailor's Silver Needle Set.name: Master Tailor's Silver Needle Set
Master Tailor's Silver Needle Set.description: A set of silver needles fine enough to stitch enchanted thread without snagging, each one worth more than most Axel adventurers earn in a month. The stitching they produce holds together armor and reputations in equal measure. [Rare]

Apprentice's Handsaw.name: Apprentice's Handsaw
Apprentice's Handsaw.description: A basic handsaw that cuts a passably straight board on the third try, which is two tries better than most Axel amateurs manage. [Common]

Journeyman's Carpentry Toolbelt.name: Journeyman's Carpentry Toolbelt
Journeyman's Carpentry Toolbelt.description: A worn leather belt hung with chisels, planes, and a level that has settled more building disputes than the guild ever has. [Uncommon]

Master Carpenter's Plane Set.name: Master Carpenter's Plane Set
Master Carpenter's Plane Set.description: Precision planes and joinery tools that shave wood to a whisper-thin curl and fit joints without a single nail. Carpenters say a chair built with this set will outlast the town, the party, and possibly the demon king. [Rare]

Home Brewing Crock.name: Home Brewing Crock
Home Brewing Crock.description: A simple clay crock for turning cheap grain into cheaper ale, beloved by adventurers too broke for the tavern but too proud to stay sober. [Common]

Journeyman's Fermentation Barrels.name: Journeyman's Fermentation Barrels
Journeyman's Fermentation Barrels.description: Oak barrels with proper airlocks that let a batch mature into something you would actually serve a guest, or at least Aqua. [Uncommon]

Master Brewer's Copper Still.name: Master Brewer's Copper Still
Master Brewer's Copper Still.description: A tall copper still capable of coaxing a spirit smooth enough to make a Crimson Demon speak in complete sentences. Its output has settled feuds, sealed trade deals, and started roughly the same number of both. [Rare]

Apprentice's Rune Chisel.name: Apprentice's Rune Chisel
Apprentice's Rune Chisel.description: A fine chisel for carving beginner glyphs, sold with a laminated card reminding you which symbol means fireball and which means please refund me. [Common]

Journeyman's Sigil Stylus.name: Journeyman's Sigil Stylus
Journeyman's Sigil Stylus.description: A mana-conductive stylus that inscribes clean enchantment sigils without the smudging that ruins a perfectly good longsword. [Uncommon]

Master Enchanter's Weaving Loom.name: Master Enchanter's Weaving Loom
Master Enchanter's Weaving Loom.description: A delicate loom for weaving raw magic into thread and steel, humming faintly with power its owner pretends is entirely under control. Even Wiz eyes it with professional envy whenever one passes through the shop. [Rare]

Herb-Gathering Basket.name: Herb-Gathering Basket
Herb-Gathering Basket.description: A woven basket with sorted compartments, so your rare medicinal roots do not end up crushed under the surprisingly heavy mushrooms. [Common]

Journeyman's Mortar and Pestle.name: Journeyman's Mortar and Pestle
Journeyman's Mortar and Pestle.description: A heavy stone mortar that grinds dried leaves into a proper poultice, and the occasional careless bug that wandered in. [Uncommon]

Master Herbalist's Pressing Kit.name: Master Herbalist's Pressing Kit
Master Herbalist's Pressing Kit.description: A brass press and drying frames that extract every drop of potency from a gathered herb, the pride of any healer working the Axel outskirts. Field medics claim its salves work faster than a hungover priest's prayers. [Rare]

Angler's Tackle Box.name: Angler's Tackle Box
Angler's Tackle Box.description: A tidy box of hooks, lures, and floats for the adventurer who has decided the river is safer than the dungeon. [Common]

Master Angler's Casting Reel.name: Master Angler's Casting Reel
Master Angler's Casting Reel.description: A precision reel that lands the big lake monsters other fishers only brag about in the tavern. Its owner is legally entitled to at least one insufferable fish story per catch. [Rare]

Bent Dowsing Rod.name: Bent Dowsing Rod
Bent Dowsing Rod.description: A crooked forked rod that twitches toward shallow buried coin, and only coin, or possibly toward whatever direction you already wanted to dig. It does not find water, vaults, or hidden chambers; it barely finds the coins. [Common]

Master Hunter's Divining Rod.name: Master Hunter's Divining Rod
Master Hunter's Divining Rod.description: A weighted brass rod that hums over hidden vaults and forgotten dungeon caches with uncanny reliability. Veterans say it has never been wrong, only occasionally pointed at somewhere extremely inconvenient to reach. [Rare]

Field Naturalist's Journal.name: Field Naturalist's Journal
Field Naturalist's Journal.description: A leather journal for sketching monsters at a safe distance, its early pages notably steadier than the ones drawn mid-retreat. [Common]

Master Researcher's Specimen Case.name: Master Researcher's Specimen Case
Master Researcher's Specimen Case.description: A padded case of vials, calipers, and pinning trays for cataloguing everything from Giant Toad glands to snow sprite cores. Guild scholars trade favors for a look inside it, then argue about the labeling for hours. [Rare]

Chipped Miner's Pick.name: Chipped Miner's Pick
Chipped Miner's Pick.description: A well-used pick with a chip in the head, still perfectly capable of freeing ore and the occasional startled cave newt. [Common]

Master Miner's Reinforced Pickaxe.name: Master Miner's Reinforced Pickaxe
Master Miner's Reinforced Pickaxe.description: A balanced steel pickaxe that reads a vein at a glance and never wastes a swing on worthless rock. Miners say it has paid for itself so many times the math has become embarrassing. [Rare]

Farmer's Seed Pouch.name: Farmer's Seed Pouch
Farmer's Seed Pouch.description: A canvas pouch of sorted seeds and a battered trowel, the humble beginning of every farm and every complaint about the weather. [Common]

Master Farmer's Toolset.name: Master Farmer's Toolset
Master Farmer's Toolset.description: A full set of hoes, scythes, and grafting knives that coax a harvest from soil the Axel plains swore was hopeless. Its owner speaks to the crops, and unsettlingly often the crops seem to listen. [Rare]

Shopkeeper's Ledger.name: Shopkeeper's Ledger
Shopkeeper's Ledger.description: A tidy account book that tracks every copper in and out, ensuring no adventurer ever haggles you down twice. [Common]

Master Merchant's Abacus.name: Master Merchant's Abacus
Master Merchant's Abacus.description: A lacquered abacus that totals a shrewd markup faster than a customer can invent an excuse to leave. Vanir himself would call the sums fair, which from a devil is a genuine endorsement. [Rare]

Cartographer's Kit.name: Cartographer's Kit
Cartographer's Kit.description: Ink, compass, and rolled vellum for mapping the road ahead, or for pretending you knew where you were going all along. [Uncommon]

Surveyor's Theodolite.name: Surveyor's Theodolite
Surveyor's Theodolite.description: A brass sighting instrument that fixes distances and bearings with a precision that makes getting lost feel like a personal choice. [Common]

Appraiser's Loupe.name: Appraiser's Loupe
Appraiser's Loupe.description: A jeweler's loupe that separates a genuine relic from a painted rock, sparing many an Axel buyer a very public regret. [Common]

Master Appraiser's Jeweler's Kit.name: Master Appraiser's Jeweler's Kit
Master Appraiser's Jeweler's Kit.description: A felt-lined kit of scales, loupes, and reagent drops that names the true worth of anything laid before it. Merchants dread its verdict and adventurers cling to it, since it once valued a hero's family heirloom at three copper and a firm handshake. [Rare]

Gravekeeper's Warding Kit.name: Gravekeeper's Warding Kit
Gravekeeper's Warding Kit.description: Salt, chalk, and iron nails for keeping the restless dead where they belong, along with a small mercy for the ones that wander back anyway. [Common]

Traveling Bard's Lute.name: Traveling Bard's Lute
Traveling Bard's Lute.description: A road-worn lute that turns a tavern's grumbling into a singalong, provided you steer well clear of the Axis Cult's request list. [Uncommon]

Wandering Flute.name: Wandering Flute
Wandering Flute.description: A carved wooden flute whose bright notes carry over a campfire, cheerfully drowning out whatever Aqua is crying about tonight. [Common]

Adventurer's Hand Drum.name: Adventurer's Hand Drum
Adventurer's Hand Drum.description: A tight little hand drum that keeps a marching beat and, in a pinch, doubles as a very stern way to wake a sleeping party. [Common]

Scribe's Writing Kit.name: Scribe's Writing Kit
Scribe's Writing Kit.description: Quills, sealing wax, and a portable inkwell for copying guild contracts, where the trick is reading the clauses before anyone signs them. [Common]

Weighted Dice Set.name: Weighted Dice Set
Weighted Dice Set.description: A pair of ivory dice that land favorably far more often than probability strictly permits, best kept away from Dust before he notices. [Common]

Marked Card Deck.name: Marked Card Deck
Marked Card Deck.description: A deck with subtle nicks along the edges, readable only to the owner and to anyone else who happens to own the identical deck. [Common]

Odd-Jobs Toolbox.name: Odd-Jobs Toolbox
Odd-Jobs Toolbox.description: A dented box of mismatched tools for the adventurer between careers, handy for fixing fences, hanging signs, and quietly avoiding the quest board. [Common]

Rusty Lockpick Twist.name: Rusty Lockpick Twist
Rusty Lockpick Twist.description: A bent length of wire that opens simple chests eventually, assuming the chest is patient and nobody is watching you sweat. [Common]

Fine Tension Lockpicks.name: Fine Tension Lockpicks
Fine Tension Lockpicks.description: A slim set of picks that clicks tumblers open with the quiet confidence of someone who has definitely never robbed a noble. [Uncommon]

Masterwork Skeleton Key Set.name: Masterwork Skeleton Key Set
Masterwork Skeleton Key Set.description: This velvet-lined roll of picks has opened every lock in Axel except the one on Wiz's back-room debt ledger, which even it politely refuses to touch. [Rare]

Padded Muffle Wraps.name: Padded Muffle Wraps
Padded Muffle Wraps.description: Cloth strips that wrap around buckles and blades so your gear stops announcing your ambush three rooms early. [Common]

Shadowstep Cloak Kit.name: Shadowstep Cloak Kit
Shadowstep Cloak Kit.description: A dark hooded rig with dulled clasps, favored by rogues who prefer to be seen only in dramatic retrospect. [Uncommon]

Voidcloth Creeper Set.name: Voidcloth Creeper Set
Voidcloth Creeper Set.description: Woven from shadow-dyed thread, this full sneaking outfit lets you slip past a sleeping Giant Toad, though waking one is entirely your own fault. [Rare]

Soot-Blackened Sneak Kit.name: Soot-Blackened Sneak Kit
Soot-Blackened Sneak Kit.description: A pouch of soot for dulling your face and buckles, because moonlight glinting off your grin has ruined many a promising heist. [Common]

Worn Riding Saddle.name: Worn Riding Saddle
Worn Riding Saddle.description: A secondhand saddle that keeps you on the horse well enough, provided the horse has also agreed to the arrangement. [Common]

Fitted Cavalry Tack.name: Fitted Cavalry Tack
Fitted Cavalry Tack.description: Properly buckled reins and stirrups that make you look like you actually know which end of the horse goes first. [Uncommon]

Masterwork Courser Saddle.name: Masterwork Courser Saddle
Masterwork Courser Saddle.description: Handstitched for long rides, this saddle turns a panicked gallop away from a monster into something almost resembling horsemanship. [Rare]

Sturdy Pack Saddle.name: Sturdy Pack Saddle
Sturdy Pack Saddle.description: Built to balance a week of supplies across a mule's back without the mule filing a complaint with the Guild. [Common]

Traveler's Map Case.name: Traveler's Map Case
Traveler's Map Case.description: A waterproof tube that keeps your maps dry and legible, unlike the coffee-stained scrawls the last party sold you. [Common]

Brass Sextant.name: Brass Sextant
Brass Sextant.description: A gleaming instrument for finding your position by the stars, or for looking impressively competent while hopelessly lost. [Uncommon]

Astronomer's Star Charts.name: Astronomer's Star Charts
Astronomer's Star Charts.description: Charts detailed enough to cross the frontier by night, annotated by a Crimson Demon who could not resist naming three constellations after himself. [Rare]

Bandage Roll Bundle.name: Bandage Roll Bundle
Bandage Roll Bundle.description: A tidy roll of clean linen for wrapping the small wounds Aqua cannot be bothered to heal for free. [Common]

Field Medic's Kit.name: Field Medic's Kit
Field Medic's Kit.description: Needles, salves, and splints enough to keep a bleeding adventurer arguing about loot until real help arrives. [Uncommon]

Master Healer's Splint Case.name: Master Healer's Splint Case
Master Healer's Splint Case.description: A complete surgical roll that has set more broken bones than the Axel Guild's entire monthly toad-hunting quota. [Rare]

Herbal Poultice Wrap Kit.name: Herbal Poultice Wrap Kit
Herbal Poultice Wrap Kit.description: Pressed leaves and gauze that soothe burns and bruises, the honest alternative to praying at a goddess who charges by the miracle. [Common]

Cracked Spyglass.name: Cracked Spyglass
Cracked Spyglass.description: A cheap glass with a hairline fracture that shows you two blurry monsters where regrettably there is only one. [Common]

Brass Magnifying Lens.name: Brass Magnifying Lens
Brass Magnifying Lens.description: A hand lens for reading fine print and spotting the tripwire you would otherwise discover with your ankle. [Uncommon]

Farseer's Listening Horn.name: Farseer's Listening Horn
Farseer's Listening Horn.description: A wide brass horn that catches whispered conversations across a tavern, ideal for eavesdropping on people insulting your party. [Rare]

Sentry's Far-Lens.name: Sentry's Far-Lens
Sentry's Far-Lens.description: A long polished spyglass that picks out an approaching wyvern while it is still a comfortable, cowardly distance away. [Uncommon]

Flint and Steel Fire Kit.name: Flint and Steel Fire Kit
Flint and Steel Fire Kit.description: A reliable striker that coaxes a campfire from damp wood, no Explosion magic and no leveling the campsite required. [Common]

Wilderness Survival Kit.name: Wilderness Survival Kit
Wilderness Survival Kit.description: Twine, snares, purifying tablets, and grim determination, packed for adventurers who wandered too far from the Guild's soup pot. [Uncommon]

Forager's Field Kit.name: Forager's Field Kit
Forager's Field Kit.description: Sorting trays and a nibble-test guide for telling which frontier berries are dinner and which are a very memorable afternoon. [Common]

Two-Person Travel Tent.name: Two-Person Travel Tent
Two-Person Travel Tent.description: A cramped canvas shelter that keeps two adventurers dry and one of them awake all night listening for toads. [Common]

Pickpocket's Finger Tools.name: Pickpocket's Finger Tools
Pickpocket's Finger Tools.description: Slim hooks and pinch-clips for relieving a distracted merchant of coins he was clearly not watching closely enough. [Common]

Sleight-of-Hand Practice Kit.name: Sleight-of-Hand Practice Kit
Sleight-of-Hand Practice Kit.description: Weighted cards and palming coins for drilling the flourishes that separate a nimble thief from a jailed one. [Uncommon]

Cutpurse's Razor Kit.name: Cutpurse's Razor Kit
Cutpurse's Razor Kit.description: A curved razor and thread for parting purse-strings in a crowd, best practiced far from Vanir, who always knows. [Uncommon]

Investigator's Evidence Kit.name: Investigator's Evidence Kit
Investigator's Evidence Kit.description: Wax, tweezers, and labeled jars for collecting clues at a scene the town guard has already trampled flat. [Uncommon]

Detective's Note-Taking Set.name: Detective's Note-Taking Set
Detective's Note-Taking Set.description: A bound notebook and inked pens for recording testimony before the witness remembers to start lying. [Common]

Magistrate's Casework Folio.name: Magistrate's Casework Folio
Magistrate's Casework Folio.description: A leather folio of cross-referenced case notes thorough enough to convict a devil, assuming the devil bothers denying it. [Rare]

Back-Alley Contact Ledger.name: Back-Alley Contact Ledger
Back-Alley Contact Ledger.description: A little book of names, favors, and grudges that opens more doors in Axel than any lockpick. [Common]

Informant's Token Pouch.name: Informant's Token Pouch
Informant's Token Pouch.description: A pouch of marked coins and pressed chits that tell the right shady people you can be trusted, mostly. [Uncommon]

Guild Rumor Ledger.name: Guild Rumor Ledger
Guild Rumor Ledger.description: A meticulously updated record of every debt, feud, and secret in town, worth more than gold and twice as dangerous to lose. [Rare]

Chalk Grip Bag.name: Chalk Grip Bag
Chalk Grip Bag.description: A pouch of drying chalk that keeps sweaty palms from turning a heroic climb into a brief, screaming descent. [Common]

Iron Climbing Pitons.name: Iron Climbing Pitons
Iron Climbing Pitons.description: A ring of iron spikes to hammer into cliffs, letting you scale walls that clearly expected you to give up. [Uncommon]

Tumbler's Training Rig.name: Tumbler's Training Rig
Tumbler's Training Rig.description: Padded bars and weighted sashes for drilling rolls and vaults until dodging a Giant Toad becomes almost graceful. [Uncommon]

Reinforced Waterskin.name: Reinforced Waterskin
Reinforced Waterskin.description: A double-stitched skin that holds a day's water without leaking down your leg at the worst possible moment. [Common]

Explorer's Rucksack.name: Explorer's Rucksack
Explorer's Rucksack.description: A roomy pack with too many pockets, half of which you will forget you stuffed with cursed souvenirs. [Common]

Whetstone and Oil Roll.name: Whetstone and Oil Roll
Whetstone and Oil Roll.description: A pocket kit for keeping an edge keen, so your blade stays sharper than your party's morning conversation. [Common]

Everburning Signal Torch.name: Everburning Signal Torch
Everburning Signal Torch.description: A treated torch that burns bright blue for hours, perfect for signaling rescue or attracting exactly the wrong attention. [Common]

Weatherproof Traveler's Pack.name: Weatherproof Traveler's Pack
Weatherproof Traveler's Pack.description: A waxed canvas pack that shrugs off rain, mud, and one truly regrettable Explosion aftermath. [Common]

Pocket Sundial Compass.name: Pocket Sundial Compass
Pocket Sundial Compass.description: A palm-sized dial that points north and tells the hour, provided the sun cooperates and you remember which way is up. [Common]

Band of the Bargainer.name: Band of the Bargainer
Band of the Bargainer.description: Turns every 'final price' into merely an opening suggestion, much to the shopkeeper's quiet despair. [Uncommon]

Ring of the Duelist.name: Ring of the Duelist
Ring of the Duelist.description: Whispers footwork tips your feet mostly ignore, yet somehow your sword still lands. [Uncommon]

Ring of Quick Hands.name: Ring of Quick Hands
Ring of Quick Hands.description: Your fingers grow suspiciously nimble around coin purses that technically belong to other people. [Uncommon]

Ring of the Silver Tongue.name: Ring of the Silver Tongue
Ring of the Silver Tongue.description: Lends your words a polish that makes even obvious lies sound like reasonable compromises. [Uncommon]

Ring of the Steady Aim.name: Ring of the Steady Aim
Ring of the Steady Aim.description: Steadies the drawing hand so completely that missing now requires genuine effort. [Rare]

Band of the Crimson Spark.name: Band of the Crimson Spark
Band of the Crimson Spark.description: Hums with the same reckless enthusiasm as a certain one-spell wizard, minus the fainting. [Rare]

Shadowstep Band.name: Shadowstep Band
Shadowstep Band.description: Muffles your footsteps so well that guards blame the draft for the missing silverware. [Uncommon]

Ring of the Open Door.name: Ring of the Open Door
Ring of the Open Door.description: Makes stubborn locks feel oddly cooperative, though the guild insists you only use it on your own doors. [Uncommon]

Ring of the Hard Stare.name: Ring of the Hard Stare
Ring of the Hard Stare.description: Sharpens your glare into something that makes goblins reconsider their life choices. [Uncommon]

Forgehand Band.name: Forgehand Band
Forgehand Band.description: Keeps your hammer strokes true even after the third straight hour of relentless clanging. [Uncommon]

Greenthumb Ring.name: Greenthumb Ring
Greenthumb Ring.description: Helps you tell a healing herb from a poisonous look-alike, usually before you eat it. [Common]

Gambler's Lucky Band.name: Gambler's Lucky Band
Gambler's Lucky Band.description: Nudges the dice in your favor just often enough to keep you dangerously optimistic. [Uncommon]

Ring of the Keen Read.name: Ring of the Keen Read
Ring of the Keen Read.description: Lets you spot the exact moment a merchant decides to overcharge you. [Uncommon]

Signet of Quiet Command.name: Signet of Quiet Command
Signet of Quiet Command.description: Carries enough understated authority that even reluctant adventurers form an orderly line. [Rare]

Ring of the Straight Face.name: Ring of the Straight Face
Ring of the Straight Face.description: Keeps your expression perfectly innocent no matter how enormous the lie you just told. [Uncommon]

Wayfarer's Band.name: Wayfarer's Band
Wayfarer's Band.description: Reminds you which mushrooms mean dinner and which mean a very memorable night. [Uncommon]

Ring of the Watchful Eye.name: Ring of the Watchful Eye
Ring of the Watchful Eye.description: Catches the glint of a hidden trap a heartbeat before your foot would have found it. [Uncommon]

Brawler's Knuckle Ring.name: Brawler's Knuckle Ring
Brawler's Knuckle Ring.description: Adds a satisfying weight to your punches without technically counting as a weapon at the door. [Uncommon]

Ring of the Tumbler.name: Ring of the Tumbler
Ring of the Tumbler.description: Turns an embarrassing stumble into something that almost looks intentional. [Uncommon]

Ring of the Beast Scholar.name: Ring of the Beast Scholar
Ring of the Beast Scholar.description: Recalls exactly which end of a Giant Toad does the swallowing, ideally in time. [Uncommon]

Alchemist's Brass Ring.name: Alchemist's Brass Ring
Alchemist's Brass Ring.description: Steadies your measuring hand so fewer experiments end in a colorful ceiling. [Uncommon]

Frostbite Signet.name: Frostbite Signet
Frostbite Signet.description: Chills the air around your fingertips, convenient for spells and terrible for handshakes. [Uncommon]

Ring of the Showman.name: Ring of the Showman
Ring of the Showman.description: Lends your act just enough flair that the crowd forgets to ask for their coins back. [Uncommon]

Ring of Proper Manners.name: Ring of Proper Manners
Ring of Proper Manners.description: Reminds you which fork the nobles use before they notice you guessing. [Uncommon]

Band of the Bull.name: Band of the Bull
Band of the Bull.description: Lends your grip enough extra force to open jars, doors, and the occasional stubborn treasure chest. [Common]

Ring of the Ogre's Grip.name: Ring of the Ogre's Grip
Ring of the Ogre's Grip.description: Packs a startling amount of brute power into a band that looks far too dainty for it. [Rare]

Ring of the Nimble Hand.name: Ring of the Nimble Hand
Ring of the Nimble Hand.description: Loosens up your fingers until sleight of hand feels almost like cheating. [Uncommon]

Ring of the Quickstep.name: Ring of the Quickstep
Ring of the Quickstep.description: Quickens your reflexes to the point that dodging becomes an annoying habit others resent. [Rare]

Band of Stone Endurance.name: Band of Stone Endurance
Band of Stone Endurance.description: Toughens you against long marches, bad taverns, and worse cooking. [Uncommon]

Ring of the Iron Gut.name: Ring of the Iron Gut
Ring of the Iron Gut.description: Lets you stomach questionable rations that would fell a lesser adventurer. [Common]

Ring of the Sharp Mind.name: Ring of the Sharp Mind
Ring of the Sharp Mind.description: Clears the mental fog just enough to remember what your spell was supposed to do. [Uncommon]

Ring of the Sage.name: Ring of the Sage
Ring of the Sage.description: Grants the rare gift of pausing before doing something spectacularly ill-advised. [Uncommon]

Ring of Easy Charm.name: Ring of Easy Charm
Ring of Easy Charm.description: Smooths your first impressions so people underestimate your debts a little longer. [Uncommon]

Ring of Effortless Grace.name: Ring of Effortless Grace
Ring of Effortless Grace.description: Lends you the poise of nobility, even when your coin purse says otherwise. [Rare]

Pendant of Minor Vitality.name: Pendant of Minor Vitality
Pendant of Minor Vitality.description: A modest charm that keeps you upright through scrapes that would send others limping home. [Uncommon]

Pendant of the Hale Heart.name: Pendant of the Hale Heart
Pendant of the Hale Heart.description: Warms against your chest and quietly shrugs off the bruises of another rough quest. [Uncommon]

Amulet of the Ox's Vigor.name: Amulet of the Ox's Vigor
Amulet of the Ox's Vigor.description: Grants the stubborn hardiness of a plow ox, minus the appetite for grass. [Rare]

Lifeglass Pendant.name: Lifeglass Pendant
Lifeglass Pendant.description: A pendant of clouded glass that seems to hold a little extra life for the truly reckless. [Rare]

Amulet of Trickling Mana.name: Amulet of Trickling Mana
Amulet of Trickling Mana.description: Refills your magic at the pace of a slow tavern tap, but it never quite runs dry. [Uncommon]

Amulet of the Deep Well.name: Amulet of the Deep Well
Amulet of the Deep Well.description: Draws on a reserve of power that feels reassuringly bottomless during a long casting day. [Rare]

Manastone Pendant.name: Manastone Pendant
Manastone Pendant.description: A polished shard of manatite that hums a little louder the more spells you have left. [Uncommon]

Amulet of the Overflowing Font.name: Amulet of the Overflowing Font
Amulet of the Overflowing Font.description: Brims with so much surplus magic that idle sparks occasionally singe your collar. [Rare]

Vanir's Money-Back Signet.name: Vanir's Money-Back Signet
Vanir's Money-Back Signet.description: A glossy black ring the merchant-devil Vanir swears comes with a full satisfaction guarantee, provided you never actually read the fine print. It sharpens your haggling to devilish precision, letting you talk down prices even Wiz refuses to lower. Vanir insists the soul-forfeiture clause is purely traditional and almost never enforced. [Epic]

Wiz's Absentminded Band.name: Wiz's Absentminded Band
Wiz's Absentminded Band.description: Wiz meant to sell this powerful mana band at a fair price, then forgot she had already marked it down to nearly nothing, as usual. It swells your reserves with the deep, quiet magic of a lich who genuinely cannot manage her own shop. Buy it quickly, before Vanir notices and adds three zeroes to the tag. [Epic]

Aqua's Blessing Pendant of Dubious Relia.name: Aqua's Blessing Pendant of Dubious Reliability
Aqua's Blessing Pendant of Dubious Relia.description: Blessed by the self-proclaimed goddess Aqua during a rare moment of focus, this pendant mends wounds with genuine divine power. It works flawlessly right up until the instant you truly need it, at which point Aqua is usually crying about something. Still, the healing is real, which is more than can be said for most of her promises. [Epic]

Megumin's Backup Bauble.name: Megumin's Backup Bauble
Megumin's Backup Bauble.description: A small crimson trinket Megumin keeps for the many hours each day after she has already used her one and only Explosion. It thrums with borrowed destructive potential that she absolutely refuses to ration more sensibly. Wearing it grants a fraction of her genius, and thankfully none of her tendency to collapse face-first afterward. [Epic]

Darkness's Ring of Unshakable Resolve.name: Darkness's Ring of Unshakable Resolve
Darkness's Ring of Unshakable Resolve.description: Forged for the crusader Darkness, who considers taking a direct hit the entire point of adventuring. This heavy band hardens your body to withstand blows that should reasonably end a career. Darkness finds this deeply disappointing, since feeling every one of them was rather the appeal. [Epic]

Chris's Sticky-Fingered Band.name: Chris's Sticky-Fingered Band
Chris's Sticky-Fingered Band.description: A plain silver ring the wandering thief Chris left behind, probably on purpose, probably not. It guides your hands toward valuables with an almost divine talent for lifting whatever isn't nailed down. Return it to her if you ever meet again, though she would honestly be a little impressed if you didn't. [Epic]

Ring of the Debtless Dream.name: Ring of the Debtless Dream
Ring of the Debtless Dream.description: Every broke adventurer in Axel dreams of the day their debts vanish and the drinks are finally free. This ring lends the easy confidence of someone who has genuinely stopped worrying about the bill. Whether that confidence counts as wisdom or denial depends entirely on how the tab looks in the morning. [Epic]

Amulet of the Lazy Adventurer.name: Amulet of the Lazy Adventurer
Amulet of the Lazy Adventurer.description: A comfortable amulet favored by adventurers whose grand ambition is a warm bed and someone else's gold. It grants no measurable power whatsoever, which its owners consider a feature rather than a flaw. Coincidentally, it pairs beautifully with a party that does all the actual fighting. [Common]

Beginner's Luck Charm.name: Beginner's Luck Charm
Beginner's Luck Charm.description: A cheap tin trinket sold to new adventurers who mistake surviving their first week for a personality trait. [Common]

Traveler's Luck Charm.name: Traveler's Luck Charm
Traveler's Luck Charm.description: Rub it before a card game and it improves your odds by exactly enough to lose slightly slower. [Common]

Gambler's Loaded Charm.name: Gambler's Loaded Charm
Gambler's Loaded Charm.description: The dealer keeps sweating and nobody can prove why, which is exactly how a good charm should behave. [Rare]

Warding Charm.name: Warding Charm
Warding Charm.description: Guaranteed to repel evil spirits, low-tier undead, and door-to-door Axis Cult recruiters, results not legally binding. [Common]

Iron Warding Talisman.name: Iron Warding Talisman
Iron Warding Talisman.description: Stamped with a stern-looking eye that watches the road so your own two can occasionally rest. [Common]

Flame Ward Charm.name: Flame Ward Charm
Flame Ward Charm.description: A scorched clay disc that promises fire resistance while itself looking suspiciously like it lost that argument. [Common]

Frost Ward Charm.name: Frost Ward Charm
Frost Ward Charm.description: Stays pleasantly cool in your palm, which is either powerful winter magic or just a rock in winter. [Common]

Toadbane Charm.name: Toadbane Charm
Toadbane Charm.description: Carved by someone who was swallowed by a Giant Toad often enough to fund a hobby. [Common]

Charm of Small Blessings.name: Charm of Small Blessings
Charm of Small Blessings.description: Grants no fortune, no protection, and no power, but jingles nicely and asks for nothing. [Common]

Manaknot Charm.name: Manaknot Charm
Manaknot Charm.description: A braided cord that pools loose mana back toward you, like a very patient magical funnel. [Uncommon]

Explosion Enthusiast's Charm.name: Explosion Enthusiast's Charm
Explosion Enthusiast's Charm.description: Officially licensed by nobody in Crimson Demon Village, worn by everyone who wishes it were. [Common]

Fortune Coin Talisman.name: Fortune Coin Talisman
Fortune Coin Talisman.description: An Eris-faced coin drilled through the middle, spent by no one because superstition beats a single silver. [Common]

Patched Traveler's Cloak.name: Patched Traveler's Cloak
Patched Traveler's Cloak.description: More patch than cloak at this point, but each hole marks a road survived and a landlord evaded. [Common]

Waxed Road Cloak.name: Waxed Road Cloak
Waxed Road Cloak.description: Sheds rain, dew, and the occasional thrown drink, so mostly a normal night in Axel. [Uncommon]

Wandermage's Field Cape.name: Wandermage's Field Cape
Wandermage's Field Cape.description: Lined with cheap manatite thread that hums faintly whenever you are about to cast something regrettable. [Uncommon]

Nightshade Stealth Cloak.name: Nightshade Stealth Cloak
Nightshade Stealth Cloak.description: Dyed the exact shade of an alley at midnight, which is flattering to absolutely no one. [Uncommon]

Ashgrey Prowler's Cloak.name: Ashgrey Prowler's Cloak
Ashgrey Prowler's Cloak.description: Swallows your outline so thoroughly that even the guild receptionist forgets you owe a tab. [Rare]

Frontier Rain Cape.name: Frontier Rain Cape
Frontier Rain Cape.description: Smells permanently of wet wool and campfire, the two great perfumes of the adventuring life. [Common]

Scholar's Reading Cape.name: Scholar's Reading Cape
Scholar's Reading Cape.description: Long enough to tuck your feet under while you pretend to study and actually nap. [Common]

Guild Courier's Cloak.name: Guild Courier's Cloak
Guild Courier's Cloak.description: Bears a faded guild crest that gets you into most doors and out of most fights. [Common]

Mistveil Traveling Cloak.name: Mistveil Traveling Cloak
Mistveil Traveling Cloak.description: Woven so fine it seems to blur at the edges, or you have simply been walking too long. [Common]

Mage's Warm Overcape.name: Mage's Warm Overcape
Mage's Warm Overcape.description: Keeps a caster cozy enough to hold a spell steady while everyone else's teeth chatter. [Common]

Adventurer's Utility Belt.name: Adventurer's Utility Belt
Adventurer's Utility Belt.description: Twelve pouches, eleven of them holding lint, and the twelfth exactly what you needed an hour ago. [Common]

Reinforced Tool Belt.name: Reinforced Tool Belt
Reinforced Tool Belt.description: Double-riveted to carry a full kit without the heartbreak of a mid-dungeon wardrobe failure. [Common]

Spell Component Sash.name: Spell Component Sash
Spell Component Sash.description: Loops of vials sorted by school, or by mood, depending on how the morning went. [Uncommon]

Potion Bandolier.name: Potion Bandolier
Potion Bandolier.description: Lets you grab a healing draught mid-swing, assuming you did not drink them all pre-emptively. [Uncommon]

Alchemist's Reagent Sash.name: Alchemist's Reagent Sash
Alchemist's Reagent Sash.description: Each pocket labeled in a hand only its owner can read, which is arguably the point. [Uncommon]

Throwing Knife Bandolier.name: Throwing Knife Bandolier
Throwing Knife Bandolier.description: A dozen blades within a fingertip's reach, so you always look ready even while ordering lunch. [Uncommon]

Sturdy Buckled Belt.name: Sturdy Buckled Belt
Sturdy Buckled Belt.description: Holds up your trousers with a reliability the rest of your gear frankly envies. [Common]

Quickdraw Potion Belt.name: Quickdraw Potion Belt
Quickdraw Potion Belt.description: Spring-loaded loops slap a vial into your hand faster than your party can shout for one. [Rare]

Copper Focus Circlet.name: Copper Focus Circlet
Copper Focus Circlet.description: A student's first circlet, greened at the temples and priced to match your ambitions. [Common]

Silver Focus Circlet.name: Silver Focus Circlet
Silver Focus Circlet.description: Polished enough to double as a mirror when you inevitably need to look serious mid-incantation. [Uncommon]

Manatite Focus Circlet.name: Manatite Focus Circlet
Manatite Focus Circlet.description: Set with a live manatite that glows brighter the closer you drift to overdrawing your reserves. [Rare]

Scholar's Thinking Circlet.name: Scholar's Thinking Circlet
Scholar's Thinking Circlet.description: Gently squeezes your temples into concentration, or a headache, whichever arrives first. [Uncommon]

Noble's Sapphire Brooch.name: Noble's Sapphire Brooch
Noble's Sapphire Brooch.description: The stone is real, the title it implies is very much not, and everyone quietly agrees not to check. [Common]

Manatite Earrings.name: Manatite Earrings
Manatite Earrings.description: Chips too small to enchant anything, sold as jewelry to the mages who cannot bear to waste them. [Common]

Steadymind Ear Studs.name: Steadymind Ear Studs
Steadymind Ear Studs.description: Cold little points that keep you present during long speeches you were never going to remember. [Common]

Brooch of Steady Nerves.name: Brooch of Steady Nerves
Brooch of Steady Nerves.description: Pinned over the heart, it hums when someone lies, or when you have simply had too much coffee. [Uncommon]

Gentleman's Monocle.name: Gentleman's Monocle
Gentleman's Monocle.description: Corrects vision in one eye and inflates self-regard in both, a fair trade at any price. [Uncommon]

Merchant's Signet Pin.name: Merchant's Signet Pin
Merchant's Signet Pin.description: Worn on the lapel to signal you know the going rate, which the stall owner disputes immediately. [Uncommon]

Fine Silk Gloves.name: Fine Silk Gloves
Fine Silk Gloves.description: Too delicate for a sword, perfect for the far deadlier art of a well-timed handshake. [Common]

Noble's Folding Fan.name: Noble's Folding Fan
Noble's Folding Fan.description: Snaps open for dramatic pauses and shut for even more dramatic ones, the whole point being drama. [Uncommon]

Calling Card Case.name: Calling Card Case
Calling Card Case.description: A slim silver case of cards claiming professions you have held for at most an afternoon. [Common]

Diplomat's Lapel Pin.name: Diplomat's Lapel Pin
Diplomat's Lapel Pin.description: Grants the wearer an air of authority right up until they open their mouth. [Common]

Cardsharp's Cuff.name: Cardsharp's Cuff
Cardsharp's Cuff.description: A hidden fold along the sleeve that holds one card and an ocean of plausible deniability. [Uncommon]

Courtier's Perfume Vial.name: Courtier's Perfume Vial
Courtier's Perfume Vial.description: A single dab masks three days on the road and one night in a Toad's stomach. [Common]

Yunyun's Friendship Bracelet.name: Yunyun's Friendship Bracelet
Yunyun's Friendship Bracelet.description: Hand-braided with painstaking care by a Crimson Demon who bought two, just in case she ever found a second friend. The spare has waited in her pocket for years, its knots tightened by hope and loosened by every awkward introduction that went nowhere. Whoever finally accepts it inherits a loyalty so fierce it borders on a summoning contract. [Epic]

Darkness's Modesty Kerchief.name: Darkness's Modesty Kerchief
Darkness's Modesty Kerchief.description: A noble crusader's kerchief, wrung to a permanent crumple by a woman who blushes harder at a compliment than at a battering ram. She insists she wears it for propriety, though the guild has watched her march unflinching into things that would flatten a war elephant. Tied at the collar, it steadies the sort of adventurer who charges the front line precisely because the front line hurts. [Epic]

Wiz's Slightly Cursed Muffler.name: Wiz's Slightly Cursed Muffler
Wiz's Slightly Cursed Muffler.description: A gorgeous knitted muffler from Wiz's shop, discounted heavily on account of the low, resentful humming it does after dark. Wiz swears the previous owner was a perfectly nice lich and that the whispering is merely a heating feature. It coils warm around your neck and floods you with mana, asking in return only that you never, ever sleep with it fully wrapped. [Epic]

Vanir's Complimentary Fortune Sash.name: Vanir's Complimentary Fortune Sash
Vanir's Complimentary Fortune Sash.description: Handed out free at Vanir's stall, which should have been the first and only warning anyone required. Embroidered with a fortune that comes true with unnerving reliability, always in the most inconvenient possible reading of the words. The merchant-devil profits somehow from every stroke of luck it brings you, and he will smile that mask-smile when you finally work out how. [Epic]

Emberheart Cinderstone.name: Emberheart Cinderstone
Emberheart Cinderstone.description: A coal that never cools, plucked from a hearth that burned out three centuries ago. Crimson Demons insist it hums with the memory of the first explosion, though it mostly just scorches the lining of whatever pocket you keep it in. Carry it and fire answers your call a little too eagerly. [Rare]

Glacier Tear Pendant.name: Glacier Tear Pendant
Glacier Tear Pendant.description: A single frozen droplet said to be wept by a mountain spirit who lost an argument with winter. It never melts, never warms, and makes small talk at parties refreshingly brief. Frost magic flows through the wearer like it was always meant to. [Epic]

Stormcoil Fulgurite.name: Stormcoil Fulgurite
Stormcoil Fulgurite.description: A twist of glassy stone forged where lightning struck a dungeon spire and apparently held a grudge. It crackles faintly whenever someone nearby says something stupid, which in most adventuring parties is constantly. The current it lends to your spellwork is genuinely alarming. [Rare]

Zephyr Vane of the Open Sky.name: Zephyr Vane of the Open Sky
Zephyr Vane of the Open Sky.description: A weathervane finger stolen from a ruined temple that worshipped the wind and nothing else, which explains why the temple blew away. It always points toward the nearest draft, or the nearest exit, whichever seems more urgent. Wind magic gathers around the bearer with cheerful obedience. [Rare]

Terrastone Core.name: Terrastone Core
Terrastone Core.description: A palm-sized nugget of compressed bedrock so dense it once fell straight through a merchant's cart, his floorboards, and his savings. It grounds every spell you cast in the stubborn patience of the earth itself. Also excellent for pressing flowers. [Rare]

Detonation Ember of the First Blast.name: Detonation Ember of the First Blast
Detonation Ember of the First Blast.description: A shard recovered from the very crater where, legend claims, a Crimson Demon first shouted the word Explosion and immediately collapsed from exhaustion. It thrums with a delight that is frankly worrying. Any student of Explosion magic will weep openly upon holding it. [Mythic]

Sunken Vault Keystone.name: Sunken Vault Keystone
Sunken Vault Keystone.description: The capstone of a flooded treasury whose owners drowned counting their coins, a cautionary tale nobody in Axel has taken to heart. It still smells faintly of old gold and worse decisions. Those who carry it find locked things curiously willing to open. [Legendary]

Duskbarrow Reliquary.name: Duskbarrow Reliquary
Duskbarrow Reliquary.description: A tarnished box the size of a fist, pried from a barrow so old even the grave robbers had grandchildren. It rattles when shaken, though nobody has ever found the courage to open it and check. It sharpens the wits of whoever carries it, mostly out of nervous vigilance. [Rare]

Forgotten Dynasty Signet.name: Forgotten Dynasty Signet
Forgotten Dynasty Signet.description: A royal seal from a kingdom so thoroughly forgotten that even Vanir claims he cannot recall its name, and Vanir remembers everything worth money. Pressing it into wax produces a crest no living herald recognizes, which is either impressive or embarrassing. It lends its bearer an unearned air of authority. [Legendary]

Coil of the Buried Colossus.name: Coil of the Buried Colossus
Coil of the Buried Colossus.description: A single bronze ring that was once a joint in something enormous, now sleeping under the hills where nobody sensible goes digging. It weighs far more than it should and hums with borrowed titan strength. Wear it and doors that used to require two adventurers require only one grunt. [Rare]

Ashen King's Diadem.name: Ashen King's Diadem
Ashen King's Diadem.description: A crown recovered from a throne room reduced entirely to grey powder, the king included. It sits cold on the brow and whispers advice nobody asked for. The rulership it once commanded is gone, but a stubborn residue of leadership clings to whoever dares wear it. [Legendary]

Weeping Obsidian Idol.name: Weeping Obsidian Idol
Weeping Obsidian Idol.description: A palm-sized figure of a sorrowful god carved from volcanic glass that leaks black tears in damp weather and self-pity in dry weather. Everyone who owns it reports vivid dreams of being scolded by their mother. The curse is real, but so is the dark magic it feeds into your hands. [Rare]

Hollow Crown of Regret.name: Hollow Crown of Regret
Hollow Crown of Regret.description: A circlet so light it seems to be made of the absence of metal, worn by a monarch who wished, at the end, that he had simply stayed home. It fills the wearer with a haunting clarity about every bad choice they have ever made. Grim, yes, but the intelligence it sharpens is undeniable. [Legendary]

Fetter of a Hundred Debts.name: Fetter of a Hundred Debts
Fetter of a Hundred Debts.description: A cursed iron band that Vanir swears he sold to someone else, a claim the ledgers dispute. It tightens by a fraction each time the wearer spends money they do not have, which around Axel means constantly. Those who endure its pinch grow uncannily persuasive, mostly out of desperation to clear their tab. [Rare]

Gravecold Locket.name: Gravecold Locket
Gravecold Locket.description: A silver locket that stays colder than a corpse no matter how long you clutch it, containing a portrait of someone nobody in living memory can name. Opening it drops the temperature of a room and the mood of everyone in it. The frost magic it channels is patient, quiet, and thoroughly unsettling. [Legendary]

Onestrike Bear Heartstone.name: Onestrike Bear Heartstone
Onestrike Bear Heartstone.description: The petrified heart of a bear famous for felling adventurers in a single swipe, which it did to its own hunters before someone got lucky. It still beats faintly when danger is near, a courtesy nobody enjoys. Carry it and raw savage strength floods your limbs. [Epic]

Wyvern's Frozen Eye.name: Wyvern's Frozen Eye
Wyvern's Frozen Eye.description: A gemlike orb harvested from a wyvern that died staring at something it very much wanted to eat. It tracks movement across a room on its own, which is delightful for perception and terrible for sleeping. Wearers see hidden threats with a predator's cold patience. [Rare]

Giant Toad Gullet Stone.name: Giant Toad Gullet Stone
Giant Toad Gullet Stone.description: A slick grey pearl coughed up by a Giant Toad, recovered by an adventurer who had already been swallowed twice that week and was frankly done with it. It smells of pond and regret and refuses to dry out. Improbably, it teaches the bearer a deep and hard-won knowledge of monsters. [Epic]

Dullahan's Whisper Bell.name: Dullahan's Whisper Bell
Dullahan's Whisper Bell.description: A tiny handbell whose ring nobody can actually hear, taken from a headless knight who presumably had no use for it either. It grows warm when spoken to and cold when ignored, like a very needy cat. It lends its bearer an unnatural insight into what others are truly thinking. [Rare]

Frost Dragon Marrow Bead.name: Frost Dragon Marrow Bead
Frost Dragon Marrow Bead.description: A single bead of bone marrow from a frost dragon, kept perpetually rimed in ice that no fire can touch. The merchant who sold it lost three fingers to frostbite and considered it a fair price. It grants command over frost magic that borders on rude. [Mythic]

Waystone Fracture Shard.name: Waystone Fracture Shard
Waystone Fracture Shard.description: A splinter of a shattered teleportation gate, still humming with the confused memory of a dozen destinations at once. Hold it wrong and you catch a whiff of somewhere three towns over. In trained hands it makes teleport magic feel almost reliable, which around here is a miracle. [Epic]

Pocket of Elsewhere.name: Pocket of Elsewhere
Pocket of Elsewhere.description: A small drawstring pouch whose inside opens onto a place that is emphatically not the inside of a pouch. Things dropped in tend to come back, though seldom promptly and sometimes damp. It bends the fabric of space just enough to give a spellcaster's teleportation an unfair edge. [Rare]

Hourglass of the Reluctant Moment.name: Hourglass of the Reluctant Moment
Hourglass of the Reluctant Moment.description: An hourglass whose sand slows to a crawl whenever its holder is about to do something foolish, which offers a generous window for reconsideration nobody ever uses. It has watched countless adventurers charge in anyway. The heightened awareness it grants is wasted on most, but real. [Legendary]

Goddess's Discarded Coin.name: Goddess's Discarded Coin
Goddess's Discarded Coin.description: A worn silver coin said to have slipped from Eris's own purse and rolled all the way down to the mortal world, which explains why it always lands heads for its owner and tails for everyone betting against them. Dust would sell his soul for it, cheaply. It nudges fortune a hair in your favor. [Rare]

Loaded Fate Charm.name: Loaded Fate Charm
Loaded Fate Charm.description: A trinket that hums with suspiciously convenient luck, the kind that makes card dealers nervous and priests suspicious. It has never once helped anyone win money they deserved. Fortune leans toward the bearer with a conspiratorial wink. [Legendary]

Fourleafed Manatite Clover.name: Fourleafed Manatite Clover
Fourleafed Manatite Clover.description: A four-petaled clover flash-crystallized into pure manatite by a magical accident in Wiz's shop that she still refuses to discuss. It glimmers faintly green and radiates the smug confidence of a thing that knows it is rare. Simply carrying it seems to make the whole day go better. [Legendary]

Lens of Unwanted Clarity.name: Lens of Unwanted Clarity
Lens of Unwanted Clarity.description: A monocle of ancient glass that shows every object exactly as valuable as it truly is, ruining flea markets and marriages alike. Vanir reportedly offered to buy it back at triple price the moment he understood what it did. Peering through it makes appraisal effortless and disappointment frequent. [Epic]

Soulquiet Bead.name: Soulquiet Bead
Soulquiet Bead.description: A smooth grey pebble that, held in a closed fist, silences the endless nervous chatter of the mind and leaves behind an eerie calm. Priests of the Axis Cult find it unusable, for reasons that surprise no one. It settles the soul enough to sharpen a wearer's focus considerably. [Legendary]

Diadem of Borrowed Wisdom.name: Diadem of Borrowed Wisdom
Diadem of Borrowed Wisdom.description: A slim circlet that whispers the accumulated knowledge of the scholars who wore it before, most of whom died being right about something everyone ignored. It occasionally corrects your grammar mid-sentence. The intelligence it lends is genuine, if a touch condescending. [Rare]

Whispering Skull of the Lecture Hall.name: Whispering Skull of the Lecture Hall
