Whispering Skull of the Lecture Hall.description: The polished skull of a professor so devoted to teaching that death barely interrupted him, and now he lectures anyone who picks him up on subjects they never asked about. Tuning him out is impossible; absorbing the material is inevitable. His endless droning genuinely deepens one's grasp of advanced magic. [Epic]

Cinderveil Brooch.name: Cinderveil Brooch
Cinderveil Brooch.description: A brooch of blackened silver that trails a faint shimmer of heat haze, once pinned to the cloak of a fire-priest who burned too brightly and too briefly. It keeps the wearer pleasantly warm in winter and unpleasantly warm in summer. Flame answers a little quicker for those who wear it. [Legendary]

Rimefrost Signet.name: Rimefrost Signet
Rimefrost Signet.description: A ring set with a stone of perpetual frost that fogs the moment anyone lies within arm's reach of it, a feature that has ended more negotiations than it has helped. Wiz priced it low simply to be rid of the chill. It deepens the wearer's command of frost magic. [Rare]

Galecaller's Feather.name: Galecaller's Feather
Galecaller's Feather.description: A single grey feather from a bird nobody has ever seen land, light enough to hover above an open palm on the stillest of days. It tugs gently toward any breeze, and toward trouble more gently still. Wind magic rushes to the bearer's fingers with unusual eagerness. [Rare]

Molten Core Fragment.name: Molten Core Fragment
Molten Core Fragment.description: A knuckle of stone from the heart of a volcano that a very foolish, very dead adventurer decided to keep as a souvenir. It glows dull orange in the dark and has ruined an unreasonable number of coin purses. In practiced hands it stokes explosion magic to frightening intensity. [Epic]

Thunderclap Bead.name: Thunderclap Bead
Thunderclap Bead.description: A dark glass bead that emits a tiny startling pop whenever its owner is surprised, which has gotten several adventurers thrown out of libraries. It stores the memory of a storm long since passed. The static it feeds into a spellcaster's work is small but very much felt. [Legendary]

Stoneblood Amulet.name: Stoneblood Amulet
Stoneblood Amulet.description: An amulet of red-veined granite worn by a lineage of quarry-guardians who, over generations, grew as stubborn and unmovable as their charges. It weighs on the neck like an accusation. Those who bear it find their bodies harder to tire and harder to fell. [Rare]

Everburning Coal of Keele.name: Everburning Coal of Keele
Everburning Coal of Keele.description: A lump of coal that has burned without fuel since before Axel had a name, taken from the hearth of an archmage who simply forgot to put it out. It is warm to hold and warmer to argue with. Any elemental caster who carries it finds their fire noticeably livelier. [Rare]

Tideheart Pearl.name: Tideheart Pearl
Tideheart Pearl.description: A pearl the size of a plum that sloshes faintly when tilted, as though a small private sea lives inside it. Aqua once tried to bless it and it blessed her back, which she has not stopped bragging about. It grants the bearer a fluid, restorative command over water and mana alike. [Mythic]

Voidtouched Compass.name: Voidtouched Compass
Voidtouched Compass.description: A compass whose needle refuses to point north, or south, or at anything a sane cartographer would recognize, insisting instead on a direction that does not exist on any map. Following it has led adventurers to treasure exactly as often as to bottomless holes. Its warped pull grants an uncanny knack for teleport magic. [Epic]

Phoenix Ash Vial.name: Phoenix Ash Vial
Phoenix Ash Vial.description: A stoppered vial of grey ash that grows warm and stirs on its own whenever its owner comes near death, though it has yet to explain what it intends to do about it. Wiz suspects it is genuinely priceless and refuses to touch it. It quietly bolsters the bearer's vitality against the worst days. [Mythic]

Serpent's Envy Emerald.name: Serpent's Envy Emerald
Serpent's Envy Emerald.description: A flawless green gem cut from the hoard of a jealous serpent who guarded it so long it forgot how to do anything else. It glints brighter when its owner covets something, which is often and embarrassing. It sharpens a certain silver tongue in matters of trade and deceit. [Legendary]

Mirror of Small Regrets.name: Mirror of Small Regrets
Mirror of Small Regrets.description: A hand mirror that reflects not your face but your most recent minor mistake, replaying it in tasteful loop until you learn something. It is the least popular relic in Wiz's shop and the most instructive. The self-knowledge it forces upon the bearer counts, grudgingly, as wisdom. [Legendary]

Beacon of the Lost Expedition.name: Beacon of the Lost Expedition
Beacon of the Lost Expedition.description: A small brass lantern recovered from a party that walked into a dungeon and, records indicate, is technically still in there. It glows faintly toward the way out, a mercy its original owners apparently never noticed. Carry it and the path home reveals itself with quiet certainty. [Rare]

Heart of the Sleeping Behemoth.name: Heart of the Sleeping Behemoth
Heart of the Sleeping Behemoth.description: A boulder-sized gem shrunk by unknown magic to fit a coat pocket, cut from a beast so vast that it is often mistaken for a hill and slept on by picnickers. It pulses once an hour with a beat you feel in your teeth. The raw endurance it lends its bearer is the stuff of tavern legend. [Mythic]

Aqua's Discarded Sandal.name: Aqua's Discarded Sandal
Aqua's Discarded Sandal.description: A single water-blue sandal the goddess kicked off during a tantrum in Axel and never bothered to retrieve. Axis priests have enshrined it behind glass and charge admission, insisting it still radiates divine grace, though it mostly radiates the faint smell of a goddess who walks everywhere barefoot. Touch it and you feel weirdly optimistic about a plan that will absolutely go wrong. [Mythic]

Grand Barrel of the Axis Faithful.name: Grand Barrel of the Axis Faithful
Grand Barrel of the Axis Faithful.description: The Axis Cult's holiest reliquary, which is a sake barrel they swear was blessed by Aqua herself and refills on its own, a miracle helped along by the fact that the faithful keep topping it up when nobody is looking. Presenting it at a shrine grants an unshakable, chapel-warming confidence that survives even the most reasonable objections. [Epic]

Founder's Waterlogged Hymnal.name: Founder's Waterlogged Hymnal
Founder's Waterlogged Hymnal.description: The original Axis Cult songbook, dropped in the Alcanretia hot springs so many times the ink has run into one long blue smear. The faithful sing from it anyway, having memorized every verse decades ago, and carrying it makes any sermon about the water goddess sound suspiciously convincing to the tone deaf. [Rare]

Reliquary of Alcanretia's Springs.name: Reliquary of Alcanretia's Springs
Reliquary of Alcanretia's Springs.description: A sealed crystal phial of genuine Alcanretia spring water, certified holy by the Axis Cult and certified merely warm by everyone else. It is said to purify the unclean, banish the undead, and leave your skin remarkably soft, and it delivers reliably on exactly one of those three promises. [Epic]

Axis Cult Miracle Testimonial Scroll.name: Axis Cult Miracle Testimonial Scroll
Axis Cult Miracle Testimonial Scroll.description: A scroll listing every documented Aqua miracle, most of which are property-damage incidents recategorized by a very generous scribe. Reading it aloud converts nobody, but it does convince a surprising number of people to buy you a drink so you will stop. [Legendary]

Eris's Consecrated Silver Piece.name: Eris's Consecrated Silver Piece
Eris's Consecrated Silver Piece.description: A single silver coin blessed at the Eris Church, kept polished by the modest goddess's most devoted, who insist it always lands facing fortune's favor. It does turn up on the lucky side unusually often, which the faithful call a miracle and the Axis Cult calls cheating with a weighted coin. [Epic]

Reliquary of the Modest Goddess.name: Reliquary of the Modest Goddess
Reliquary of the Modest Goddess.description: A quiet silver locket enshrined in the Eris Church, containing what the clergy describe only as a token of the goddess's grace and refuse to open on principle. Wearing it steadies the nerves and settles debts of conscience, and its dignified restraint makes the Axis Cult's barrel-worship look even worse by comparison. [Rare]

Eris Church Ledger of Returned Coins.name: Eris Church Ledger of Returned Coins
Eris Church Ledger of Returned Coins.description: A sacred account book recording every coin honest travelers have returned to its rightful owner under Eris's watch, treated by the clergy as scripture and by thieves as a shopping list. Presenting it lends a merchant or magistrate the calm authority of someone whose books are unimpeachably clean. [Rare]

Crimson Elder's Detonation Effigy.name: Crimson Elder's Detonation Effigy
Crimson Elder's Detonation Effigy.description: A carved obsidian idol of the Crimson Demon Village elder mid-incantation, one hand raised, mouth open in an eternal chuunibyou monologue. Village children rub it for luck before their first Explosion, and it hums faintly whenever anyone nearby says something needlessly dramatic. [Mythic]

Crimson Demon Naming Stone.name: Crimson Demon Naming Stone
Crimson Demon Naming Stone.description: The village's ancestral stone tablet, upon which every Crimson Demon's gloriously embarrassing chosen name is carved for eternity, including several the bearers now deeply regret. Laying a hand on it grants the courage to introduce yourself with a completely straight face and far too many syllables. [Rare]

Ember Reliquary of the Crimson Line.name: Ember Reliquary of the Crimson Line
Ember Reliquary of the Crimson Line.description: A crimson glass orb said to hold a single ember from the first Explosion the village ever cast, still glowing after generations because nobody in a Crimson Demon household is willing to be the one who lets it go out. It flares brighter in the hands of anyone about to attempt something spectacularly overpowered and slightly stupid. [Mythic]

Guildmaster's Seal of Office.name: Guildmaster's Seal of Office
Guildmaster's Seal of Office.description: The heavy brass seal the Axel Guildmaster stamps on quest contracts, commendations, and, most frequently, notices of property damage owed. Whoever carries it is treated as guild authority by every clerk in Belzerg, a privilege that comes bundled with responsibility for whatever the guild's rowdiest party breaks next. [Epic]

Adamant-Rank Adventurer Medallion.name: Adamant-Rank Adventurer Medallion
Adamant-Rank Adventurer Medallion.description: The rarest rank token the Adventurers Guild issues, awarded to the handful of adventurers who survived a demon general and filed the paperwork afterward. Flashing it at the guild counter skips every queue, opens every high-tier quest, and quietly triples the odds that the request will get you killed. [Epic]

Hall of Heroes Commemorative Tankard.name: Hall of Heroes Commemorative Tankard
Hall of Heroes Commemorative Tankard.description: A dented pewter tankard hung in the Axel Guild hall, engraved with the names of adventurers who saved the town and were never quite reimbursed for it. Drinking from it on quest night is a guild tradition, and doing so somehow makes even a doomed party feel like the heroes the plaque says they are. [Rare]

Quest Board Master Key.name: Quest Board Master Key
Quest Board Master Key.description: The single iron key that unlocks the glass case over the Adventurers Guild's high-bounty board, kept on a cord around the receptionist's neck and guarded more fiercely than the vault. Holding it grants first pick of the day's most lucrative and least survivable postings, a privilege every seasoned adventurer has learned to fear. [Rare]

Beldia's Recovered Cravat.name: Beldia's Recovered Cravat
Beldia's Recovered Cravat.description: The immaculate lace cravat worn by the Dullahan general Beldia, recovered from the battlefield without a single wrinkle, because a headless knight has ample time to worry about his collar. Nobles bid absurd sums for it, convinced its impeccable knot lends the wearer the poise of a monster who kept his dignity right up until he lost his head. [Epic]

Winter Shogun's Shattered Warhorn.name: Winter Shogun's Shattered Warhorn
Winter Shogun's Shattered Warhorn.description: The great frost-rimed horn the Winter Shogun sounded to summon his blizzard, cracked clean down the middle when the general fell and never able to hold a note since. It still breathes a curl of cold fog when raised, enough to make a tavern go quiet and remember the season the whole town nearly froze. [Epic]

Verdia's Reclaimed Bridle Bell.name: Verdia's Reclaimed Bridle Bell
Verdia's Reclaimed Bridle Bell.description: A single silver bell from the bridle of the Dullahan Verdia's nightmarish steed, still faintly ringing on windless nights as if the horse were circling back for its rider. Adventurers keep it as proof they faced a demon general's cavalry and lived, and its cold chime is said to spook lesser undead into keeping a respectful distance. [Rare]

Hans's Congealed Signet.name: Hans's Congealed Signet
Hans's Congealed Signet.description: The command signet of Hans the poison sludge general, preserved forever in a translucent lump of the very slime it once ordered around. It is disgusting to hold, impossible to clean, and weirdly effective at convincing an alchemist you know exactly what you are doing with something that should not be touched. [Epic]

Sylvia's Chimera Fang Trophy.name: Sylvia's Chimera Fang Trophy
Sylvia's Chimera Fang Trophy.description: A curved fang taken from the chimera form of the general Sylvia after her reign of cheerful menace ended, mounted on a plaque nobody in the Royal Capital likes to look at directly. It radiates the unsettling charm of a monster who smiled the whole time, and steadies the hand of anyone forced to fight something far above their weight. [Rare]

General's Cracked Devil Mask Shard.name: General's Cracked Devil Mask Shard
General's Cracked Devil Mask Shard.description: A jagged fragment of the ornate mask a certain devil wore during his tenure as a Demon King general, before he decided retail was less exhausting than conquest. It occasionally whispers unsolicited predictions in a smug voice, most of which are annoyingly accurate and all of which end with a suggestion to buy something. [Epic]

Rivet of the Mobile Fortress Destroyer.name: Rivet of the Mobile Fortress Destroyer
Rivet of the Mobile Fortress Destroyer.description: A single fist-sized iron rivet salvaged from the walking fortress Destroyer after Axel's adventurers brought it down, sold as a keepsake by vendors who claim to have a thousand of them. Genuine or not, the weight of it in your palm is a humbling reminder of the day a whole town's amateurs stopped an apocalypse by accident. [Rare]

Princess Iris's Gifted Brooch.name: Princess Iris's Gifted Brooch
Princess Iris's Gifted Brooch.description: A dainty enameled brooch the young princess of Belzerg presses upon adventurers she has decided are heroes, whether they want the honor or the attention it attracts. Wearing it opens doors at court and closes them at every tavern that fears the tax collectors such favor tends to bring. [Rare]

Royal Charter Seal of Belzerg.name: Royal Charter Seal of Belzerg
Royal Charter Seal of Belzerg.description: A wax-and-gold charter bearing the crown's authority, granting its holder the right to requisition, command, and be blamed for outcomes in the kingdom's name. Officials snap to attention at the sight of it, right up until they read the fine print about who pays for the damages. [Epic]

Crown Loyalty Medallion.name: Crown Loyalty Medallion
Crown Loyalty Medallion.description: A heavy gold medallion awarded to those who served the throne of Belzerg with distinction, or at least survived doing so on the record. It commands instant respect from the Royal Capital's guards and instant suspicion from anyone who knows how these are usually earned. [Rare]

Noble House Reparations Deed.name: Noble House Reparations Deed
Noble House Reparations Deed.description: A gilded legal deed by which a grateful noble family signed over a small fortune to the adventurers who saved their estate, or possibly the ones who accidentally set fire to it and then put it out. Framed and carried as a boast, it opens the purses of lesser nobles eager not to look stingy by comparison. [Epic]

Wiz's Definitely Not Cursed Music Box.name: Wiz's Definitely Not Cursed Music Box
Wiz's Definitely Not Cursed Music Box.description: A lovely antique music box from Wiz's shop, sold at a heartbreaking loss with her sincere assurance that the previous owner's misfortunes were entirely coincidental. It plays a haunting lullaby, occasionally on its own at three in the morning, and Wiz would really appreciate it if you did not bring it back. [Rare]

Vanir's Devil Merchant Guarantee Seal.name: Vanir's Devil Merchant Guarantee Seal
Vanir's Devil Merchant Guarantee Seal.description: A brass stamp Vanir presses onto his sales contracts, guaranteeing satisfaction under terms so precisely worded that dissatisfaction is legally impossible. Merchants who examine it come away convinced the devil has never technically told a lie, which is somehow more alarming than if he had. [Epic]

Wiz's Unsellable Warranty Lantern.name: Wiz's Unsellable Warranty Lantern
Wiz's Unsellable Warranty Lantern.description: A magnificent enchanted lantern from Wiz's shop that burns without oil, casts a warm undying glow, and cannot be sold because it also softly narrates the regrets of anyone standing in its light. Wiz keeps trying to move it; Vanir keeps quietly moving it back to the shelf where the customers can find it. [Epic]

Vanir's Ledger of Guaranteed Regret.name: Vanir's Ledger of Guaranteed Regret
Vanir's Ledger of Guaranteed Regret.description: A slim black account book in which Vanir records every future misfortune he intends to profit from, written in advance because to a fortune-devil the past and future are the same tidy column. Reading your name in it is deeply upsetting, though Vanir cheerfully notes that a small consulting fee can adjust the details. [Epic]

Fragment of the Sage's Staff.name: Fragment of the Sage's Staff
Fragment of the Sage's Staff.description: A splinter of blackened wood said to be all that remains of a legendary sage's staff, sold with breathless reverence by three separate merchants who each own the only genuine piece. Real or not, holding it makes a mage feel the quiet weight of a tradition far older and far more dignified than anything they have personally accomplished. [Mythic]

Vial of the Useless Goddess's Tears.name: Vial of the Useless Goddess's Tears
Vial of the Useless Goddess's Tears.description: A tiny stoppered vial the Axis Cult swears contains the actual tears Aqua shed over the state of her worshippers, harvested during one of her many public sobbing fits in Axel. The clergy call it a font of purest divine sorrow; skeptics call it a vial of a goddess crying because she is broke again, and neither side can prove the other wrong. [Mythic]

Emblem of the Reluctant Party.name: Emblem of the Reluctant Party
Emblem of the Reluctant Party.description: A small brass emblem struck to commemorate Belzerg's most infamous adventuring party, depicting four figures pointedly facing four different directions. Guild veterans hand it to newcomers as a warning that the strongest bonds are forged by people who cannot stand each other but keep showing up anyway. [Rare]

Goddess-Blessed Debt Relief Writ.name: Goddess-Blessed Debt Relief Writ
Goddess-Blessed Debt Relief Writ.description: A holy writ, allegedly blessed by a goddess, declaring the bearer's debts spiritually forgiven, a claim no bank in Belzerg has ever once honored. Adventurers carry it not for the miracle but for the small comfort of waving it at a creditor before paying anyway, which the Eris Church gently discourages and the Axis Cult heartily endorses. [Epic]

The Party Fund Strongbox.name: The Party Fund Strongbox
The Party Fund Strongbox.description: A dented iron strongbox with three separate locks, invented by every exhausted party treasurer who ever tried to keep the group's earnings safe from the group. It is a legend among adventurers precisely because no one has ever managed to keep it full for more than a single night in town. [Rare]

Reliquary of the Devil King's Fall.name: Reliquary of the Devil King's Fall
Reliquary of the Devil King's Fall.description: An ornate sealed casket the guilds commissioned to hold a shard of the Demon King's shattered throne, to be opened only on the day his castle finally falls. It sits in the Axel hall gathering dust and bets, a solemn promise that the ridiculous, broke, warm little kingdom will one day finish the job it keeps almost dying to start. [Rare]

Effigy of the Water Goddess.name: Effigy of the Water Goddess
Effigy of the Water Goddess.description: A hand-carved wooden effigy of Aqua that the Axis Cult distributes to new converts, rendered flattering enough to be recognizable and unflattering enough that she would sulk for a week. Set on a shelf it is said to bless a household with clean water and good fortune, and it reliably delivers the water at least when it rains through the roof. [Epic]

Eris Church Luck Offering Bowl.name: Eris Church Luck Offering Bowl
Eris Church Luck Offering Bowl.description: A modest silver bowl kept at the Eris Church altar, into which the faithful drop a coin and a quiet wish for fortune to smile on their humble endeavors. The clergy insist the goddess rewards sincerity, not sums, a doctrine the Axis Cult across town finds financially baffling. [Rare]

Axel Founders Commemorative Plaque.name: Axel Founders Commemorative Plaque
Axel Founders Commemorative Plaque.description: A weathered bronze plaque marking the founding of Axel, the beginner town, listing names of adventurers long retired to running its inns and stalls. Guild hopefuls touch it for luck on their first quest, drawing a little steadiness from the reminder that even legends started out broke, clueless, and fighting Giant Toads for lunch money. [Rare]

Rusted Scrap Iron.name: Rusted Scrap Iron
Rusted Scrap Iron.description: Salvaged from a fence some adventurer flattened during a Giant Toad panic, and worth roughly one copper on a good day. [Common]

Iron Ore.name: Iron Ore
Iron Ore.description: A dull grey lump the Axel mines cough up by the cartload, entirely unremarkable until a smith gets impatient with it. [Common]

Refined Steel Ingot.name: Refined Steel Ingot
Refined Steel Ingot.description: Bar stock hammered flat by an honest guild smith, the kind of thing you actually want between you and a Beginner's Bear. [Common]

Silver Ore.name: Silver Ore
Silver Ore.description: Prized by jewelers and by every acolyte convinced the undead flinch at anything shiny. [Common]

Mithril Ore.name: Mithril Ore
Mithril Ore.description: Light, blue, and expensive enough that Vanir smiles the very second you walk through his door with it. [Uncommon]

Adamantite Shard.name: Adamantite Shard
Adamantite Shard.description: So absurdly hard that most Axel forges simply give up and use it as a very heavy paperweight. [Rare]

Orichalcum Nugget.name: Orichalcum Nugget
Orichalcum Nugget.description: A faintly humming golden ore that legends insist was left over from the gods, though Eris politely declines to confirm this. [Rare]

Copper Ore.name: Copper Ore
Copper Ore.description: Cheap, soft, and the traditional first purchase of every apprentice who will inevitably ruin it. [Common]

Tin Ingot.name: Tin Ingot
Tin Ingot.description: Nobody is excited about tin, but every bronze pot in Axel quietly owes it a debt. [Common]

Cold Iron Billet.name: Cold Iron Billet
Cold Iron Billet.description: Worked at low heat and whispered to bite at spirits, which is either ancient smithing wisdom or a very good sales pitch. [Common]

Common Healing Herb.name: Common Healing Herb
Common Healing Herb.description: The green weed every novice alchemist mashes first, growing thick along every road out of Axel like it wants to be found. [Common]

Bitter Mana Blossom.name: Bitter Mana Blossom
Bitter Mana Blossom.description: A pale flower that tastes like regret and brews into potions no wizard will ever admit to enjoying. [Common]

Crimson Fireweed.name: Crimson Fireweed
Crimson Fireweed.description: Harvested near the Crimson Demon Village, where it apparently absorbed the local flair for bursting into flame unprompted. [Common]

Alcanretia Spring Moss.name: Alcanretia Spring Moss
Alcanretia Spring Moss.description: Scraped from the hot spring stones, it reeks of sulfur and refuses to stop being faintly holy about it. [Common]

Nightshade Sprig.name: Nightshade Sprig
Nightshade Sprig.description: Deadly to eat, wonderful for poisons, and exactly the sort of thing rogues buy while making unconvincing eye contact. [Common]

Dawnbloom Petal.name: Dawnbloom Petal
Dawnbloom Petal.description: Opens only at sunrise, which makes gathering it a cruel joke on adventurers who drank too much the night before. [Common]

Sunpetal Clover.name: Sunpetal Clover
Sunpetal Clover.description: A mild restorative herb so common that herbalists mostly use it to pad out a thin gathering basket. [Common]

Deepwood Fungus.name: Deepwood Fungus
Deepwood Fungus.description: A glowing cave mushroom that is either a potent reagent or the last thing you ever eat, depending on your appraisal skill. [Common]

Giant Toad Hide.name: Giant Toad Hide
Giant Toad Hide.description: Thick, slimy, and instantly recognizable to anyone in Axel who has ever been swallowed whole and lived to complain about it. [Common]

Giant Toad Meat Cut.name: Giant Toad Meat Cut
Giant Toad Meat Cut.description: Surprisingly tender once you get past the fact that it recently tried to eat you. [Common]

Goblin Fang.name: Goblin Fang
Goblin Fang.description: A crooked little tooth strung on cords by adventurers who want to look tougher than their bounty count suggests. [Common]

Wolf Pelt.name: Wolf Pelt
Wolf Pelt.description: Warm, sheddable, and the reliable bread and butter of every fur trader working the Axel frontier. [Common]

Kobold Horn.name: Kobold Horn
Kobold Horn.description: Ground into powder for reagents, though the kobold it came from would prefer you found a different hobby. [Common]

Slime Jelly.name: Slime Jelly
Slime Jelly.description: A quivering blob that alchemists swear is useful and everyone else swears is impossible to get out of a satchel. [Common]

Undead Ash.name: Undead Ash
Undead Ash.description: The grey residue an Axis Cult acolyte leaves behind after enthusiastically purifying something that was minding its own business. [Common]

Wyvern Talon.name: Wyvern Talon
Wyvern Talon.description: Curved, black, and heavy enough that owning one implies you either fought a wyvern or looted a much braver corpse. [Uncommon]

One-Hit Bear Claw.name: One-Hit Bear Claw
One-Hit Bear Claw.description: A trophy from Axel's most infamous rookie-killer, sold with the strong recommendation that you not go fetch another. [Common]

Dragon Scale.name: Dragon Scale
Dragon Scale.description: One iridescent plate that costs more than a house and comes with the sobering knowledge of where the rest of the dragon is. [Rare]

Frog Spawn Cluster.name: Frog Spawn Cluster
Frog Spawn Cluster.description: Fished out of the Axel wetlands and used in tinctures, assuming you can convince anyone it was worth wading in for. [Common]

Raw Beast Hide.name: Raw Beast Hide
Raw Beast Hide.description: Straight off the carcass and still arguing with the tanner about it, this is the starting stock of every leatherworker. [Common]

Tanned Beast Leather.name: Tanned Beast Leather
Tanned Beast Leather.description: Supple, clean, and finally something a tailor can work without wrinkling their nose the entire time. [Common]

Spun Wool Thread.name: Spun Wool Thread
Spun Wool Thread.description: Humble stuff, but it holds together most of the adventuring wardrobe you see falling apart mid-quest. [Common]

Bolt of Coarse Linen.name: Bolt of Coarse Linen
Bolt of Coarse Linen.description: Scratchy enough to build character, which is what merchants say when they mean it is cheap. [Common]

Enchanted Silk.name: Enchanted Silk
Enchanted Silk.description: Woven with a faint shimmer that makes mage robes cost triple and impress absolutely no one at the Guild bar. [Common]

Griffon Down Tuft.name: Griffon Down Tuft
Griffon Down Tuft.description: Feather-light insulation plucked at considerable personal risk, mostly for cloaks worn by people who never left town. [Uncommon]

Rough Timber.name: Rough Timber
Rough Timber.description: Freshly felled logs from the Axel woods, still leaking sap onto whatever cart is unlucky enough to carry them. [Common]

Seasoned Oak Plank.name: Seasoned Oak Plank
Seasoned Oak Plank.description: Dried, straight, and reliable, which in carpentry counts as thrilling. [Common]

Enchanted Lumber.name: Enchanted Lumber
Enchanted Lumber.description: Wood that hums faintly and refuses to rot, sold by Wiz with a slightly nervous smile about where it came from. [Common]

Cut Granite Block.name: Cut Granite Block
Cut Granite Block.description: Quarried, squared, and heavy enough to remind every apprentice exactly why masons charge what they do. [Common]

Crimson Village Charwood.name: Crimson Village Charwood
Crimson Village Charwood.description: Scorched hardwood from the Crimson Demon lands, priced for its rarity and its lingering whiff of dramatic monologue. [Common]

Cloudy Mana Shard.name: Cloudy Mana Shard
Cloudy Mana Shard.description: A fogged little crystal that leaks magic sluggishly, perfect for enchantments no one is willing to pay full price for. [Common]

Ember Crystal.name: Ember Crystal
Ember Crystal.description: Warm to the touch and popular with wannabe Crimson Demons who want fire magic without the years of study. [Common]

Tempest Shard.name: Tempest Shard
Tempest Shard.description: Crackles faintly when the weather turns, which enchanters find useful and laundry lines find infuriating. [Common]

Verdant Focus Gem.name: Verdant Focus Gem
Verdant Focus Gem.description: A green stone said to steady a caster's nerves, though it has never once helped anyone survive an Explosion recital. [Common]

Tidewater Opal.name: Tidewater Opal
Tidewater Opal.description: A cool blue gem that Aqua insists is sacred and every appraiser insists is merely pretty. [Common]

Grave Onyx.name: Grave Onyx
Grave Onyx.description: A black stone dug from old barrows, favored by exactly the kind of mage the Eris Church files paperwork about. [Common]

Rare Salt Crystals.name: Rare Salt Crystals
Rare Salt Crystals.description: Mined coarse and glittering, the one ingredient that turns Giant Toad stew from survival food into something you brag about. [Common]

Belzerg Peppercorns.name: Belzerg Peppercorns
Belzerg Peppercorns.description: Small, fierce, and responsible for at least half the tears shed in the Adventurers Guild kitchen. [Common]

Axel Field Cabbage.name: Axel Field Cabbage
Axel Field Cabbage.description: A stout local vegetable that survives frost, drought, and the occasional stampede of fleeing novices. [Common]

Highland Butter Churn.name: Highland Butter Churn
Highland Butter Churn.description: Rich yellow butter from the hill pastures, hoarded by every chef who has tasted the alternative. [Common]

Wild Boar Loin.name: Wild Boar Loin
Wild Boar Loin.description: A prime cut from a beast that gored two adventurers before dinner, which the cook feels adds flavor. [Common]

Axel Hops.name: Axel Hops
Axel Hops.description: Bitter green cones grown behind the tavern, the soul of every mediocre ale the Guild pretends to enjoy. [Common]

Alcanretia Spring Water.name: Alcanretia Spring Water
Alcanretia Spring Water.description: Bottled from the holy hot springs, faintly warm, faintly divine, and faintly smelling of a hundred bathing pilgrims. [Common]

Malted Barley Sack.name: Malted Barley Sack
Malted Barley Sack.description: The honest backbone of any brew, sold by the sack to brewers who have long since stopped counting the grains. [Common]

Wild Yeast Culture.name: Wild Yeast Culture
Wild Yeast Culture.description: A jar of temperamental froth that turns sugar into ale or into a smell the neighbors report to the Guild. [Common]

Fermented Toad Mash.name: Fermented Toad Mash
Fermented Toad Mash.description: An Axel specialty best described as an acquired courage rather than an acquired taste. [Common]

Pure Mana Distillate.name: Pure Mana Distillate
Pure Mana Distillate.description: A single vial of concentrated magic so potent that even holding it makes a wizard feel briefly, dangerously competent. [Common]

Concentrated Healing Essence.name: Concentrated Healing Essence
Concentrated Healing Essence.description: Reduced from a barrel of herbs to one glowing drop, the sort of reagent Wiz keeps on a high shelf away from customers. [Common]

Dragon's Heartblood.name: Dragon's Heartblood
Dragon's Heartblood.description: A sealed flask of still-warm crimson that hums with borrowed ferocity and terrifies every alchemist assigned to it. [Rare]

Mid-Grade Healing Draught.name: Mid-Grade Healing Draught
Mid-Grade Healing Draught.description: A respectable middle-shelf remedy that closes the gap between the potion that barely works and the one you cannot afford. [Common]

Field Medic's Healing Salve.name: Field Medic's Healing Salve
Field Medic's Healing Salve.description: A greasy herbal paste that stitches cuts closed reasonably well and smells like a compost heap for exactly the same reason. [Common]

Concentrated Mana Elixir.name: Concentrated Mana Elixir
Concentrated Mana Elixir.description: A vial of eye-watering blue concentrate that refills a wizard fast enough to make one more terrible decision. [Uncommon]

Wizard's Blue Tonic.name: Wizard's Blue Tonic
Wizard's Blue Tonic.description: Tastes like ink and regret, but a mage will down it gladly for the mana it restores before the next chant. [Common]

Panacea Tablet.name: Panacea Tablet
Panacea Tablet.description: A chalky cure-all lozenge that clears poison, fever, and mild curses, though it does nothing for a wounded ego. [Uncommon]

Petrification Reversal Tincture.name: Petrification Reversal Tincture
Petrification Reversal Tincture.description: Splash this on a friend who got turned to stone and they crumble back to flesh, usually mid-complaint. [Common]

Paralysis Cure Powder.name: Paralysis Cure Powder
Paralysis Cure Powder.description: A pinch under the nose unlocks frozen limbs, restoring your full and hard-won ability to run away. [Common]

Bull's Strength Draught.name: Bull's Strength Draught
Bull's Strength Draught.description: One gulp and your arms remember they lift things, for about as long as the bull-shaped bottle suggests. [Common]

Cat's Grace Tonic.name: Cat's Grace Tonic
Cat's Grace Tonic.description: Drink it and your footwork turns nimble and smug, right up until the effect ends and you trip on nothing. [Common]

Owl's Wisdom Infusion.name: Owl's Wisdom Infusion
Owl's Wisdom Infusion.description: A steeped brew that sharpens your judgment briefly, long enough to notice the party's plan is a bad one. [Common]

Sharpshooter's Steady Draught.name: Sharpshooter's Steady Draught
Sharpshooter's Steady Draught.description: Steadies the hands and the breath so your next few arrows land where you aimed instead of where you prayed. [Common]

Duelist's Focus Cordial.name: Duelist's Focus Cordial
Duelist's Focus Cordial.description: A sip clears the nerves before a bout, tightening your blade work while the warm fizz lasts. [Common]

Potion of Fleeting Invisibility.name: Potion of Fleeting Invisibility
Potion of Fleeting Invisibility.description: Turns you gloriously unseen for a short spell, which is plenty of time to walk into a very visible wall. [Common]

Water-Walking Tonic.name: Water-Walking Tonic
Water-Walking Tonic.description: Lets you stroll across rivers like a smug messiah until it wears off halfway across, as it always does. [Common]

Night-Vision Eyedrops.name: Night-Vision Eyedrops
Night-Vision Eyedrops.description: A couple of stinging drops turn pitch dark into murky green, ideal for spotting the monster that already saw you. [Common]

Featherfall Philter.name: Featherfall Philter
Featherfall Philter.description: Drink before falling and you drift down like a leaf, giving you ample time to reconsider the jump. [Common]

Fire Resistance Balm.name: Fire Resistance Balm
Fire Resistance Balm.description: Smear it on before facing anything flaming, and the burns become merely uncomfortable rather than terminal. [Common]

Scroll of Recall.name: Scroll of Recall
Scroll of Recall.description: Tear it and snap home to your last inn, a mercy for adventurers who wandered too far chasing loot. [Common]

Scroll of Warding Barrier.name: Scroll of Warding Barrier
Scroll of Warding Barrier.description: Read the incantation and a shimmering dome shields the party, assuming someone remembered to stand inside it. [Common]

Scroll of Lesser Explosion.name: Scroll of Lesser Explosion
Scroll of Lesser Explosion.description: A budget blast for people who want the boom without the coma, which a certain archwizard finds deeply insulting. [Common]

Scroll of Frost Nova.name: Scroll of Frost Nova
Scroll of Frost Nova.description: Unrolls into a burst of biting cold that freezes everything nearby, including the ally who leaned in to read it. [Common]

Scroll of Guiding Light.name: Scroll of Guiding Light
Scroll of Guiding Light.description: Conjures a floating orb of daylight that follows you around, judging your every step through the dungeon. [Common]

Alchemist's Fire Flask.name: Alchemist's Fire Flask
Alchemist's Fire Flask.description: Hurl it and the glass shatters into clinging flame, so mind your footing and your eyebrows. [Common]

Frost Grenade.name: Frost Grenade
Frost Grenade.description: A thrown crystal that bursts into a cloud of freezing shards, slowing pursuers and any friend standing too close. [Common]

Caltrop Pouch.name: Caltrop Pouch
Caltrop Pouch.description: Scatter a handful behind you and listen for the satisfying yelp of whatever was chasing your party. [Common]

Flash Powder Bomb.name: Flash Powder Bomb
Flash Powder Bomb.description: One blinding pop buys a few precious seconds to flee, provided you closed your own eyes first. [Common]

Sticky Tar Flask.name: Sticky Tar Flask
Sticky Tar Flask.description: Splash it at a charging monster's feet and watch it stagger, glued to the ground and furious about it. [Common]

Axel Tavern Beef Stew.name: Axel Tavern Beef Stew
Axel Tavern Beef Stew.description: The guild tavern's house stew, hearty and honest, and the only warm meal an adventurer can afford after a bad quest. [Common]

Giant Toad Steak Platter.name: Giant Toad Steak Platter
Giant Toad Steak Platter.description: A generous slab of pan-seared toad from the very beasts that swallowed you last week, so consider it revenge served hot. [Common]

Crimson Demon Firepepper Skewers.name: Crimson Demon Firepepper Skewers
Crimson Demon Firepepper Skewers.description: Village street food so aggressively spicy that eating a full skewer without dramatic weeping is a rite of passage. [Common]

Succubus Cafe Cream Parfait.name: Succubus Cafe Cream Parfait
Succubus Cafe Cream Parfait.description: A layered dessert from the town's most discreet cafe, sweet enough to make grown adventurers blush over spoons. [Common]

Sun-Baked Trail Biscuit.name: Sun-Baked Trail Biscuit
Sun-Baked Trail Biscuit.description: A rock-hard travel biscuit best softened in soup, or thrown, since it holds an edge either way. [Common]

Solid Gold Frog Idol.name: Solid Gold Frog Idol
Solid Gold Frog Idol.description: A fist-sized golden toad recovered from a flooded ruin, grinning as if it knows exactly how much it will fetch. [Rare]

Uncut Belzerg Sapphire.name: Uncut Belzerg Sapphire
Uncut Belzerg Sapphire.description: A rough blue stone the size of a plum, worthless to look at and priceless to anyone who owns a lapidary. [Rare]

Devil King's Coronation Goblet.name: Devil King's Coronation Goblet
Devil King's Coronation Goblet.description: An ornate chalice of black gold looted from a general's hoard, still faintly smelling of expensive wine and worse intentions. [Rare]

Portrait of a Smug Noble.name: Portrait of a Smug Noble
Portrait of a Smug Noble.description: A gilt-framed oil painting of some long-dead lord whose self-satisfied smirk somehow raises the asking price. [Rare]

Filigreed Reliquary Box.name: Filigreed Reliquary Box
Filigreed Reliquary Box.description: A silver keepsake casket worked with delicate scrollwork, empty of relics but heavy with resale value. [Rare]

String of Deepwater Pearls.name: String of Deepwater Pearls
String of Deepwater Pearls.description: A strand of lustrous pearls fished from perilous depths, the kind of loot that pays a party's tab for a season. [Rare]

Bouquet of Axel Wildflowers.name: Bouquet of Axel Wildflowers
Bouquet of Axel Wildflowers.description: A cheerful bundle of roadside blooms, the sincerest gift an adventurer can afford after paying the guild fees. [Common]

Box of Alcanretia Hot Spring Sweets.name: Box of Alcanretia Hot Spring Sweets
Box of Alcanretia Hot Spring Sweets.description: Sticky steamed confections from the spa town, wrapped prettily and guaranteed to survive one week in a backpack. [Common]

Aqua-Brand Bottled Blessing Water.name: Aqua-Brand Bottled Blessing Water
Aqua-Brand Bottled Blessing Water.description: A goddess-endorsed bottle of ordinary spring water with a self-drawn label promising miracles it cannot legally deliver. [Common]

Novelty Frog Plushie.name: Novelty Frog Plushie
Novelty Frog Plushie.description: A soft toy modeled on the very toads that terrorize Axel, sold as adorable to people who have never met one. [Common]

Crimson Demon Poetry Anthology.name: Crimson Demon Poetry Anthology
Crimson Demon Poetry Anthology.description: A slim volume of dramatically titled verse, best gifted to someone who enjoys watching a poet strike a pose mid-recital. [Common]

Heart-Shaped Chocolate Box.name: Heart-Shaped Chocolate Box
Heart-Shaped Chocolate Box.description: A blushing seasonal gift of assorted chocolates, delivered with the desperate hope it will not be misread entirely. [Common]

Eris Grand Banknote.name: Eris Grand Banknote
Eris Grand Banknote.description: A crisp high-denomination note bearing the coin goddess's serene face, worth a fat stack of the coins named after her.

Foreign Trade Sovereign.name: Foreign Trade Sovereign
Foreign Trade Sovereign.description: A heavy gold coin from some distant kingdom, accepted grudgingly by merchants who weigh it twice before smiling.

Rejected Holy Sword.name: Rejected Holy Sword
Rejected Holy Sword.description: A genuine holy sword with excellent steel and a personality. It was meant for a hero and says so, refuses to glow on command, and offers commentary on its wielder's form. Devils and undead still fear it. It is waiting for someone better and is not subtle about it. [Rare]

Healer's Satchel.name: Healer's Satchel
Healer's Satchel.description: A worn leather satchel of salves, splints, and chalk-marked vials, organized by a system only its owner understands. Every clinic in Axel issues one, and every healer swears theirs is the good one. [Uncommon]

Bonesetter's Gloves.name: Bonesetter's Gloves
Bonesetter's Gloves.description: Thin enchanted gloves that feel a fracture before the patient does and guide the healer's magic straight to it. Patients still scream; they just scream for less time. [Rare]

Lifewood Mending Staff.name: Lifewood Mending Staff
Lifewood Mending Staff.description: Cut from a tree that grew back every branch anyone ever broke off it, this staff makes healing magic take faster and hold longer. It heals undead patients as gently as living ones, which has made it popular in one particular Axel magic shop. [Epic]

Kindlewright's Gauntlets.name: Kindlewright's Gauntlets
Kindlewright's Gauntlets.description: Soot-black gauntlets lined with salamander hide, made for mages who throw fire with their hands and would like to keep the hands. Every pair smells faintly of a tavern kitchen fire. [Rare]

Undertow Rod.name: Undertow Rod
Undertow Rod.description: A driftwood rod that drips constantly and pulls toward the nearest river. Water magic cast through it grips harder and drags deeper. Innkeepers ask that it be left outside. [Rare]

Skyreaver Circlet.name: Skyreaver Circlet
Skyreaver Circlet.description: A thin silver circlet that hums whenever a storm is within a day's walk. Wind mages who wear it cut with the air instead of merely pushing it. [Rare]

Thunderbrand Wand.name: Thunderbrand Wand
Thunderbrand Wand.description: A wand cut from a tree struck nine times in one storm, its grain still scorched in a branching pattern. Lightning cast through it hits harder and chains farther. Do not wave it in the rain. [Rare]

Quarrymother Staff.name: Quarrymother Staff
Quarrymother Staff.description: A staff of petrified oak capped with raw granite, beloved by Grausten quarry crews and earth mages alike. The ground listens to it the way dogs listen to a good shepherd. [Rare]

Explosion.name: Explosion
Explosion.description: Unleash a single catastrophic blast of raw arcane force capable of erasing a building. The signature spell of the school's true believers, a club with very few living members and one very famous one. Costs 100 Mana. Targets in the blast radius take massive damage. If the cast empties your pool you collapse: no movement, no casting, no dignity, until you rest. With Mana to spare you stay standing, smoking and smug.

Steal.name: Steal
Steal.description: A thief technique taught by a certain masked goddess-in-disguise. On a successful thievery check one RANDOM item leaves the target and appears in your hand: no contact, no damage, works at a short distance, and works on bosses, generals, and gods. Luck runs the show, exactly as in the source material: the luckier the thief, the easier the check and the better the item; the unluckier, the more embarrassing the result. The narrator picks the item and the player does not.

Drain Touch.name: Drain Touch
Drain Touch.description: Siphon life force or mana from a target on contact and optionally transfer it to an ally. Deals modest damage to the target and restores the caster or an ally. Beloved by adventurers too cheap to buy mana potions. Any adventurer can unlock it from character level 5, no teacher needed; each successful use is practice toward the drain touch skill.

Sacred Turn Undead.name: Sacred Turn Undead
Sacred Turn Undead.description: Channel divine power to purify and obliterate undead in a radius. Devastating against skeletons, zombies, and liches. At high power it also purifies nearby scenery, water, and occasionally allies who did not consent, for comedic effect. Deals heavy damage to undead-type enemies only.

Bind.name: Bind
Bind.description: A crusader restraint technique: lock down a single enemy and hold it in place, forcing its attacks onto the crusader instead of the party. The target cannot easily disengage until the crusader falls or releases it. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Nature's Beauty.name: Nature's Beauty
Nature's Beauty.description: A goddess-tier party trick: purify water, sober up a drunk, or perform minor miracles that impress everyone and solve nothing about the rent. Non-combat utility with maximum showmanship.

Create Water.name: Create Water
Create Water.description: Conjure a surge of purified water from ambient moisture, drenching a target area. Useful for extinguishing fires, cleaning, filling containers, and making a mess. Purified water from a divine caster is devastating to undead and slime-type enemies. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next divine magic action.

Heal.name: Heal
Heal.description: Channel divine energy into a wounded ally, knitting flesh and bone. The healing is genuine and effective; the caster may feel residual sympathy pain. A skilled priest can heal significant wounds in seconds. Significantly increases the effectiveness of your next healing action.

Resurrection.name: Resurrection
Resurrection.description: Call a recently departed soul back from the afterlife and restore their body. This is high-level divine magic that only powerful priests and goddesses can perform. The process is exhausting, expensive, and the resurrected individual typically wakes up confused and embarrassed. Massively increases the effectiveness of your next divine restoration action.

Create Fire.name: Create Fire
Create Fire.description: Produce a controlled burst of magical flame from your hands, ranging from a campfire-sized flicker to a torrent depending on skill. Useful in combat, for warmth, for cooking, and for property damage. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next fire-type attack action.

Freeze.name: Freeze
Freeze.description: Flash-freeze moisture in the air around a target, encasing them in ice or creating treacherous footing. Effective against water-based and fire-based enemies. The ice is genuine and takes time to thaw. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next ice-type attack action.

Lightning.name: Lightning
Lightning.description: Call down a bolt of electrical energy on a target. Fast, dramatic, and difficult to dodge. Particularly effective against armored targets and constructs. The thunderclap is a nice bonus. Significantly increases the effectiveness of your next lightning-type attack action.

Light of Saber.name: Light of Saber
Light of Saber.description: Condense magical energy into a blade of pure arcane force, slashing through physical and magical defenses alike. A high-level offensive spell favored by versatile mages, especially Crimson Demons who consider it a perfectly acceptable backup for days when Explosion is impractical. Greatly increases the effectiveness of your next arcane melee attack action.

Detect Trap.name: Detect Trap
Detect Trap.description: Read a room, corridor, or container for hidden mechanisms, magical wards, and ambush positions. The skill is instinctive for trained thieves; to everyone else it looks like paranoia. Identifies traps before they trigger and marks their locations for the party. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next perception-based trap detection.

Backstab.name: Backstab
Backstab.description: Strike from concealment or from a target's blind spot, delivering a devastating single hit before the target can react. Requires positioning and surprise; ineffective if the target is aware. Greatly increases the effectiveness of your next stealth attack action.

Fortress.name: Fortress
Fortress.description: Plant your feet, raise your shield, and become an immovable wall. While in this stance you cannot attack, but physical damage to you is dramatically reduced and attacks aimed at allies behind you are redirected to your shield. A crusader's signature defense. Greatly increases the effectiveness of your next defensive action. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Decoy.name: Decoy
Decoy.description: Draw all enemy attention to yourself through a combination of taunting, positioning, and sheer aggression. While active, enemies prioritize attacking you over your allies. Darkness considers this the best ability in the game for reasons the party finds concerning. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next taunt action. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Snipe.name: Snipe
Snipe.description: Take careful aim at a distant target, trading speed for accuracy. The shot ignores minor cover and hits with precision that normal archery cannot match. Requires a moment of stillness and concentration. Greatly increases the effectiveness of your next ranged precision attack.

Power Slash.name: Power Slash
Power Slash.description: Channel strength into a single devastating melee strike that cleaves through armor and guard alike. The wind from the swing is visible. Effective against heavily armored opponents and destructible barriers. Greatly increases the effectiveness of your next melee power attack.

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description: Instantly transport yourself and nearby allies to a previously visited location. The spell requires precise visualization of the destination and significant mana. Inaccurate visualization results in arriving slightly off-target, which in the wrong terrain can be fatal. Massively useful for escape and travel.

Inferno.name: Inferno
Inferno.description: Unleash a massive area-of-effect fire spell that engulfs everything in the target zone. Devastatingly effective but indiscriminate: allies, enemies, and property all burn equally. A step below Explosion in raw power but far more practical since the caster remains standing afterward. Massively increases the effectiveness of your next area fire attack.

Sprint.name: Sprint
Sprint.description: Push your body to maximum speed for a short burst, closing distance or creating it in seconds. Useful for chasing, fleeing, and dramatically arriving somewhere at the last moment. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next movement or pursuit action.

Power Lift.name: Power Lift
Power Lift.description: Brace and lift something far heavier than a normal person should manage, through training, leverage, and stubborn refusal to acknowledge physics. Useful for clearing rubble, throwing large objects, and showing off. Significantly increases the effectiveness of your next strength-based action.

Dodge Roll.name: Dodge Roll
Dodge Roll.description: Throw yourself sideways with trained precision, evading an incoming attack and ending in a recovery stance. Looks ridiculous. Works reliably. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next evasion action.

Wall Run.name: Wall Run
Wall Run.description: Run along a vertical surface for a short distance using momentum and balance, reaching positions that stairs would have been more sensible for. Useful for ambushes, escapes, and dramatic entrances. Significantly increases the effectiveness of your next acrobatic movement action.

Keen Eye.name: Keen Eye
Keen Eye.description: Focus your senses to notice details others miss: a faint trail, a hidden switch, a face in a crowd, or the specific way someone is lying. Not magic, just attention trained to a sharp edge. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next perception-based action.

Danger Sense.name: Danger Sense
Danger Sense.description: An instinctive awareness of incoming threats, trained through enough near-death experiences. The hair on your neck rises, your body moves before your brain catches up. Warns of ambushes, traps, and the moment someone behind you decides to swing. Significantly increases the effectiveness of your next danger detection action.

Silver Tongue.name: Silver Tongue
Silver Tongue.description: Choose exactly the right words to make someone reconsider their position. Not mind control; genuine persuasion deployed by someone who understands what the other person wants to hear. Works on merchants, officials, and romantic interests. Does not work on the Axis Cult. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next persuasion attempt.

Inspiring Speech.name: Inspiring Speech
Inspiring Speech.description: Deliver a speech that makes people want to follow you into something they would normally refuse. Effective on groups, crowds, and adventuring parties considering whether to take a terrible quest. In Belzerg, the best inspiring speeches end with someone pointing out the pay is still bad. Greatly increases the effectiveness of your next rallying or motivational action.

Menacing Aura.name: Menacing Aura
Menacing Aura.description: Project an aura of physical threat through posture, eye contact, and the specific kind of silence that makes people reconsider their choices. No actual magic involved; just the trained ability to make a room decide you are the most dangerous person in it. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next intimidation attempt.

Poker Face.name: Poker Face
Poker Face.description: Maintain a completely neutral expression while saying something that is not true, partially true, or true in a way that leads to false conclusions. Essential for negotiations, gambling, and explaining to Sena why the explosion was not your fault. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next deception attempt.

Disguise.name: Disguise
Disguise.description: Alter your appearance through clothing, posture, and behavioral changes convincing enough to pass casual inspection. Not magic; just the trained ability to be someone else for long enough to get the job done. Greatly increases the effectiveness of your next disguise or impersonation action.

Read the Room.name: Read the Room
Read the Room.description: Assess the social dynamics, power structures, and immediate dangers of any environment within seconds of walking in. Know who runs the place, who to avoid, and where the exits are. Essential for taverns, back alleys, and Axis Cult territory. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next streetwise assessment.

Forage.name: Forage
Forage.description: Find edible food, drinkable water, and usable materials in the wilderness. The quality varies by terrain and season. In Belzerg's wilderness, 'edible' is a lower bar than you might hope. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next foraging or survival action.

Camp Setup.name: Camp Setup
Camp Setup.description: Establish a secure, efficient camp in the field: fire, shelter, watch positions, and escape routes. A well-set camp keeps the party alive and rested in hostile territory. Significantly increases the effectiveness of your next camping or rest action.

Brew Potion.name: Brew Potion
Brew Potion.description: Combine reagents into a consumable potion with predictable effects. Quality depends on ingredients and skill. A competent alchemist can produce healing potions, antidotes, and buffs. An incompetent one produces explosions, which in Axel is sometimes the same thing. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next alchemy action.

Repair Equipment.name: Repair Equipment
Repair Equipment.description: Fix damaged weapons and armor to functional condition using available materials and tools. A field repair is not a masterwork restoration, but it keeps the blade sharp and the armor intact until you can afford a proper smith. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next repair action.

Captivate Audience.name: Captivate Audience
Captivate Audience.description: Hold a crowd's attention through song, story, or spectacle. Useful for earning coin, creating distractions, and making a dramatic entrance that even the Crimson Demons would respect. A performance good enough creates a genuine moment of connection in a room full of strangers. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next performance action.

Appraise.name: Appraise
Appraise.description: Determine the true value of an item, service, or deal with a trained eye. Know when a merchant is overcharging, when loot is worth more than it looks, and when Vanir's 'incredible deal' is technically legal but practically a trap. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next appraisal or negotiation action.

Hard Bargain.name: Hard Bargain
Hard Bargain.description: Negotiate a price down (or up) through a combination of market knowledge, social pressure, and the willingness to walk away. In Belzerg, where money is always short, this is arguably the most useful skill an adventurer can have. Significantly increases the effectiveness of your next commerce negotiation.

Forge Weapon.name: Forge Weapon
Forge Weapon.description: Craft a new weapon from raw materials at a forge. The quality depends on your smithing skill, the materials available, and whether the forge is properly heated. A skilled smith can produce equipment that matches or exceeds shop quality. Significantly increases the effectiveness of your next weapon crafting action.

Temper Armor.name: Temper Armor
Temper Armor.description: Harden and reinforce existing armor through heat treatment and structural adjustment. The armor becomes more durable without adding weight. Requires a forge and proper tools. Greatly increases the effectiveness of your next armor improvement action.

Identify Reagent.name: Identify Reagent
Identify Reagent.description: Analyze an unknown material to determine its alchemical properties, potency, and potential uses. Essential for processing dungeon drops and wild-gathered ingredients. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next alchemical analysis.

Distill Essence.name: Distill Essence
Distill Essence.description: Extract and concentrate the magical essence from a material, creating a more potent ingredient for high-level potions and enchantments. Requires equipment and patience. Greatly increases the effectiveness of your next essence extraction.

Craft Antidote.name: Craft Antidote
Craft Antidote.description: Create a targeted antidote for a specific poison or toxin using available materials. More effective than generic antidotes. Essential for dealing with poison slimes and toxic dungeon environments. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next antidote creation.

Bulk Deal.name: Bulk Deal
Bulk Deal.description: Negotiate a wholesale purchase or sale, trading volume for better per-unit pricing. Requires a merchant who deals in quantity and the social skill to close the deal. Greatly increases the effectiveness of your next bulk commerce negotiation.

Bardic Inspiration.name: Bardic Inspiration
Bardic Inspiration.description: Perform a song, speech, or dramatic piece that genuinely inspires allies, boosting their morale and focus. The effect is real and measurable: inspired allies perform better in combat and skill checks for a short time. Significantly increases the effectiveness of your next inspirational performance.

Dramatic Distraction.name: Dramatic Distraction
Dramatic Distraction.description: Create a performance or spectacle that draws all attention in the area to you, giving allies time to act unobserved. Useful for heists, escapes, and the specific KonoSuba tradition of solving problems by making a bigger, louder problem somewhere else. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next distraction action.

Track Prey.name: Track Prey
Track Prey.description: Follow a creature's trail through wilderness terrain using physical signs: tracks, broken vegetation, scent marks, droppings. Effective for hunting, finding missing people, and avoiding monsters by knowing where they are. Significantly increases the effectiveness of your next tracking action.

Fish.name: Fish
Fish.description: Cast a line and wait. Fishing in Belzerg is straightforward: find water, use appropriate bait, and hope what bites is edible rather than hostile. Riverhead Lake and the mountain streams near Alcanretia are the best fishing spots. The catch can be food, alchemical ingredients, or occasionally something that was not supposed to be in the water. Moderately increases the effectiveness of your next fishing action.

Weathercraft.name: Weathercraft
Weathercraft.description: Read weather patterns and environmental signs to predict conditions hours or days in advance. Essential for travel planning, avoiding storms, and knowing when the Snowfield Forest is especially dangerous. Significantly increases the effectiveness of your next weather prediction action.

Guard Stance.name: Guard Stance
Guard Stance.description: A defensive posture that trades offense for protection. Raise your blade to deflect incoming attacks, reducing damage taken while you hold the stance. The first thing any swordsman learns and the last thing a reckless one remembers.

Riposte.name: Riposte
Riposte.description: Parry an incoming strike and immediately counter in the same motion. Timing is everything: a successful riposte turns an enemy's attack into your opening. Requires reading the opponent's tempo, which most Axel rookies never learn to do.

Blade Dance.name: Blade Dance
Blade Dance.description: A flowing sequence of strikes that flows from one target to the next, ideal against multiple weaker enemies. The swordsman becomes a spinning threat that nothing wants to approach. Requires genuine training and better footwork than complaining allows.

Mortal Draw.name: Mortal Draw
Mortal Draw.description: A single devastating strike drawn from perfect stillness, channeling every ounce of skill into one decisive cut. The technique of a master swordsman, capable of ending a fight before it truly begins. Precise, lethal, and impossible without mastery.

Steady Aim.name: Steady Aim
Steady Aim.description: Take a moment to steady your breathing and line up the shot, improving accuracy on your next attack. The foundation of all archery: patience over panic. Rushed shots miss.

Quick Nock.name: Quick Nock
Quick Nock.description: Fire multiple arrows in rapid succession, trading some accuracy for volume. Useful for suppressing enemies or dealing with several targets. The archer's answer to being swarmed.

Piercing Shot.name: Piercing Shot
Piercing Shot.description: An arrow shot with enough force and precision to punch through armor and continue into whatever is behind it. Ignores a portion of the target's defenses. Requires a strong draw and a steady hand.

Rain of Arrows.name: Rain of Arrows
Rain of Arrows.description: Loose a volley arced high to descend on a wide area, striking everything in the target zone. The archer's equivalent of an area attack, devastating against grouped enemies. Requires the skill to place every arrow where it counts.

Chant Mastery.name: Chant Mastery
Chant Mastery.description: Refined control over the explosion incantation, reducing the chant time and improving the spell's precision. The caster can now aim the blast with slightly more control, which matters when allies are anywhere near the target. Does not reduce the Mana cost.

Concentrated Blast.name: Concentrated Blast
Concentrated Blast.description: Focus the explosion into a tighter radius for maximum damage at a single point rather than a wide area. Trades area coverage for sheer destructive force. Costs the same 100 Mana as a full Explosion.

Crimson Detonation.name: Crimson Detonation
Crimson Detonation.description: The pinnacle of explosion magic: a blast of such magnitude that it reshapes the landscape and one-shots nearly anything caught in it. This is what an Explosion devotee spends their entire life working toward, while their clan begs them to learn something respectable. It costs 130 Mana, and a caster it empties stays down longer, because the body pays for power. Worth it. Always worth it.

Bulwark.name: Bulwark
Bulwark.description: Plant yourself and become an immovable defensive anchor, dramatically reducing damage to yourself and any ally directly behind you. A crusader's purpose distilled: be the wall. Accuracy not required, which is fortunate. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Undying Guardian.name: Undying Guardian
Undying Guardian.description: Channel every ounce of crusader endurance into a state where you simply refuse to fall, shrugging off blows that would kill anyone else and drawing every enemy's attention. The ultimate expression of a tank who cannot hit anything but can survive everything. For certain crusaders, this ability is less a technique and more a lifestyle. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Pick Lock.name: Pick Lock
Pick Lock.description: Open locked doors, chests, and mechanisms without the key. Essential for dungeon delving and the occasional morally flexible acquisition. The difficulty scales with the lock; some dungeon vaults resist even skilled hands.

Shadow Step.name: Shadow Step
Shadow Step.description: Move through an area unseen, slipping past guards, enemies, and awkward social situations. The thief's core survival skill. Works best in shadow and worst under the direct gaze of someone with a grudge.

Grand Larceny.name: Grand Larceny
Grand Larceny.description: A masterwork theft: relieve a target of something valuable and specific, chosen rather than random, without them noticing until far too late. Unlike the basic Steal skill, this lets the thief actually pick the prize. The pinnacle of a light-fingered career.

Mana Spark.name: Mana Spark
Mana Spark.description: A minor bolt of raw elemental energy: the first spell any mage learns. Weak but reliable, costing little mana and requiring no components. The building block from which every greater spell grows.

Elemental Ward.name: Elemental Ward
Elemental Ward.description: Conjure a protective barrier attuned to a chosen element, reducing damage of that type. A versatile defensive spell that a skilled mage adjusts on the fly to counter whatever the enemy throws.

Blessing.name: Blessing
Blessing.description: Bestow a divine blessing on an ally, boosting their fortune and effectiveness for a time. The everyday work of a priest: not flashy, but the reason parties with a good priest survive and parties without one do not.

Sacred Purification.name: Sacred Purification
Sacred Purification.description: Channel divine energy to purify an area, cleansing curses, banishing weak undead, and neutralizing corruption. Devastating to undead and slimes, uncomfortable for anything unholy standing nearby. The signature strength of a water-goddess devotee.

Divine Intervention.name: Divine Intervention
Divine Intervention.description: Call upon genuine divine power for a moment of overwhelming holy force: mass healing, a shield of light, or the smiting of the unholy. The highest expression of faith, available only to priests whose connection to their goddess is profound. The kind of miracle that ends sieges.

Second Wind.name: Second Wind
Second Wind.description: Push through exhaustion to recover a burst of stamina and shake off fatigue. The difference between an adventurer who makes it home and one who collapses on the road. Pure grit applied to a tired body.

Bull Rush.name: Bull Rush
Bull Rush.description: Charge an enemy with your full body weight, knocking them back and disrupting their footing. Effective for creating space, breaking formations, or shoving something off a cliff. Subtlety not included.

Unbreakable.name: Unbreakable
Unbreakable.description: Reach a physical peak where your body simply refuses to quit, resisting knockdown, exhaustion, and the kind of punishment that ends most fights. The endurance of someone who has trained their body into a tool rather than complained about using it.

Nimble Step.name: Nimble Step
Nimble Step.description: Light-footed movement that improves your ability to evade and reposition. The foundation of every acrobatic technique. Keeps you out of reach of things that want to eat you.

Deflect.name: Deflect
Deflect.description: Redirect an incoming attack with a precise, minimal movement rather than absorbing it. Requires timing and nerve. A well-timed deflect turns a killing blow into a near miss.

Phantom Evasion.name: Phantom Evasion
Phantom Evasion.description: Move with such speed and grace that attacks seem to pass through where you were rather than where you are. The peak of acrobatic defense, letting you dance through danger that would flatten anyone slower.

Spot Details.name: Spot Details
Spot Details.description: Notice the small things others miss: hidden compartments, subtle expressions, the detail that turns out to matter. The first skill of any investigator or cautious adventurer.

Read Intentions.name: Read Intentions
Read Intentions.description: Study a person's body language and micro-expressions to gauge their true intentions, spotting lies, hostility, or hidden agendas. Invaluable in negotiation, interrogation, and avoiding ambushes.

Eye of Truth.name: Eye of Truth
Eye of Truth.description: A perceptive state so acute that little escapes notice: hidden enemies, concealed magic, structural weaknesses, and the subtle tells that reveal a situation's true shape. The perception of a master, bordering on foresight.

Small Talk.name: Small Talk
Small Talk.description: Ease into a conversation and build basic rapport, lowering a stranger's guard. The foundation of every social skill. Surprisingly powerful in a world where most adventurers lead with a sword.

Negotiate.name: Negotiate
Negotiate.description: Work toward a mutually acceptable outcome through reasoned argument and compromise. Useful for talking down enemies, securing better deals, and defusing situations that would otherwise end in property damage.

Force of Will.name: Force of Will
Force of Will.description: Bend a conversation to your desired outcome through sheer conviction and rhetorical mastery, swaying crowds, convincing skeptics, and occasionally talking your way out of situations that should have killed you. The persuasive peak of a natural leader.

Hard Stare.name: Hard Stare
Hard Stare.description: A look that communicates you are not to be trifled with, discouraging casual aggression. The cheapest form of self-defense: convince the enemy the fight is not worth it.

Threaten.name: Threaten
Threaten.description: A pointed, credible threat that makes a target reconsider their choices. Works best when backed by visible capability. Effective for extracting information or clearing a path without drawing steel.

Killing Intent.name: Killing Intent
Killing Intent.description: Project a wave of raw, focused menace so palpable that weaker enemies freeze, flee, or surrender outright. The intimidation of someone who has genuinely earned their reputation. Some fights end before they start.

White Lie.name: White Lie
White Lie.description: A small, convincing untruth delivered smoothly enough to pass casual scrutiny. The foundation of deception. Useful for smoothing over awkward moments and minor cover stories.

Misdirect.name: Misdirect
Misdirect.description: Draw attention away from what matters through a convincing feint, false tell, or planted assumption. Essential for heists, escapes, and the fine art of not being where the enemy thinks you are.

Master Manipulator.name: Master Manipulator
Master Manipulator.description: Weave a web of deception so complete that targets act on false beliefs without ever suspecting they were steered. The deceptive peak of a con artist or spymaster: the enemy does exactly what you want and thanks you for it.

Local Knowledge.name: Local Knowledge
Local Knowledge.description: Know how a town actually works: who to ask, where the deals are, which alleys to avoid. The practical wisdom of someone who has survived on the streets rather than in a manor.

Grease Palms.name: Grease Palms
Grease Palms.description: Know exactly who to bribe, how much, and how to make the offer without giving offense. The lubricant of every functional underworld. Opens doors that persuasion cannot.

Underworld Contacts.name: Underworld Contacts
Underworld Contacts.description: A network of informants, fixers, and favors built over years of navigating the seedier side of Belzerg. Whatever you need, someone in your network can get it, for a price. The streetwise peak of a true operator.

Chill Grasp.name: Chill Grasp
Chill Grasp.description: A touch that leeches warmth and vitality, weakening the target while faintly restoring the user. The mark of the undead and those who traffic with them. Unsettling to be on the receiving end of.

Life Siphon.name: Life Siphon
Life Siphon.description: Drain a significant portion of a target's life force, transferring their vitality to yourself. Powerful and deeply taboo. The signature technique of a lich, capable of turning a losing fight around through sheer parasitism.

Basic Maintenance.name: Basic Maintenance
Basic Maintenance.description: Clean, oil, and adjust equipment to keep it functional. The first thing any smith learns and the difference between gear that lasts and gear that fails at the worst moment.

Masterwork Forging.name: Masterwork Forging
Masterwork Forging.description: Craft equipment of exceptional quality, the kind that earns a maker's mark and gets passed down. A masterwork blade holds an edge, balances perfectly, and accepts enchantment far better than common steel. The peak of the smith's art.

Basic Mixing.name: Basic Mixing
Basic Mixing.description: Combine simple ingredients into functional if unglamorous concoctions: minor healing salves, cleaning solutions, and the occasional accidental stink bomb. The foundation of alchemy, learned through trial and mild explosion.

Transmutation.name: Transmutation
Transmutation.description: Fundamentally alter the properties of a material through advanced alchemy, turning base components into something far more valuable. The pinnacle of the alchemist's craft, requiring deep knowledge and steady nerves. The results fund a comfortable retirement.

Quick Sale.name: Quick Sale
Quick Sale.description: Move goods efficiently at a fair price, converting inventory to coin without lengthy haggling. The foundation of commerce: know what things are worth and sell them promptly.

Market Manipulation.name: Market Manipulation
Market Manipulation.description: Understand and influence the flow of an entire market: corner a supply, drive demand, time a sale for maximum profit. The commercial peak of a merchant prince. Elroad's economy runs on people with this skill, and so does its debt.

Play a Tune.name: Play a Tune
Play a Tune.description: Perform a competent song or piece that entertains a casual audience and earns a few coins. The foundation of a performer's craft. The tavern crowd is forgiving; the tips are not generous.

Legendary Performance.name: Legendary Performance
Legendary Performance.description: Deliver a performance so moving that it inspires allies to their peak, demoralizes enemies, and becomes the kind of story people tell for years. The peak of a bard's art: a song that changes the outcome of the moment through sheer emotional force.

Basic Foraging.name: Basic Foraging
Basic Foraging.description: Find edible plants, clean water, and safe shelter in the wilderness. The bare minimum for staying alive outside town walls. Most rookies learn it the hard way.

Wilderness Master.name: Wilderness Master
Wilderness Master.description: Thrive in any environment, from frozen snowfields to monster-infested forests. Track, hunt, shelter, and navigate with the effortless competence of someone the wilderness has stopped trying to kill. The survival peak of a true frontier veteran.

Goddess's Favor.name: Goddess's Favor
Goddess's Favor.description: Once called upon, a flicker of genuine divine luck tilts a single moment in your favor: a reroll on a failed critical action, a coincidence that saves you, a door that happens to be unlocked. The goddesses are watching, occasionally, when it is funny.

Second Breath.name: Second Breath
Second Breath.description: Draw on hidden reserves to shrug off exhaustion and recover a burst of vitality in a desperate moment. The blessing of everyone who has ever refused to die on schedule.
