Merchant's Instinct.name: Merchant's Instinct
Merchant's Instinct.description: A flash of commercial intuition reveals the true value of an item, the honesty of a deal, or the weak point in a negotiation. Vanir would approve, which is unsettling.

Explosive Enthusiasm.name: Explosive Enthusiasm
Explosive Enthusiasm.description: Channel a surge of dramatic energy that briefly amplifies your next magical or combat action to spectacular effect. Comes with an involuntary dramatic pose. The pose is not optional.

Lucky Escape.name: Lucky Escape
Lucky Escape.description: When things go catastrophically wrong, an improbable escape route appears: a conveniently placed cart, a distracted guard, a hole in the wall that was not there a moment ago. Cowardice, blessed by fortune.

Party Spirit.name: Party Spirit
Party Spirit.description: Rally your companions with a burst of camaraderie, briefly boosting the whole party's morale and coordination. Works even when the party is actively bickering, which is always.

Toad Sense.name: Toad Sense
Toad Sense.description: A hard-won instinct for incoming danger honed by too many giant toad ambushes. Grants a moment of warning before something tries to swallow, bite, or explode near you.

Divine Purification Echo.name: Divine Purification Echo
Divine Purification Echo.description: A faint echo of purification power cleanses a minor curse, weak poison, or lingering corruption. Not enough to make you a priest, but enough to ruin an undead's afternoon.

Minor Enchantment.name: Minor Enchantment
Minor Enchantment.description: Imbue an item with a simple, temporary magical property: a faint glow, a warm cloak, a blade that stays sharp a little longer. The foundation of enchanting.

Elemental Imbue.name: Elemental Imbue
Elemental Imbue.description: Bind an elemental effect into a weapon or piece of gear: flame on a blade, frost on an arrow, a static charge on armor. Requires materials and steady mana control.

Lasting Enchantment.name: Lasting Enchantment
Lasting Enchantment.description: Create a permanent enchantment that does not fade with use, the mark of a true enchanter. The kind of work that turns ordinary gear into an heirloom.

Grand Enchantment.name: Grand Enchantment
Grand Enchantment.description: Imbue an item with a powerful, complex enchantment worthy of legend, layering multiple effects into a single piece. The pinnacle of the enchanter's art, and the sort of thing that ends up in a hero's hands.

Field Cooking.name: Field Cooking
Field Cooking.description: Prepare a hot, nourishing meal from whatever ingredients are at hand, restoring stamina and morale. The foundation of a cook's craft and the reason a party stays functional on long quests.

Buff Cuisine.name: Buff Cuisine
Buff Cuisine.description: Cook a meal that grants a real, temporary boost to whoever eats it: strength, endurance, focus. Requires quality ingredients and genuine skill. The difference between food and fuel.

Restorative Feast.name: Restorative Feast
Restorative Feast.description: Prepare a lavish meal that heals wounds, cures minor ailments, and lifts spirits across an entire party. Battle cooking at its finest.

Legendary Banquet.name: Legendary Banquet
Legendary Banquet.description: Create a feast so exceptional it becomes a story: powerful sustained buffs, full restoration, and the kind of morale that wins wars. The cooking mastery that a whole town remembers.

Cast Line.name: Cast Line
Cast Line.description: Fish a body of water for whatever is biting, from common food fish to the occasional surprise. The peaceful foundation of the angler's craft.

Patient Angler.name: Patient Angler
Patient Angler.description: Read the water and target specific catches, improving your odds of landing rare or valuable specimens. The skill that separates a hobbyist from a supplier.

Master Angler.name: Master Angler
Master Angler.description: Land the rare, valuable, and occasionally dangerous catches that alchemists and researchers pay premium prices for. The fishing mastery that makes a quiet living into a good one.

Gather Herbs.name: Gather Herbs
Gather Herbs.description: Identify and collect useful plants from the wild: edible, medicinal, and alchemical. The foundation of herbalism and the reason alchemists stay stocked.

Potent Harvest.name: Potent Harvest
Potent Harvest.description: Locate and gather rare, high-potency botanical reagents, often in dangerous territory. The skill that supplies the good potions.

Master Botanist.name: Master Botanist
Master Botanist.description: Command an encyclopedic knowledge of Belzerg's flora, safely harvesting even the most dangerous and valuable plants. The herbalism mastery that even Crimson Demons respect.

Mend Cloth.name: Mend Cloth
Mend Cloth.description: Repair torn clothing, cloaks, and fabric gear so it holds up to another quest. The everyday foundation of a tailor's trade: unglamorous, constant, and the difference between an adventurer who looks like a professional and one who looks like they lost a fight with a hedge. Quality of repair scales with skill.

Fine Garment.name: Fine Garment
Fine Garment.description: Craft quality clothing and fabric armor with real protective value and genuine style. The work that earns repeat customers.

Master Tailor.name: Master Tailor
Master Tailor.description: Create exceptional cloth goods worthy of nobility or a dramatic Crimson Demon entrance: protective, beautiful, and enchantment-ready. The tailoring mastery that dresses heroes.

Spot Valuables.name: Spot Valuables
Spot Valuables.description: Notice loot, hidden compartments, and items worth more than they appear. The foundation of a treasure hunter's instinct.

Appraise Find.name: Appraise Find
Appraise Find.description: Accurately assess the true value, origin, and quality of a discovered item at a glance. The skill that keeps a hunter from being cheated.

Master Hunter.name: Master Hunter
Master Hunter.description: Follow the trail to genuine fortune: hidden vaults, lost artifacts, and the treasures others walked right past. The treasure-hunting mastery that makes legends and enemies.

Identify Monster.name: Identify Monster
Identify Monster.description: Recognize a monster's species, rough threat level, and general habits on sight. The foundation of monster research and a genuine survival advantage.

Expose Weakness.name: Expose Weakness
Expose Weakness.description: Analyze a monster to reveal its specific vulnerabilities, letting allies target them directly. The skill that turns a hard fight into a manageable one.

Monster Sage.name: Monster Sage
Monster Sage.description: Command a definitive understanding of monster ecology across the kingdom, predicting behavior, exploiting weaknesses, and knowing exactly how to handle threats others flee from. The lore mastery that makes a researcher indispensable.

Lurk.name: Lurk
Lurk.description: Suppress your presence to blend into shadows and background, becoming difficult to notice even in plain sight. A core thief skill for scouting, ambush, and avoiding fights you would rather not have. Skilled use lets you slip past guards, tail a target, or vanish mid-conversation when a situation turns bad. It does not make you invisible, only overlooked, so bold movement or loud action breaks it instantly.

Jab.name: Jab
Jab.description: A quick straight punch that lands before your opponent expects it. Nothing fancy, but it beats swinging wild and hoping. The first thing anyone learns after losing a bar fight.

Roundhouse Kick.name: Roundhouse Kick
Roundhouse Kick.description: Pivot your weight through a full leg swing to strike with real force, knocking a lighter foe off balance. Slower than a punch but hits far harder.

Grapple Throw.name: Grapple Throw
Grapple Throw.description: Seize an opponent and use their own momentum to slam them to the ground. Leaves them prone and winded, and works even against someone holding a weapon.

Palm Heel Strike.name: Palm Heel Strike
Palm Heel Strike.description: A short, brutal strike with the base of the palm that drives force straight into a vulnerable spot. Ideal for cracking a jaw or breaking a nose without breaking your knuckles.

Pressure Point Jab.name: Pressure Point Jab
Pressure Point Jab.description: Target a nerve cluster with a precise strike, numbing a limb or briefly staggering the target. Low raw damage, but it can turn an armed opponent into a fumbling one.

Iron Body Conditioning.name: Iron Body Conditioning
Iron Body Conditioning.description: Years of tempering the body let you shrug off blows that would fell an armored knight, reducing incoming damage while you brawl. A passive toughness that makes swordsmen feel overdressed and underprepared.

Flurry of Blows.name: Flurry of Blows
Flurry of Blows.description: Unleash a rapid chain of punches and kicks that overwhelms a single target's guard. Each hit is modest, but the sheer volume gives them no room to counter.

Disarming Grip.name: Disarming Grip
Disarming Grip.description: Trap an armed opponent's wrist and wrench their weapon free with a joint lock. Ends with their blade in the dirt and their arm at an unhappy angle.

Rising Dragon Kick.name: Rising Dragon Kick
Rising Dragon Kick.description: An explosive upward kick that launches a target into the air and leaves them helpless on the way down. The signature move of martial artists who like a bit of drama.

Hundred Fist Barrage.name: Hundred Fist Barrage
Hundred Fist Barrage.description: A blistering storm of strikes delivered faster than the eye can follow, pounding a target from every angle at once. By the end they are less standing than being held up by the punches.

Diamond Fist.name: Diamond Fist
Diamond Fist.description: Focus every ounce of strength and technique into a single fist that shatters stone, plate, and bone alike. One connecting blow ends most fights and most walls in the way.

Unbreakable Stance.name: Unbreakable Stance
Unbreakable Stance.description: Enter a state of perfect martial focus where your body refuses to fall, resisting knockdown and pain while your counters land with punishing force. For a time you simply cannot be put down.

Fist of the Fallen Star.name: Fist of the Fallen Star
Fist of the Fallen Star.description: Gather the full weight of a lifetime of training into one earthshaking strike that lands like a meteor. Armor, monsters, and fortifications all fold before a blow no weapon could ever match, the answer to anyone who claimed fists were for people without money.

Quick Nick.name: Quick Nick
Quick Nick.description: A fast shallow cut aimed at a hand or forearm to draw first blood and make a foe flinch. It will not end anyone, but it sets the tempo of a knife fight.

Gut Slash.name: Gut Slash
Gut Slash.description: A short slashing arc across the midsection that opens a real wound and forces a target to cover up. Best thrown when they expect a thrust instead.

Off-Hand Feint.name: Off-Hand Feint
Off-Hand Feint.description: Fake a strike with your empty hand to pull their guard aside, then slip the blade in where it is now open. Dishonest, effective, and exactly the point of a dagger.

Twist the Blade.name: Twist the Blade
Twist the Blade.description: Sink the knife home and turn it, widening the wound and dropping the target's fighting ability. Cruel, but nobody picks up a dagger to fight fair.

Hamstring Cut.name: Hamstring Cut
Hamstring Cut.description: A low, precise slash to the back of the leg that cripples mobility and drops a runner in their tracks. Modest damage, but a target that cannot move is already losing.

Fan of Knives.name: Fan of Knives
Fan of Knives.description: Hurl a spread of throwing knives in a single flick of the wrist, peppering several enemies at once. Useful for softening a group or covering a hasty exit.

Seam Puncture.name: Seam Puncture
Seam Puncture.description: Drive the point cleanly through the gap between armor plates, ignoring protection that would stop a heavier weapon. The reward for knowing exactly where a suit of armor stops covering.

Bleeding Edge.name: Bleeding Edge
Bleeding Edge.description: A drawing cut placed to sever vessels, leaving a wound that keeps bleeding and wears the target down over the following moments. Patience turned into a weapon.

Shadow Stab.name: Shadow Stab
Shadow Stab.description: Slip behind a distracted foe and bury the blade in a vital spot before they register you moved. The strike lands for devastating damage when the target has not seen you coming.

Thousand Cuts.name: Thousand Cuts
Thousand Cuts.description: A whirlwind of impossibly fast slashes that leaves a target covered in wounds and unsure which one to clutch. Each cut is small; together they are catastrophic.

Assassin's Mark.name: Assassin's Mark
Assassin's Mark.description: Study a single target and place a precise strike on the one point that ends them fastest, dealing enormous damage to a marked enemy. The quiet expertise every guild rogue swears they do not have.

Death by a Whisper.name: Death by a Whisper
Death by a Whisper.description: Move so smoothly that the blade has done its work before the sound of it reaches the target's ears. A near silent flurry that fells even armored veterans in a heartbeat.

Silent Verdict.name: Silent Verdict
Silent Verdict.description: Vanish from sight, cross the distance unseen, and deliver a single perfect thrust that no armor, guard, or luck can turn aside. The fight ends before the target ever knew it had begun, the final word of a master of the knife.

Straight Thrust.name: Straight Thrust
Straight Thrust.description: A clean forward jab that keeps the pointy end aimed where it belongs. Simple, safe, and enough to remind a foe you outrange them.

Keep at Bay.name: Keep at Bay
Keep at Bay.description: Hold your spear in a steady guard and jab at anything that tries to close, denying an enemy the space to reach you. The smug core advantage of hitting people before they hit you.

Sweeping Haft.name: Sweeping Haft
Sweeping Haft.description: Swing the shaft low in a wide arc to sweep an enemy's legs out from under them. Leaves them flat on their back and well within skewering range.

Brace Against Charge.name: Brace Against Charge
Brace Against Charge.description: Plant the butt of the spear and set the point forward to receive a charging enemy on your terms. A beast that rushes you impales itself on its own momentum.

Piercing Lunge.name: Piercing Lunge
Piercing Lunge.description: Step deep and drive the point through with your full weight behind it, punching past shields and light armor. Extends your reach even further for one committed strike.

Whirling Guard.name: Whirling Guard
Whirling Guard.description: Spin the spear in a broad circle, striking every enemy within reach and warding off approach from all sides. Buys space when a single foe becomes a crowd.

Impale.name: Impale
Impale.description: Run the spear clean through a target and pin them in place, dealing heavy damage and holding them where they stand. A charging beast becomes a stationary problem.

Doorway Hold.name: Doorway Hold
Doorway Hold.description: Anchor yourself in a chokepoint and threaten the whole width of it with sweeping thrusts, letting no enemy pass unpunished. One disciplined spear can hold a corridor against many.

Dragoon Leap.name: Dragoon Leap
Dragoon Leap.description: Launch into the air and come down point first with the full force of the fall behind the strike. Devastating against a single large target and impossible to ignore.

Serpent's Reach.name: Serpent's Reach
Serpent's Reach.description: A blur of thrusts that snap out and retract faster than the eye can track, striking a target repeatedly from just beyond their range. They cannot close the gap and cannot escape it.

Skewering Line.name: Skewering Line
Skewering Line.description: A single overwhelming thrust with such force that it drives through everything standing in a straight line before you. Ranks of enemies become a single unlucky row.

Phalanx of One.name: Phalanx of One
Phalanx of One.description: Enter a state of flawless polearm discipline where every angle is covered and no enemy finds an opening, striking down all who approach. For a time you are an entire spearwall by yourself.

Heaven Piercing Spear.name: Heaven Piercing Spear
Heaven Piercing Spear.description: Gather every year of discipline into one thrust that parts armor, monster, and the very air with a shaft of raw force. The reach becomes limitless and nothing in its line survives, the legendary answer of a master who truly hits first and hits last.

Crushing Grapple.name: Crushing Grapple
Crushing Grapple.description: Seize an enemy and pin them with raw strength, holding them in place while your grip squeezes out steady damage until they wrench free. Works best on things smaller than a giant toad, which is most things.

Boulder Heave.name: Boulder Heave
Boulder Heave.description: Hoist a massive object, a rock, a loaded barrel, an unlucky goblin, and hurl it at a target for heavy blunt damage. If nothing throwable is nearby, an ally will do in a pinch.

Piledriver.name: Piledriver
Piledriver.description: Lift a foe bodily off the ground and slam them back down headfirst, dealing severe damage and leaving them dazed. The louder the impact, the more effective.

Quaking Stomp.name: Quaking Stomp
Quaking Stomp.description: Drive a heel into the ground hard enough to buckle the earth, knocking down every enemy standing near you. Allies should consider staying off the floor.

Juggernaut Rush.name: Juggernaut Rush
Juggernaut Rush.description: Lower your shoulder and plow through an entire line of enemies without slowing, trampling and scattering everything in your path. Momentum does the work; stopping is the hard part.

Mountain Splitter.name: Mountain Splitter
Mountain Splitter.description: A single overhead blow delivered with your whole body, shattering armor, shields, and the ground beneath the target alike. Cracks stone and reputations.

Titan Overhead.name: Titan Overhead
Titan Overhead.description: Grab a monster that dwarfs you, wrench it off its feet, and throw it into whatever stands behind it, damaging both. Physically absurd, deeply satisfying.

Apex of Mortal Might.name: Apex of Mortal Might
Apex of Mortal Might.description: For a few overwhelming moments your strength surpasses anything a mortal frame should hold, letting you lift, break, and throw on a scale that rewrites the battlefield. The legendary peak of raw physical power, and the sort of feat that ends up carved into a tavern wall.

Feint Thrust.name: Feint Thrust
Feint Thrust.description: Sell a false opening, then drive a precise thrust through the gap it creates, slipping past a raised guard for clean damage. The trick only works on someone paying attention.

Whirlwind Cut.name: Whirlwind Cut
Whirlwind Cut.description: Spin with your blade fully extended, carving through every enemy pressed in close around you at once. Ideal when surrounded, which for most rookies is always.

Rising Slash.name: Rising Slash
Rising Slash.description: An upward cut that breaks through a defensive guard and launches lighter foes off their feet, opening them to follow-up. Turns a wall of shields into an invitation.

Perfect Parry.name: Perfect Parry
Perfect Parry.description: Read an incoming strike and turn it aside completely, then answer with a counter before the attacker recovers. A refined riposte that negates the blow entirely rather than trading for it.

Guardbreaker.name: Guardbreaker
Guardbreaker.description: A relentless flurry aimed at a defender's guard, battering the shield or blade aside and leaving them wide open. Patience is for people who cannot do this.

Falling Star Cut.name: Falling Star Cut
Falling Star Cut.description: Leap and bring the blade down in one descending stroke of such force it splits armor and the earth behind it. A single decisive cut that ends most arguments.

Dance of a Thousand Edges.name: Dance of a Thousand Edges
Dance of a Thousand Edges.description: Close on a target and unleash a blur of strikes too fast to count or block, each landing before the last is seen. The kind of technique that makes onlookers question what they witnessed.

Blade of the Sword Saint.name: Blade of the Sword Saint
Blade of the Sword Saint.description: For one perfect exchange your blade moves without wasted motion or hesitation, cutting through defense, weapon, and foe as though they offered no resistance at all. The legendary mastery of the Sword Saint, earned by those who trained instead of complaining.

Pinning Shot.name: Pinning Shot
Pinning Shot.description: Nail a limb or a trailing cloak to the ground or a wall with a well-placed arrow, immobilizing the target for precious seconds. Deals modest damage but the disable is the point.

Split Shot.name: Split Shot
Split Shot.description: Loose two arrows in a single draw, striking two separate targets or driving both into one for double the damage. Requires a steady hand and a fuller quiver.

Heartseeker.name: Heartseeker
Heartseeker.description: Read a target's movement and thread an arrow into a vital point, dealing heavy critical damage on a clean hit. The shot that turns a wounded monster into a dead one.

Curving Arrow.name: Curving Arrow
Curving Arrow.description: Bend an arrow's flight around cover or a raised shield to strike a target that thought itself safe. Impossible-looking, and that is exactly the reaction it earns.

Skyfall Shot.name: Skyfall Shot
Skyfall Shot.description: Send a single arrow arcing so high it drops on a distant target like a falling star, ignoring cover between you and it. Range and patience over speed.

Phantom Quiver.name: Phantom Quiver
Phantom Quiver.description: Draw and loose so fast the air seems to fill with shafts, burying a single target under a private storm of arrows. Onlookers swear you had three hands.

Godseye Ricochet.name: Godseye Ricochet
Godseye Ricochet.description: A trick shot calculated to the finger's width, striking one enemy and glancing off to fell a second, then a third. The sort of impossible marksmanship that makes even Crimson Demons grudgingly quiet.

Arrow That Splits the Horizon.name: Arrow That Splits the Horizon
Arrow That Splits the Horizon.description: One shot loosed with absolute certainty, crossing any distance and any obstacle to strike precisely where you willed it, through whatever stands between. The legendary shot spoken of by every archer who ever missed one.

Shield Bash.name: Shield Bash
Shield Bash.description: Slam a foe with the flat of your shield, staggering them and drawing their fury squarely onto you. Modest damage, since hitting things was never the point, but excellent for making an enemy furious at the right person. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Aegis Wall.name: Aegis Wall
Aegis Wall.description: Sweep your guard wide to cover an adjacent ally, intercepting attacks meant for them and absorbing the blows yourself. The crusader's whole job, formalized into a stance. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Holy Provocation.name: Holy Provocation
Holy Provocation.description: Blaze with divine presence so overpowering that every nearby enemy is compelled to strike at you, their resolve dimmed as they do. You will be hit a great deal, exactly as intended. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Guardian Retribution.name: Guardian Retribution
Guardian Retribution.description: Every blow you absorb stores holy force, released in a burst of radiant damage against the foes who struck you. The rare crusader technique that actually deals damage, by way of turning the other cheek very aggressively. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Sanctuary Ground.name: Sanctuary Ground
Sanctuary Ground.description: Consecrate the earth around you into hallowed ground, sharply reducing damage taken by every ally who stands within it. Hold the circle and the party holds together. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Bastion of Faith.name: Bastion of Faith
Bastion of Faith.description: Become a living fortress, stepping to intercept blows aimed anywhere across the party line and shrugging off punishment that would fell a lesser guardian. Nothing gets past while you stand. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Immortal Vanguard.name: Immortal Vanguard
Immortal Vanguard.description: Take every wound dealt to your allies onto your own body while your endurance refuses to let you fall, holding the whole party's fate on your shoulders for a time. Painful, heroic, and precisely what crusaders are for. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Wall of the Eternal Guardian.name: Wall of the Eternal Guardian
Wall of the Eternal Guardian.description: Plant yourself and become an unbreakable bulwark that no attack can pass and no force can move, shielding all behind you against blows that should have ended everyone. The legendary last line the Demon King's Army learned to complain about rather than break. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Mana Leech.name: Mana Leech
Mana Leech.description: A weak touch that pulls a trickle of mana from a target and tops off a sliver of your own reserves. The first thing a cheapskate learns to avoid buying mana potions.

Withering Grip.name: Withering Grip
Withering Grip.description: Sap a target's strength on contact, lowering their attack power for a time while restoring a little of your own vitality. They feel the years drain out of their arms.

Vampiric Strike.name: Vampiric Strike
Vampiric Strike.description: Channel the drain through a weapon blow, dealing damage and stealing vitality with the same swing rather than a bare-handed touch. Convenient for those who prefer not to grab their problems.

Soul Tap.name: Soul Tap
Soul Tap.description: Drain life and mana at once, staggering the target as you refill whichever of your own reserves is running low. Doubly rude, doubly efficient.

Enervating Touch.name: Enervating Touch
Enervating Touch.description: A prolonged drain that leaves a target weakened and slowed, bleeding vitality steadily into you over several seconds. They wilt while you thrive, faintly sinister and extremely practical.

Life Transfer.name: Life Transfer
Life Transfer.description: Drain a foe and pour the stolen vitality directly into a wounded ally, substantially healing them in the same motion. Battlefield first aid with the bill sent to the enemy.

Grave Chill.name: Grave Chill
Grave Chill.description: An icy necromantic drain that inflicts creeping decay, damaging the target over time and dropping weaker foes outright as the cold takes hold. The lich-taught touch at its most unsettling.

Soul Harvest.name: Soul Harvest
Soul Harvest.description: Sweep a hand across a cluster of enemies, siphoning life from every one you touch and gathering it all into yourself at once. Deeply efficient and the reason people keep their distance.

Withering Plague.name: Withering Plague
Withering Plague.description: The drain spreads from your touch into a spreading field of leeching decay, sapping the strength and vitality of everything caught within it. Everyone inside grows weaker while you grow stronger.

Grasp of the Lich Lord.name: Grasp of the Lich Lord
Grasp of the Lich Lord.description: Lay a single hand upon a foe and tear the life from them near-instantly, felling lesser enemies where they stand and flooding you and your allies with the stolen vitality. The legendary technique of the lich who taught this art, and the reason cheapskates are feared as well as mocked.

Heavy Swing.name: Heavy Swing
Heavy Swing.description: Put your whole shoulder behind a wide swing of mace or club. Clumsy but honest, and it hits harder than a rookie's sword ever will.

Shield Dent.name: Shield Dent
Shield Dent.description: Aim for the shield instead of the man. A solid blow buckles the boss and leaves the arm behind it ringing, spoiling the enemy's next block.

Armor Crack.name: Armor Crack
Armor Crack.description: Drive a hammer into a plated seam to split rivets and dent steel inward. Armor is only a suggestion, and you are here to argue.

Skull Knock.name: Skull Knock
Skull Knock.description: A short, sharp crack to the helm that rattles whatever is inside it. A solid hit leaves the target stunned and briefly unsure which way is up.

Crushing Blow.name: Crushing Blow
Crushing Blow.description: A committed overhead strike that lands with the full weight of the weapon and the swing behind it. Guards fold, footing goes, and something usually gives.

Bone Breaker.name: Bone Breaker
Bone Breaker.description: Target a limb and swing to disable rather than to kill. A landed hit fractures the joint, crippling the enemy's ability to fight or flee.

Plate Splitter.name: Plate Splitter
Plate Splitter.description: A veteran's strike that ignores the notion of protective steel entirely, caving breastplates and the ribs beneath them. Knights hate this one specifically.

Concussive Slam.name: Concussive Slam
Concussive Slam.description: Slam the weapon down with such force the shock travels through armor into the body. The target is staggered and dazed, often dropping whatever they were holding.

Guard Breaker.name: Guard Breaker
Guard Breaker.description: A hammer blow tuned to punish defense, shattering raised shields and braced weapons alike. Once the guard is gone, the follow up is a formality.

Earthshaker Smash.name: Earthshaker Smash
Earthshaker Smash.description: Bring the weapon down on the ground itself, sending a shockwave that knocks nearby enemies off their feet. Loud, dramatic, and very hard on the paving.

Ruinous Hammerfall.name: Ruinous Hammerfall
Ruinous Hammerfall.description: A single descending strike that flattens armor, weapon, and wielder into one unfortunate arrangement. Reserved for foes who genuinely needed to be a crater.

Undying Ender.name: Undying Ender
Undying Ender.description: A hallowed crushing technique built to end an undead's second career for good, pulping bone that blades merely scatter. Skeletons do not get back up from this.

Meteor Maul.name: Meteor Maul
Meteor Maul.description: The final word in percussive problem solving: a full body swing that lands like a falling star and erases whatever stood beneath it. Fortresses, generals, and unlucky terrain are equally negotiable.

Raise Guard.name: Raise Guard
Raise Guard.description: Get the shield up and pointed at the threat. The bare minimum, but the bare minimum still beats catching a rock with your face. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Rock Block.name: Rock Block
Rock Block.description: Angle the shield to bounce thrown stones, arrows, and other cheap opening moves. The novice's introduction to standing there and refusing to flinch. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Turn Aside.name: Turn Aside
Turn Aside.description: Meet an incoming sword blow at an angle so it skates off the rim instead of biting in. Deflection costs less strength than a flat block and looks far calmer. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Shield Bash (Shielding).name: Shield Bash (Shielding)
Shield Bash (Shielding).description: Turn defense into offense with a hard shove of the shield face, staggering the enemy and buying room. Not elegant, but it interrupts a chant nicely. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Brace Formation.name: Brace Formation
Brace Formation.description: Plant your feet and set the shield to weather a heavy hit without giving ground. Absorbs punishment that would send a lesser guard sliding backward. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Cover Ally.name: Cover Ally
Cover Ally.description: Step in front of a chosen ally and take the blow meant for them onto your shield. The whole point of the job, performed on purpose for once. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Hold the Line.name: Hold the Line
Hold the Line.description: Anchor a chokepoint and refuse to be moved, blunting a charge that should have rolled straight over you. Enemies pile up, and so does their frustration. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Bulwark Stance.name: Bulwark Stance
Bulwark Stance.description: Drop into a braced guard that turns you into a near solid obstacle, slashing damage to yourself and any ally directly behind you. Slow to move, impossible to shift. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Aegis Wall (Shielding).name: Aegis Wall (Shielding)
Aegis Wall (Shielding).description: Project a broad zone of protection where allies at your side share in your defense. For a few brave moments the party fights as though behind a fortress gate. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Guardian's Vow.name: Guardian's Vow
Guardian's Vow.description: Swear the whole party under your guard and intercept the worst of a bad turn on their behalf. Every stray blow finds your shield first, whether you like it or not. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Immovable Rampart.name: Immovable Rampart
Immovable Rampart.description: Become a fixed point on the battlefield that simply does not yield, shrugging off charges, blasts, and the occasional siege weapon. The enemy will have to route around you, and they will complain about it. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Sheltering Bastion.name: Sheltering Bastion
Sheltering Bastion.description: Raise a living wall of guarded resolve that shelters every ally within reach from a single overwhelming attack. Whatever was meant to wipe the party breaks against you instead. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Unbreakable Aegis.name: Unbreakable Aegis
Unbreakable Aegis.description: The summit of standing there and refusing to die: for one glorious span nothing gets through, not blade, not spell, not the Demon King's Army's best idea. You are the wall they file grievances about for years. Protects you and your allies from enemy attacks only; it never shields a foe.

Twin Grip.name: Twin Grip
Twin Grip.description: Hold a weapon in each hand without dropping either one. It sounds simple, and yet this is where most would be dual wielders quietly wash out.

Off-Hand Strike.name: Off-Hand Strike
Off-Hand Strike.description: Follow the main hand with a quick jab from the off hand while the enemy is still reacting. Half the power, but it arrives when nobody expects it.

Double Slash.name: Double Slash
Double Slash.description: Two clean cuts in quick succession, one from each blade, worked into a single motion. The second hit lands before the first has fully registered.

Cross Cut.name: Cross Cut
Cross Cut.description: Sweep both weapons inward to meet at the target in an X, catching a raised guard from two angles at once. Blocking one blade only frees the other.

Rapid Flurry.name: Rapid Flurry
Rapid Flurry.description: A short burst of alternating strikes that comes faster than the eye tracks comfortably. Individually light, collectively a problem.

Whirling Blades.name: Whirling Blades
Whirling Blades.description: Spin through a knot of enemies with both weapons extended, tagging everything within a step. Best used when surrounded, which for you is most days.

Twin Fang Assault.name: Twin Fang Assault
Twin Fang Assault.description: Drive both blades into a single target like a pair of fangs, one high and one low to defeat the guard. A veteran's opener that leaves little to counter.

Mirror Strike.name: Mirror Strike
Mirror Strike.description: Attack and defend at once, one weapon parrying while the other answers in the same breath. The enemy commits to your left and pays on your right.

Blade Storm.name: Blade Storm
Blade Storm.description: Unleash a sustained torrent of cuts from both hands that overwhelms even a careful defense. Somewhere in the blur, several of them get through.

Hundred Cuts.name: Hundred Cuts
Hundred Cuts.description: Close in and bury the target under a relentless count of shallow, precise strikes. No single wound is fatal, but they add up with alarming speed.

Tempest Dance.name: Tempest Dance
Tempest Dance.description: Flow through a whole formation as a spinning storm of steel, striking in every direction without pausing. Flashy, exhausting, and effective far past what it has any right to be.

Thousand Edges.name: Thousand Edges
Thousand Edges.description: A master's flurry so dense the two blades seem to become a dozen, leaving no safe angle to approach or retreat. By the time the count is done, so is the fight.

Twin Dragon Ascendant.name: Twin Dragon Ascendant
Twin Dragon Ascendant.description: The perfected form of two weapon mastery: both blades move as if guided by separate minds, carving a single unbroken storm that nothing living walks out of. The flashiest technique in the kingdom, and the one that actually earns the reputation.

Crimson Spark.name: Crimson Spark
Crimson Spark.description: A fledgling devotee's first true detonation, a fist sized burst that cracks stone and singes eyebrows. Small enough that the caster stays standing afterward, which is the only reason it gets practiced in town at all.

Bursting Bloom.name: Bursting Bloom
Bursting Bloom.description: A proper blast that blooms outward in a petal shaped shockwave, flattening a market stall and everything unlucky enough to share it. The caster staggers hard after casting and needs a long moment before doing anything useful again.

Cratercaller.name: Cratercaller
Cratercaller.description: Focus the detonation straight down to punch a smoking crater into the earth, hurling debris and enemies in every direction. Leaves the caster winded and swaying, one bad step from collapse.

Scarlet Cataclysm.name: Scarlet Cataclysm
Scarlet Cataclysm.description: A roaring crimson pillar of force that erases a squad and the terrain they were standing on. It costs 150 Mana, and the recoil drops the caster to their knees, spent and grinning.

Devastation Pillar.name: Devastation Pillar
Devastation Pillar.description: Channel arcane force into a towering column of destruction that scours a wide swath down to bedrock. It costs 150 Mana. After the light fades the caster sways, arms trembling, boasting through gritted teeth about the size of it.

Worldscar Blast.name: Worldscar Blast
Worldscar Blast.description: A blast so violent it leaves a permanent scar across the map, the kind of wound in the land that outlives everyone who saw it made. It costs 150 Mana, and a caster it empties collapses for the day, exactly as the school demands.

Doomsday Blossom.name: Doomsday Blossom
Doomsday Blossom.description: A cataclysmic flower of fire and force that unfolds across an entire battlefield, unmaking fortifications and armies alike. It costs 180 Mana; a pool it empties leaves a helpless, satisfied heap where a mage used to stand.

Heaven Piercing Detonation.name: Heaven Piercing Detonation
Heaven Piercing Detonation.description: A vertical spear of pure explosive power that lances up through the clouds and detonates everything beneath it, visible for miles as a second sunrise. It costs 180 Mana; a caster it empties is unconscious before the debris even lands.

Crimson God Annihilation.name: Crimson God Annihilation
Crimson God Annihilation.description: The apex of the school, a single apocalyptic blast that reshapes the horizon and reduces fortresses, generals, and mountains to a glassed crater in one heartbeat. It costs 200 Mana, the largest bill in magic. A caster it empties gets no recovery that day, only a limp and radiant body and the devotee's unshakable conviction that it was absolutely worth it.

Elemental Dart.name: Elemental Dart
Elemental Dart.description: Shape a small bolt of any chosen element, flame, frost, or a snap of static, and fling it at a target. Cheap, quick, and endlessly adaptable, the workhorse cantrip of every sensible mage the Crimson Demons pretend to look down on.

Howling Tempest.name: Howling Tempest
Howling Tempest.description: Summon a screaming gale that hurls enemies off their feet, scatters projectiles, and shreds lighter foes in a cone of cutting wind. Excellent for controlling a crowd or clearing a ledge of anyone standing on it.

Absolute Zero Field.name: Absolute Zero Field
Absolute Zero Field.description: Drop the temperature of a wide area to killing cold, flash freezing water, ground, and any creature caught inside into brittle statues. Frozen targets take shattering damage from the next solid hit.

Thunderous Cascade.name: Thunderous Cascade
Thunderous Cascade.description: Call down a lattice of lightning that leaps from target to target across the battlefield, each arc branching into the next. Nearly impossible to dodge and brutal against armored or clustered enemies.

Elemental Convergence.name: Elemental Convergence
Elemental Convergence.description: Weave fire, ice, wind, and lightning into a single braided assault that strikes a target zone with all four at once. Few defenses are attuned against everything, which is precisely the point.

Primordial Maelstrom.name: Primordial Maelstrom
Primordial Maelstrom.description: Conjure a churning storm of every element that grinds across a huge area, freezing, burning, and battering everything within for several seconds. The kind of battlefield weather that ends engagements rather than shaping them.

Sovereign Elemental Cataclysm.name: Sovereign Elemental Cataclysm
Sovereign Elemental Cataclysm.description: The crowning work of elemental mastery, a controlled apocalypse in which the caster commands all six elements as extensions of their own will, sculpting fire, ice, wind, water, earth, and lightning into a single devastating verdict. Total power with total precision, the answer to every mage who ever called versatility a weakness.

Radiant Mending.name: Radiant Mending
Radiant Mending.description: Pour divine light into a wounded ally to knit deep wounds, mend cracked bone, and wash away fatigue in moments. Reliable, warm, and genuinely miraculous, right up until the priest starts taking credit for it.

Consecrated Sanctuary.name: Consecrated Sanctuary
Consecrated Sanctuary.description: Sanctify a patch of ground into holy territory where allies are shielded, steadily healed, and undead recoil at the border. A blessed foothold to hold a bad line or catch a party's breath under pressure.

Tidal Restoration.name: Tidal Restoration
Tidal Restoration.description: Release a rolling wave of purified divine water that surges across the party, healing every ally it touches and cleansing minor ailments as it passes. Mass restoration with a goddess's signature flair for the dramatic.

Purifying Radiance.name: Purifying Radiance
Purifying Radiance.description: Unleash a blinding pulse of holy light that annihilates undead outright and sears curses and corruption from everything in range. Devils and skeletons cease to be a problem and, in the process, cease to be at all.

Aegis of Grace.name: Aegis of Grace
Aegis of Grace.description: Bless the entire party with a lasting mantle of divine favor, sharply raising their protection, resolve, and fortune for the fight ahead. The unglamorous party buff that quietly decides which side survives the day.

Miracle of Renewal.name: Miracle of Renewal
Miracle of Renewal.description: Call the recently fallen back across the veil all at once, restoring several downed allies to their feet with wounds sealed and vigor renewed. High divine magic at its most triumphant, and its most likely to be undercut by the caster demanding thanks.

Descent of the Goddess.name: Descent of the Goddess
Descent of the Goddess.description: The ultimate expression of divine magic, a moment where genuine goddess power floods the world to mass heal the living, resurrect the fallen, and obliterate every undead and corruption for a vast radius in a single tide of holy light. Aqua-tier majesty made real, awesome enough that no one mentions the scenery it accidentally purified along with the enemy.

Chill Touch.name: Chill Touch
Chill Touch.description: Draw the warmth out of a small target, frosting a mug or numbing a foe's fingers. The first trick every apprentice learns before they can freeze anything worth freezing.

Frost Bolt.name: Frost Bolt
Frost Bolt.description: Hurl a shard of hardened ice at a single target, dealing cold damage and slowing whatever it strikes. Reliable, cheap, and considerably less likely to level the building than certain alternatives.

Numbing Cold.name: Numbing Cold
Numbing Cold.description: Drop the temperature around a target until muscles stiffen and reactions slow. Enemies caught in the chill attack sluggishly and lose their footing on the sudden frost underfoot.

Ice Prison.name: Ice Prison
Ice Prison.description: Freeze a single target in place inside a casing of solid ice, holding them immobile until they break free or thaw. Effective on anything that needs to stop moving for a moment.

Rime Coating.name: Rime Coating
Rime Coating.description: Sheath a weapon or an ally in a layer of protective frost that bites back at attackers and blunts incoming heat. The armor cracks under repeated blows but buys valuable seconds.

Glacial Wall.name: Glacial Wall
Glacial Wall.description: Raise a thick barrier of ice from the ground, walling off a corridor or breaking an enemy charge. Solid enough to stop a monster, temporary enough to melt before it becomes a nuisance.

Blizzard Front.name: Blizzard Front
Blizzard Front.description: Summon a howling squall of snow and ice across a wide area, chilling every enemy caught inside and reducing their visibility to nothing. Allies learn to stand behind the caster.

Flash Freeze.name: Flash Freeze
Flash Freeze.description: Instantly encase a target in ice from the inside out, halting them completely in a single heartbeat. The signature setup for a certain Lich shopkeeper's favorite two part trick.

Shatter Point.name: Shatter Point
Shatter Point.description: Strike a frozen target and detonate the ice outward, converting the freeze into a burst of lethal shards. Pairs with Flash Freeze exactly as Wiz intended: freeze first, then shatter.

Permafrost Field.name: Permafrost Field
Permafrost Field.description: Blanket the entire battlefield in creeping permafrost that slows, chills, and freezes anything standing on it for good. The ground stays hazardous long after the fight ends.

Absolute Zero.name: Absolute Zero
Absolute Zero.description: Draw all heat from a single target down to nothing, freezing it so thoroughly that motion itself becomes impossible. Few living things survive the process and none of them enjoy it.

Cryostatic Cascade.name: Cryostatic Cascade
Cryostatic Cascade.description: Freeze one target and chain the shatter outward, each burst flash freezing the next enemy in a spreading lattice of ice and shrapnel. A whole formation locked and broken in one flowing sequence.

Eternal Winter.name: Eternal Winter
Eternal Winter.description: Call down winter itself across the land, freezing armies where they stand beneath endless snow and silence. The legendary pinnacle of frost magic, a season summoned on command and remembered for generations.

Short Blink.name: Short Blink
Short Blink.description: Wink out and reappear a few paces away, just far enough to sidestep a swing or reach a high shelf. The humble first step of every teleporter, and the one they use most.

Sidestep Jump.name: Sidestep Jump
Sidestep Jump.description: Flick across a room in an instant, trading a step through space for a step out of danger. Requires clear sight of the destination, or the arrival becomes memorably unpleasant.

Flank Step.name: Flank Step
Flank Step.description: Blink behind or beside a target mid fight, appearing where they least want you. The bread and butter maneuver for anyone who prefers hitting backs to hitting shields.

Recall Point.name: Recall Point
Recall Point.description: Mark a location in memory and snap back to it later from a short distance away. Useful for holding a fallback position or retrieving loot without walking the whole way twice.

Battlefield Shift.name: Battlefield Shift
Battlefield Shift.description: Cross the length of a battlefield in a blink, repositioning to a chokepoint or an exposed ally in an instant. The kind of mobility that makes slower opponents deeply frustrated.

Party Warp.name: Party Warp
Party Warp.description: Teleport yourself and nearby allies together to a location you have personally visited before. The standard escape hatch for a party that has once again bitten off far too much.

Displace Threat.name: Displace Threat
Displace Threat.description: Teleport a hazard away from you rather than yourself: a charging beast, a falling boulder, or a certain bomb shaped problem that was about to become everyone's problem. Range depends on the object's cooperation, which is minimal.

Swap Places.name: Swap Places
Swap Places.description: Instantly exchange positions with an ally or an enemy across the field, pulling a wounded friend to safety or dropping a foe into a trap. Timing turns this from clever into decisive.

Long Range Jump.name: Long Range Jump
Long Range Jump.description: Cover miles in a single cast, crossing to a distant place held clearly in memory. The difference between a two week overland journey and arriving in time for lunch.

Phase Retreat.name: Phase Retreat
Phase Retreat.description: React to an incoming strike by blinking the whole party clear at the last possible instant, leaving attackers hitting empty air. The escape that turns a wipe into a regroup.

Gate Anchor.name: Gate Anchor
Gate Anchor.description: Fix a stable teleport anchor in space that allies can travel to and from repeatedly for a time. A moving army suddenly gains a back door, and the enemy loses their siege.

Mass Relocation.name: Mass Relocation
Mass Relocation.description: Warp an entire group across vast distance in one coordinated cast, dozens of people delivered intact to a remembered place. The logistics of a campaign folded into a single spell.

Worldwalk.name: Worldwalk
Worldwalk.description: Step from anywhere to anywhere across the whole of the world in a heartbeat, distance rendered meaningless and no wall able to hold you. The legendary capstone that makes every other escape plan obsolete.

Arcane Primer.name: Arcane Primer
Arcane Primer.description: Grasp the theory beneath a spell well enough to squeeze a little more out of it than the textbook promises. The first sign a mage intends to show off rather than merely cast.

Efficient Weave.name: Efficient Weave
Efficient Weave.description: Streamline the flow of mana through a spell, casting it for less cost and faster than a plodding apprentice manages. Small savings that add up over a long, dramatic fight.

Twin Casting.name: Twin Casting
Twin Casting.description: Hold and release two lesser spells in the same breath, doubling output at the cost of considerable concentration. Crimson Demons practice this specifically to look impressive at parties.

Spell Overcharge.name: Spell Overcharge
Spell Overcharge.description: Force extra mana into a spell to push its power beyond its intended limit. The results are stronger and the backlash is real, so grip your staff and hope your calculations hold.

Chained Incantation.name: Chained Incantation
Chained Incantation.description: Link several spells into one continuous casting without pausing to breathe, unleashing them in rapid sequence. Collapsing halfway through is a common and humbling risk for the underprepared.

Mana Amplifier.name: Mana Amplifier
Mana Amplifier.description: Restructure your own mana flow to amplify every spell cast for a short window. A theatrical burst of raw arcane theory that turns a competent mage into a briefly terrifying one.

Spell Refraction.name: Spell Refraction
Spell Refraction.description: Bend a cast spell's shape and trajectory in midair, curving a bolt around cover or splitting one beam into several. The upper tier control that separates a scholar from a showman.

Counterspell Weave.name: Counterspell Weave
Counterspell Weave.description: Read an enemy's incantation as it forms and unravel it before it completes, snuffing a spell mid cast. Requires arcane theory sharp enough to think faster than another mage speaks.

Triple Weave.name: Triple Weave
Triple Weave.description: Cast three full spells simultaneously in a single coordinated release, a feat the textbooks list as strictly theoretical. The mage who pulls it off never lets anyone forget it.

Impossible Casting.name: Impossible Casting
Impossible Casting.description: Bring a spell the academies label impossible into working reality through sheer mastery of the underlying theory. Each successful cast quietly rewrites what the next generation believes can be done.

Grand Convergence.name: Grand Convergence
Grand Convergence.description: Fuse multiple high tier spells into a single unified effect greater than the sum of its parts. The flashiest display a Crimson Demon can manage before someone politely asks them to stop.

Sovereign Weave.name: Sovereign Weave
Sovereign Weave.description: Command a full lattice of spells at once, shaping, chaining, and amplifying each in real time as the battle demands. Arcane mastery so complete it looks less like casting and more like conducting.

Genius of the Arcane.name: Genius of the Arcane
Genius of the Arcane.description: Reach the genius tier the textbooks only whisper about, wielding the full breadth of high magic with effortless, devastating precision. The legendary capstone of arcane theory, the peak a certain one spell prodigy could touch if only she diversified.

Sense the Dead.name: Sense the Dead
Sense the Dead.description: Feel out corpses, graves, and lingering undead within a short radius. The first thing any necromancer learns, mostly so they stop being surprised by cemeteries.

Rattle Bones.name: Rattle Bones
Rattle Bones.description: Jolt a nearby set of remains into twitching, clattering motion for a few seconds. Useful for spooking bandits, less useful for actual labor, but everyone starts somewhere.

Raise Skeleton.name: Raise Skeleton
Raise Skeleton.description: Animate a single skeleton from available bones to shamble, carry, or swing a rusty blade. It follows simple orders and files no complaints, which is the entire appeal.

Animate Corpse.name: Animate Corpse
Animate Corpse.description: Reanimate a fresher body into a shambling servant with real weight behind it. Slow, obedient, and only mildly unsettling to the neighbors.

Grave Whisper.name: Grave Whisper
Grave Whisper.description: Issue silent commands to your undead across a distance, coordinating them like a very quiet, very dead work crew. No shouting required, which the dead appreciate.

Bone Ward.name: Bone Ward
Bone Ward.description: Fuse loose bones into a rattling barrier that intercepts blows meant for you. The wall absorbs punishment and can be rebuilt from whatever falls in the fight.

Marshal the Fallen.name: Marshal the Fallen
Marshal the Fallen.description: Raise and command a small squad of undead at once, directing their movements in unison. The paperwork of employing several corpses is real, but the labor is free.

Summon Ghoul Pack.name: Summon Ghoul Pack
Summon Ghoul Pack.description: Call forth a pack of fast, hungry ghouls that swarm and harry the living. Faster and nastier than skeletons, and considerably harder to schedule.

Bind Wight.name: Bind Wight
Bind Wight.description: Bind a wight, a thinking undead that retains cunning and can lead lesser minions for you. A genuine middle manager who thankfully will never unionize.

Deathless Legion.name: Deathless Legion
Deathless Legion.description: Raise a full host of the dead from a battlefield or crypt, fielding an army that does not tire, flee, or eat. Sustaining them is exhausting, but morale is never an issue.

Soul Tether.name: Soul Tether
Soul Tether.description: Anchor a departing soul to its body, keeping a powerful undead servant coherent and loyal far longer than nature permits. The kind of work that gets a necromancer politely uninvited from town.

Grave Sovereign.name: Grave Sovereign
Grave Sovereign.description: Assert dominion over every corpse in a wide area, raising and commanding them as a single obedient host. Whole graveyards rise at once and await instruction.

Lichs Dominion.name: Lichs Dominion
Lichs Dominion.description: The legendary art of a true Lich: command an unkillable army of the dead while binding your own existence beyond death itself. Whatever falls before you simply reports for duty in the morning.

Sour Luck.name: Sour Luck
Sour Luck.description: Nudge a target's fortune slightly downhill, so their next small task goes wrong. A stubbed toe, a dropped coin, a stumble. Petty, and deeply satisfying.

Petty Jinx.name: Petty Jinx
Petty Jinx.description: Lay a minor jinx that makes a foe fumble their grip or misstep at an inconvenient moment. The favorite prank of every apprentice devil worshipper.

Evil Eye.name: Evil Eye
Evil Eye.description: Fix a target with a cursed stare that saps their confidence and clouds their aim. The effect lingers as long as they can feel you watching.

Clumsy Hex.name: Clumsy Hex
Clumsy Hex.description: Curse a foe with sudden, persistent clumsiness, spoiling their footing and coordination in a fight. Watching a swordsman trip over nothing never gets old.

Withering Mark.name: Withering Mark
Withering Mark.description: Brand a target with a slow curse that gradually drains their strength over time. The mark deepens the longer it goes uncleansed, and it is not polite about it.

Lingering Curse.name: Lingering Curse
Lingering Curse.description: Attach a hex that clings past the fight, weakening the target for hours no matter how far they run. Ordinary prayers barely scratch it.

Curse of Frailty.name: Curse of Frailty
Curse of Frailty.description: Inflict deep bodily frailty, making a foe bruise easy, tire fast, and dread every blow. A devil's idea of a fair fight, which is to say not fair at all.

Doom Brand.name: Doom Brand
Doom Brand.description: Sear a brand of impending misfortune onto a target so that every risk they take turns against them. Their good rolls become bad ones with grim reliability.

Unbreakable Hex.name: Unbreakable Hex
Unbreakable Hex.description: Cast a curse woven to resist purification, shrugging off holy magic and clumsy exorcists alike. Removing it requires a specialist and usually a large fee.

Plague of Misfortune.name: Plague of Misfortune
Plague of Misfortune.description: Spread a rolling curse of bad luck across a group, so that accidents cascade through their ranks. One stumble triggers the next until the whole formation unravels.

Mask Devils Hex.name: Mask Devils Hex
Mask Devils Hex.description: A hex worthy of a Mask Devil, tailored precisely to a target's dearest hopes and turned against them. The misfortune arrives in whatever form would sting the most.

Grand Malediction.name: Grand Malediction
Grand Malediction.description: Pronounce a towering curse that layers frailty, doom, and lingering ruin onto a foe all at once. Even seasoned priests advise simply leaving the area.

Fate Unmaking.name: Fate Unmaking
Fate Unmaking.description: The legendary pinnacle of curse magic: bend a target's very fortune into a weapon that ensures nothing they attempt can ever go right. Misfortune becomes a precision instrument, and the target becomes a cautionary tale.

Conjure Shadow.name: Conjure Shadow
Conjure Shadow.description: Gather a patch of unnatural darkness in your hand or across a corner. Barely more than a parlor trick, but the church still frowns on it.

Gloom Veil.name: Gloom Veil
Gloom Veil.description: Draw a thin veil of shadow around yourself to soften your outline and dim nearby light. Good for skulking, better for dramatic entrances.

Shadow Bolt.name: Shadow Bolt
Shadow Bolt.description: Hurl a bolt of condensed darkness that bites at a target's nerve and morale as much as flesh. The go to forbidden spell for a novice who wants to look ominous.

Sap Strength.name: Sap Strength
Sap Strength.description: Reach into a foe's shadow and drain the vigor from their limbs at range. They grow sluggish while you feel a faint, guilty warmth.

Umbral Grasp.name: Umbral Grasp
Umbral Grasp.description: Command a target's own shadow to seize their feet and hold them in place. Escaping means fighting a piece of yourself, which rarely goes well.

Cloak of Night.name: Cloak of Night
Cloak of Night.description: Wrap yourself in living darkness that muffles sound and swallows light, turning you nearly invisible in dim conditions. The forbidden answer to needing an exit.

Shadow Strike.name: Shadow Strike
Shadow Strike.description: Lash out with a blade of pure shadow that cuts through mundane armor as if it were mist. Silent, cold, and exactly the sort of thing that ends up in a sermon.

Vitality Leech.name: Vitality Leech
Vitality Leech.description: Bleed the life warmth from a foe through tendrils of darkness, transferring it to sustain yourself. Devastating in a long fight and thoroughly disapproved of everywhere.

Shade Bind.name: Shade Bind
Shade Bind.description: Bind several foes at once with chains of writhing shadow that tighten as they struggle. Holds a whole group while your allies decide what to do about it.

Nights Embrace.name: Nights Embrace
Nights Embrace.description: Blanket an area in smothering darkness that drains and disorients everything inside it save you. Enemies grope blindly while their strength quietly ebbs away.

Void Lance.name: Void Lance
Void Lance.description: Compress shadow into a lance of hollow nothingness and drive it through a single target and whatever stands behind them. The church has a very thick file on this one.

Eclipse Field.name: Eclipse Field
Eclipse Field.description: Blot out all light across the battlefield, weakening every foe within while your own shadow magic swells to full power. Daylight simply stops being a thing that applies to you.

Abyssal Oblivion.name: Abyssal Oblivion
Abyssal Oblivion.description: The legendary summit of forbidden magic: open a rift of pure abyssal darkness that drains, crushes, and unmakes all it touches. Entire threats vanish into it, and the church convenes an emergency meeting the moment it is cast.

Conjure Glimmer.name: Conjure Glimmer
Conjure Glimmer.description: Summon a floating mote of soft light to read by, find a dropped coin, or reassure a party too broke for lanterns. It is the first thing any acolyte learns and the last thing anyone respects.

Guiding Radiance.name: Guiding Radiance
Guiding Radiance.description: Cast a steady sphere of daylight that follows you and lights a full room or corridor. Bright enough to expose a lurking ambush, dim enough that nobody is impressed.

Blinding Flash.name: Blinding Flash
Blinding Flash.description: Detonate a sudden burst of white light in an enemy's face, leaving them dazzled and swinging at afterimages. Works on people, monsters, and, embarrassingly often, allies standing too close.

Flare Burst.name: Flare Burst
Flare Burst.description: Release an expanding ring of searing brilliance that scorches nearby foes and blinds the rest. A reliable opener that clears space and announces you are, in fact, a caster of some kind.

Light Lance.name: Light Lance
Light Lance.description: Condense light into a thin javelin and hurl it through a target at range. Holy energy makes it especially unpleasant for undead and mildly rude to everyone else.

Radiant Blade.name: Radiant Blade
Radiant Blade.description: Shape a humming blade of pure light in your hand that cuts through armor and weak wards alike. A certain lonely Crimson Demon overuses this exact spell and refuses to hear about it.

Holy Lance.name: Holy Lance
Holy Lance.description: Call down a spear of consecrated light that punches through a single target with brutal force. Devastating to the undead, and it leaves a glowing scorch mark that lingers for hours.

Purging Brilliance.name: Purging Brilliance
Purging Brilliance.description: Flood an area with anti-undead radiance that sears skeletons, ghouls, and specters to ash. The living merely wince and complain about the spots in their vision.

Solar Flare.name: Solar Flare
Solar Flare.description: Conjure a miniature sun overhead and let it burst, bathing the field in blistering light and heat. Enemies burn, undead disintegrate, and nearby laundry dries instantly.

Blades of Dawn.name: Blades of Dawn
Blades of Dawn.description: Summon a rotating array of light blades that scythe through everything in range in a single sweeping pass. Precise, brilliant, and the kind of technique swordsmen quietly resent.

Radiant Judgment.name: Radiant Judgment
Radiant Judgment.description: Pin a target under a descending pillar of holy light that grows brighter until it detonates. Larger foes and greater undead rarely walk away, and smaller ones do not walk anywhere ever again.

Heaven's Brilliance.name: Heaven's Brilliance
Heaven's Brilliance.description: Tear the sky open and pour a cascade of searing radiance across the entire battlefield, scouring undead and shredding dark magic wholesale. Witnesses report afterimages that linger for days.

Dawn of Creation.name: Dawn of Creation
Dawn of Creation.description: The pinnacle of light magic: manifest a false dawn so absolute that darkness itself is erased and every undead within sight is annihilated in a single silent flash. Survivors see spots for a week and speak of it for the rest of their lives.

Kindle Tinder.name: Kindle Tinder
Kindle Tinder.description: Spark a small flame at a fingertip to light a fire, a lantern, or a stubborn cigarette. The unglamorous cantrip that quietly keeps a broke party warm and fed.

Create Water (Support Magic).name: Create Water (Support Magic)
Create Water (Support Magic).description: Conjure a surge of clean water from the air to drink, douse a fire, or ruin a bandit's day at exactly the wrong moment. A favorite trick of a certain penny-pinching adventurer.

Lesser Bind.name: Lesser Bind
Lesser Bind.description: Snare a single weak foe with threads of magical force, locking their limbs for a few precious seconds. Enough to let an ally line up a hit, assuming the ally is paying attention.

Drowsing Word.name: Drowsing Word
Drowsing Word.description: Whisper a soporific spell that drags a lightly guarded mind toward sleep. Fragile enemies drop where they stand, and heavy sleepers become disturbingly easy to rob.

Paralyze.name: Paralyze
Paralyze.description: Seize a target's nervous system and lock them rigid for a short window. Deals no damage, wins fights anyway, and infuriates anyone proud of their reflexes.

Swift Blessing.name: Swift Blessing
Swift Blessing.description: Layer an ally with a haste enchantment, sharpening their footwork and doubling their tempo for a time. The buff every front-liner forgets to thank you for.

Rallying Ward.name: Rallying Ward
Rallying Ward.description: Blanket the whole party in a protective blessing that steadies nerves and stiffens defenses at once. Unglamorous, unnoticed, and the reason everyone survives the ambush.

Binding Chains.name: Binding Chains
Binding Chains.description: Wrap a target in heavy coils of woven mana that resist struggling and outlast a lesser bind by far. Strong enough to hold a charging brute long enough to regret its charge.

Deep Slumber.name: Deep Slumber
Deep Slumber.description: Force a powerful sleep over several enemies at once, dropping even hardened veterans if their guard slips. The polite way to win a battle nobody wanted to fight.

Mass Reinforcement.name: Mass Reinforcement
Mass Reinforcement.description: Stack strength, speed, and resilience buffs across the entire party in a single sweeping cast. Turns a group of underdogs into a functioning fighting unit for as long as it lasts.

Grand Sanctuary.name: Grand Sanctuary
Grand Sanctuary.description: Raise a wide zone of protective magic that shields allies, blunts hostile spells, and steadies the ground itself. Standing inside it is the closest a doomed plan gets to survivable.

Total Lockdown.name: Total Lockdown
Total Lockdown.description: Bind, paralyze, and pin every hostile in range at once, freezing an entire enemy line in place. For a few glorious seconds the fight simply stops, which is usually all a clever party needs.

Field of Silent Rest.name: Field of Silent Rest
Field of Silent Rest.description: The culmination of support magic: blanket a vast area in an irresistible weave of sleep and binding that lays low armies without a single wound. The utility caster nobody praised now decides the battle alone, and still gets none of the credit.

Cold Warning.name: Cold Warning
Cold Warning.description: Deliver a flat, unhurried threat that lands harder than shouting ever could. A small group reconsiders picking a fight, though anyone above your pay grade will simply raise an eyebrow.

Crack the Bravado.name: Crack the Bravado
Crack the Bravado.description: Find the exact moment a tough act is held together by nerves and lean on it. The loudest thug in the room goes quiet, and the rest quietly recalculate their odds.

Cow the Crowd.name: Cow the Crowd
Cow the Crowd.description: Project menace across a whole room rather than a single target, pinning a mob in place before it decides to become a problem. Useful for clearing a tavern without paying for the broken furniture.

Grim Renown.name: Grim Renown
Grim Renown.description: Your reputation arrives before you do, so the threatening is already half finished. Enemies who have heard the stories hesitate, flinch, or find urgent business elsewhere.

Bloodfreezing Glare.name: Bloodfreezing Glare
Bloodfreezing Glare.description: A single look weighted with genuine intent to end things, freezing weaker foes mid motion. Stronger enemies shrug it off and are usually annoyed you tried.

Command the Silence.name: Command the Silence
Command the Silence.description: Walk into any gathering and let the noise die on its own, every eye tracking you and every argument suddenly forgotten. Nobody wants to be the one who speaks first.

Warlord's Bearing.name: Warlord's Bearing
Warlord's Bearing.description: Carry yourself like something that has broken armies and expects to break more, bending even seasoned officers toward compliance. Whole units surrender rather than test the claim.

Aura of Terror.name: Aura of Terror
Aura of Terror.description: Radiate dread so thick that ordinary enemies drop their weapons and run without deciding to. Only the truly powerful, or the truly stupid, hold their ground.

Sovereign of Dread.name: Sovereign of Dread
Sovereign of Dread.description: The capstone of pure menace. Presence alone forces a battlefield to its knees, routing armies, silencing generals, and making even monsters recall pressing appointments in the next kingdom. The kind of fear that rewrites how a name is spoken for generations.

Steal the Show.name: Steal the Show
Steal the Show.description: Open with a flourish loud enough that nobody in the room can look away. Buys attention, tips, and just enough distraction for an ally to slip out the back.

Work the Room.name: Work the Room
Work the Room.description: Read a crowd's mood and play directly to it, turning a lukewarm audience warm within a verse or two. Morale rises, coins land, and hecklers lose their footing.

Crimson Demon Entrance.name: Crimson Demon Entrance
Crimson Demon Entrance.description: The mandatory dramatic self introduction, pose and title and all, delivered with absolutely no shame. Enemies are too baffled to attack for a moment, and allies pretend they do not know you.

Enthrall the Hall.name: Enthrall the Hall
Enthrall the Hall.description: Hold an entire venue in the palm of your hand, every guard and patron rooted where they stand. Perfect cover for allies to move, steal, or leave unnoticed while all eyes stay on you.

Rousing Anthem.name: Rousing Anthem
Rousing Anthem.description: Strike up a piece that genuinely lifts a party past their limits, steadying nerves and sharpening focus mid battle. The tune sticks in their heads for days, which they will complain about later.

Grand Spectacle.name: Grand Spectacle
Grand Spectacle.description: Stage a performance so large and loud it becomes the only thing happening in the district. Draws every wandering eye to one point, demoralizes watching enemies, and inspires everyone on your side at once.

Standing Ovation.name: Standing Ovation
Standing Ovation.description: End on a note that pulls a crowd to its feet whether they meant to stand or not, cementing loyalty and awe. Those who witnessed it will argue in your favor long after you have gone.

Soul of the Crowd.name: Soul of the Crowd
Soul of the Crowd.description: Become the shared heartbeat of everyone present, bending an entire audience toward whatever emotion you choose to play. Grief, courage, or riotous joy, all of it yours to conduct.

Ballad Everlasting.name: Ballad Everlasting
Ballad Everlasting.description: The masterwork of performance. A single piece that inspires allies to their absolute peak, breaks the will of every enemy who hears it, and becomes a song the kingdom sings for a hundred years. The kind of moment that turns out to be load bearing to the entire plot.

Reasoned Appeal.name: Reasoned Appeal
Reasoned Appeal.description: Lay out a clean, honest argument that a reasonable person cannot easily wave away. Shifts a firm opinion a notch, which is often all a negotiation needs.

Find Common Ground.name: Find Common Ground
Find Common Ground.description: Locate the one thing both sides actually want and build the whole deal on it. Turns a standoff into a conversation, even between people who arrived ready to draw weapons.

Turn the Table.name: Turn the Table
Turn the Table.description: Reframe a losing position until the other party believes your outcome was their idea all along. Hostile negotiators walk away convinced they won, which is the best kind of winning.

Sway the Council.name: Sway the Council
Sway the Council.description: Address a room of decision makers and move the majority toward your side through sheer clarity and conviction. Works on guild boards, town councils, and the occasional skeptical noble.

Undeniable Case.name: Undeniable Case
Undeniable Case.description: Assemble an argument so airtight that refusing it would make the listener look foolish, and they know it. Firm minds fold, and the stubborn ask for time to save face.

Master Diplomat.name: Master Diplomat
Master Diplomat.description: Navigate a tense standoff between rival powers and leave with everyone shaking hands. The rare talent that ends wars over a table instead of a battlefield.

Change of Heart.name: Change of Heart
Change of Heart.description: Speak to what a person truly wants beneath the argument and turn a sworn enemy into a reluctant ally. Not magic, just words that reach further than a sword ever could.

Peace Without Blood.name: Peace Without Blood
Peace Without Blood.description: The highest art of honest persuasion. Talk down forces that came to destroy, unravel a fanatic's resolve, and convince even a Demon King's general to lay down the sword and open a quiet little shop instead. It has genuinely happened, which is the most frightening part.

Convincing Cover.name: Convincing Cover
Convincing Cover.description: Spin a cover story with enough specific, boring detail that questioning it feels rude. Holds up to a suspicious glance and most casual follow up questions.

Flawless Alibi.name: Flawless Alibi
Flawless Alibi.description: Construct a false account so consistent that even a careful investigator finds nothing to pull on. The property damage was, of course, already there when you arrived.

Perfect Disguise.name: Perfect Disguise
Perfect Disguise.description: Adopt an appearance, voice, and manner complete enough to pass for someone else under real scrutiny. Fools acquaintances of the person you are imitating, at least for a while.

Con the Official.name: Con the Official
Con the Official.description: Talk a wary official into waving through exactly what they were posted to stop, papers and all. They will insist everything was in order right up until it obviously was not.

Elaborate Ruse.name: Elaborate Ruse
Elaborate Ruse.description: Run a layered scheme with props, planted rumors, and a supporting cast of assumptions, all pointing a target the wrong way. By the time they see through one layer, three more have already done their work.

The Long Con.name: The Long Con
The Long Con.description: Set a deception that unfolds over days or weeks, each piece confirming the last until the mark trusts the lie more than the truth. Devastating, patient, and deeply satisfying to pull off.

Weave False Reality.name: Weave False Reality
Weave False Reality.description: Build a web of fabrication so complete that a target acts on entirely false beliefs and never once suspects it. They defend your lie to others as if it were their own memory.

Ghost of a Lie.name: Ghost of a Lie
Ghost of a Lie.description: The last thing you learn about deceit. Orchestrate a con so total that whole factions chase a story you invented, records agree with you, and by the end nobody can prove you were ever involved at all. The masterpiece leaves no seam, no witness, and no trace it was a lie.

Clear Order.name: Clear Order
Clear Order.description: State a single, unambiguous instruction that an ally can actually follow. Half of party command is just not being confusing, a bar most Axel rookies fail to clear.

Rally Cry.name: Rally Cry
Rally Cry.description: A short shout that steadies nervous allies and shakes off minor fear. Works best when you sound more confident than you are.

Hold Formation.name: Hold Formation
Hold Formation.description: Keep a party in workable positions instead of scattering the moment a monster appears. Grants nearby allies a brief boost to defense while they stay in line.

Focus Fire.name: Focus Fire
Focus Fire.description: Direct the whole party onto one target so effort stops being wasted on three at once. Marked enemies take coordinated pressure until they drop.

Steady the Line.name: Steady the Line
Steady the Line.description: Anchor a wavering group so nobody breaks and runs at the worst moment. Allies within earshot resist panic and keep their assigned roles for the exchange.

Coordinated Assault.name: Coordinated Assault
Coordinated Assault.description: Time the party's actions into one clean sequence rather than four separate accidents. Allies acting on your call gain a shared bonus to their next moves.

Take Command.name: Take Command
Take Command.description: Step into a leaderless mess and impose order through sheer decisiveness. Even allies who are not yours will follow clear direction when nobody else is giving any.

Turn the Tide.name: Turn the Tide
Turn the Tide.description: Read a collapsing fight and call the one adjustment that flips momentum back. A losing engagement becomes survivable, at least for a few decisive rounds.

Unbreakable Morale.name: Unbreakable Morale
