Unbreakable Morale.description: Instill a confidence so firm the party fights on through losses that should have routed them. Allies shrug off fear, despair, and the urge to blame the priest.

Battlefield Presence.name: Battlefield Presence
Battlefield Presence.description: Command a wide field by voice and bearing alone, coordinating groups too far apart to hear each other clearly. Allied units move as if they share one plan.

Rally the Doomed.name: Rally the Doomed
Rally the Doomed.description: Make a suicidal plan sound not only survivable but reasonable, and get people to commit to it. Allies attempt long odds they would flatly refuse from anyone else.

Master Tactician.name: Master Tactician
Master Tactician.description: Orchestrate an entire engagement in advance, assigning every ally a role that fits their strengths and hides their many weaknesses. The party performs far above its actual competence.

Banner of the Vanguard.name: Banner of the Vanguard
Banner of the Vanguard.description: A legendary presence that welds a doomed rabble into a genuine fighting force through will alone. For as long as you stand and speak, four idiots become a party, allies ignore fear entirely, and even hopeless stands hold. Briefly.

Proper Bow.name: Proper Bow
Proper Bow.description: Bow at the correct depth to the correct person without falling over. The first thing separating an adventurer from a scandal.

Table Manners.name: Table Manners
Table Manners.description: Use the right fork and refrain from eating like you just cleared a dungeon. Passes a casual meal among people who care about such things.

Polite Deflection.name: Polite Deflection
Polite Deflection.description: Turn aside a nosy or awkward question with a courteous non-answer nobody can object to. Buys time and avoids offense in one motion.

Court Introduction.name: Court Introduction
Court Introduction.description: Present yourself and your party to nobility with the correct titles, order, and phrasing. A smooth introduction opens doors that a fumbled one bolts shut.

Graceful Poise.name: Graceful Poise
Graceful Poise.description: Hold composed, correct bearing through an entire formal function without a visible slip. Improves how seriously the room takes you, regardless of your actual rank.

Ballroom Navigation.name: Ballroom Navigation
Ballroom Navigation.description: Move through a formal ball reading who to greet, who to avoid, and where the real conversations happen. Reach the person you came for without causing a single stir.

Veiled Insult.name: Veiled Insult
Veiled Insult.description: Deliver a barb so wrapped in courtesy the target thanks you for it and only later understands. The favored weapon of nobles who cannot legally draw steel.

Noble Bearing.name: Noble Bearing
Noble Bearing.description: Carry yourself with such assured refinement that others assume you belong wherever you stand. Servants defer and guards hesitate to question you.

Diplomatic Immunity.name: Diplomatic Immunity
Diplomatic Immunity.description: Invoke protocol and formal courtesy so precisely that hostile hosts cannot act against you without disgracing themselves. A social shield stronger than most armor at a dinner.

Courtier's Grace.name: Courtier's Grace
Courtier's Grace.description: Glide through overlapping cliques, feuds, and slights, keeping every faction satisfied at once. The kind of footwork that makes veteran courtiers ask who trained you.

Flawless Protocol.name: Flawless Protocol
Flawless Protocol.description: Observe every rule of ceremony so perfectly that even those hunting for a misstep find none. Leaves rivals unable to challenge your standing on any point of form.

Highborn Presence.name: Highborn Presence
Highborn Presence.description: Command a formal room by manner alone, setting the tone that everyone present quietly follows. Nobles adjust to you, mistaking practiced grace for the accident of noble birth.

Born to the Court.name: Born to the Court
Born to the Court.description: A legendary command of high society so complete that the highest circles simply accept you as one of their own. You navigate any court, defuse any insult, and end an evening owed favors by people who never noticed conceding them. Whether or not you own a single drop of noble blood.

Notice Nerves.name: Notice Nerves
Notice Nerves.description: Catch the obvious signs that someone is uneasy: a fidget, a glance, a swallowed word. The first step toward not being the last to know.

Spot the Tell.name: Spot the Tell
Spot the Tell.description: Pick out the small habit that gives a person away when they stretch the truth. Useful at a card table and more useful outside one.

Gauge Mood.name: Gauge Mood
Gauge Mood.description: Read the emotional temperature of a person or small group before it turns into a problem. Know when to press, when to soothe, and when to leave immediately.

Sense Motive.name: Sense Motive
Sense Motive.description: Judge whether someone's stated reason matches their real one. Flags the mismatch between what a person says they want and what they are actually after.

Detect Lie.name: Detect Lie
Detect Lie.description: Separate a bluff from the truth with trained attention to voice, pause, and posture. Not infallible, but far better than the party's usual method of finding out the hard way.

Pierce the Bluff.name: Pierce the Bluff
Pierce the Bluff.description: See past a confident front to the doubt underneath, calling a threat that has nothing behind it. Turns a convincing act into an obvious one.

Weigh the Words.name: Weigh the Words
Weigh the Words.description: Parse a careful statement for the thing being talked around, hearing the omission as clearly as the words. Catch the half-truth that a lie detector would pass.

See Through.name: See Through
See Through.description: Read intent early enough to know a fight is coming before a hand reaches for a weapon. The warning that lets a party act first instead of reacting late.

Devil's Contract Eye.name: Devil's Contract Eye
Devil's Contract Eye.description: Spot the trap in a too-generous offer, the clause buried in the honeyed terms. Devils and merchants both hate the person who reads before they sign.

Unmasked Truth.name: Unmasked Truth
Unmasked Truth.description: Strip a practiced facade down to the person underneath, even one built to deceive experts. Few disguises of manner survive this level of scrutiny for long.

Read the Heart.name: Read the Heart
Read the Heart.description: Grasp a person's true fear, want, and intention from a handful of small signs. Knowing what someone actually needs makes the rest of any conversation a formality.

Mind's Mirror.name: Mind's Mirror
Mind's Mirror.description: Anticipate a decision before the person has consciously reached it, reading the choice in its earliest signs. Unsettling to be near, invaluable to have on your side.

The Unspoken Known.name: The Unspoken Known
The Unspoken Known.description: A legendary perception that lays a person's intentions bare before a single word is spoken. No bluff holds, no contract hides its teeth, and no schemer keeps a secret you have decided to read. The rare gift that makes liars simply give up trying.

Refuse First Price.name: Refuse First Price
Refuse First Price.description: Say no to the opening number, as tradition and basic sense demand. The single most profitable word a customer ever learns.

Counter Offer.name: Counter Offer
Counter Offer.description: Name a lower figure without insulting the vendor into silence. The first real move of any honest haggle.

Fair Deal.name: Fair Deal
Fair Deal.description: Settle on a price both sides can live with instead of storming off over a few coins. Keeps a shop willing to serve you again next week.

Talk Down Price.name: Talk Down Price
Talk Down Price.description: Work a stubborn seller off their asking figure through patience and pointed comparison. Reliably shaves a meaningful cut off common goods.

Feigned Disinterest.name: Feigned Disinterest
Feigned Disinterest.description: Set down the item you want and turn to leave, letting the vendor's fear of a lost sale do the arguing. A cheap trick that works far more often than it should.

Sweeten the Pot.name: Sweeten the Pot
Sweeten the Pot.description: Fold in a small extra that costs you little and reads as generous, tipping a stalled deal your way. The difference between a haggle that stalls and one that closes.

Corner the Deal.name: Corner the Deal
Corner the Deal.description: Steer a hard negotiation so the other side runs out of room without noticing the walls closing in. Wins the price you wanted while they think it was their idea.

Guild Negotiator.name: Guild Negotiator
Guild Negotiator.description: Hold your own against professional buyers who haggle for a living and expect to win. Secures terms a merchant guild considers uncomfortably generous.

Merchant's Ruin.name: Merchant's Ruin
Merchant's Ruin.description: Dismantle a seller's every justification until their own numbers argue for your side. They agree to the deal and quietly wonder how it went so wrong.

Silver Ledger.name: Silver Ledger
Silver Ledger.description: Track the true worth, margin, and weak point of every item on the table at once. Out-calculate a shop that has been pricing goods since before you were born.

Vanir's Method.name: Vanir's Method
Vanir's Method.description: Close a deal so favorable it looks like a gift, right up until the coins are counted. The mark of a dealer who profits while the other party celebrates the bargain.

The Better End.name: The Better End
The Better End.description: Walk into any negotiation and walk out holding the longer side of the deal, whatever the starting terms. Seasoned traders learn to check their purses after shaking your hand.

Shirt and Gratitude.name: Shirt and Gratitude
Shirt and Gratitude.description: A legendary command of the deal that leaves a merchant parted from their finest goods, their best price, and somehow still thanking you for the honor. No first offer survives, no guild out-haggles you, and everyone at the table believes they came out ahead. They did not.

Cat Landing.name: Cat Landing
Cat Landing.description: Fall from a height that should break a normal body and land rolling, shedding most of the impact. Gravity files a complaint. You keep walking.

Vault Chain.name: Vault Chain
Vault Chain.description: String vaults, wall kicks, and handsprings into one unbroken line of movement, clearing obstacles that would stop a pursuer cold. Terrain stops mattering to you.

Aerial Twist.name: Aerial Twist
Aerial Twist.description: Twist mid air to slip a blow you have already committed to dodging, changing your trajectory in open defiance of physics. You land facing the enemy, entirely unbothered.

Ricochet Escape.name: Ricochet Escape
Ricochet Escape.description: Kick off walls, foes, and thin air to bounce clear of a closing trap or encirclement, leaving pursuers grabbing empty space. Works best when everyone was certain you were cornered.

Impossible Angle.name: Impossible Angle
Impossible Angle.description: Bend your body around a strike at an angle joints were never meant to reach, turning a guaranteed hit into a graze. Onlookers wince. You keep moving.

Gravity's Suggestion.name: Gravity's Suggestion
Gravity's Suggestion.description: Treat footing as optional for a few seconds, running along ceilings, rails, and sheer walls as though they were the floor. The world's rules become briefly negotiable.

Untouchable Flow.name: Untouchable Flow
Untouchable Flow.description: Enter a flowing state where every incoming attack meets only the space you just left, chaining dodges into one continuous unhittable dance. It ends when you decide to stop, not when they finally land a hit.

Feather in a Hurricane.name: Feather in a Hurricane
Feather in a Hurricane.description: The pinnacle of acrobatic mastery. For one impossible stretch you become genuinely untouchable, sliding between blades, blasts, and collapsing terrain as if the whole battlefield were choreographed for your survival. Legends claim you can dodge an Explosion, and the people who tell those legends watched you do it.

Iron Stomach.name: Iron Stomach
Iron Stomach.description: Eat questionable field food, drink dubious water, and shrug off the parasites, rot, and mild toxins that would fell a soft city dweller. The wilds stop being a slow poison.

Cold Trail Reader.name: Cold Trail Reader
Cold Trail Reader.description: Read a trail gone cold hours ago, following broken sign, faint scent, and disturbed ground across terrain that erased it for everyone else. The quarry runs, and you already know where to.

Weather Sense.name: Weather Sense
Weather Sense.description: Feel a coming storm, cold snap, or clear spell a full day out and move the party to exploit it. The sky stops surprising you, and starts working for you.

Living Off Ruin.name: Living Off Ruin
Living Off Ruin.description: Wring shelter, food, and clean water from terrain that offers none, keeping a flat broke party alive through winter with a knife and pure stubbornness. Poverty stops being fatal.

Predator's Patience.name: Predator's Patience
Predator's Patience.description: Wait out and outlast a hunting monster, reading its habits until it tires itself or blunders into your ambush. The wilds reward whoever blinks last, and you flatly refuse to.

Unkillable Wanderer.name: Unkillable Wanderer
Unkillable Wanderer.description: Endure exposure, starvation, and terrain that swallows whole expeditions, walking out of the deep wilds weeks later thinner but breathing. The environment gives up before you do.

One With the Wilds.name: One With the Wilds
One With the Wilds.description: Move through any biome as though born to it, tracking, foraging, sheltering, and predicting hazards with near infallible instinct. Frozen waste or monster forest, the land quietly tells you its secrets.

Heart of the Untamed.name: Heart of the Untamed
Heart of the Untamed.description: The absolute summit of survival craft. No environment in the kingdom can kill you through its own nature, not the frozen north, not the cursed marsh, not the monster thick deep forest. You keep a ruined party alive where a veteran ranger would have started writing the wills, because the wilderness has stopped being an enemy and become, grudgingly, home.

Nimble Fingers.name: Nimble Fingers
Nimble Fingers.description: Lift a coin purse, swap a document, or palm a key with a touch too light to register. Casual pickpocketing becomes reflex rather than gamble.

Aimed Steal.name: Aimed Steal
Aimed Steal.description: Refine the infamous Steal skill enough to nudge the odds toward the target's actual valuables instead of their underwear. The randomness shrinks. The potential for humiliation, true to the technique, never fully leaves.

Ghost Hands.name: Ghost Hands
Ghost Hands.description: Rob a target in the middle of a conversation, sliding items free while they look you in the eye. They notice the loss only well after you are gone.

Trapsmith's Touch.name: Trapsmith's Touch
Trapsmith's Touch.description: Disarm the lock and its trap in a single motion, reading the mechanism by feel and defeating both before either can bite. Vaulted dungeon chests stop being a gamble.

Crowd Skimmer.name: Crowd Skimmer
Crowd Skimmer.description: Work an entire crowd in one unhurried pass, coming out the far side heavier by a dozen purses and suspected by none. Market days quietly become paydays.

Perfect Steal.name: Perfect Steal
Perfect Steal.description: Bend the Steal skill fully to your will at last, choosing the exact item you rip from a target: their weapon, their key, their one trump card. The gods of random loot finally look the other way.

Phantom Larcenist.name: Phantom Larcenist
Phantom Larcenist.description: Relieve a guarded target of something valuable and specific with no alarm, no trace, and no evidence a theft ever happened. The victim files no report because the victim never suspects.

Kingdom in a Pocket.name: Kingdom in a Pocket
Kingdom in a Pocket.description: The legendary apex of thievery. Nothing is truly guarded from you, not a noble's sealed vault, not a general's warded relic, not the ring off a sleeping dragon's claw. You can Steal the single item that decides a war and vanish before the loss is even noticed. Whether the deed reads as heroic or shameless depends entirely on what you chose to take.

Sharp Instincts.name: Sharp Instincts
Sharp Instincts.description: Catch the ambush, the pickpocket, and the padded price tag a beat before they land on you. Little in plain sight survives your first glance.

Trap Eye.name: Trap Eye
Trap Eye.description: Read a room for hidden mechanisms, tripwires, and wards at a glance, marking every danger before a single foot moves. Dungeons stop hiding their teeth from you.

Tell Reader.name: Tell Reader
Tell Reader.description: Catch the flicker of a lie in a face, a voice, or a twitching hand, separating the honest word from the rehearsed one. Con artists find your company exhausting.

Wide Awareness.name: Wide Awareness
Wide Awareness.description: Track everything in a crowded, chaotic space at once: the exits, the threats, the hand drifting toward a knife. Nothing flanks you, because nothing goes unseen.

Precognitive Flinch.name: Precognitive Flinch
Precognitive Flinch.description: Sense a strike, spell, or trap in the instant before it triggers, buying the split second that turns a fatal blow into a near miss. Enough brushes with death have rewired your instincts.

Pierce the Veil.name: Pierce the Veil
Pierce the Veil.description: Notice what was deliberately concealed: the invisible lurker, the disguised assassin, the magic worked specifically to be missed. Concealment becomes a suggestion you politely decline.

All Seeing Focus.name: All Seeing Focus
All Seeing Focus.description: Enter a state of total awareness where hidden foes, concealed magic, structural flaws, and every subtle intent lie plainly visible. The scene has no secrets left to keep from you.

Eye That Misses Nothing.name: Eye That Misses Nothing
Eye That Misses Nothing.description: The legendary summit of perception. In your presence nothing stays hidden, not the assassin three roofs away, not the lie beneath a friendly smile, not the gap in a Demon King general's guard. You read a battlefield, a ballroom, or a betrayal in a single sweep and act before anyone realizes you noticed. The rest of the world feels perpetually one step behind your eyes.

Rumor Ear.name: Rumor Ear
Rumor Ear.description: Catch the useful gossip drifting through a tavern or market and sort the real lead from a drunk's fantasy. Every town talks. You are the one who actually listens.

Know a Guy.name: Know a Guy
Know a Guy.description: Turn up a local contact for nearly any need in a strange town: a fence, a fixer, a bed with no questions asked. Somebody always knows somebody, and you find them fast.

Black Market Map.name: Black Market Map
Black Market Map.description: Locate the hidden economy of any city cold: the back room auctions, the smuggler stalls, the goods no honest shop admits to stocking. If it changes hands quietly, you know exactly where.

Read the Streets.name: Read the Streets
Read the Streets.description: Take the pulse of a district in minutes, reading who holds the power, who owes whom, and which alley to avoid after dark. A strange city stops being dangerous ground.

Favor Network.name: Favor Network
Favor Network.description: Call in the web of small debts and quiet favors you have seeded across the underworld, producing information, muscle, or an alibi on short notice. Years of greased palms all pay out at once.

Word on the Street.name: Word on the Street
Word on the Street.description: Put out a single question and have the answer come back through a dozen mouths by nightfall: a bounty's truth, a target's whereabouts, a lie's origin. The whole city becomes your informant.

Underworld Broker.name: Underworld Broker
Underworld Broker.description: Move through the criminal hierarchy of any city as a known quantity, brokering deals, safe passage, and secrets among people who trust almost no one. Doors that stay shut to outsiders open on your name alone.

Shadow of the City.name: Shadow of the City
Shadow of the City.description: Command a kingdom spanning network of informants, fences, and fixers so complete that little happens in any town without word reaching you first. You stay three streets ahead of everyone else's plans.

King of the Gutter.name: King of the Gutter
King of the Gutter.description: The legendary peak of street mastery. No city in the kingdom keeps its secrets from you, since every black market, every crooked official, and every rumor's true source sits one call away through a network built over a lifetime of favors. Arrive a stranger and own the underworld by supper. Nobles run the map. You run everything beneath it.

Quiet Footing.name: Quiet Footing
Quiet Footing.description: Learn to place your feet where the floorboards do not complain. It is the difference between sneaking and announcing yourself to everyone in the tavern.

Hug the Wall.name: Hug the Wall
Hug the Wall.description: Stick to walls, corners, and doorways to keep out of the open. A bored guard's eyes slide right over anyone patient enough to stay still against the stone.

Blend In.name: Blend In
Blend In.description: Match your posture and pace to a crowd or a shadow so you stop looking like a person worth watching. Works far better than the dramatic ninja crouch, which fools nobody.

Silent Passage.name: Silent Passage
Silent Passage.description: Move through a room without a sound: no scuff, no creak, no rustle of gear. Slip past a patrol or reach a locked door before anyone thinks to look up.

Break Line of Sight.name: Break Line of Sight
Break Line of Sight.description: Read where every eye is pointed and use cover, timing, and angles to stay out of all of them at once. Cross open ground a step ahead of the head that would have turned.

Ambush Setup.name: Ambush Setup
Ambush Setup.description: Position yourself in concealment before a fight begins, priming the first strike for maximum effect. The next attack from hiding lands with brutal, unexpected force.

Ghost Across.name: Ghost Across
Ghost Across.description: Traverse a wide, well lit, well guarded space and come out the far side with no one able to say how. The sensible explanation is that you were never really seen at all.

Vanish Mid Step.name: Vanish Mid Step
Vanish Mid Step.description: Drop out of notice even while people are actively looking at you, breaking their attention in the space of a single stride. By the time they blink, you are simply gone.

Shadowbound Approach.name: Shadowbound Approach
Shadowbound Approach.description: Flow from one patch of darkness to the next with such control that shadows feel like territory you own. Close on a target across a lit hall and arrive unheard at their shoulder.

Phantom Presence.name: Phantom Presence
Phantom Presence.description: Suppress your presence so thoroughly that even trained sentries and keen eyed monsters register nothing. Those who sense you at all report only an unease they cannot name.

Unseen All Day.name: Unseen All Day
Unseen All Day.description: Remain in a guarded place for hours, watching and moving, while every witness would swear on their pay that the room was empty. Infiltration becomes a matter of patience, not luck.

The Ninth Shadow.name: The Ninth Shadow
The Ninth Shadow.description: Become so absent from perception that guards, hounds, and detection magic all agree nothing is there. You walk through a fortress like a rumor that never quite reached anyone.

Never Was There.name: Never Was There
Never Was There.description: The legendary height of the stealth arts: you pass through any place and leave the memory of your passing empty. Witnesses do not merely fail to see you, they become certain no one came at all, and the record shows no intruder ever existed.

Read the Pins.name: Read the Pins
Read the Pins.description: Feel your way across the pins of a simple lock and learn which one is holding. The first lesson every guild rogue pretends they taught themselves.

Simple Padlock.name: Simple Padlock
Simple Padlock.description: Open a basic padlock or a cheap door latch with a pick and a little patience. Nothing a shopkeeper would trust with anything valuable, which is exactly the point.

Chest Cracker.name: Chest Cracker
Chest Cracker.description: Defeat the tumbler locks on chests and strongboxes without the key. The bread and butter of anyone who delves dungeons and dislikes leaving loot behind.

Warded Ways.name: Warded Ways
Warded Ways.description: Work through the wards and false gates built into better locks to stop casual picks. Slow, careful, and deeply satisfying when the mechanism finally gives.

Trap Sense.name: Trap Sense
Trap Sense.description: Recognize the telltale signs of a rigged lock or a pressure plate before you commit to it. Noticing the needle is generally preferable to noticing the needle in your thumb.

Disarm Mechanism.name: Disarm Mechanism
Disarm Mechanism.description: Safely neutralize a trap wired into a lock, door, or container before you open it. Handle the snare first and the treasure second, in that order, always.

Tumbler Whisperer.name: Tumbler Whisperer
Tumbler Whisperer.description: Read a lock so precisely by feel that its inner workings lay themselves out in your mind. Complex mechanisms fall open in a fraction of the time they should take.

Blind Pick.name: Blind Pick
Blind Pick.description: Open a lock in total darkness, behind your back, or with a guard's boots approaching, working entirely by touch. Composure under pressure is half the craft and all of the reputation.

Ward and Snare.name: Ward and Snare
Ward and Snare.description: Untangle a lock and its layered traps together, disarming each stage as the mechanism reveals it. The kind of work that keeps a whole delving party alive and intact.

Vault Breaker.name: Vault Breaker
Vault Breaker.description: Crack the heavy multi stage locks that guard noble vaults and sealed dungeon doors. Where lesser thieves give up and go home, you are still working, and winning.

Dungeon Locksmith.name: Dungeon Locksmith
Dungeon Locksmith.description: Treat any mechanism as a puzzle already solved, from arcane bound locks to trap chains built to punish the greedy. Doors that were meant to stay shut for centuries open on your schedule.

Every Door Opens.name: Every Door Opens
Every Door Opens.description: Approach a lock the way a scholar approaches a familiar book, certain it holds no secrets you cannot read. Traps disarm cleanly and tumblers surrender as though they were waiting for you.

The Uncrackable Lie.name: The Uncrackable Lie
The Uncrackable Lie.description: The grand finale of the trade: you open the lock its maker swore could never be picked, trap and ward and mechanism alike. Whatever the dungeon designer built to keep you out becomes, in your hands, merely a door with a slightly dramatic reputation.

Sit the Saddle.name: Sit the Saddle
Sit the Saddle.description: Learn to stay on a calm horse at a walk without clutching the mane. Humble, unglamorous, and more than most Axel rookies can manage on the first try.

Steady Trot.name: Steady Trot
Steady Trot.description: Keep your seat and your dignity while a mount moves at a trot. The bouncing is a rite of passage that every new rider suffers through exactly once.

Guide the Reins.name: Guide the Reins
Guide the Reins.description: Direct a mount cleanly through turns, stops, and changes of pace with light, confident hands. The animal stops arguing and starts listening, mostly.

Mounted Balance.name: Mounted Balance
Mounted Balance.description: Stay centered and secure through gallops, jumps, and sudden swerves. Keep your seat over rough ground that would toss a lesser rider straight into the mud.

Battle Seat.name: Battle Seat
Battle Seat.description: Hold your mount steady amid the noise, blood, and chaos of a fight. A trained horse still wants to flee a monster, so half the work is convincing it to stay.

Charge Control.name: Charge Control
Charge Control.description: Drive a mount into a controlled charge and strike from the saddle without losing balance. Commit fully to the run, then pull up clean before you overrun the whole engagement.

Calm the Beast.name: Calm the Beast
Calm the Beast.description: Settle a panicking or unfamiliar mount through voice, weight, and steady nerve. Talk a spooked animal down from bolting in the space of a few breaths.

Trick Rider.name: Trick Rider
Trick Rider.description: Perform mounted maneuvers most riders consider suicidal: hanging low, standing tall, or firing across the gallop. Flashy, dangerous, and it works far more often than it has any right to.

Many Legged Mastery.name: Many Legged Mastery
Many Legged Mastery.description: Control mounts with too many legs, too much attitude, or too little interest in being ridden. Whether it walks, scuttles, or stomps, you keep your seat and your commands land.

Break the Wild.name: Break the Wild
Break the Wild.description: Bring an untamed or monstrous mount under your control through patience and sheer refusal to be thrown. What bucked off every other rider decides, eventually, to carry you.

Cavalry Precision.name: Cavalry Precision
Cavalry Precision.description: Move mount and rider as a single trained instrument, executing maneuvers that make veteran cavalry officers openly jealous. Every step, turn, and strike falls exactly where you intend it.

One with the Mount.name: One with the Mount
One with the Mount.description: Ride as though your thoughts pass straight into the animal, needing neither reins nor spurs to guide it. Beast and rider react as one creature, faster than any command could be given.

Rider of Legend.name: Rider of Legend
Rider of Legend.description: The legendary summit of horsemanship: no mount is too wild, too monstrous, or too proud to bear you into battle. You ride the untameable through the heart of an army and out the other side, and the bards decide the mount was the lucky one.

Clean the Wound.name: Clean the Wound
Clean the Wound.description: Rinse and clear a scrape or shallow cut so it does not fester. The most basic field care, learned the first time a party member trips over their own sword.

Wrap Bandage.name: Wrap Bandage
Wrap Bandage.description: Bind a wound with clean cloth to slow bleeding and keep dirt out. Simple, cheap, and more reliable than waiting for a certain goddess to bother casting Heal.

Stop the Bleed.name: Stop the Bleed
Stop the Bleed.description: Apply firm pressure and a tourniquet to halt heavy bleeding before it becomes fatal. Buys an injured ally the time they need to reach real help.

Splint the Break.name: Splint the Break
Splint the Break.description: Immobilize a fractured limb with rigid supports and binding so it stays set. It will not fix the bone, but it stops the patient from making things dramatically worse.

Stabilize the Wounded.name: Stabilize the Wounded
Stabilize the Wounded.description: Steady a badly hurt ally's breathing and pulse, pulling them back from the edge of shock. The quiet difference between a bad day and a funeral.

Field Suture.name: Field Suture
Field Suture.description: Stitch a deep laceration closed with needle and thread in the middle of nowhere. Ugly work, but the wound holds and the patient survives the walk home.

Triage.name: Triage
Triage.description: Assess a group of casualties at a glance and treat them in the order that saves the most lives. Coldly practical, which is why nobody enjoys being ranked by it.

Draw the Venom.name: Draw the Venom
Draw the Venom.description: Cut, drain, and neutralize poison from a bite or sting using only field tools and steady nerves. Works on most Belzerg toxins, assuming the patient holds still.

Battlefield Medic.name: Battlefield Medic
Battlefield Medic.description: Treat multiple serious wounds mid-combat while everything is still on fire around you. The mark of a medic who has stopped flinching at the screaming.

Reset the Joint.name: Reset the Joint
Reset the Joint.description: Force a dislocated or shattered joint back into place with precise, practiced pressure. The patient will curse your entire bloodline, then thank you once the shock fades.

Pull From Death.name: Pull From Death
Pull From Death.description: Keep a dying ally breathing through wounds that should have finished them, using nothing but hands, cloth, and refusal. No magic involved, which makes it faintly miraculous.

Surgeon's Hands.name: Surgeon's Hands
Surgeon's Hands.description: Perform field surgery of a caliber city hospitals would envy, removing shrapnel and repairing damage others would call hopeless. Steady, exact, and entirely mundane, which is the point.

The Last Breath.name: The Last Breath
The Last Breath.description: The legendary field medicine that snatches an ally back from the brink of death with no priest, no potion, and no time to spare. A master medic has saved more parties this way than every resurrection spell combined, and never once sent a bill.

Search the Room.name: Search the Room
Search the Room.description: Go over a space thoroughly instead of glancing around and declaring it empty. The novice habit that separates investigators from adventurers who miss the obvious loot.

Note the Detail.name: Note the Detail
Note the Detail.description: Catch the small thing that does not fit: a moved chair, a fresh scuff, a drawer left open. Most people walk past it. You write it down.

Spot the Discrepancy.name: Spot the Discrepancy
Spot the Discrepancy.description: Notice when a story, a scene, or an account contradicts itself. The loose thread that turns a lie into a case worth pulling on.

Follow the Trail.name: Follow the Trail
Follow the Trail.description: Piece together where someone went and what they did from the traces they left behind. Slower than tracking prey, and it works indoors on people who thought they were careful.

Reconstruct the Scene.name: Reconstruct the Scene
Reconstruct the Scene.description: Work backward from the evidence to lay out what happened here, in order, step by step. The room stops being a mess and starts being a testimony.

Question the Witness.name: Question the Witness
Question the Witness.description: Draw the useful truth out of a nervous, evasive, or lying witness through careful questioning. They will tell you more than they meant to, usually without noticing.

Connect the Threads.name: Connect the Threads
Connect the Threads.description: Link scattered clues into a single coherent picture, seeing the pattern others dismissed as coincidence. This is the moment the case stops being a pile of facts.

Read the Motive.name: Read the Motive
Read the Motive.description: Deduce why a thing was done, and therefore who benefits, from the shape of the evidence alone. Once you know the reason, the culprit tends to name themselves.

Unravel the Scheme.name: Unravel the Scheme
Unravel the Scheme.description: Pull an entire plot apart from a single loose end, exposing the plan and everyone tangled in it. Devils and con artists find this deeply inconvenient.

Cold Case Logic.name: Cold Case Logic
Cold Case Logic.description: Solve a trail gone stale, reconstructing events from evidence long since disturbed or hidden. Where others see nothing left to find, you find the one thing that remains.

Airtight Deduction.name: Airtight Deduction
Airtight Deduction.description: Assemble a conclusion so complete and so precisely supported that no one can argue with it. Annoyingly, being this correct rarely makes you popular in the room.

Case Cracked.name: Case Cracked
Case Cracked.description: Name the culprit, the method, and the proof in one decisive stroke, closing a case others called unsolvable. The kind of reveal that leaves a room silent and a guard captain embarrassed.

Truth Made Plain.name: Truth Made Plain
Truth Made Plain.description: The legendary deductive streak that lays the whole truth bare from a single overlooked detail, solving the case before the guards have even found the body. Reality itself seems to run out of places to hide the answer from you.

Read the Map.name: Read the Map
Read the Map.description: Understand a simple map well enough to know which way is which. The bare minimum for not wandering out of Axel and into a giant toad's mouth.

Hold a Heading.name: Hold a Heading
Hold a Heading.description: Keep walking in one straight direction instead of quietly curving into a circle. Harder than it sounds in thick woods, which is how most lost parties become lost.

Read the Stars.name: Read the Stars
Read the Stars.description: Fix your position and direction by the night sky when there are no roads or signs. Clear skies only, so pray the weather cooperates.

Mark the Landmark.name: Mark the Landmark
Mark the Landmark.description: Fix reliable reference points in your memory so you can retrace a route later without a map. The trick that turns a one-way trip into a round one.

Chart the Route.name: Chart the Route
Chart the Route.description: Plan an efficient path across unmarked terrain, accounting for rivers, ridges, and things that eat travelers. Saves days of walking and at least one avoidable ambush.

Dead Reckoning.name: Dead Reckoning
Dead Reckoning.description: Track your exact position by pace, time, and heading alone, with no map and no landmarks. Blind navigation that works even in fog, snow, or featureless waste.

Shortcut Sense.name: Shortcut Sense
Shortcut Sense.description: Find the faster way through, the gap in the hills or the trail nobody marked. Cuts a long march short, assuming the shortcut is not guarded by something hungry.

Labyrinth Sense.name: Labyrinth Sense
Labyrinth Sense.description: Keep a perfect mental map of a winding dungeon or maze, always knowing the way back out. The skill that keeps a party from starving one corridor from the entrance.

Pathfinder's Instinct.name: Pathfinder's Instinct
Pathfinder's Instinct.description: Sense the right way forward across trackless country as if the land itself were signposted. Guides a whole party through terrain that swallows lesser guides whole.

Trailblazer.name: Trailblazer
Trailblazer.description: Cut a viable route through country no one has mapped, and remember it well enough to sell later. Explorers pay handsomely for a path someone already survived.

Uncharted Passage.name: Uncharted Passage
Uncharted Passage.description: Lead a party safely through a labyrinth, a shifting wilderness, or a place that actively resists being crossed. Where the map runs out, you keep going anyway.

Compass Within.name: Compass Within
Compass Within.description: Always know precisely where you stand and which way to go, with no instrument and no doubt. Disorienting magic, sealed doors, and spinning corridors simply fail to work on you.

Never Lost.name: Never Lost
Never Lost.description: The legendary certainty of a guide who cannot be lost, even where there are no roads, no stars, and no land that stays put. Point them at anywhere that exists, and they will find the way there and bring everyone home.

Stable Reaction.name: Stable Reaction
Stable Reaction.description: Coax volatile reagents to combine without the usual smoke, hiss, or cursed side effect. Yields hold their potency far longer on the shelf, which Wiz appreciates and her customers survive.

Batch Brewing.name: Batch Brewing
Batch Brewing.description: Produce potions by the crate rather than the vial, with quality that no longer collapses at scale. The difference between a hobbyist and a supplier who can actually fill a guild order.

Volatile Catalyst.name: Volatile Catalyst
Volatile Catalyst.description: Introduce a sharp catalyst that pushes a potion's effect well past its normal ceiling. The occasional beaker still explodes, but the successful brews are worth the singed eyebrows.

Panacea Draught.name: Panacea Draught
Panacea Draught.description: Brew a broad-spectrum cure that neutralizes most poisons, toxins, and lingering ailments in a single dose. Not miraculous, merely reliable, which in alchemy is rarer than miraculous.

Reagent Synthesis.name: Reagent Synthesis
Reagent Synthesis.description: Transmute common stock into scarce, high-grade reagents on demand, ending the eternal shortage of expensive ingredients. Effectively printing money, if money were made of powdered manticore gland.

Elixir Refinement.name: Elixir Refinement
Elixir Refinement.description: Distill elixirs to near-perfect purity, producing buffs so clean they leave no aftertaste and no side effects. The kind of merchandise a shop can charge a genuinely offensive price for.

Homunculus Brew.name: Homunculus Brew
Homunculus Brew.description: Culture a stable alchemical construct in the flask, a living reagent that refines further potions on its own. Faintly unsettling, extremely productive, and best not named or fed after midnight.

Philosopher's Distillate.name: Philosopher's Distillate
Philosopher's Distillate.description: The master alchemist's signature: a single flawless distillate that can perfect any potion, cure nearly any affliction, or transmute lead stock into something worth a fortune. Cursed failures no longer apply, because at this tier there are no failures.

Precise Tempering.name: Precise Tempering
Precise Tempering.description: Read the color of hot steel exactly and quench at the perfect instant, producing gear that holds an edge and shrugs off stress fractures. The line between a smith and a hammer-swinging optimist.

Folded Steel.name: Folded Steel
Folded Steel.description: Fold and reforge the metal many times over, driving out impurities for a blade that is both harder and tougher. Veterans notice the grain and pay accordingly.

Balanced Edge.name: Balanced Edge
Balanced Edge.description: Forge a weapon whose weight, edge, and balance are matched to its wielder, so it swings faster and cuts truer than its stats suggest. A well-balanced sword flatters even a mediocre swordsman.

Reinforced Plating.name: Reinforced Plating
Reinforced Plating.description: Layer and structurally brace armor at exactly the points that take a blow, adding real protection without turning the wearer into a statue. Even a crusader can move in it, barely.

Living Metal.name: Living Metal
Living Metal.description: Work the metal so that it flexes under impact and springs back true, refusing to bend or crack where lesser gear would fail. Armor that outlives the adventurer wearing it, which happens often around Axel.

Dragonbone Forging.name: Dragonbone Forging
Dragonbone Forging.description: Forge with monster bone, scale, and exotic ore that ordinary heat cannot even soften, producing arms and armor of terrifying quality. Sourcing the materials is the adventure; the smithing is merely the hard part after.

Adamant Masterpiece.name: Adamant Masterpiece
Adamant Masterpiece.description: Produce a flawless piece worthy of its own maker's mark and a suitably dramatic name, the sort a hero carries into legend. Vanir would sell it at a profit and Wiz would somehow still buy it at a loss.

Godsteel Forging.name: Godsteel Forging
Godsteel Forging.description: The master smith's signature work: an arm or armor forged so perfectly it seems to have been poured rather than hammered, holding an eternal edge and never failing its wielder. Kingdoms have gone to war over lesser blades.

Steady Ledger.name: Steady Ledger
Steady Ledger.description: Keep books so clean that leaks, shrinkage, and quiet theft have nowhere to hide, squeezing steady profit from thin margins. Deeply boring, which is precisely why it keeps a shop open.

Loyal Clientele.name: Loyal Clientele
Loyal Clientele.description: Cultivate regulars who return, recommend, and forgive the occasional cursed inventory. A dependable customer base turns a struggling stall into a going concern.

Debt Restructuring.name: Debt Restructuring
Debt Restructuring.description: Talk a looming creditor into softer terms, a longer horizon, and a smaller cut, buying a failing venture the time to recover. The financial equivalent of a crusader taunting the debt collector off your allies.

Supply Chain.name: Supply Chain
Supply Chain.description: Line up reliable suppliers, caravans, and storage so stock arrives cheap, on time, and unspoiled. The unglamorous machinery behind every merchant who never seems to run out.

Franchise Expansion.name: Franchise Expansion
Franchise Expansion.description: Open a second location and a third without either one dragging the others under, multiplying income across a growing network. Each branch runs itself well enough that you can afford to ignore it.

Cornered Market.name: Cornered Market
Cornered Market.description: Quietly buy up the entire available supply of a good, then set the price at whatever the desperate will pay. Ruthless, legal by a hair, and enormously profitable.

Merchant Empire.name: Merchant Empire
Merchant Empire.description: Command a web of shops, caravans, and contracts spanning multiple towns, moving coin and goods faster than the tax office can follow. Nobles start returning your letters.

Devil's Bargain.name: Devil's Bargain
Devil's Bargain.description: The master trader's signature deal, structured so cleverly that every party believes they came out ahead while you took the real profit. Vanir himself would tip his mask; the ink is barely dry before it has already paid for itself.

Ward Sigil.name: Ward Sigil
Ward Sigil.description: Scratch a simple protective glyph onto gear that turns aside a little bad luck and a lot of moisture. The first mark every enchanter learns, and the reason apprentice cloaks stop molding.

Runic Binding.name: Runic Binding
Runic Binding.description: Anchor an enchantment with a proper runic frame so it stops leaking mana and holds through daily abuse. The difference between a charm that lasts a week and one that lasts a season.

Attribute Infusion.name: Attribute Infusion
Attribute Infusion.description: Weave a lasting stat boost into a piece of gear, lending its wearer steady strength, agility, or focus. Reliable, understated work that veterans pay well for and never brag about.

Glyph Layering.name: Glyph Layering
Glyph Layering.description: Stack several enchantments on one item without the glyphs interfering and blowing the whole thing apart. Requires the patience of a scholar and the nerve of someone standing near a Crimson Demon.

Sentient Charm.name: Sentient Charm
Sentient Charm.description: Bind a flicker of awareness into an item so it responds to its owner, warming in the cold or tightening its grip in a fight. Faintly eerie, extremely convenient, and prone to developing opinions.

Self Repairing Weave.name: Self Repairing Weave
Self Repairing Weave.description: Inscribe an enchantment that slowly mends its own item, closing scratches and re-knitting frayed threads over time. Gear that outlasts its owner's ability to lose it.

Elemental Anchor.name: Elemental Anchor
Elemental Anchor.description: Fuse a full elemental force permanently into a weapon or shield, flame that never gutters or frost that never thaws. No recharging, no fading, just a blade that has simply decided to be on fire forever.

Mythic Inscription.name: Mythic Inscription
Mythic Inscription.description: Layer a complex, self-sustaining enchantment worthy of a named artifact, the kind museums argue over. Wiz would clear her shelves to stock a single one.

Heroic Signature Weapon.name: Heroic Signature Weapon
Heroic Signature Weapon.description: The master enchanter's masterpiece: a weapon carrying layered, permanent enchantments tuned to a single hero, growing subtly with their deeds. The sort of arm that ends up in the final chapter of somebody's saga, usually the villain's.

Hearty Stew.name: Hearty Stew
Hearty Stew.description: Turn scraps, roots, and a questionable cut of meat into a filling pot that restores a little stamina and a lot of morale. The dish that convinces a demoralized party the day was not a total loss.

Seasoned Rations.name: Seasoned Rations
Seasoned Rations.description: Prepare trail food that keeps for weeks yet still tastes like an actual meal, sparing the party the misery of gnawing hardtack. Morale in a wax-paper wrapper.

Monster Cuisine.name: Monster Cuisine
Monster Cuisine.description: Butcher and cook the drops most adventurers throw away, drawing real buffs out of giant toad, wolf, and worse. The trick is knowing which glands to remove before anyone tastes them.

Morale Feast.name: Morale Feast
Morale Feast.description: Cook a spread so good it drags a bickering, exhausted party back into fighting spirits. Cheaper than a priest and considerably better company.

Vigor Broth.name: Vigor Broth
Vigor Broth.description: Simmer a deep restorative broth that mends fatigue, steadies nerves, and grants lasting endurance to everyone who finishes a bowl. Best served the night before something is going to try to eat the party.

Ironhide Roast.name: Ironhide Roast
Ironhide Roast.description: Roast a monster cut with the right herbs to toughen the flesh of whoever eats it, granting a sustained defensive buff. A crusader who has eaten one becomes very nearly as hard to move as they already claim to be.

Ambrosia Course.name: Ambrosia Course
Ambrosia Course.description: Plate a single exquisite course that restores wounds and stacks a powerful buff in one flawless bite. Taverns remember it for years and quietly overcharge for anything served on the same plate.

Grand Tasting Menu.name: Grand Tasting Menu
Grand Tasting Menu.description: Serve a full sequence of dishes, each layering a different buff, so a party leaves the table fully healed and stacked with advantages. Diners weep, and not only from the seasoning.

Feast of Heroes.name: Feast of Heroes
Feast of Heroes.description: The master cook's legendary banquet: full restoration, a wall of sustained buffs, and the rare miracle of turning a broken party of disasters into a functional one for an entire day. Songs get written about the food, which is unusual and slightly insulting to the bards.

Match the Bait.name: Match the Bait
Match the Bait.description: Choose the right bait, depth, and time of day for whatever is biting. The difference between an empty bucket and dinner.

Steady Reel.name: Steady Reel
Steady Reel.description: Fight a hooked catch without snapping the line, tiring it out until it comes to net. Patience beats strength on the water.

Net Haul.name: Net Haul
Net Haul.description: Work a net rather than a single line, bringing in a full haul worth cooking and selling. Volume over elegance.

Deep Line.name: Deep Line
Deep Line.description: Fish the cold deep water where larger specimens wait, far below where common anglers bother to cast.

Alchemist's Catch.name: Alchemist's Catch
Alchemist's Catch.description: Target the rare aquatic specimens alchemists and researchers pay premium coin for, identifying them by the ripple alone.

Riverhead Prize.name: Riverhead Prize
Riverhead Prize.description: Land the prized catches of Riverhead Lake, the ones locals swear are only rumor. They are not, if you know where to sit.

Trophy Hook.name: Trophy Hook
Trophy Hook.description: Bring in dangerous large game fish that fight back, the kind that drag lesser anglers off the dock.

Reading the Depths.name: Reading the Depths
Reading the Depths.description: Sense the shape and habits of whatever swims below before your line ever touches water, choosing your catch on purpose.

Leviathan Bait.name: Leviathan Bait
Leviathan Bait.description: Prepare a lure for something that has no business being caught, the shadow that turns the water black beneath the boat.

The Deep One's Reward.name: The Deep One's Reward
The Deep One's Reward.description: Haul up the thing that lurks in the deepest water and was never meant to surface. The catch of a lifetime, assuming the boat holds and the thing stays caught.

Sort the Weeds.name: Sort the Weeds
Sort the Weeds.description: Tell the useful plants from the roadside filler, collecting common edible and medicinal growth without poisoning anyone by mistake.

Poultice Craft.name: Poultice Craft
Poultice Craft.description: Turn gathered plants into simple field remedies: poultices, teas, and salves that actually work. The bridge between picking and healing.

Seasonal Forage.name: Seasonal Forage
Seasonal Forage.description: Know exactly when and where each useful plant blooms, timing a harvest for peak potency rather than luck.

Reagent Cultivation.name: Reagent Cultivation
Reagent Cultivation.description: Locate and gather high-potency reagents an alchemist genuinely wants, preserving their properties from field to flask.

Toxin Handling.name: Toxin Handling
Toxin Handling.description: Harvest poisonous and caustic flora safely, the plants that put careless gatherers in an early grave. Gloves optional but recommended.

Rare Bloom Finder.name: Rare Bloom Finder
Rare Bloom Finder.description: Track down rare, potent specimens hidden in dangerous territory, the ones worth a week's pay per stem.

Living Pharmacy.name: Living Pharmacy
Living Pharmacy.description: Identify any plant's medicinal and alchemical uses on sight, reading a hedgerow like a stocked apothecary shelf.

Thornwild Harvest.name: Thornwild Harvest
Thornwild Harvest.description: Gather the plants even Crimson Demons approach carefully, the ones that bite, sting, or scream when pulled.

Deathbloom Gathering.name: Deathbloom Gathering
Deathbloom Gathering.description: Harvest the legendary flora that grows only where something powerful died, potent enough to change a potion entirely.

Verdant Sovereign.name: Verdant Sovereign
Verdant Sovereign.description: Command the botanical wealth of the whole kingdom, coaxing even world-tier flora into your basket unharmed. Every apothecary in Belzerg knows your name and dreads your prices.

Cut and Stitch.name: Cut and Stitch
Cut and Stitch.description: Cut cloth clean and sew a straight seam, producing simple garments that hold together through ordinary wear.

Reinforced Seam.name: Reinforced Seam
Reinforced Seam.description: Stitch seams that survive real strain, so a cloak stops tearing at the shoulder every time its owner falls in a ditch.

Tailored Fit.name: Tailored Fit
Tailored Fit.description: Fit a garment precisely to its wearer, trading loose comfort for freedom of movement in a fight.

Layered Weave.name: Layered Weave
Layered Weave.description: Craft fabric armor with genuine protective value, layering cloth dense enough to turn a glancing blade.

Padded Ward.name: Padded Ward
Padded Ward.description: Quilt and reinforce armor that absorbs blunt force and shrugs off arrows, the practical mage's best friend.

Noble Wardrobe.name: Noble Wardrobe
Noble Wardrobe.description: Produce garments fine enough for a noble's closet, cut and finished to a standard that opens doors before the wearer speaks.

Crimson Robes.name: Crimson Robes
Crimson Robes.description: Sew the billowing, dramatic robes a Crimson Demon considers mandatory, engineered so the hem flares on cue with zero wind.

Enchant Ready Weave.name: Enchant Ready Weave
Enchant Ready Weave.description: Weave cloth prepared to hold magical work, the threads aligned so an enchanter's imbuing takes cleanly and lasts.

Featherlight Plating.name: Featherlight Plating
Featherlight Plating.description: Construct masterwork protective cloth as light as silk and as tough as a leather cuirass, the envy of anyone tired of heavy armor.

Weaver of Heroes.name: Weaver of Heroes
Weaver of Heroes.description: Create legendary garments worthy of the people songs are written about: protective, beautiful, and ready to carry a hero's signature enchantment. The kind of work passed down instead of worn out.

Loot Instinct.name: Loot Instinct
Loot Instinct.description: Notice the obvious loot others somehow miss, the coin purse in plain sight and the glint under the rubble.

Quick Appraisal.name: Quick Appraisal
Quick Appraisal.description: Judge an item's fair market value at a glance, so a hunter knows what to grab and what to leave behind.

Hidden Cache.name: Hidden Cache
Hidden Cache.description: Find the stash tucked behind the loose stone or false floor that the rest of the party walked straight past.

Vault Sense.name: Vault Sense
Vault Sense.description: Develop the instinct for where treasure actually hides in a ruin, reading a room for the corner that says wealth.

Trapline Reading.name: Trapline Reading
Trapline Reading.description: Recognize that the best loot sits behind the nastiest traps, and read the trapline to reach it intact.

Fortune's Trail.name: Fortune's Trail
Fortune's Trail.description: Follow scattered signs to genuine fortune, the hidden cache others dismissed as a dead end.

Sealed Door Lore.name: Sealed Door Lore
Sealed Door Lore.description: Read old vaults, their makers, and the way their doors were meant to open, sparing the dungeon a great deal of shouting.

Artifact Eye.name: Artifact Eye
Artifact Eye.description: Recognize a lost artifact for what it truly is rather than the junk it pretends to be, appraising history and power together.

Dungeon Cartomancer.name: Dungeon Cartomancer
Dungeon Cartomancer.description: Read a dungeon's layout and history well enough to chart where its spoils lie before setting a single foot inside.

Keeper of Lost Hoards.name: Keeper of Lost Hoards
Keeper of Lost Hoards.description: Uncover the sealed vaults and legendary artifacts that make careers and enemies in equal measure. The kind of find that ends up in a museum, a war, or both.

Field Bestiary.name: Field Bestiary
Field Bestiary.description: Identify a common monster on sight, naming its species and rough threat before it gets close enough to be a problem.

Habit Study.name: Habit Study
Habit Study.description: Know a monster's habits, diet, and lair, so the party knows where it sleeps and when it hunts.

Weak Point Read.name: Weak Point Read
Weak Point Read.description: Pinpoint a monster's specific vulnerabilities and call them out, letting allies aim where it actually hurts.

Behavior Prediction.name: Behavior Prediction
Behavior Prediction.description: Predict a monster's moves in a fight from posture and pattern, warning allies a beat before it strikes.

Ecology Mastery.name: Ecology Mastery
Ecology Mastery.description: Understand a monster's place in the whole food chain, exploiting what it fears, hunts, and flees for tactical advantage.

Threat Assessment.name: Threat Assessment
Threat Assessment.description: Gauge a foe's exact danger before anyone engages, so the party fights what it can win and flees what it cannot.

Solved Problem.name: Solved Problem
Solved Problem.description: Reduce a deadly foe to a routine encounter for the whole party, handing out the exact plan that turns terror into chores.

Apex Study.name: Apex Study
Apex Study.description: Dissect the behavior and weaknesses of the kingdom's most fearsome beasts, the ones most researchers only study posthumously.

Demon King Dossier.name: Demon King Dossier
Demon King Dossier.description: Maintain detailed knowledge of the Demon King's Army and its generals, their powers, tells, and the flaws they hide.

The Complete Bestiary.name: The Complete Bestiary
The Complete Bestiary.description: Command a definitive understanding of every monster in the kingdom, turning any foe into a solved problem and yourself into its worst nightmare. The researcher every party wishes they had brought.

Steady Pickswing.name: Steady Pickswing
Steady Pickswing.description: Hold the pick right and hit the rock instead of your own foot. Slow, sore, and mostly correct. Every quarryman starts here, blisters included.

Vein Sense.name: Vein Sense
Vein Sense.description: Read the color and grain of exposed rock to guess where ore actually runs. Improves the odds of digging toward metal rather than a wall of worthless gravel.

Ore Sorting.name: Ore Sorting
Ore Sorting.description: Separate raw haul into good ore, poor ore, and rubbish before it wastes a smith's afternoon. A trained eye at the sorting table doubles the value of a day's dig.

Shaft Bracing.name: Shaft Bracing
Shaft Bracing.description: Set timbers and props so the tunnel holds while you work under it. Keeps ceilings overhead and miners breathing, which the profession rates highly.

Gem Cutting.name: Gem Cutting
Gem Cutting.description: Cleave and facet rough stones along their natural planes to reveal the value inside. One clean strike makes a fortune, one wrong tap makes gravel.

Deep Delving.name: Deep Delving
Deep Delving.description: Push a shaft far past comfortable depth without flooding it or losing the air. Reaches the richer rock the timid quarries never touch.

Rich Seam Finder.name: Rich Seam Finder
Rich Seam Finder.description: Trace a promising vein to the fat seam others gave up on and walked past. The difference between scraping by and a quarry worth naming.

Efficient Extraction.name: Efficient Extraction
Efficient Extraction.description: Pull maximum ore per swing with minimal shattered rock and wasted effort. The output of three ordinary miners from one who plans each cut.

Mother Lode.name: Mother Lode
Mother Lode.description: Locate and open a truly enormous deposit, the kind that funds a town for a decade. Rare, exhausting, and worth every callus to break into.

Flawless Facet.name: Flawless Facet
Flawless Facet.description: Cut gemstones without a single internal flaw, producing the flawless stock nobles fight over. Vanir would sell it at a profit and Wiz would somehow lose money on it.

Stone Reading.name: Stone Reading
Stone Reading.description: Read a rock face like a page, knowing depth, ore, and fault lines before the first strike. The Grausten quarrymen swear by it and rarely dig a dry shaft.

Quarry Master.name: Quarry Master
Quarry Master.description: Run an entire operation flawlessly: seams found, shafts safe, output at peak, and not one collapse to explain. The name every mining town wants on its payroll.

Heart of the Mountain.name: Heart of the Mountain
Heart of the Mountain.description: Sense the buried treasure of an entire mountain and carve straight to it, unearthing legendary ore and gems thought to be only stories. A once-in-a-generation strike that reshapes fortunes and skylines alike.

True Nail.name: True Nail
True Nail.description: Drive a nail straight on the third or fourth try, usually into the wood rather than a thumb. The humble beginning of everything that later stands up.

Sturdy Crate.name: Sturdy Crate
Sturdy Crate.description: Assemble a plain box that survives being dropped, kicked, and shipped. Not pretty, but it holds, which is more than most beginner work manages.

Plumb and Level.name: Plumb and Level
Plumb and Level.description: Set posts and shelves that are actually vertical and flat instead of merely close. Doors that latch and floors that do not roll a dropped coin to the corner.

Roof Framing.name: Roof Framing
Roof Framing.description: Cut and raise rafters into a frame that sheds rain and bears its own weight. The skill that separates a house from a pile of lumber with ambitions.

Clean Joinery.name: Clean Joinery
Clean Joinery.description: Fit two pieces of wood so tight the seam nearly vanishes. Stronger joints, less glue, and the quiet pride of work that does not wobble.

Fine Furniture.name: Fine Furniture
Fine Furniture.description: Build chairs and tables worth selling rather than burning, sturdy and shaped with care. The work that earns repeat customers and a proper workshop.

Mortise and Tenon.name: Mortise and Tenon
Mortise and Tenon.description: Lock timbers together with interlocking cuts that hold for generations. Furniture and frames that outlive the carpenter and most of the family.

Seasoned Timber.name: Seasoned Timber
Seasoned Timber.description: Choose and cure wood so it will not warp, crack, or split once built. The unglamorous foresight that keeps a masterpiece from twisting into firewood.

Dovetail Mastery.name: Dovetail Mastery
Dovetail Mastery.description: Cut interlocking dovetails so precise they need no fastener to stay married. Drawers and chests that a noble would pay a small fortune to own.

Load Bearing Genius.name: Load Bearing Genius
Load Bearing Genius.description: Frame structures that carry impossible weight through clever distribution rather than brute mass. Bridges and halls that stand when they clearly should not.

Nailless Joinery.name: Nailless Joinery
Nailless Joinery.description: Join wood so cleanly that no nail, peg, or glue is required to hold it. The rock face of the craft made from timber, admired and rarely equaled.

Master Joiner.name: Master Joiner
Master Joiner.description: Design and build anything of wood flawlessly, from a music box to a manor, without a single joint out of true. The name commissioned when failure is not an option.

Grand Hall Raising.name: Grand Hall Raising
Grand Hall Raising.description: Raise an entire timber hall in a single inspired effort, every beam true and every joint perfect, standing for centuries. A legendary feat of building that outlasts the kingdoms it was raised in.

Clean Batch.name: Clean Batch
Clean Batch.description: Manage not to ruin the whole batch through bad hygiene or worse timing. It is drinkable, technically, if nobody thinks about it too hard.

Drinkable Ale.name: Drinkable Ale
Drinkable Ale.description: Brew a plain ale that patrons will finish without complaint or grimace. The foundation of every tavern tap and every rent payment.

Steady Fermentation.name: Steady Fermentation
Steady Fermentation.description: Hold temperature and timing so the batch ferments evenly instead of by luck. Consistent results, which taverns value far above the occasional accidental masterpiece.

Balanced Brew.name: Balanced Brew
Balanced Brew.description: Tune malt, hops, and water so nothing overpowers the rest. A round, pleasant drink that keeps customers ordering a second round.

Marketable Batch.name: Marketable Batch
Marketable Batch.description: Produce a brew good enough that people pay for it by name rather than by thirst. The line between a hobby and an actual trade.

Spirited Distillation.name: Spirited Distillation
Spirited Distillation.description: Distill a clean spirit with a genuine kick and no headache-brewing impurities. Stronger stock for customers who want their evening to move along briskly.

Cask Aging.name: Cask Aging
Cask Aging.description: Age a batch in the right wood for the right span, trading months for depth of flavor. Patience that most brewers lack and every connoisseur can taste.

House Blend.name: House Blend
House Blend.description: Compose a signature recipe a tavern becomes known for, consistent barrel after barrel. The kind of drink regulars walk across town to order.

Signature Vintage.name: Signature Vintage
Signature Vintage.description: Craft a batch distinctive enough to start friendly arguments about which tavern serves the best. Reputation in a bottle, and a steady stream of thirsty pilgrims.

Master Distiller.name: Master Distiller
Master Distiller.description: Pull spirits of remarkable smoothness and strength from the still with practiced ease. The bottles merchants haggle over and nobles quietly stock their cellars with.

Cellar Mastery.name: Cellar Mastery
Cellar Mastery.description: Manage a full cellar of casks at their peak, each pulled at exactly the right moment. Nothing sours, nothing is wasted, and every tap runs excellent.

Legendary Reserve.name: Legendary Reserve
Legendary Reserve.description: Produce a rare reserve batch spoken of across the region and rationed by the cup. The vintage taverns display rather than pour except on the finest occasions.

Axis Cultist's Delight.name: Axis Cultist's Delight
Axis Cultist's Delight.description: Brew a legendary vintage so sublime it keeps an entire tavern of Axis Cultists cheerful, which is a genuine miracle of the craft. A once-in-a-lifetime batch that becomes the standard every other brewer is measured against and none reach.

Straight Furrow.name: Straight Furrow
Straight Furrow.description: Plant a row that actually runs straight, more or less. The first thing any Axel farmhand learns before the vegetables start fighting back.

Sow Seed.name: Sow Seed
Sow Seed.description: Space and bury seed at the correct depth so most of it sprouts. Modest work, but it is the difference between a field and a patch of hopeful dirt.

Tend Field.name: Tend Field
Tend Field.description: Weed, water, and turn soil to keep a crop healthy through the growing season. Boring, constant, and the reason anyone eats at all.

Read the Soil.name: Read the Soil
Read the Soil.description: Judge whether ground will feed a crop or waste your season by its color, smell, and crumble. Saves a farmer from planting hope into dead earth.

Cabbage Wrangling.name: Cabbage Wrangling
Cabbage Wrangling.description: Corral Axel's giant fighting cabbages into the cart before they scatter across the county. Requires nerve, a stout net, and the acceptance that a vegetable may headbutt you.

Full Harvest.name: Full Harvest
Full Harvest.description: Bring in an entire field at peak ripeness without bruising the yield or missing the window. A clean harvest is worth more than a large one left to rot.

Pest Rout.name: Pest Rout
Pest Rout.description: Drive off the beetles, blights, and hungry giant toads that treat a crop as a buffet. Protects a season's income from being eaten overnight.

Bumper Crop.name: Bumper Crop
Bumper Crop.description: Coax a field into yielding far beyond its normal return through timing, care, and stubborn attention. The harvest that pays off a farm's debts in one autumn.

Cabbage Roundup.name: Cabbage Roundup
Cabbage Roundup.description: Herd an entire stampede of migrating cabbages into the pens single handed, a feat Axel treats as an annual civic duty. Fewer townsfolk are trampled when a real hand runs the drive.

Season of Plenty.name: Season of Plenty
Season of Plenty.description: Manage rotation, weather, and soil across a whole growing year for a harvest that keeps every larder full. The mark of a farmer a village depends on.

Soil Whisperer.name: Soil Whisperer
Soil Whisperer.description: Restore exhausted or cursed ground back to fertile life through knowledge no book fully holds. Fields others gave up on grow again under your care.

Master Cultivator.name: Master Cultivator
Master Cultivator.description: Command every stage of growth so completely that crops rarely fail and vegetables rarely win. Neighboring farms send their sons to learn from you.

Harvest of Legends.name: Harvest of Legends
Harvest of Legends.description: Feed an entire town from land that should not sustain it, raising monstrous crops that fight, feast halls that never empty, and cabbages that finally know their place. The green thumb bards mention in passing, right before the part about the giant vegetables.

Rough Estimate.name: Rough Estimate
Rough Estimate.description: Glance at an item and name a ballpark price that is usually within reason. Wrong often enough to be humble, right often enough to bother learning.

Price Common Goods.name: Price Common Goods
Price Common Goods.description: Value everyday wares, tools, and produce accurately at a glance. Keeps a buyer from overpaying and a seller from giving it away.

Spot the Fake.name: Spot the Fake
Spot the Fake.description: Notice the wrong stitch, the poured seam, or the too new shine that marks a forgery. Saves a great deal of embarrassment before the coin changes hands.

Weigh and Measure.name: Weigh and Measure
Weigh and Measure.description: Judge the true metal content, weight, and grade of a piece without a scale or acid. The quiet skill that catches a shorted purse or a plated fake.

Trained Eye.name: Trained Eye
Trained Eye.description: Assess craftsmanship, materials, and condition in a single unhurried look. Merchants raise their prices when they see you studying the goods.

Value Unknowns.name: Value Unknowns
Value Unknowns.description: Put a fair number on unfamiliar or exotic items you have never handled before. Reasoning from make and material where memory offers nothing.

Grade Quality.name: Grade Quality
Grade Quality.description: Sort a mixed pile into tiers by true worth faster than a clerk with a ledger. Turns a heap of dungeon loot into a sensible sale order.

Read Provenance.name: Read Provenance
Read Provenance.description: Trace an item's origin, maker, and history from wear patterns and marks alone. Knowing where a thing came from often doubles what it will fetch.

Assess Enchantment.name: Assess Enchantment
Assess Enchantment.description: Gauge the true properties and strength of a magic item by sight, without a mage's spell. Separates a genuine relic from a glowing paperweight priced like one.

Hidden Flaw.name: Hidden Flaw
Hidden Flaw.description: Find the crack, curse, or catch a seller worked hard to conceal. The talent that keeps a buyer from paying full price for a lawsuit.

True Worth.name: True Worth
True Worth.description: Name what a thing is genuinely worth in any market, accounting for demand, rarity, and who wants it. Prices that hold up under any haggler's scrutiny.

Master Appraiser.name: Master Appraiser
Master Appraiser.description: Value nearly anything, mundane or magical, with an accuracy that ends arguments. Guilds and nobles pay handsomely for a verdict from your eye.

Eye of Fair Value.name: Eye of Fair Value
Eye of Fair Value.description: State the worth, origin, and hidden flaw of any item before the seller finishes lying about it, the honest half of a certain cheat skill perfected. No forgery, curse, or padded price survives a single glance, and every merchant in the kingdom quietly dreads your visit.

Know the Odds.name: Know the Odds
Know the Odds.description: Understand which bets are merely bad and which are catastrophic. The first step toward losing rent slightly slower than everyone else.

Friendly Hand.name: Friendly Hand
Friendly Hand.description: Win a casual game of cards or dice against untrained company. Enough to cover the drinks, rarely enough to cover the trip.

Read the Table.name: Read the Table
Read the Table.description: Track the flow of a game, the pot, and who is nervous about their stake. Half of winning is knowing when the room has already decided to lose.

Call a Bluff.name: Call a Bluff
Call a Bluff.description: Spot the tell that separates a strong hand from a loud one. Confidence at a card table is cheap, and you have learned to price it correctly.

Count the Cards.name: Count the Cards
Count the Cards.description: Keep a running tally of what has been played to guess what remains. Entirely a matter of arithmetic, which is why the Elroad houses pretend to hate it.

Weighted Dice Sense.name: Weighted Dice Sense
Weighted Dice Sense.description: Feel when the dice are loaded or the deck is stacked against you. Knowing the game is rigged is worth more than any lucky roll.

Beat the Odds.name: Beat the Odds
Beat the Odds.description: Grind out a modest profit over a long night through discipline rather than luck. Walking out of a casino ahead is against the rules of nature, and you break them politely.

Cold Read.name: Cold Read
Cold Read.description: Size up a stranger's hand, nerve, and bankroll before the first card turns. The table stops being a game of chance and starts being a game of people.

Winning Streak.name: Winning Streak
Winning Streak.description: Ride a run of good fortune far longer than probability should allow, and quit before it turns. Knowing when to stand up is the rarest talent in any casino.

Beat the House.name: Beat the House
Beat the House.description: Turn a casino's own edge back on it across dice, cards, and wheel alike. The floor managers begin watching your table with professional concern.

Table Domination.name: Table Domination
Table Domination.description: Control the pace, the pot, and the confidence of everyone seated with you. Opponents fold decent hands simply because you looked comfortable.

Uncanny Luck.name: Uncanny Luck
Uncanny Luck.description: Win with a consistency that makes onlookers question the fairness of chance itself. No trick, allegedly, just fortune that keeps choosing your side of the table.

Fortune's Favorite.name: Fortune's Favorite
Fortune's Favorite.description: Read every table, dice, and deck in Elroad so completely that walking out poor becomes impossible and the pit bosses run out of polite excuses. The uncanny run that gets a player quietly escorted to the door, banned for the crime of winning too honestly.

Item Box.name: Item Box
Item Box.description: An extradimensional inventory that holds far more than it should, weightless and bottomless within reason. Store and retrieve items instantly, no backpack required.

Minimap.name: Minimap
Minimap.description: A map that lives in the corner of your vision showing your position, heading, and nearby life signs. Getting lost becomes almost impossible.

Language Comprehension.name: Language Comprehension
Language Comprehension.description: You read, write, and speak every language in this world without effort. Every sign, contract, and muttered threat is perfectly clear.

Appraisal Eye.name: Appraisal Eye
Appraisal Eye.description: See the stats, level, and hidden information of whatever you focus on. People find being read this way deeply unsettling, which is half the fun.

Divine Weapon.name: Divine Weapon
Divine Weapon.description: A weapon chosen at reincarnation, bonded to you and unnaturally effective in your hands. It never dulls and never leaves your grip unwillingly.

Mostly Useless Familiar.name: Mostly Useless Familiar
Mostly Useless Familiar.description: A small, immortal, opinionated divine companion of almost no combat value. It is, occasionally, right about things, which nobody expects.

Sealed Power.name: Sealed Power
Sealed Power.description: Something sealed inside you that aches before storms and stirs near strong magic. Once in a great while it answers, briefly and unpredictably.

Otherworld Knowledge.name: Otherworld Knowledge
Otherworld Knowledge.description: You kept your complete memories from your old world. Recipes, tactics, and half-remembered science surface at inconveniently useful moments.

Curious Artifact.name: Curious Artifact
Curious Artifact.description: An artifact the goddess called very interesting while smiling in a way you still think about. Its effects are real, occasional, and hard to predict.

Half Blessing.name: Half Blessing
Half Blessing.description: The first half of a blessing, interrupted mid-bestowal. It works, mostly, in roughly the direction it was originally aimed.

Ember Spark.name: Ember Spark
Ember Spark.description: Snap a bead of fire onto your fingertip, enough to light a lantern, seal a letter, or singe the whiskers of anything foolish enough to sniff your hand. The cantrip every apprentice masters the week before they beg to learn a real fireball.

Kindle.name: Kindle
Kindle.description: Coax a steady flame out of damp wood, wet tinder, or a campfire that has spitefully refused to catch for the last hour. Unglamorous, universally loved, and the only fire spell a party will actually thank you for.

Cinder Dart.name: Cinder Dart
Cinder Dart.description: Flick a small dart of hardened flame at a single target, dealing reliable burn damage at a comfortable distance. Cheap on mana and far less likely to earn a lecture from the Adventurers Guild than the alternatives.

Searing Palm.name: Searing Palm
