Masochist.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: Masochist. The character actively seeks out dangerous situations and visibly enjoys taking damage. NPC reactions range from confusion to horror. Play the reactions, not the masochism itself. PG-13.

Chuunibyou.name: Chuunibyou
Chuunibyou.description: You believe you are the protagonist of a dark fantasy epic. You have a special technique name for every attack, a dramatic title you insist on, and a backstory involving sealed powers that may or may not be real. All Crimson Demons have this. You have it worse.
Chuunibyou.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: Chuunibyou. The character delivers dramatic speeches, names their attacks, strikes poses, and refers to themselves in the third person during moments of intensity. The comedy is in the gap between the drama and the reality.

Chronic Debt.name: Chronic Debt
Chronic Debt.description: You owe money. Always. To everyone. The guild, merchants, landlords, and at least one person whose name you cannot remember but whose collection agent you recognize on sight. Every reward goes toward interest. Every windfall creates new obligations. Kazuma's party lives in this state permanently.
Chronic Debt.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: Chronic Debt. The character's finances are a disaster. Quest rewards are garnished. Shopping involves math that always comes out negative. Debt creates comedy through the gap between ambition and budget.

Hopelessly Lazy.name: Hopelessly Lazy
Hopelessly Lazy.description: You are capable. You are skilled. You will not use either unless the alternative is worse. Your natural state is horizontal. Motivation requires either genuine danger or the promise of enough money to be lazy for longer afterward.
Hopelessly Lazy.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: Hopelessly Lazy. The character avoids effort and seeks the easiest path. When they do act, their competence is surprising because everyone assumed they could not be bothered.

One-Trick Specialist.name: One-Trick Specialist
One-Trick Specialist.description: You can do one thing and it is the most powerful version of that thing anyone has ever seen. You cannot do anything else. Megumin is the archetype: one Explosion, one collapse, every day. Your commitment to your specialty is absolute and your versatility is zero.
One-Trick Specialist.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: One-Trick Specialist. The character excels at exactly one technique and is useless at everything else. Their specialty is genuinely impressive. Their range is genuinely terrible.

Compulsive Gambler.name: Compulsive Gambler
Compulsive Gambler.description: You bet on everything. Quest outcomes, card games, whether the next person through the door will be taller than the last one. You are not good at gambling. You do it anyway. Dust shares this trait. Your wallet suffers.
Compulsive Gambler.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: Compulsive Gambler. The character bets constantly and loses more often than they win. Gambling creates opportunities, debt, and comedy in roughly equal measure.

Terminally Honest.name: Terminally Honest
Terminally Honest.description: You cannot lie. Not will not. Cannot. Something about your face, your voice, or your complete inability to construct a believable story makes deception impossible. In a world of schemes and social maneuvering, you are a liability in conversations and a relief in friendships.
Terminally Honest.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: Terminally Honest. The character cannot lie convincingly. Deception attempts fail visibly. NPCs either trust them completely or find them insufferable.

Glory Obsessed.name: Glory Obsessed
Glory Obsessed.description: You want to be famous. Specifically, you want everyone to know your name, your deeds, and your title. You take on dangerous quests for the reputation. You announce yourself before entering rooms. You are deeply annoyed when someone else gets the credit.
Glory Obsessed.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: Glory Obsessed. The character prioritizes reputation over safety, profit, or common sense. They take risks for the story and resent obscurity.

The Reluctant Leader.name: The Reluctant Leader
The Reluctant Leader.description: People keep looking at you for decisions and you keep wishing they would stop. You are competent enough that the group defaults to your judgment. You resent this. Kazuma is the archetype: dragged into leadership by circumstance and sustained by complaints.
The Reluctant Leader.traitNarrativeEffects: SOCIAL: Reluctant Leader. NPCs defer to the character's judgment. The character complains about the responsibility but handles it competently.

The Loyal Second.name: The Loyal Second
The Loyal Second.description: You have someone you follow and you follow them into everything. Not blind loyalty; you argue, you push back, you tell them when they are being stupid. But when it matters, you are there. Your bond to your person is the most important thing in your life.
The Loyal Second.traitNarrativeEffects: SOCIAL: Loyal Second. The character bonds deeply to one person and supports them through everything. Loyalty is expressed through action, not words.

The Lone Wolf.name: The Lone Wolf
The Lone Wolf.description: You work alone by preference and in a party by necessity. Cooperation is a tactical decision, not a social one. You are not unfriendly; you are self-contained. Bonds form slowly and surprise you when they do.
The Lone Wolf.traitNarrativeEffects: SOCIAL: Lone Wolf. The character prefers independence. Party interactions are practical first, personal second. When warmth appears, it catches them off guard.

The Class Clown.name: The Class Clown
The Class Clown.description: You make people laugh. On purpose, by accident, through carefully timed stupidity, or through the specific gift of saying exactly the wrong thing at exactly the right moment. Humor is your defense and your contribution.
The Class Clown.traitNarrativeEffects: SOCIAL: Class Clown. The character uses humor as their primary social tool. Jokes deflect tension, build bonds, and occasionally cause problems.

The Quiet Competent.name: The Quiet Competent
The Quiet Competent.description: You do your job, you do it well, and you do not talk about it. While others are arguing, posing, or monologuing, you are solving the problem. Keith energy. Your contributions are noticed in retrospect.
The Quiet Competent.traitNarrativeEffects: SOCIAL: Quiet Competent. The character contributes through action rather than words. NPCs notice their reliability after the fact.

The Dramatic Rival.name: The Dramatic Rival
The Dramatic Rival.description: You have someone you compete with in everything. Every encounter is a contest. Every achievement is measured against theirs. You would never admit you care this much. Yunyun is the archetype: desperate for acknowledgment from someone who barely notices.
The Dramatic Rival.traitNarrativeEffects: SOCIAL: Dramatic Rival. The character frames interactions as competition. The rivalry is more important to them than to their rival.

The Earnest Idiot.name: The Earnest Idiot
The Earnest Idiot.description: You mean well. You try hard. You are sincere in a way that is its own kind of power. The gap between your intentions and your results is where the comedy lives. People cannot help liking you even when you cause problems.
The Earnest Idiot.traitNarrativeEffects: SOCIAL: Earnest Idiot. Sincerity is the character's defining trait. Their incompetence is charming rather than frustrating because the effort is genuine.

The Scheming Mastermind.name: The Scheming Mastermind
The Scheming Mastermind.description: You have a plan. You always have a plan. The plan is clever and accounts for multiple variables. The plan will fall apart on contact with reality in the most spectacular way possible. You will then improvise a new plan on the spot and pretend it was the original.
The Scheming Mastermind.traitNarrativeEffects: SOCIAL: Scheming Mastermind. The character plans elaborately and adapts when plans fail. The comedy is in the gap between the plan and the reality.

Fire Affinity.name: Fire Affinity
Fire Affinity.description: Your magic leans toward flame: combustion, heat, and controlled devastation, emphasis on controlled, please. Fire mages are common and respected in Belzerg. They are also the leading cause of property damage claims and the reason the guild keeps a bucket by every exit. Boosts fire magic skill.
Fire Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC: Fire Affinity. Fire magic comes naturally. Flames respond to the character's emotions. Nearby candles flicker when they are agitated.

Water Affinity.name: Water Affinity
Water Affinity.description: Your magic flows like water: healing, purification, and the sacred support traditions of the Axis Cult, who insist that water is the purest element and will debate this loudly with anyone holding a drink. Boosts water magic skill.
Water Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC: Water Affinity. Water magic comes naturally. The character can purify water by touch. Rain seems to follow them.

Ice Affinity.name: Ice Affinity
Ice Affinity.description: Your magic crystallizes: frost, cold, and the preservation of things that would rather not be preserved. Ice mages are equally useful in combat and in kitchens, and the Snowfield Forest feels like home. Boosts frost magic skill.
Ice Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC: Ice Affinity. Ice magic comes naturally. The air around the character is slightly cooler. Drinks stay cold in their hands.

Wind Affinity.name: Wind Affinity
Wind Affinity.description: Your magic moves like air: speed, redirection, and breezes that are equal parts useful and deeply annoying to party members with loose papers. Wind mages are fast, hard to pin down, and responsible for most outdoor hat-related incidents. Boosts wind magic skill.
Wind Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC: Wind Affinity. Wind magic comes naturally. The character's hair moves in breezes that do not exist for anyone else.

Lightning Affinity.name: Lightning Affinity
Lightning Affinity.description: Your magic strikes like a bolt: sudden, dramatic, and deeply satisfying to describe in the third person. Lightning mages are dramatic by nature, effective against armored opponents, and the reason the guild reminds everyone to stay indoors during casting practice. Boosts lightning magic skill.
Lightning Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC: Lightning Affinity. Lightning magic comes naturally. Static follows the character. Their hair stands up in humid weather.

Earth Affinity.name: Earth Affinity
Earth Affinity.description: Your magic is grounded: walls, barriers, tremors, and the patient power of stone. Earth mages are defensive specialists and excellent at construction, which means they get hired twice: once to fight the monster and once to fix what the fire mage did to the building. Boosts earth magic skill.
Earth Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC: Earth Affinity. Earth magic comes naturally. The ground responds subtly to the character's presence. Plants grow slightly faster near them.

Light Affinity.name: Light Affinity
Light Affinity.description: Your magic shines: illumination, purification, and the kind of anti-undead power that makes skeletons reconsider their career choices. Light magic is the Eris Church's domain, equal parts holy tradition and practical monster deterrent. Boosts divine magic skill.
Light Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC: Light Affinity. Light magic comes naturally. The character glows faintly when casting. Undead are instinctively uncomfortable near them.

Dark Affinity.name: Dark Affinity
Dark Affinity.description: Your magic is shadow: concealment, drain, and the uncomfortable power of things that hide in the dark. Dark magic users are viewed with suspicion by the churches and with interest by everyone else.
Dark Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC: Dark Affinity. Dark magic comes naturally. Shadows deepen around the character. The Eris Church watches them with polite concern.

Explosion Affinity.name: Explosion Affinity
Explosion Affinity.description: EXPLOSION. Your magic is focused entirely on the single most powerful and most impractical spell in existence. One cast, maximum destruction, and a Mana bill that floors anyone who cannot pay it. You understand what almost nobody else does, including most Crimson Demons: there is no substitute and absolutely no indoor use. Boosts explosion magic skill.
Explosion Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC: Explosion Affinity. Explosion magic is the only magic worth learning. The character talks about explosions with religious fervor.

No Magic.name: No Magic
No Magic.description: You have no magical affinity whatsoever. Your mana pool is negligible. You solve problems with your hands, your brain, and occasionally your feet when running is the smart move. In a world of mages, you are the practical one.
No Magic.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC: None. The character has no magical ability. Describe them solving magical problems through physical means, cleverness, or asking a mage for help.

Party Trick Expert.name: Party Trick Expert
Party Trick Expert.description: You know exactly one impressive non-combat skill and you deploy it at every opportunity. Card tricks, coin rolling, juggling, or the ability to open any bottle with your teeth.
Party Trick Expert.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Has one impressive party trick that surfaces at inappropriate moments.

Terrible Cook.name: Terrible Cook
Terrible Cook.description: Your cooking is a biological weapon. You try your best. The results are consistently inedible and occasionally mobile. The party hides the cookware when you volunteer.
Terrible Cook.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Cannot cook. Attempts at cooking produce results that are technically food but practically a disaster. NPCs who taste it react with genuine distress.

Chronic Oversleeper.name: Chronic Oversleeper
Chronic Oversleeper.description: Mornings are a theoretical concept you have never mastered. Parties learn to build the schedule around it or to leave without you.
Chronic Oversleeper.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Cannot wake up on time. Misses early departures. Genuinely apologetic, entirely unreformed.

Animal Magnet.name: Animal Magnet
Animal Magnet.description: Animals are drawn to you. Stray cats follow you home. Birds land on your shoulder. Giant toads consider you non-threatening, which is either a blessing or an insult.
Animal Magnet.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Animals approach and trust the character. This is sometimes useful and sometimes deeply inconvenient.

Terrible With Names.name: Terrible With Names
Terrible With Names.description: You forget names immediately after hearing them and compensate with increasingly creative nicknames that the named person never agreed to.
Terrible With Names.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Cannot remember names. Uses nicknames that range from accurate to offensive. NPCs have opinions about their assigned nicknames.

Collects Useless Things.name: Collects Useless Things
Collects Useless Things.description: You pick up items of zero practical value and cannot explain why. Interesting rocks, broken pottery, unusual sticks. Your inventory is 40 percent junk you refuse to drop.
Collects Useless Things.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Collects objects with no value. The collection occasionally contains something accidentally useful.

Dramatic Entrance Compulsion.name: Dramatic Entrance Compulsion
Dramatic Entrance Compulsion.description: You cannot enter a room normally. Every door is an opportunity for a pose, a one-liner, or a dramatic pause. The Crimson Demons respect this. Everyone else finds it exhausting.
Dramatic Entrance Compulsion.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Makes dramatic entrances every time. Poses, one-liners, and timing. Cannot be casual about doorways.

Stress Eater.name: Stress Eater
Stress Eater.description: When things go wrong, you eat. When things go right, you eat to celebrate. The tavern knows your order. Your food budget exceeds your equipment budget.
Stress Eater.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Eats in response to every emotion. Food is comfort, celebration, and coping mechanism simultaneously.

Directionally Challenged.name: Directionally Challenged
Directionally Challenged.description: You get lost in buildings you have visited before. Your sense of direction is not just bad; it is actively hostile. You will find the wrong path with unerring consistency.
Directionally Challenged.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Gets lost constantly. Navigation attempts produce unexpected results. The party has learned not to let them lead.

Lucky Finds.name: Lucky Finds
Lucky Finds.description: You stumble onto useful things by accident. Coins in the road, dropped items, the one unlocked window in a fortress. Your luck with discovery is inversely proportional to your luck with everything else.
Lucky Finds.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Finds things by accident. Not magic, just consistent improbable luck with discovery.

Fear of Frogs.name: Fear of Frogs
Fear of Frogs.description: Giant toads terrify you. Regular frogs make you nervous. This is the worst possible phobia to have in Axel, where giant toad extermination is the most common quest.
Fear of Frogs.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Afraid of frogs and toads. Giant toad quests are a source of genuine terror rather than routine work. The comedy writes itself.

Apologizes for Everything.name: Apologizes for Everything
Apologizes for Everything.description: You apologize before, during, and after every interaction. You apologize for apologizing. Wiz has this trait. It is endearing and slightly exhausting.
Apologizes for Everything.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Apologizes constantly. The apologies are sincere every time. NPCs find it either endearing or maddening.

Lithe Build.name: Lithe Build
Lithe Build.description: Slim and quick, built for dodging giant toads rather than wrestling them.
Lithe Build.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Body Type): Slim and quick, built for dodging giant toads rather than wrestling them. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Sturdy Build.name: Sturdy Build
Sturdy Build.description: Solid and grounded, the kind of frame a crusader is grateful for.
Sturdy Build.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Body Type): Solid and grounded, the kind of frame a crusader is grateful for. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Average Build.name: Average Build
Average Build.description: An unremarkable adventurer's frame, which is honestly on-brand for Axel.
Average Build.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Body Type): An unremarkable adventurer's frame, which is honestly on-brand for Axel. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Petite Build.name: Petite Build
Petite Build.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Body Type): Small, deceptively fragile-looking, dangerously overconfident. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Broad Build.name: Broad Build
Broad Build.description: Big and imposing, ideal for tanking hits and blocking doorways.
Broad Build.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Body Type): Big and imposing, ideal for tanking hits and blocking doorways. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Fair Skin.name: Fair Skin
Fair Skin.description: Fair, porcelain-pale skin that catches light softly. Common among nobles who stay indoors and Crimson Demons who spend their days studying magic rather than farming.
Fair Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Skin Tone): Fair, porcelain-pale skin that catches light softly. Common among nobles who stay indoors and Crimson Demons who spend their days studying magic rather than farming. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Light Skin.name: Light Skin
Light Skin.description: Light skin with a healthy warmth to it, the most common complexion among Belzerg's townsfolk and adventurers.
Light Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Skin Tone): Light skin with a healthy warmth to it, the most common complexion among Belzerg's townsfolk and adventurers. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Olive Skin.name: Olive Skin
Olive Skin.description: Warm olive skin with golden undertones, weathered attractively by outdoor work and travel.
Olive Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Skin Tone): Warm olive skin with golden undertones, weathered attractively by outdoor work and travel. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Tan Skin.name: Tan Skin
Tan Skin.description: Sun-bronzed skin earned through long days on the road or in the field, the mark of an adventurer who works outdoors.
Tan Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Skin Tone): Sun-bronzed skin earned through long days on the road or in the field, the mark of an adventurer who works outdoors. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Brown Skin.name: Brown Skin
Brown Skin.description: Deep brown skin with warm undertones, radiant and handsome in any light.
Brown Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Skin Tone): Deep brown skin with warm undertones, radiant and handsome in any light. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Pale Skin.name: Pale Skin
Pale Skin.description: Very pale, moonlight-fair skin, common among nobles who avoid the sun and mages who rarely leave their libraries.
Pale Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Skin Tone): Very pale, moonlight-fair skin, common among nobles who avoid the sun and mages who rarely leave their libraries. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Short Cropped Hair.name: Short Cropped Hair
Short Cropped Hair.description: Short cropped hair kept close and practical, out of the way of a helmet or a fight. Favored by fighters and anyone who values function over flair.
Short Cropped Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Short cropped hair kept close and practical, out of the way of a helmet or a fight. Favored by fighters and anyone who values function over flair. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Messy Hair.name: Messy Hair
Messy Hair.description: Tousled, artfully (or genuinely) messy hair, giving an unbothered, roguish air, the look of someone who rolled out of a guild tavern bench.
Messy Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Tousled, artfully (or genuinely) messy hair, giving an unbothered, roguish air, the look of someone who rolled out of a guild tavern bench. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Long Straight Hair.name: Long Straight Hair
Long Straight Hair.description: Long, sleek straight hair falling cleanly past the shoulders, elegant and eye-catching in motion.
Long Straight Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Long, sleek straight hair falling cleanly past the shoulders, elegant and eye-catching in motion. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

High Ponytail.name: High Ponytail
High Ponytail.description: Hair gathered high into a bouncy ponytail, energetic and ready for action.
High Ponytail.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Hair gathered high into a bouncy ponytail, energetic and ready for action. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Twin Tails.name: Twin Tails
Twin Tails.description: Hair bound into two playful tails, energetic and youthful, a signature look among certain dramatic mages.
Twin Tails.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Hair bound into two playful tails, energetic and youthful, a signature look among certain dramatic mages. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Braided Hair.name: Braided Hair
Braided Hair.description: Neatly braided hair, whether a single plait or an elaborate weave, suggesting patience and care.
Braided Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Neatly braided hair, whether a single plait or an elaborate weave, suggesting patience and care. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Hair Bun.name: Hair Bun
Hair Bun.description: Hair gathered into a neat, practical bun, tidy and dignified, keeping it clear of the work at hand.
Hair Bun.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Hair gathered into a neat, practical bun, tidy and dignified, keeping it clear of the work at hand. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Shoulder-Length Hair.name: Shoulder-Length Hair
Shoulder-Length Hair.description: Hair falling to the shoulders, a versatile middle-length that frames the face without getting in the way.
Shoulder-Length Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Hair falling to the shoulders, a versatile middle-length that frames the face without getting in the way. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Wavy Hair.name: Wavy Hair
Wavy Hair.description: Soft waves that catch the light, relaxed and naturally elegant. Survives weather, helmets, and explosions with suspicious grace.
Wavy Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Soft waves that catch the light, relaxed and naturally elegant. Survives weather, helmets, and explosions with suspicious grace. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Hooded (Hair Hidden).name: Hooded (Hair Hidden)
Hooded (Hair Hidden).description: Hair concealed beneath a drawn hood, lending an air of mystery or simple practicality against the weather.
Hooded (Hair Hidden).traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Hair concealed beneath a drawn hood, lending an air of mystery or simple practicality against the weather. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Black Hair.name: Black Hair
Black Hair.description: Deep black hair, glossy and dark as ink. The most common shade in Belzerg and the signature of the Crimson Demon clan.
Black Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Deep black hair, glossy and dark as ink. The most common shade in Belzerg and the signature of the Crimson Demon clan. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Brown Hair.name: Brown Hair
Brown Hair.description: Warm brown hair in any shade from chestnut to chocolate, the plain and pleasant default of most townsfolk.
Brown Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Warm brown hair in any shade from chestnut to chocolate, the plain and pleasant default of most townsfolk. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Chestnut Hair.name: Chestnut Hair
Chestnut Hair.description: Rich reddish-brown chestnut hair that glows warm in sunlight. The color of reliable people and good stew, and Belzerg trusts both.
Chestnut Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Rich reddish-brown chestnut hair that glows warm in sunlight. The color of reliable people and good stew, and Belzerg trusts both. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Blonde Hair.name: Blonde Hair
Blonde Hair.description: Golden blonde hair, prized and eye-catching, common among nobles like the Dustiness house.
Blonde Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Golden blonde hair, prized and eye-catching, common among nobles like the Dustiness house. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Silver Hair.name: Silver Hair
Silver Hair.description: Striking silver hair that shimmers like moonlight, unusual and memorable, the mark of a certain chivalrous thief.
Silver Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Striking silver hair that shimmers like moonlight, unusual and memorable, the mark of a certain chivalrous thief. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

White Hair.name: White Hair
White Hair.description: Pure white hair, whether from age, magic, or birth, lending an ethereal or venerable air.
White Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Pure white hair, whether from age, magic, or birth, lending an ethereal or venerable air. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Blue Hair.name: Blue Hair
Blue Hair.description: Vivid blue hair like flowing water, rare and divine, the unmistakable signature of a certain useless goddess.
Blue Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Vivid blue hair like flowing water, rare and divine, the unmistakable signature of a certain useless goddess. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Pink Hair.name: Pink Hair
Pink Hair.description: Soft pink hair, cheerful and distinctive, the kind that draws a second glance in any tavern.
Pink Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Soft pink hair, cheerful and distinctive, the kind that draws a second glance in any tavern. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Red Hair.name: Red Hair
Red Hair.description: Fiery red hair in shades from copper to crimson, bold and warm. Strangers assume a temper and are rarely entirely wrong.
Red Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Fiery red hair in shades from copper to crimson, bold and warm. Strangers assume a temper and are rarely entirely wrong. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Green Hair.name: Green Hair
Green Hair.description: Unusual green hair like spring leaves, exotic and magical in origin. Somewhere in your ancestry, someone made an arrangement with a forest.
Green Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Unusual green hair like spring leaves, exotic and magical in origin. Somewhere in your ancestry, someone made an arrangement with a forest. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Purple Hair.name: Purple Hair
Purple Hair.description: Deep purple hair with a magical shimmer, striking and uncommon. Shopkeepers quietly adjust their prices upward when it walks in.
Purple Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Deep purple hair with a magical shimmer, striking and uncommon. Shopkeepers quietly adjust their prices upward when it walks in. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Crimson Eyes.name: Crimson Eyes
Crimson Eyes.description: Glowing crimson eyes, the unmistakable genetic mark of the Crimson Demon clan, blazing with dramatic intensity whether the moment calls for it or not.
Crimson Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Glowing crimson eyes, the unmistakable genetic mark of the Crimson Demon clan, blazing with dramatic intensity whether the moment calls for it or not. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Brown Eyes.name: Brown Eyes
Brown Eyes.description: Warm brown eyes, honest and common, the everyday gaze of Belzerg's working folk.
Brown Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Warm brown eyes, honest and common, the everyday gaze of Belzerg's working folk. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Blue Eyes.name: Blue Eyes
Blue Eyes.description: Clear blue eyes, bright and expressive, the kind that catch torchlight across a tavern and make strangers think you look trustworthy.
Blue Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Clear blue eyes, bright and expressive, the kind that catch torchlight across a tavern and make strangers think you look trustworthy. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Green Eyes.name: Green Eyes
Green Eyes.description: Vivid green eyes, sharp and memorable, the color of a keen and watchful mind.
Green Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Vivid green eyes, sharp and memorable, the color of a keen and watchful mind. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Amber Eyes.name: Amber Eyes
Amber Eyes.description: Warm amber eyes that catch the light like honey, unusual and arresting. People being appraised by them tend to confess things.
Amber Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Warm amber eyes that catch the light like honey, unusual and arresting. People being appraised by them tend to confess things. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Grey Eyes.name: Grey Eyes
Grey Eyes.description: Cool grey eyes, calm and unreadable, the steady gaze of someone difficult to surprise.
Grey Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Cool grey eyes, calm and unreadable, the steady gaze of someone difficult to surprise. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Violet Eyes.name: Violet Eyes
Violet Eyes.description: Deep violet eyes, striking and magical, uncommon enough to be remembered.
Violet Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Deep violet eyes, striking and magical, uncommon enough to be remembered. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Heterochromia.name: Heterochromia
Heterochromia.description: Two different-colored eyes, one and then the other, a rare and captivating trait that draws immediate attention and, in Belzerg, immediate assumptions of hidden power.
Heterochromia.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Two different-colored eyes, one and then the other, a rare and captivating trait that draws immediate attention and, in Belzerg, immediate assumptions of hidden power. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Youthful Face.name: Youthful Face
Youthful Face.description: Bright, expressive, quick to show every emotion including panic.
Youthful Face.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Facial Features): Bright, expressive, quick to show every emotion including panic. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Sharp Features.name: Sharp Features
Sharp Features.description: Angular and striking, good for dramatic close-ups. Angular, defined features that read as decisive or severe depending entirely on the expression wearing them.
Sharp Features.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Facial Features): Angular and striking, good for dramatic close-ups. Angular, defined features that read as decisive or severe depending entirely on the expression wearing them. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Soft Features.name: Soft Features
Soft Features.description: Gentle and approachable, disarming even when scheming. Gentle rounded features that consistently cause people to underestimate you, which has its uses.
Soft Features.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Facial Features): Gentle and approachable, disarming even when scheming. Gentle rounded features that consistently cause people to underestimate you, which has its uses. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Tired Eyes.name: Tired Eyes
Tired Eyes.description: The permanent under-eye shadows of someone in debt. Permanently shadowed eyes that suggest either hard living or hard thinking. In Axel it is usually both.
Tired Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Facial Features): The permanent under-eye shadows of someone in debt. Permanently shadowed eyes that suggest either hard living or hard thinking. In Axel it is usually both. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Confident Smirk.name: Confident Smirk
Confident Smirk.description: A default expression that promises this is definitely a good idea.
Confident Smirk.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Facial Features): A default expression that promises this is definitely a good idea. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Rookie Adventurer Gear.name: Rookie Adventurer Gear
Rookie Adventurer Gear.description: Practical leather and cloth, standard Guild-approved starting kit. Smells faintly of the previous owner's optimism.
Rookie Adventurer Gear.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): Practical leather and cloth, standard Guild-approved starting kit. Smells faintly of the previous owner's optimism. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Mage's Robes.name: Mage's Robes
Mage's Robes.description: Flowing robes cut for casting, with sleeves wide enough for dramatic gestures and deep enough pockets for spell components and snacks.
Mage's Robes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): Flowing robes cut for casting, with sleeves wide enough for dramatic gestures and deep enough pockets for spell components and snacks. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Crimson Demon Regalia.name: Crimson Demon Regalia
Crimson Demon Regalia.description: Dark, dramatic robes designed to billow at the exact moment you finish an incantation. The cape is mandatory. The cape is always mandatory.
Crimson Demon Regalia.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): Dark, dramatic robes designed to billow at the exact moment you finish an incantation. The cape is mandatory. The cape is always mandatory. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Priestly Habit.name: Priestly Habit
Priestly Habit.description: Ceremonial church garb, respectability optional depending on the church.
Priestly Habit.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): Ceremonial church garb, respectability optional depending on the church. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Heavy Armor.name: Heavy Armor
Heavy Armor.description: Full plate and a big shield, heavy enough to nap standing up.
Heavy Armor.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): Full plate and a big shield, heavy enough to nap standing up. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Casual Traveler's Clothes.name: Casual Traveler's Clothes
Casual Traveler's Clothes.description: Comfortable, unremarkable clothes built for sleeping rough, walking far, and not being remembered by anyone you pass on the road.
Casual Traveler's Clothes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): Comfortable, unremarkable clothes built for sleeping rough, walking far, and not being remembered by anyone you pass on the road. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Faded Noble Attire.name: Faded Noble Attire
Faded Noble Attire.description: Once-fine clothing kept immaculate through sheer stubborn pride.
Faded Noble Attire.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): Once-fine clothing kept immaculate through sheer stubborn pride. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Guild Tavern Background.name: Guild Tavern Background
Guild Tavern Background.description: The warm, crowded interior of the Adventurers Guild tavern, where quest stories get louder with every round and the barkeep has heard all of them.
Guild Tavern Background.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Scene Background): The warm, crowded interior of the Adventurers Guild tavern, where quest stories get louder with every round and the barkeep has heard all of them. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Axel Streets Background.name: Axel Streets Background
Axel Streets Background.description: The cobbled streets of Axel under a friendly sky, where the buildings lean together like old friends and the biggest danger is usually a cart.
Axel Streets Background.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Scene Background): The cobbled streets of Axel under a friendly sky, where the buildings lean together like old friends and the biggest danger is usually a cart. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Ruins Background.name: Ruins Background
Ruins Background.description: A crumbling stone ruin at the edge of town, half-swallowed by ivy, the sort of place beginners train and veterans avoid out of nostalgia.
Ruins Background.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Scene Background): A crumbling stone ruin at the edge of town, half-swallowed by ivy, the sort of place beginners train and veterans avoid out of nostalgia. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Snowy Belzerg Background.name: Snowy Belzerg Background
Snowy Belzerg Background.description: The cold, broke, beautiful Belzerg winter: snow-dusted rooftops, fogging breath, and the particular melancholy of an adventurer who cannot afford heating.
Snowy Belzerg Background.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Scene Background): The cold, broke, beautiful Belzerg winter: snow-dusted rooftops, fogging breath, and the particular melancholy of an adventurer who cannot afford heating. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Hot Spring Background.name: Hot Spring Background
Hot Spring Background.description: The steam and stone of an Alcanretia bath, misty and tranquil, with the faint sulfur tang of blessed water and a lurking recruiter or two.
Hot Spring Background.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Scene Background): The steam and stone of an Alcanretia bath, misty and tranquil, with the faint sulfur tang of blessed water and a lurking recruiter or two. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Anime Cel Shading.name: Anime Cel Shading
Anime Cel Shading.description: Clean cel-shaded anime style, bright and expressive, true to KonoSuba's vibrant, comedic look.
Anime Cel Shading.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Portrait Style): Clean cel-shaded anime style, bright and expressive, true to KonoSuba's vibrant, comedic look. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Soft Anime Painterly.name: Soft Anime Painterly
Soft Anime Painterly.description: A softer painted anime look with gentle light and blended color, warmer and more delicate than sharp cel shading.
Soft Anime Painterly.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Portrait Style): A softer painted anime look with gentle light and blended color, warmer and more delicate than sharp cel shading. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Light Novel Illustration.name: Light Novel Illustration
Light Novel Illustration.description: Detailed light-novel cover-art rendering, polished and dramatic, with fine linework and rich color.
Light Novel Illustration.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Portrait Style): Detailed light-novel cover-art rendering, polished and dramatic, with fine linework and rich color. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Portrait Bust.name: Portrait Bust
Portrait Bust.description: Close head-and-shoulders framing, focusing on the face and expression. The classic choice for guild cards and wanted posters alike.
Portrait Bust.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Portrait Framing): Close head-and-shoulders framing, focusing on the face and expression. The classic choice for guild cards and wanted posters alike. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Half Body.name: Half Body
Half Body.description: Waist-up framing that shows outfit details, posture, and the character's upper presence.
Half Body.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Portrait Framing): Waist-up framing that shows outfit details, posture, and the character's upper presence. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Dynamic Pose.name: Dynamic Pose
Dynamic Pose.description: An action pose, mid-motion, as though you were caught between drawing a weapon and delivering a monologue. Crimson Demons would not have it otherwise.
Dynamic Pose.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Portrait Framing): An action pose, mid-motion, as though you were caught between drawing a weapon and delivering a monologue. Crimson Demons would not have it otherwise. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Seasoned Nerve.name: Seasoned Nerve
Seasoned Nerve.description: Nothing surprises you anymore. You have seen the goddess cry, the lich apologize, and the devil run a shop.
Seasoned Nerve.traitNarrativeEffects: The character remains unflappable in bizarre situations.

Guild Regular.name: Guild Regular
Guild Regular.description: You know everyone at the guild, every quest board trick, and exactly which receptionist to ask.
Guild Regular.traitNarrativeEffects: The character navigates guild systems and social circles smoothly.

Debt Survivor.name: Debt Survivor
Debt Survivor.description: You have owed so much money for so long that financial catastrophe no longer frightens you.
Debt Survivor.traitNarrativeEffects: The character stays functional under crushing financial pressure.

Hardened Adventurer.name: Hardened Adventurer
Hardened Adventurer.description: The guild life has toughened you into a genuine professional, for better or worse.
Hardened Adventurer.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries the competence and cynicism of a veteran.

Crowd Worker.name: Crowd Worker
Crowd Worker.description: You have learned to read and play a crowd, turning a room to your favor.
Crowd Worker.traitNarrativeEffects: The character influences groups and audiences effectively.

Iron Stomach.name: Iron Stomach
Iron Stomach.description: You can eat literally anything. Toad jerky, mystery stew, Aqua's cooking. Nothing fazes you.
Iron Stomach.traitNarrativeEffects: The character resists poison, spoiled food, and stomach ailments.

Cheapskate.name: Cheapskate
Cheapskate.description: Your legendary unwillingness to spend money has become a genuine survival skill.
Cheapskate.traitNarrativeEffects: The character finds cheaper options and stretches every coin.

Dramatic Flair.name: Dramatic Flair
Dramatic Flair.description: You have absorbed the Crimson Demon lesson that presentation is half of everything.
Dramatic Flair.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's actions carry theatrical weight that affects onlookers.

Unlucky.name: Unlucky
Unlucky.description: Bad things find you. Puddles, lawsuits, giant toads, the wrong quest.
Unlucky.traitNarrativeEffects: Misfortune gravitates toward you. Play up comedic bad luck; it makes the payoffs sweeter.

Weirdly Lucky.name: Weirdly Lucky
abilities: Lucky Escape
Weirdly Lucky.description: You should be dead. You are not. The statistics are offended by your continued existence.
Weirdly Lucky.traitNarrativeEffects: The character survives situations they have no business surviving.

Party Magnet.name: Party Magnet
abilities: Party Spirit
Party Magnet.description: Somehow you keep ending up at the center of the group, the one everyone rallies around.
Party Magnet.traitNarrativeEffects: The character naturally draws companions and builds bonds.

Legendary Weapon.name: Legendary Weapon
abilities: Divine Weapon
Legendary Weapon.description: You chose a divine weapon as your gift when you were reincarnated. A blade, a bow, or a staff imbued with divine power. Kyouya Mitsurugi chose a cursed sword called Gram. Kazuma stole it with the Steal skill and sold it for beer money. Choose your weapon wisely; someone will try to take it.
Legendary Weapon.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE GIFT: Legendary Weapon. The character carries a divinely gifted weapon that is genuinely powerful. It may attract attention, theft attempts, and jealousy from other adventurers who chose less impressive gifts.

Enhanced Body.name: Enhanced Body
abilities: Second Breath
Enhanced Body.description: You chose physical enhancement: faster reflexes, stronger muscles, sharper senses, and a body that recovers from damage like it was designed for adventuring. Which it was. By a goddess. Your physical abilities are noticeably above human normal, which makes training feel like cheating.
Enhanced Body.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE GIFT: Enhanced Body. The character is physically superior: faster, stronger, tougher than natural ability allows. This surfaces in athletics, combat recovery, and the specific way other adventurers notice something is off about their performance.

Cheat Skill: Appraisal.name: Cheat Skill: Appraisal
abilities: Appraisal Eye
Cheat Skill: Appraisal.description: You chose the ability to see the stats, level, and hidden information of anyone you look at. In a game world, this is broken. In Belzerg, this means you know exactly how outclassed you are by the Level 30 lich running the magic shop and exactly how much debt the adventurer next to you is carrying. Knowledge is power. Knowledge is also depressing.
Cheat Skill: Appraisal.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE GIFT: Appraisal. The character can read people's approximate level, stats, and hidden traits with a look. Use this to reveal information the character should not know, creating comedy and tactical advantage.

Cheat Skill: Language Mastery.name: Cheat Skill: Language Mastery
abilities: Language Comprehension
Cheat Skill: Language Mastery.description: You chose the ability to read, write, and speak every language in this world instantly. This sounded amazing until you realized almost everyone in Belzerg speaks the same language and the only time it matters is reading ancient dungeon inscriptions that say things like 'TURN BACK' and 'WHY DID YOU IGNORE THE LAST SIGN.'
Cheat Skill: Language Mastery.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE GIFT: Language Mastery. The character reads all languages. This is occasionally useful (ancient texts, foreign visitors) and mostly a party trick.

Chose the Goddess.name: Chose the Goddess
abilities: Goddess's Favor
Chose the Goddess.description: Instead of choosing a weapon or power, you brought a reincarnating goddess of your own into Belzerg. She is now your responsibility and your biggest headache. This mirrors the choice that shaped the most famous party in the kingdom, though the goddess you dragged along is yours to answer for and never Aqua herself, who belongs to Kazuma. Only available for otherworlder origins.
Chose the Goddess.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE GIFT: The Goddess. The character chose a reincarnating goddess of their own as their cheat item, which is both the worst and best decision they ever made. She is not Aqua, who belongs to Kazuma's party. Their relationship with divine entities is... complicated. She is a real companion present in scenes: instantiate her ONCE at story start as her own NPC, an original goddess (never Aqua), placed with the player and persistent.

Chose Nothing.name: Chose Nothing
Chose Nothing.description: You refused the goddess's offer. Out of spite, principle, or the specific kind of stubbornness that makes a person turn down free divine power and walk into a fantasy world with nothing but the clothes on their back. You arrived in Belzerg empty-handed. Everything you have, you earned. This is either admirable or stupid.
Chose Nothing.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE GIFT: Nothing. The character has no divine advantage whatsoever. Everything is earned through effort, cleverness, and refusing to die. NPCs who learn this react with either respect or confusion.

Mysterious Artifact.name: Mysterious Artifact
abilities: Curious Artifact
Mysterious Artifact.description: You chose an artifact that the goddess described as 'very interesting' with a smile that suggested she was not telling you everything. The artifact does something. You are not entirely sure what. It activates at inconvenient moments and the effects are unpredictable but never boring.
Mysterious Artifact.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE GIFT: Mysterious Artifact. The character carries a divine artifact with unclear properties. It activates unpredictably, creating both opportunities and complications. The goddess who gave it definitely knew what it did and chose not to explain.

Retained Memories.name: Retained Memories
abilities: Otherworld Knowledge
Retained Memories.description: Instead of a weapon or power, you chose to keep your complete memories and knowledge from your previous life. Every skill, every piece of trivia, every late-night internet rabbit hole is intact. You know about chemistry, engineering, agriculture, and exactly how to make ramen from scratch. In a medieval fantasy world, this is either revolutionary or completely useless depending on the availability of ingredients.
Retained Memories.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE GIFT: Full Memory Retention. The character has complete knowledge from modern Japan. Science, technology, cooking, pop culture. Most of it requires infrastructure that does not exist here. Some of it is game-changing when it works.

Born Here (No Gift).name: Born Here (No Gift)
Born Here (No Gift).description: You were born in Belzerg. No goddess sent you, no divine gift awaits. Your abilities are your own, earned through a lifetime in a world where toads are a real hazard. You find otherworlders fascinating and slightly annoying. Pick this if your Origin Story is native to Belzerg.
Born Here (No Gift).traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE GIFT: None (native). The character is native to Belzerg and has no divine advantage. They compensate with lived experience and the quiet confidence of someone who has never needed a goddess to tell them how the world works.

Explosions Only.name: Explosions Only
Explosions Only.description: There is one answer to every combat problem and that answer is the biggest, loudest, most devastating spell available, deployed at maximum power with zero concern for collateral damage, personal safety, or mana conservation. Megumin's philosophy. It works exactly once per fight, and that one time is usually enough.
Explosions Only.traitNarrativeEffects: COMBAT: Explosions Only. The character solves every fight with maximum force. Describe their attacks as dramatic, devastating, and immediately followed by exhaustion or consequences. Property damage is not their concern.

Support Specialist.name: Support Specialist
Support Specialist.description: You keep everyone else alive and effective. Healing, buffing, removing debuffs, and shouting tactical advice that the party ignores until they need it. The hardest job in any party because the reward is that nobody notices you did anything.
Support Specialist.traitNarrativeEffects: COMBAT: Support Specialist. The character heals, buffs, and enables allies. Their contributions are felt in the party's survival rate, not in flashy kills.

Calculated Striker.name: Calculated Striker
Calculated Striker.description: Observe, analyze, exploit. You watch the fight before joining it, identify the weakness, and deliver one precise, devastating attack. Maximum effect, minimum effort. The rest of the party thinks you are lazy until the fight ends in a single move.
Calculated Striker.traitNarrativeEffects: COMBAT: Calculated Striker. The character waits for the right moment, then strikes decisively. Describe their combat as patient, precise, and efficient.

Berserker Rush.name: Berserker Rush
Berserker Rush.description: Think later. Hit now. Your combat philosophy is to close the distance immediately and overwhelm the enemy with aggression before they can organize a response. It works more often than tacticians want to admit.
Berserker Rush.traitNarrativeEffects: COMBAT: Berserker Rush. The character charges in immediately with maximum aggression. Describe their combat as fast, reckless, and terrifyingly effective when it works.

Run Away Expert.name: Run Away Expert
Run Away Expert.description: The best fight is the one you escape from. You have an encyclopedic knowledge of exit strategies, escape routes, and the exact moment a fight tips from 'winnable' to 'run.' Cowardice is a survival strategy and survival is winning.
Run Away Expert.traitNarrativeEffects: COMBAT: Run Away Expert. The character excels at tactical retreat, escape, and knowing when to disengage. This is not cowardice; it is advanced survival.

Improviser.name: Improviser
Improviser.description: You do not have a plan. You have never had a plan. You react to whatever is happening with whatever is available: a chair, a potion, an ally's spell redirected sideways, the terrain, and a prayer. It works because nobody, including you, knows what you will do next.
Improviser.traitNarrativeEffects: COMBAT: Improviser. The character adapts in real-time with no predetermined strategy. Describe their combat as creative, unpredictable, and occasionally brilliant.

The Nobody.name: The Nobody
The Nobody.description: Nobody knows who you are. Nobody cares. You are a blank slate in a town full of adventurers, and you will have to earn every scrap of recognition from the ground up. This is actually liberating: no expectations, no debts, no reputation to protect.
The Nobody.traitNarrativeEffects: REPUTATION: Unknown. NPCs have no preconceptions. The character must earn recognition through actions. First impressions are entirely on them.

The Promising Rookie.name: The Promising Rookie
The Promising Rookie.description: The guild receptionist noticed something about you during registration. Maybe your test scores were slightly better than average. Maybe you did not flinch at the wrong moment. You have been flagged as 'worth watching,' which in guild terms means you get slightly better quest recommendations and slightly more attention from recruiters.
The Promising Rookie.traitNarrativeEffects: REPUTATION: Promising. Guild staff give the character slightly better treatment and quest recommendations. Other adventurers notice the favoritism and have opinions.

The Troublemaker.name: The Troublemaker
The Troublemaker.description: You have already caused problems. Before you even registered, something went wrong and your name is in a file somewhere. The guild accepted your registration with a visible sigh. Sena may already have a preliminary folder. The good news is that in Belzerg, causing problems and solving them often look identical from the outside.
The Troublemaker.traitNarrativeEffects: REPUTATION: Troublemaker. Guild staff are wary. Sena has a file. Other adventurers find the character interesting or avoid them. NPCs expect chaos.

The Veteran's Referral.name: The Veteran's Referral
The Veteran's Referral.description: An established adventurer vouched for you. Someone with rank, reputation, and the kind of credibility that makes the guild skip a few questions during registration. You do not know why they did it. They might have owed someone a favor. Either way, their name is attached to yours now, which is both a door and a leash.
The Veteran's Referral.traitNarrativeEffects: REPUTATION: Referred. The character was vouched for by a veteran adventurer. Guild staff are respectful. Other adventurers are curious about the connection.

The Former Somebody.name: The Former Somebody
The Former Somebody.description: You were important somewhere else. A soldier, a noble, a merchant, someone whose name meant something in a context that does not exist in Axel. Now you are a rookie with a famous-sounding name and no local reputation. The adjustment is ongoing.
The Former Somebody.traitNarrativeEffects: REPUTATION: Former Somebody. NPCs occasionally recognize the character's name or background and react with curiosity, respect, or skepticism about why they are here.

Property Damage Record.name: Property Damage Record
Property Damage Record.description: You have not been in Axel long and you have already broken something expensive. The guild has a damage report with your name on it. Sena has flagged your file. Merchants watch you nervously. You are on a first-name basis with the town's construction crew.
Property Damage Record.traitNarrativeEffects: REPUTATION: Damage Record. NPCs are cautious around the character. Merchants increase prices or refuse to sell breakable items. Sena checks in periodically.

Cult Escapee.name: Cult Escapee
Cult Escapee.description: The Axis Cult had you. You got out. The recruitment pamphlets stopped arriving a week ago, which means they are planning something. The Eris Church is sympathetic. The Axis Cult considers you an unfinished conversion. You flinch at the color blue.
Cult Escapee.traitNarrativeEffects: REPUTATION: Cult Escapee. The Axis Cult considers the character a project. The Eris Church is quietly supportive. Other adventurers are sympathetic.

The Lucky One.name: The Lucky One
The Lucky One.description: Things work out for you in ways they should not. Not through skill, not through effort, through dumb luck that defies statistical analysis. You have survived things that should have killed you and stumbled into rewards you did not earn. People who know this either want to party with you or suspect you are cursed.
The Lucky One.traitNarrativeEffects: REPUTATION: Lucky. NPCs notice the character's improbable fortune. Some want to be near it; others are suspicious. The luck is real but unreliable.

Side Ponytail.name: Side Ponytail
Side Ponytail.description: A ponytail swept to one side, casual and slightly asymmetric, as if you left in a hurry and made it work.
Side Ponytail.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): A ponytail swept to one side, casual and slightly asymmetric, as if you left in a hurry and made it work. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Spiky Hair.name: Spiky Hair
Spiky Hair.description: Dramatically spiked hair, bold and attention-grabbing, popular among those who want to look intense.
Spiky Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Dramatically spiked hair, bold and attention-grabbing, popular among those who want to look intense. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Bob Cut.name: Bob Cut
Bob Cut.description: A tidy bob framing the face, sharp and stylish, neat enough for a noble and practical enough for a fight.
Bob Cut.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): A tidy bob framing the face, sharp and stylish, neat enough for a noble and practical enough for a fight. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Wild Untamed Hair.name: Wild Untamed Hair
Wild Untamed Hair.description: Wild, uncombed, going in every direction at once. The hair of someone who has decided the wind is a stylist.
Wild Untamed Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Wild, uncombed, going in every direction at once. The hair of someone who has decided the wind is a stylist. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Hime Cut.name: Hime Cut
Hime Cut.description: The elegant hime cut, straight with sidelocks and a level fringe, refined and traditional, favored by nobles.
Hime Cut.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): The elegant hime cut, straight with sidelocks and a level fringe, refined and traditional, favored by nobles. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Low Ponytail.name: Low Ponytail
Low Ponytail.description: Hair gathered at the nape of the neck. Practical, composed, and a quiet signal that you intend to get work done today.
Low Ponytail.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Hair gathered at the nape of the neck. Practical, composed, and a quiet signal that you intend to get work done today. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Undercut.name: Undercut
Undercut.description: A bold undercut, shaved at the sides with length on top, striking and modern.
Undercut.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): A bold undercut, shaved at the sides with length on top, striking and modern. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Drill Curls.name: Drill Curls
Drill Curls.description: Elaborate spiral curls, the signature of nobility and of people who have staff for this. Each ringlet is a small announcement.
Drill Curls.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Elaborate spiral curls, the signature of nobility and of people who have staff for this. Each ringlet is a small announcement. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Thief's Leathers.name: Thief's Leathers
Thief's Leathers.description: Dark, close-fitting leather designed for silence and flexibility. Built to move in, hide in, and escape in. Chris wears something similar.
Thief's Leathers.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): Dark, close-fitting leather designed for silence and flexibility. Built to move in, hide in, and escape in. Chris wears something similar. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Guild Uniform.name: Guild Uniform
Guild Uniform.description: The Adventurers Guild staff uniform: clean, professional, and designed to withstand beer stains and adventurer-related chaos. Luna's standard issue.
Guild Uniform.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): The Adventurers Guild staff uniform: clean, professional, and designed to withstand beer stains and adventurer-related chaos. Luna's standard issue. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Axis Cult Robes.name: Axis Cult Robes
Axis Cult Robes.description: The bright blue robes of the Axis Cult. Immediately recognizable. Wearing these in public is a statement that you worship Aqua, love water, and are prepared to recruit anyone who makes eye contact.
Axis Cult Robes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): The bright blue robes of the Axis Cult. Immediately recognizable. Wearing these in public is a statement that you worship Aqua, love water, and are prepared to recruit anyone who makes eye contact. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Battle-Worn Plate.name: Battle-Worn Plate
Battle-Worn Plate.description: Heavy plate armor that has clearly seen combat: dented, scratched, repaired, and repaired again. Every mark tells a story and most of the stories end in property damage.
Battle-Worn Plate.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): Heavy plate armor that has clearly seen combat: dented, scratched, repaired, and repaired again. Every mark tells a story and most of the stories end in property damage. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Merchant's Fine Clothes.name: Merchant's Fine Clothes
Merchant's Fine Clothes.description: Quality clothing designed to project success and trustworthiness. Well-tailored, understated expensive, and chosen to make clients feel like they are dealing with someone who can afford to be honest.
Merchant's Fine Clothes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): Quality clothing designed to project success and trustworthiness. Well-tailored, understated expensive, and chosen to make clients feel like they are dealing with someone who can afford to be honest. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Witch's Ensemble.name: Witch's Ensemble
Witch's Ensemble.description: A dramatic witch-styled outfit: pointed hat, flowing dark dress or coat, and enough accessories to make an entrance. Wiz's aesthetic. Equal parts practical and theatrical.
Witch's Ensemble.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): A dramatic witch-styled outfit: pointed hat, flowing dark dress or coat, and enough accessories to make an entrance. Wiz's aesthetic. Equal parts practical and theatrical. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Tavern Casual.name: Tavern Casual
Tavern Casual.description: What you wear when you are off duty: a loose shirt, comfortable trousers, and the relaxed look of someone who has no intention of doing anything heroic today.
Tavern Casual.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): What you wear when you are off duty: a loose shirt, comfortable trousers, and the relaxed look of someone who has no intention of doing anything heroic today. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Military Uniform.name: Military Uniform
Military Uniform.description: A Belzerg military uniform, either current or kept from a previous career. Formal, structured, and carrying the weight of service. People who see it make assumptions about discipline that may or may not be accurate.
Military Uniform.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): A Belzerg military uniform, either current or kept from a previous career. Formal, structured, and carrying the weight of service. People who see it make assumptions about discipline that may or may not be accurate. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Golden Eyes.name: Golden Eyes
Golden Eyes.description: Rare golden eyes that seem to glow faintly, a sign of unusual heritage or magic.
Golden Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Rare golden eyes that seem to glow faintly, a sign of unusual heritage or magic. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Dark Eyes.name: Dark Eyes
Dark Eyes.description: So dark they read black in low light. Intense, unreadable, and excellent at winning staring contests you did not agree to.
Dark Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): So dark they read black in low light. Intense, unreadable, and excellent at winning staring contests you did not agree to. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Teal Eyes.name: Teal Eyes
Teal Eyes.description: Blue-green teal that shifts shade with the light, never quite the same color twice. People check. That is the point.
Teal Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Blue-green teal that shifts shade with the light, never quite the same color twice. People check. That is the point. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Glowing Eyes.name: Glowing Eyes
Glowing Eyes.description: Any color, with a faint magical luminescence. Convenient for reading in bed, inconvenient for hiding at night.
Glowing Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Any color, with a faint magical luminescence. Convenient for reading in bed, inconvenient for hiding at night. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Scar Across the Face.name: Scar Across the Face
Scar Across the Face.description: A visible scar crossing the face: evidence of a fight, an accident, or a very bad day. Adds character. People assume a story and they are usually right.
Scar Across the Face.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Facial Features): A visible scar crossing the face: evidence of a fight, an accident, or a very bad day. Adds character. People assume a story and they are usually right. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Freckles.name: Freckles
Freckles.description: A scatter of freckles across the nose and cheeks. Adds warmth to any face and undercuts dramatic pretensions, which is either an asset or a problem.
Freckles.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Facial Features): A scatter of freckles across the nose and cheeks. Adds warmth to any face and undercuts dramatic pretensions, which is either an asset or a problem. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Beauty Mark.name: Beauty Mark
Beauty Mark.description: A small mole near the mouth, eye, or cheekbone. The kind of detail that portrait artists love and that makes a face memorable.
Beauty Mark.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Facial Features): A small mole near the mouth, eye, or cheekbone. The kind of detail that portrait artists love and that makes a face memorable. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Glasses.name: Glasses
Glasses.description: Wears glasses: round, rectangular, or half-frame. Possibly for actual vision correction. Possibly because they make the wearer look smarter and they know it.
Glasses.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Facial Features): Wears glasses: round, rectangular, or half-frame. Possibly for actual vision correction. Possibly because they make the wearer look smarter and they know it. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Eyepatch.name: Eyepatch
Eyepatch.description: Wears an eyepatch over one eye. In Belzerg, this could mean a lost eye, sealed power, or (if you are a Crimson Demon) pure aesthetic choice. Megumin wears one for fashion. Nobody is sure which category yours falls into.
Eyepatch.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Facial Features): Wears an eyepatch over one eye. In Belzerg, this could mean a lost eye, sealed power, or (if you are a Crimson Demon) pure aesthetic choice. Megumin wears one for fashion. Nobody is sure which category yours falls into. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Crimson Demon Village Background.name: Crimson Demon Village Background
Crimson Demon Village Background.description: The mountain village of the Crimson Demons, where every building has a dramatic name and the evening skyline glows faintly from someone practicing.
Crimson Demon Village Background.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Scene Background): The mountain village of the Crimson Demons, where every building has a dramatic name and the evening skyline glows faintly from someone practicing. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Elroad Casino Background.name: Elroad Casino Background
Elroad Casino Background.description: The gilded interior of an Elroad casino, all warmth and calculated luxury.
Elroad Casino Background.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Scene Background): The gilded interior of an Elroad casino, all warmth and calculated luxury. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Forest Trail Background.name: Forest Trail Background
Forest Trail Background.description: A mountain forest path dappled with light and scarred with explosion craters.
Forest Trail Background.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Scene Background): A mountain forest path dappled with light and scarred with explosion craters. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Frontier Fort Background.name: Frontier Fort Background
Frontier Fort Background.description: The stone courtyard of the northern frontier fort, bleak and military. Built by engineering, held by stubbornness.
Frontier Fort Background.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Scene Background): The stone courtyard of the northern frontier fort, bleak and military. Built by engineering, held by stubbornness. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Moonlit Road Background.name: Moonlit Road Background
Moonlit Road Background.description: A country road at night under a full moon, peaceful and slightly eerie. Perfect for travel, confessions, and being followed.
Moonlit Road Background.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Scene Background): A country road at night under a full moon, peaceful and slightly eerie. Perfect for travel, confessions, and being followed. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Tall and Lean.name: Tall and Lean
Tall and Lean.description: Notably tall with a lean frame, the kind of build that makes doorways a consideration and crowds easy to see over.
Tall and Lean.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Body Type): Notably tall with a lean frame, the kind of build that makes doorways a consideration and crowds easy to see over. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Short and Stocky.name: Short and Stocky
Short and Stocky.description: Compact and densely built, closer to the ground and harder to knock over. What you lack in reach you make up in being a difficult target.
Short and Stocky.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Body Type): Compact and densely built, closer to the ground and harder to knock over. What you lack in reach you make up in being a difficult target. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Athletic Build.name: Athletic Build
Athletic Build.description: Visibly fit and trained, with the defined muscles of someone who uses their body for work rather than show. The build of a working adventurer.
Athletic Build.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Body Type): Visibly fit and trained, with the defined muscles of someone who uses their body for work rather than show. The build of a working adventurer. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Competitive About Everything.name: Competitive About Everything
Competitive About Everything.description: Every interaction is a contest. Eating speed, quest completion time, who can carry more loot. You keep score mentally and announce results nobody asked for.
Competitive About Everything.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Turns everything into a competition. Keeps mental scoreboards. Announces results.

Allergic to Mornings.name: Allergic to Mornings
Allergic to Mornings.description: You are a different, worse person before noon. Conversation attempts before breakfast receive hostile responses. The party has learned to leave food near your bedroll and retreat to a safe distance.
Allergic to Mornings.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Non-functional before noon. Hostile to morning interactions. Needs food to activate.

Involuntary Honesty Under Pressure.name: Involuntary Honesty Under Pressure
Involuntary Honesty Under Pressure.description: When stressed, panicked, or caught off guard, you blurt out exactly what you are thinking with zero filter. Plans, secrets, opinions about people's outfits. Everything.
Involuntary Honesty Under Pressure.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Blurts out unfiltered truth when stressed. Secrets escape under pressure.

Haunted by Past Cooking.name: Haunted by Past Cooking
Haunted by Past Cooking.description: You once cooked something so terrible that people still bring it up. The incident is a local legend. You are no longer allowed near the guild kitchen.
Haunted by Past Cooking.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Infamous for a specific past cooking disaster. NPCs reference it. Ban from kitchens.

Excessive Note-Taker.name: Excessive Note-Taker
Excessive Note-Taker.description: You write everything down. Quest details, NPC names, weather observations, the exact time someone said something interesting. Your notebook is a comprehensive record of everything and a fire hazard due to volume.
Excessive Note-Taker.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Documents everything in a notebook. Occasionally useful. Mostly excessive.

Can Sleep Anywhere.name: Can Sleep Anywhere
Can Sleep Anywhere.description: You can fall asleep in any position, in any location, under any circumstances. Standing up, in a tree, during a briefing. This talent is impressive and deeply annoying to party members trying to include you in discussions.
Can Sleep Anywhere.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Falls asleep anywhere. Impressive survival skill disguised as laziness.

Accidentally Intimidating.name: Accidentally Intimidating
Accidentally Intimidating.description: You are not trying to be scary. Your resting face, your posture, and your general presence just read as threatening. Children cross the street. Merchants offer discounts preemptively. You have never understood why people are nervous around you.
Accidentally Intimidating.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Unintentionally intimidating appearance. NPCs react with caution. The character has no idea why.

Blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
Blacksmith.description: You work metal at the forge: weapons, armor, and the endless repairs Axel's adventurers need after breaking their gear on giant toads. A good smith never wants for work.
Blacksmith.traitNarrativeEffects: PROFESSION: Blacksmith. Forges and repairs weapons and armor. Judges people by how they maintain their gear.

Alchemist.name: Alchemist
Alchemist.description: You brew potions and process reagents, mixing chemistry and magic in roughly equal measure. Your successes heal. Your failures smell terrible and occasionally explode.
Alchemist.traitNarrativeEffects: PROFESSION: Alchemist. Brews potions and processes reagents. Their workspace has a distinctive aroma.

Enchanter.name: Enchanter
Enchanter.description: You weave magical effects into items: sharpness into blades, warmth into cloaks, and the occasional accidental curse. Enchanting demands precision and a tolerance for magic that has opinions of its own.
Enchanter.traitNarrativeEffects: PROFESSION: Enchanter. Imbues items with magical properties. Their work glows; their mistakes glow brighter.

Cook.name: Cook
Cook.description: You turn monster drops and foraged ingredients into meals that heal, buff, and remind adventurers that life is worth living. Battle cooking is a genuine discipline in Belzerg.
Cook.traitNarrativeEffects: PROFESSION: Cook. Prepares meals with practical effects. Carries spices everywhere and has opinions about tavern food.

Fisher.name: Fisher
Fisher.description: You fish. In a world of explosions and demon kings, you sit by water with a rod and wait. It is the most peaceful profession in Belzerg and, thanks to what lurks in Riverhead Lake, occasionally the most profitable.
Fisher.traitNarrativeEffects: PROFESSION: Fisher. Fishes for food and profit. Knows every body of water in the region.

Herbalist.name: Herbalist
Herbalist.description: You gather, identify, and process plants and fungi from Belzerg's wilderness. Your knowledge of what heals, what poisons, and what bites back is encyclopedic. Alchemists depend on your supply.
Herbalist.traitNarrativeEffects: PROFESSION: Herbalist. Identifies and gathers botanical ingredients. Knows every plant by sight and smell.

Tailor.name: Tailor
Tailor.description: You make and repair clothing, robes, and fabric armor. In the Crimson Demon Village tailors are artists; in Axel you are the person who patches what the toads chewed. Both are honest work.
Tailor.traitNarrativeEffects: PROFESSION: Tailor. Crafts and repairs cloth goods. Notices what everyone is wearing and judges it quietly.

Treasure Hunter.name: Treasure Hunter
Treasure Hunter.description: You find, appraise, and liberate valuables from places they should not be: dungeons, ruins, and the occasional clearance bin at Wiz's shop. Your eye for value is sharp and your ethics are flexible.
Treasure Hunter.traitNarrativeEffects: PROFESSION: Treasure Hunter. Finds and appraises valuables. Has a generous definition of 'abandoned property.'

Monster Researcher.name: Monster Researcher
