Monster Researcher.description: You study monsters: their behavior, weaknesses, habitats, and how they taste when cooked (for science). The guild pays for field reports. Alchemists pay for samples. The monsters do not consent.
Monster Researcher.traitNarrativeEffects: PROFESSION: Monster Researcher. Studies monster ecology. Carries a field journal adventurers find surprisingly useful.

No Profession.name: No Profession
No Profession.description: You have no trade beyond adventuring. You kill things for money and hope the loot covers the bar tab. This is the most common career path in Axel and it shows.
No Profession.traitNarrativeEffects: PROFESSION: None. A full-time adventurer with no crafting specialization. Buys what they need, breaks what they have.

Blessing of Fortune.name: Blessing of Fortune
abilities: Goddess's Favor
Blessing of Fortune.description: Eris, goddess of luck, has taken a passing interest in you. Small coincidences tend to break your way.
Blessing of Fortune.traitNarrativeEffects: Minor luck bends slightly in the character's favor at opportune moments.

Blessing of the Water Goddess.name: Blessing of the Water Goddess
abilities: Divine Purification Echo
Blessing of the Water Goddess.description: Aqua's divine essence has rubbed off on you, whether you wanted it or not. Water is a little kinder to you now.
Blessing of the Water Goddess.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has a faint affinity for water and purification effects.

Touched by Providence.name: Touched by Providence
Touched by Providence.description: Something watches over you. Nobody knows what. Its interventions are rare, timely, and never explained.
Touched by Providence.traitNarrativeEffects: Rare, well-timed strokes of good fortune protect the character.

Sacred Resilience.name: Sacred Resilience
Sacred Resilience.description: A trace of divine protection strengthens your body against dark and unholy forces.
Sacred Resilience.traitNarrativeEffects: The character resists dark magic and undead effects slightly better.

Battle Instinct.name: Battle Instinct
Battle Instinct.description: Countless fights have sharpened your reflexes into something close to precognition. You react before you think.
Battle Instinct.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's combat reflexes are notably sharper.

Iron Constitution.name: Iron Constitution
Iron Constitution.description: Years of bad food, worse luck, and monster attacks have made your body genuinely tough.
Iron Constitution.traitNarrativeEffects: The character shrugs off physical hardship that would fell others.

Warrior's Focus.name: Warrior's Focus
Warrior's Focus.description: You have learned to narrow the world to the fight in front of you, blocking out fear and distraction.
Warrior's Focus.traitNarrativeEffects: The character maintains combat focus under pressure.

Nimble Reflexes.name: Nimble Reflexes
Nimble Reflexes.description: Your body has learned to move out of the way of danger before your mind registers it.
Nimble Reflexes.traitNarrativeEffects: The character dodges and repositions with instinctive speed.

Unbreakable Will.name: Unbreakable Will
abilities: Second Breath
Unbreakable Will.description: You have survived enough despair to develop a stubborn refusal to give up.
Unbreakable Will.traitNarrativeEffects: The character resists fear, despair, and mental effects.

Adrenaline Surge.name: Adrenaline Surge
abilities: Second Breath
Adrenaline Surge.description: In moments of genuine danger, your body floods with desperate energy.
Adrenaline Surge.traitNarrativeEffects: The character gains bursts of energy when threatened.

Mana Wellspring.name: Mana Wellspring
Mana Wellspring.description: Your magical reserves have deepened through practice and stubbornness.
Mana Wellspring.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has expanded mana capacity for spellcasting.

Arcane Insight.name: Arcane Insight
Arcane Insight.description: You understand the flow of magic a little better than you did, seeing patterns others miss.
Arcane Insight.traitNarrativeEffects: The character reads and manipulates magical phenomena more effectively.

Explosive Talent.name: Explosive Talent
abilities: Explosive Enthusiasm
Explosive Talent.description: Your affinity for destructive magic has grown. Things break more spectacularly around you.
Explosive Talent.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's destructive magic hits harder.

Elemental Harmony.name: Elemental Harmony
Elemental Harmony.description: The elements answer your call more readily, their power flowing with less resistance.
Elemental Harmony.traitNarrativeEffects: The character channels elemental magic more smoothly.

Healer's Grace.name: Healer's Grace
Healer's Grace.description: Your restorative magic flows with genuine compassion, mending wounds more effectively, whether it comes from a god or from your own two hands.
Healer's Grace.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's healing magic is more potent.

Silver Tongued.name: Silver Tongued
Silver Tongued.description: You have talked your way out of enough trouble that persuasion comes naturally now.
Silver Tongued.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is more convincing in conversation.

Natural Charm.name: Natural Charm
Natural Charm.description: People warm to you more easily than they should, given everything.
Natural Charm.traitNarrativeEffects: The character makes favorable first impressions.

Intimidating Presence.name: Intimidating Presence
Intimidating Presence.description: You have developed a bearing that makes people think twice before crossing you.
Intimidating Presence.traitNarrativeEffects: The character discourages aggression through presence alone.

Reading People.name: Reading People
Reading People.description: You have learned to see through pleasantries to what people actually want.
Reading People.traitNarrativeEffects: The character perceives others' intentions and moods clearly.

Survivor's Instinct.name: Survivor's Instinct
abilities: Toad Sense
Survivor's Instinct.description: Every near-death experience has taught you something. You have had many.
Survivor's Instinct.traitNarrativeEffects: The character senses and avoids lethal danger.

Escape Artist.name: Escape Artist
abilities: Lucky Escape
Escape Artist.description: You have gotten out of enough impossible situations that fleeing has become an art form.
Escape Artist.traitNarrativeEffects: The character excels at escaping danger and confinement.

Nine Lives.name: Nine Lives
Nine Lives.description: Death keeps missing you by inches. You have stopped questioning it and started relying on it.
Nine Lives.traitNarrativeEffects: The character endures fatal situations through sheer improbability.

Cockroach Resilience.name: Cockroach Resilience
Cockroach Resilience.description: Like the humble cockroach, you simply cannot be gotten rid of. It is your best quality.
Cockroach Resilience.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is remarkably difficult to permanently incapacitate.

Merchant's Eye.name: Merchant's Eye
abilities: Merchant's Instinct
Merchant's Eye.description: You have developed an instinct for value, spotting a good deal or a rip-off at a glance.
Merchant's Eye.traitNarrativeEffects: The character appraises worth and negotiates prices well.

Skilled Hands.name: Skilled Hands
Skilled Hands.description: Your hands have grown clever with craft and creation, whether forge, workbench, or kitchen.
Skilled Hands.traitNarrativeEffects: The character crafts and repairs with improved skill.

Frugal Genius.name: Frugal Genius
Frugal Genius.description: Constant poverty has made you brilliant at stretching every coin, resource, and scrap.
Frugal Genius.traitNarrativeEffects: The character makes resources last far beyond reason.

Wilderness Wisdom.name: Wilderness Wisdom
Wilderness Wisdom.description: The wild has stopped trying to kill you quite so hard. You know its rhythms now.
Wilderness Wisdom.traitNarrativeEffects: The character thrives in wilderness environments.

Green Thumb.name: Green Thumb
Green Thumb.description: Plants, herbs, and growing things respond to your care with unusual vigor.
Green Thumb.traitNarrativeEffects: The character excels at cultivation and gathering.

Quick Study.name: Quick Study
Quick Study.description: You pick up new skills faster than you have any right to, absorbing lessons at a glance.
Quick Study.traitNarrativeEffects: The character learns and adapts quickly.

Keen Senses.name: Keen Senses
Keen Senses.description: Your senses have sharpened to catch details others walk right past.
Keen Senses.traitNarrativeEffects: The character notices hidden and subtle things.

Steady Nerves.name: Steady Nerves
Steady Nerves.description: You have seen enough chaos that very little rattles you anymore. Waiters, bar fights, and dragons all receive the same mild expression.
Steady Nerves.traitNarrativeEffects: The character stays calm under pressure.

Light Sleeper.name: Light Sleeper
abilities: Toad Sense
Light Sleeper.description: Too many ambushes have taught you to wake at the smallest wrong sound.
Light Sleeper.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is hard to catch off guard while resting.

Tireless Traveler.name: Tireless Traveler
Tireless Traveler.description: The road no longer wears you down the way it used to. You can go far without flagging.
Tireless Traveler.traitNarrativeEffects: The character travels long distances without fatigue.

Comedic Timing.name: Comedic Timing
Comedic Timing.description: Your sense of exactly when to speak, act, or duck has become supernaturally precise.
Comedic Timing.traitNarrativeEffects: The character acts at exactly the right (or funniest) moment.

Chivalrous Spirit.name: Chivalrous Spirit
abilities: Party Spirit
Chivalrous Spirit.description: A genuine streak of heroism has taken root in you, whether you admit it or not.
Chivalrous Spirit.traitNarrativeEffects: The character acts with courage that inspires allies.

Trickster's Cunning.name: Trickster's Cunning
Trickster's Cunning.description: You have mastered the KonoSuba art of winning through cleverness rather than strength.
Trickster's Cunning.traitNarrativeEffects: The character excels at tricks, feints, and unconventional solutions.

Beloved by Beasts.name: Beloved by Beasts
Beloved by Beasts.description: Animals and monsters alike seem oddly fond of you, which is occasionally useful and often inconvenient.
Beloved by Beasts.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has an unusual rapport with creatures.

Divine Endurance.name: Divine Endurance
abilities: Second Breath
Divine Endurance.description: Some fragment of divine stamina keeps you going long after you should have collapsed.
Divine Endurance.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has exceptional physical and magical endurance.

Fated Encounter.name: Fated Encounter
Fated Encounter.description: The threads of fate seem to tangle around you, drawing you into significant meetings and events.
Fated Encounter.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is drawn into meaningful encounters and opportunities.

Explosive Finale.name: Explosive Finale
abilities: Explosive Enthusiasm
Explosive Finale.description: When you commit to something dramatic, the world seems to cooperate with the spectacle.
Explosive Finale.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's decisive moments land with extra impact.

Goddess's Pity.name: Goddess's Pity
abilities: Goddess's Favor
Goddess's Pity.description: A goddess somewhere feels sorry enough for you to nudge fate in your favor now and then. It is not flattering, but it works.
Goddess's Pity.traitNarrativeEffects: Divine sympathy occasionally intervenes on the character's behalf.

Beast-Kin.name: Beast-Kin
Beast-Kin.description: A demi-human of the stronger sort: prominent animal traits, heightened physical power, and senses that make you the first to know when something is wrong. Belzerg treats beast-kin as ordinary residents with an unusual profile, which mostly works until someone needs a chair that accommodates a tail.
Beast-Kin.traitNarrativeEffects: RACE: Beast-Kin. Visible animal traits (ears, tail), enhanced strength and senses. Notices things others miss. Occasional practical friction with human-built furniture and doorways.

Reincarnated Twice.name: Reincarnated Twice
Reincarnated Twice.description: Something went wrong with the paperwork. You have died and been sent to Belzerg twice, which the goddesses insist is not possible and the evidence insists it is. You remember two previous lives, neither in full, and you have a strong suspicion that somebody upstairs is avoiding your letters.
Reincarnated Twice.traitNarrativeEffects: RACE: Otherworlder, twice-reincarnated. Fragmented memories of two prior lives. A divine clerical error nobody will admit to. Occasionally recalls something useful at random.

Ranger.name: Ranger
abilities: Snipe
Ranger.description: A wilderness specialist who tracks, survives, and shoots. Rangers work the spaces between settlements where the guild's maps go vague, and they are the reason many expeditions come back at all. Unglamorous, competent, and quietly indispensable.
Ranger.traitNarrativeEffects: CLASS: Ranger. Tracking, survival, and ranged combat. Comfortable in wilderness, uncomfortable in cities. Reads terrain like other people read notice boards.

Arch-Priest.name: Arch-Priest
abilities: Heal
Arch-Priest.description: An advanced divine class with genuine command of healing, purification, and resurrection. Arch-priests are strategically vital in a kingdom fighting undead, and are treated with a respect that occasionally survives contact with their personality.
Arch-Priest.traitNarrativeEffects: CLASS: Arch-Priest. Powerful divine magic: healing, purification, resurrection. Devastating against undead. Enormous value to a party, and knows it.

Duelist.name: Duelist
Duelist.description: A precision fighter who wins through footwork, timing, and reading an opponent rather than raw force. Duelists thrive one-on-one and struggle in a brawl, which makes them spectacular in an arena and a liability in a dungeon corridor.
Duelist.traitNarrativeEffects: CLASS: Duelist. Precise single-target swordwork, footwork, and counters. Excellent in duels, poor when surrounded. Prone to treating fights as conversations.

Scholar.name: Scholar
Scholar.description: A researcher who solves problems with knowledge rather than force: monster ecology, magical theory, historical precedent, and the specific document that makes a lawsuit go away. Scholars are underestimated right up until the moment their information saves the party.
Scholar.traitNarrativeEffects: CLASS: Scholar. Knowledge-based problem solving, research, and identification. Poor in a fight, invaluable before and after one. Takes notes constantly.

Nature Affinity.name: Nature Affinity
Nature Affinity.description: Your magic runs through growing things: plants, weather, and the slow patient processes of the living world. It is less flashy than fire and considerably more useful when a party is starving three days from the nearest road.
Nature Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY: Nature. Plant growth, weather sense, and living-world magic. Practical rather than spectacular. Thrives outdoors, weakens in dead places.

Illusion Affinity.name: Illusion Affinity
Illusion Affinity.description: Your talent lies in what people perceive rather than what is there: false images, misheard sounds, and the confident lie made visible. Illusion wins fights that never happen, and fails embarrassingly against anyone who simply refuses to believe you.
Illusion Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY: Illusion. Deceptive images and sounds. Excellent for escape, infiltration, and distraction. Collapses against skeptics and against anything without eyes.

Guild Orphan.name: Guild Orphan
Guild Orphan.description: You grew up in and around a guild hall, raised collectively by receptionists, adventurers, and whoever was between quests. You know the paperwork, the politics, and every dirty trick in the trade before you ever registered. What you lack is anyone who is specifically yours.
Guild Orphan.traitNarrativeEffects: ORIGIN: Guild Orphan. Raised inside the adventuring world. Knows guild procedure and gossip intimately. Well-liked by staff, quietly rootless.

Failed Hero.name: Failed Hero
Failed Hero.description: You were somebody's chosen one once. A prophecy, a summons, a sword in a stone, something. It did not work out, the world moved on, and you are still here with the training and none of the destiny. It is a better foundation for adventuring than it sounds.
Failed Hero.traitNarrativeEffects: ORIGIN: Failed Hero. Trained for a destiny that did not materialize. Competent, disillusioned, and quietly relieved. Reacts badly to prophecy talk.

Fight Dirty.name: Fight Dirty
Fight Dirty.description: Honor is a luxury for people who can afford to lose. You throw sand, aim low, use the terrain, and end fights before they become fights. It works, it is deeply unpopular, and you have never once regretted it.
Fight Dirty.traitNarrativeEffects: COMBAT PHILOSOPHY: Fights dirty. Sand, low blows, terrain tricks, ambushes. Effective and widely resented. Considers a fair fight a tactical failure.

Protect the Party.name: Protect the Party
Protect the Party.description: Your instinct in any fight is to put yourself between danger and the people behind you. It is not strategy, it is reflex, and it has cost you more injuries than it has prevented. The party has stopped arguing about it.
Protect the Party.traitNarrativeEffects: COMBAT PHILOSOPHY: Protective. Instinctively shields allies, draws danger onto themselves. Takes hits meant for others. Argues about it afterward and does it again.

Relentlessly Cheerful.name: Relentlessly Cheerful
Relentlessly Cheerful.description: You are upbeat in a way that survives contact with reality, which people find either inspiring or unbearable with no middle ground. Bad news bounces off you. This is a genuine asset in a kingdom this miserable and a genuine problem in a library.
Relentlessly Cheerful.traitNarrativeEffects: SOCIAL PERSONA: Relentlessly cheerful. Upbeat regardless of circumstances. Inspiring or exhausting depending on the listener. Difficult to demoralize.

Deadpan Operator.name: Deadpan Operator
Deadpan Operator.description: You deliver everything at the same flat register: threats, jokes, condolences, and orders. People cannot read you, which unsettles them productively. You find this useful and have stopped trying to explain that you are, in fact, having a good time.
Deadpan Operator.traitNarrativeEffects: SOCIAL PERSONA: Deadpan. Flat affect, dry delivery, unreadable. Unsettles opponents and confuses allies. Is enjoying themselves more than anyone realizes.

Compulsive Bargainer.name: Compulsive Bargainer
Compulsive Bargainer.description: You cannot let a price stand. Not at a market stall, not at an inn, not when negotiating with a devil for your immortal soul. It has saved you money and nearly killed you, in roughly that order of frequency.
Compulsive Bargainer.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: Compulsively haggles over every price, including in situations where haggling is dangerous or absurd. Cannot accept a first offer. Has negotiated with things that should not be negotiated with.

Terminal Curiosity.name: Terminal Curiosity
Terminal Curiosity.description: You have to know. What is behind the door, what the inscription says, what happens if you touch it. Your survival to this point is a statistical anomaly and you are aware of that and it has changed nothing.
Terminal Curiosity.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: Cannot leave a mystery alone. Opens the door, reads the inscription, touches the artifact. Has triggered more traps than any three adventurers combined and learned more than any of them too.

Known Debtor.name: Known Debtor
Known Debtor.description: Your name appears in more ledgers than you would like. Innkeepers ask for coin up front, merchants quote you higher, and at least two people in every town are looking for you. None of it is criminal. All of it is inconvenient.
Known Debtor.traitNarrativeEffects: REPUTATION: Known debtor. Owes money across multiple towns. Charged up front, quoted high, occasionally pursued. Not a criminal, just permanently behind.

Quietly Respected.name: Quietly Respected
Quietly Respected.description: You have no fame and a solid reputation among the people who matter: guild staff, working craftsmen, and veterans. Nobody sings about you. Everybody who has worked with you would work with you again, which is worth considerably more.
Quietly Respected.traitNarrativeEffects: REPUTATION: Quietly respected. No fame, strong standing with professionals and veterans. Gets better postings and honest prices without ever being famous.

Names Their Weapons.name: Names Their Weapons
Names Their Weapons.description: You give every weapon you own a grand dramatic name and use it in conversation without irony. Other people's reactions have never once discouraged you.
Names Their Weapons.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Names weapons dramatically and uses the names aloud. Deeply committed. Visibly hurt when others do not use the name.

Hoards Receipts.name: Hoards Receipts
Hoards Receipts.description: You keep every receipt, contract, and written agreement you have ever been given, filed by date. It looks obsessive right up until a property damage claim goes to arbitration.
Hoards Receipts.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Keeps meticulous records of every transaction. Appears obsessive. Wins every arbitration.

Talks to Monsters.name: Talks to Monsters
Talks to Monsters.description: You address monsters conversationally before, during, and after fighting them. It has never worked. You have not stopped.
Talks to Monsters.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Talks to monsters as though they might reply. Occasionally one does, which encourages the behavior enormously.

Aggressively Generous.name: Aggressively Generous
Aggressively Generous.description: You buy the round, cover the tab, and hand over your last coin to anyone with a sad story. Your finances reflect this. You do not intend to change.
Aggressively Generous.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Compulsively generous with money they do not have. Perpetually broke through kindness rather than vice.

Superstitious.name: Superstitious
Superstitious.description: You have a ritual for everything: before a fight, after a kill, when entering a dungeon. You know it does nothing. You will not be skipping it.
Superstitious.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Performs personal rituals for luck. Aware they are meaningless. Will not proceed without them.

Pixie Cut.name: Pixie Cut
Pixie Cut.description: A very short, feathered pixie cut that frames the face and takes no maintenance at all.
Pixie Cut.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): A very short, feathered pixie cut that frames the face and takes no maintenance at all. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Buzz Cut.name: Buzz Cut
Buzz Cut.description: Cropped to the scalp. Practical, uncompromising, and impossible to grab in a fight.
Buzz Cut.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Cropped to the scalp. Practical, uncompromising, and impossible to grab in a fight. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Shaggy Layers.name: Shaggy Layers
Shaggy Layers.description: Choppy shoulder-brushing layers that look deliberately careless and mostly are.
Shaggy Layers.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Choppy shoulder-brushing layers that look deliberately careless and mostly are. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Bowl Cut.name: Bowl Cut
Bowl Cut.description: A blunt, even bowl cut. Unfashionable, unmistakable, and worn with total conviction.
Bowl Cut.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): A blunt, even bowl cut. Unfashionable, unmistakable, and worn with total conviction. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Curtained Bangs.name: Curtained Bangs
Curtained Bangs.description: Hair parted in the center and falling in soft curtains either side of the face. Excellent for avoiding eye contact with creditors.
Curtained Bangs.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Hair parted in the center and falling in soft curtains either side of the face. Excellent for avoiding eye contact with creditors. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Waist-Length Hair.name: Waist-Length Hair
Waist-Length Hair.description: Hair falling all the way to the waist, kept in careful condition and a genuine time commitment.
Waist-Length Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Hair falling all the way to the waist, kept in careful condition and a genuine time commitment. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Loose Curls.name: Loose Curls
Loose Curls.description: Soft loose curls with plenty of volume, catching the light with every movement.
Loose Curls.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Soft loose curls with plenty of volume, catching the light with every movement. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Ringlet Curls.name: Ringlet Curls
Ringlet Curls.description: Tight defined ringlets, bouncy and formal, favored at court and at festivals.
Ringlet Curls.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Tight defined ringlets, bouncy and formal, favored at court and at festivals. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Feathered Layers.name: Feathered Layers
Feathered Layers.description: Long hair cut into sweeping feathered layers that move as a unit. Moves dramatically in wind, which Belzerg supplies free of charge.
Feathered Layers.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Long hair cut into sweeping feathered layers that move as a unit. Moves dramatically in wind, which Belzerg supplies free of charge. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Straight with Sidelocks.name: Straight with Sidelocks
Straight with Sidelocks.description: Long straight hair with two deliberate sidelocks framing the face, traditional and precise.
Straight with Sidelocks.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Long straight hair with two deliberate sidelocks framing the face, traditional and precise. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Windswept.name: Windswept
Windswept.description: Long hair permanently arranged as though caught mid-gust. Achieved deliberately, denied constantly.
Windswept.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Long hair permanently arranged as though caught mid-gust. Achieved deliberately, denied constantly. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Twin Braids.name: Twin Braids
Twin Braids.description: Two long braids hanging either side, practical for travel and quietly charming.
Twin Braids.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Two long braids hanging either side, practical for travel and quietly charming. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Crown Braid.name: Crown Braid
Crown Braid.description: A braid wound around the head like a coronet. Formal, elegant, and takes an hour.
Crown Braid.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): A braid wound around the head like a coronet. Formal, elegant, and takes an hour. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Half-Up Tie.name: Half-Up Tie
Half-Up Tie.description: The top half gathered and tied, the rest left loose. The compromise everyone eventually reaches.
Half-Up Tie.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): The top half gathered and tied, the rest left loose. The compromise everyone eventually reaches. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Messy Bun.name: Messy Bun
Messy Bun.description: Hair twisted up and pinned with whatever was to hand. Deliberately imperfect.
Messy Bun.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Hair twisted up and pinned with whatever was to hand. Deliberately imperfect. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Topknot.name: Topknot
Topknot.description: Hair gathered high into a tight topknot. Martial, disciplined, and easy to maintain on the road.
Topknot.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Hair gathered high into a tight topknot. Martial, disciplined, and easy to maintain on the road. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Space Buns.name: Space Buns
Space Buns.description: Two rounded buns set high on the head, cheerful and immediately memorable.
Space Buns.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Two rounded buns set high on the head, cheerful and immediately memorable. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Fishtail Braid.name: Fishtail Braid
Fishtail Braid.description: A single intricate fishtail braid over one shoulder, showing off both patience and skill.
Fishtail Braid.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): A single intricate fishtail braid over one shoulder, showing off both patience and skill. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Ahoge (Stray Cowlick).name: Ahoge (Stray Cowlick)
Ahoge (Stray Cowlick).description: A single stubborn strand standing straight up from the crown, immune to all correction.
Ahoge (Stray Cowlick).traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): A single stubborn strand standing straight up from the crown, immune to all correction. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Two-Tone Dyed.name: Two-Tone Dyed
Two-Tone Dyed.description: Hair deliberately dyed in two contrasting colors, split or streaked. A statement and an expense.
Two-Tone Dyed.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Hair deliberately dyed in two contrasting colors, split or streaked. A statement and an expense. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Asymmetric Cut.name: Asymmetric Cut
Asymmetric Cut.description: Cut dramatically shorter on one side than the other. Bold, modern, and slightly aggressive.
Asymmetric Cut.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Cut dramatically shorter on one side than the other. Bold, modern, and slightly aggressive. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Floor-Length Hair.name: Floor-Length Hair
Floor-Length Hair.description: Hair grown to an impractical, magnificent, floor-brushing length. Purely a flex.
Floor-Length Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Style): Hair grown to an impractical, magnificent, floor-brushing length. Purely a flex. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Ash Brown Hair.name: Ash Brown Hair
Ash Brown Hair.description: Cool-toned ash brown, understated and common among Belzerg's townsfolk.
Ash Brown Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Cool-toned ash brown, understated and common among Belzerg's townsfolk. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Auburn Hair.name: Auburn Hair
Auburn Hair.description: Deep reddish-brown auburn that turns warm copper in firelight and makes people guess your heritage incorrectly at least twice a day.
Auburn Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Deep reddish-brown auburn that turns warm copper in firelight and makes people guess your heritage incorrectly at least twice a day. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Sandy Blonde Hair.name: Sandy Blonde Hair
Sandy Blonde Hair.description: Muted sandy blonde, the kind the sun bleaches lighter every season until you stop remembering what the original color was.
Sandy Blonde Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Muted sandy blonde, the kind the sun bleaches lighter every season until you stop remembering what the original color was. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Platinum Blonde Hair.name: Platinum Blonde Hair
Platinum Blonde Hair.description: Very pale, almost white blonde. Rare enough to be noticed, natural enough to be believed.
Platinum Blonde Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Very pale, almost white blonde. Rare enough to be noticed, natural enough to be believed. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Jet Black with Blue Sheen.name: Jet Black with Blue Sheen
Jet Black with Blue Sheen.description: Black so dark it throws a blue sheen in direct light. Common among Crimson Demons.
Jet Black with Blue Sheen.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Black so dark it throws a blue sheen in direct light. Common among Crimson Demons. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Grey Hair.name: Grey Hair
Grey Hair.description: Grey from age, stress, or something that happened once and is not discussed.
Grey Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Grey from age, stress, or something that happened once and is not discussed. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Crimson Hair.name: Crimson Hair
Crimson Hair.description: Deep true crimson, closer to blood than to copper. Impossible to mistake for natural red.
Crimson Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Deep true crimson, closer to blood than to copper. Impossible to mistake for natural red. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Lavender Hair.name: Lavender Hair
Lavender Hair.description: Soft pale lavender, gentle and unmistakably magical in origin. People assume you know healing magic and hand you their injured friends.
Lavender Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Soft pale lavender, gentle and unmistakably magical in origin. People assume you know healing magic and hand you their injured friends. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Mint Green Hair.name: Mint Green Hair
Mint Green Hair.description: Pale mint green, cool and uncommon, the sort of shade that starts conversations.
Mint Green Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Pale mint green, cool and uncommon, the sort of shade that starts conversations. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Teal Hair.name: Teal Hair
Teal Hair.description: Deep blue-green teal, vivid and striking against most skin tones. Sailors consider it lucky. Sailors consider many things lucky.
Teal Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Deep blue-green teal, vivid and striking against most skin tones. Sailors consider it lucky. Sailors consider many things lucky. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Orange Hair.name: Orange Hair
Orange Hair.description: Bright copper-orange, energetic and impossible to lose in a crowd. Guild receptionists remember your name on the first try, for better or worse.
Orange Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Bright copper-orange, energetic and impossible to lose in a crowd. Guild receptionists remember your name on the first try, for better or worse. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Gradient Hair.name: Gradient Hair
Gradient Hair.description: Hair that shifts color from root to tip, whether by dye, heritage, or ambient magic.
Gradient Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): Hair that shifts color from root to tip, whether by dye, heritage, or ambient magic. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Streaked Hair.name: Streaked Hair
Streaked Hair.description: A single contrasting streak through otherwise ordinary hair. Deliberate or not, people ask.
Streaked Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Hair Color): A single contrasting streak through otherwise ordinary hair. Deliberate or not, people ask. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Hazel Eyes.name: Hazel Eyes
Hazel Eyes.description: Shifting hazel that reads brown or green depending on the light and the mood.
Hazel Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Shifting hazel that reads brown or green depending on the light and the mood. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Light Brown Eyes.name: Light Brown Eyes
Light Brown Eyes.description: Warm light brown, open and easy to trust, the sort of eyes that make shopkeepers give you the honest price without being asked.
Light Brown Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Warm light brown, open and easy to trust, the sort of eyes that make shopkeepers give you the honest price without being asked. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Steel Blue Eyes.name: Steel Blue Eyes
Steel Blue Eyes.description: Cool steel blue, sharp and a little distant, the gaze of someone who has already decided what they think and is waiting for you to catch up.
Steel Blue Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Cool steel blue, sharp and a little distant, the gaze of someone who has already decided what they think and is waiting for you to catch up. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Olive Green Eyes.name: Olive Green Eyes
Olive Green Eyes.description: Muted olive green, calm and observant, the kind of eyes that notice the exit before they notice the room.
Olive Green Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Muted olive green, calm and observant, the kind of eyes that notice the exit before they notice the room. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Black Eyes.name: Black Eyes
Black Eyes.description: Eyes dark enough that the pupil is invisible. Gives away nothing.
Black Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Eyes dark enough that the pupil is invisible. Gives away nothing. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Rose Eyes.name: Rose Eyes
Rose Eyes.description: Soft rose-pink eyes, rare enough that strangers stare and polite enough in color that they get away with it.
Rose Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Soft rose-pink eyes, rare enough that strangers stare and polite enough in color that they get away with it. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Copper Eyes.name: Copper Eyes
Copper Eyes.description: Warm metallic copper that catches light like a coin in a fountain, bright and a little unsettling up close.
Copper Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Warm metallic copper that catches light like a coin in a fountain, bright and a little unsettling up close. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Lilac Eyes.name: Lilac Eyes
Lilac Eyes.description: Pale lilac, faintly luminous in low light, the color people describe as 'otherworldly' when they are being kind and 'unnerving' when they are not.
Lilac Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Pale lilac, faintly luminous in low light, the color people describe as 'otherworldly' when they are being kind and 'unnerving' when they are not. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Sea Green Eyes.name: Sea Green Eyes
Sea Green Eyes.description: Clear sea green, shifting between blue and green depending on the light, the weather, and possibly your mood.
Sea Green Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Clear sea green, shifting between blue and green depending on the light, the weather, and possibly your mood. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Ice Blue Eyes.name: Ice Blue Eyes
Ice Blue Eyes.description: Very pale ice blue, striking and cold to meet, the sort of eyes that end conversations and start rumors.
Ice Blue Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Very pale ice blue, striking and cold to meet, the sort of eyes that end conversations and start rumors. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Slit Pupils.name: Slit Pupils
Slit Pupils.description: Vertical slit pupils, marking demonic, draconic, or beast-kin heritage. Unsettling in low light.
Slit Pupils.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Vertical slit pupils, marking demonic, draconic, or beast-kin heritage. Unsettling in low light. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Ringed Irises.name: Ringed Irises
Ringed Irises.description: Irises banded with a contrasting ring, a documented sign of latent magical talent.
Ringed Irises.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Irises banded with a contrasting ring, a documented sign of latent magical talent. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Void Black Eyes.name: Void Black Eyes
Void Black Eyes.description: Eyes entirely black from lid to lid, with no visible white. The mark of something not fully mortal.
Void Black Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Eyes entirely black from lid to lid, with no visible white. The mark of something not fully mortal. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Faintly Luminous Eyes.name: Faintly Luminous Eyes
Faintly Luminous Eyes.description: Eyes that give off the faintest light in darkness. Harmless, permanent, and hard to explain.
Faintly Luminous Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Eyes): Eyes that give off the faintest light in darkness. Harmless, permanent, and hard to explain. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Studded Leather Kit.name: Studded Leather Kit
Studded Leather Kit.description: Reinforced studded leather over practical layers. The workhorse outfit of the mid-rank adventurer.
Studded Leather Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): Reinforced studded leather over practical layers. The workhorse outfit of the mid-rank adventurer. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Ranger's Cloak and Greens.name: Ranger's Cloak and Greens
Ranger's Cloak and Greens.description: Muted greens and browns under a weatherproof cloak, cut for wilderness travel and staying unseen.
Ranger's Cloak and Greens.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): Muted greens and browns under a weatherproof cloak, cut for wilderness travel and staying unseen. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Scout's Light Harness.name: Scout's Light Harness
Scout's Light Harness.description: Minimal straps, pouches, and soft boots. Everything secured, nothing that rattles.
Scout's Light Harness.traitNarrativeEffects: APPEARANCE (Outfit): Minimal straps, pouches, and soft boots. Everything secured, nothing that rattles. Purely visual; no stats or gameplay effect.

Chainmail Hauberk.name: Chainmail Hauberk

Elf.name: Elf
Elf.description: One of the long-lived forest peoples, rare enough in Belzerg that innkeepers still get the pillow arrangements wrong. Elves are graceful, patient, and quietly appalled by almost everything humans do, which in Belzerg gives them a full-time hobby. You have decades of perspective and it has prepared you for none of this.
Elf.traitNarrativeEffects: RACE: Elf. Describe with pointed ears, fine features, and unhurried grace. The character reacts to Belzerg's chaos with weary, centuries-deep patience. Locals stare politely. Innkeepers panic about protocol.

Dwarf.name: Dwarf
Dwarf.description: One of the mountain craft-folk, short, broad, and constitutionally incapable of walking past shoddy workmanship without commentary. Dwarves in Belzerg cluster around the foothill quarries and good taverns, in that order or the other one. Your beard, braided or absent, is a personal matter and you will thank people to treat it as such.
Dwarf.traitNarrativeEffects: RACE: Dwarf. Describe as short, broad, and durable. The character audits craftsmanship reflexively, respects honest work, and has strong opinions about stone, metal, and ale. Insults to any of the three are remembered.

Dhampir.name: Dhampir
Dhampir.description: Half-vampire: sun-tolerant, garlic-ambivalent, and permanently explaining yourself. You get the good parts, night vision, sharp senses, a certain drama, without the fatal allergies, but the Axis Cult does not do nuance and has attempted to purify you on sight an average of twice per city. You carry paperwork now. It does not help.
Dhampir.traitNarrativeEffects: RACE: Dhampir. Describe with pale coloring, sharp canines, and faintly luminous eyes. The character is living, harmless, and constantly mistaken for a threat by zealots. Axis Cultists attempt purification on sight; the purification tickles. Play the bureaucratic weariness.

Divine Clerical Error.name: Divine Clerical Error
Divine Clerical Error.description: You were reincarnated wrong. The paperwork said one thing, the divine intake desk read another, and you arrived in Belzerg as something the goddesses' help desk describes, in writing, as 'within acceptable tolerances.' You receive an apology coupon each solstice. The coupons are not redeemable anywhere. You have kept every one.
Divine Clerical Error.traitNarrativeEffects: RACE: Divine Clerical Error. The character's body, species presentation, or general existence carries one obvious wrongness that heaven refuses to fix and cannot explain. Divine agents get visibly awkward around them. The apology coupons arrive on schedule and are worthless.

Spearman.name: Spearman
Spearman.description: The guild's most sensible martial class: reach, formation discipline, and a weapon that doubles as a walking stick, a tent pole, and a means of retrieving things from high shelves. Spearmen are beloved by tacticians and mocked by duelists, whom they routinely defeat by standing slightly further away.
Spearman.traitNarrativeEffects: CLASS: Spearman. Fights with reach and positioning, keeps enemies at pole's length, and solves an unreasonable number of non-combat problems with the same spear. Practical to a fault.

Brawler.name: Brawler
Brawler.description: No weapon, no armor, no patience for either. Brawlers fight with fists, elbows, furniture, and momentum, and the guild classifies them, in official paperwork, as 'self-arming.' Cheap to equip, expensive to insure.
Brawler.traitNarrativeEffects: CLASS: Brawler. Unarmed and improvised combat. Grabs, throws, tavern-style haymakers, and creative use of the environment. Property damage clauses apply and are cited often.

Sword Master.name: Sword Master
Sword Master.description: The advanced blade class, all speed and certainty, the one every isekai arrival with a cheat sword picks on day one. A true Sword Master is genuinely formidable: one draw, one line of light, one sheathed blade before the enemy notices. The class attracts prodigies, poseurs, and people with very expensive swords, and the guild charges all three the same dues.
Sword Master.traitNarrativeEffects: CLASS: Sword Master. Advanced swordsmanship: fast draws, clean single strikes, effortless parries. The character's skill is real; whether their gravitas is real depends entirely on them.

Assassin.name: Assassin
Assassin.description: The advanced stealth class, which in Belzerg means less 'silent killer of kings' and more 'person the guild sends when the bounty says do not let it see you first.' Assassins are quiet, efficient, and constantly explaining at parties that it is a certification, not a lifestyle.
Assassin.traitNarrativeEffects: CLASS: Assassin. Stealth, ambush, and precision strikes from concealment. The character defaults to scouting and flanking, and is mildly defensive about the job title in social settings.

Battle Mage.name: Battle Mage
Battle Mage.description: The advanced class for casters who refuse to stand at the back: armored spellwork, blade in one hand, incantation in the other. Battle Mages are respected, effective, and permanently exhausted, because both of their disciplines schedule morning training.
Battle Mage.traitNarrativeEffects: CLASS: Battle Mage. Blends melee and elemental casting in close quarters. Spells are quick and practical rather than grand. The character treats magic as a sidearm and the sword as punctuation.

Sage.name: Sage
Sage.description: The advanced scholar-caster class: broad magic, deep learning, and an insufferable amount of context. Sages know the monster's name, the monster's weakness, and the monster's place in a historical footnote, and will provide all three while the party is already running.
Sage.traitNarrativeEffects: CLASS: Sage. Versatile magic backed by encyclopedic knowledge. The character identifies threats, recalls lore, and lectures. The lectures are accurate and poorly timed.

Licensed Necromancer.name: Licensed Necromancer
abilities: Drain Touch
Licensed Necromancer.description: Yes, it is legal. No, not like that. Belzerg licenses a small number of necromancers under crushing regulation: consent forms for the deceased, monthly audits, and a mandatory two-day ethics seminar with the Eris Church. The license is a laminated card. You will be asked to produce it constantly, including, memorably, by the dead.
Licensed Necromancer.traitNarrativeEffects: CLASS: Licensed Necromancer. Regulated death magic: speaking with the departed, calming restless spirits, and strictly small-scale, fully documented animation. The character produces their license reflexively. Everyone asks. The paperwork jokes write themselves and should.

Master Thief.name: Master Thief
abilities: Steal
Master Thief.description: The advanced larceny class, graduate tier of Steal, lockwork, and exits. Master Thieves in Belzerg trend heroic despite themselves; the famous ones target corrupt nobles and dangerous relics, and the guild maintains a diplomatic fiction of not knowing any of their names. You have opinions about the Chivalrous Thief. Most of them are professional envy.
Master Thief.traitNarrativeEffects: CLASS: Master Thief. Elite theft, infiltration, and escape. The character cases every room by habit, steals with artistry, and follows a personal code they pretend is just branding.

Teleport Affinity.name: Teleport Affinity
Teleport Affinity.description: Your magic bends distance: blinks, marked returns, and the advanced art of being somewhere else when the problem arrives. Teleport specialists are the kingdom's couriers, rescuers, and most punctual cowards.
Teleport Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC: Teleport Affinity. Movement and translocation magic comes naturally. The character marks safe points by habit and vanishes from danger with a signature sound the party learns to resent.

Enchantment Affinity.name: Enchantment Affinity
Enchantment Affinity.description: Your magic improves things: keener edges, lighter packs, boots that do not blister, blades that glow on command. Enchanters are the most employable mages in Belzerg and the least likely to be thanked, because good support magic looks exactly like luck.
Enchantment Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC: Enchantment Affinity. Buffing, warding, and item enhancement come naturally. The character's party performs mysteriously well and credits themselves. The character keeps score privately.

Healing Affinity.name: Healing Affinity
Healing Affinity.description: Your magic mends: wounds close, fevers break, and hangovers, for a modest consideration, vanish. Healers never buy their own drinks in Axel and never get to finish them either, because somebody is always bleeding by last call.
Healing Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC: Healing Affinity. Restorative magic comes naturally. The character is permanently on call in any adventurer social setting and has learned to heal with one hand and hold a tankard with the other.

Drain Affinity.name: Drain Affinity
Drain Affinity.description: Your magic takes: vitality, mana, and the occasional headache, drawn out through a touch. Drain magic has a sinister reputation and a wildly practical everyday application, and its practitioners are equal parts feared, licensed, and asked to fix people's insomnia.
Drain Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC: Drain Affinity. Absorption magic comes naturally. The character can siphon energy with a touch, is politely feared by strangers, and gets asked for the insomnia treatment more than anything combat-related.

Party Trick Affinity.name: Party Trick Affinity
Party Trick Affinity.description: Your magic is astonishing and useless: doves from sleeves, water into slightly better water, fireworks with your own face on them. This is the goddess Aqua's true domain, and her devotees insist that mastering it is a form of worship. Taverns pay in drinks. It does not pay in anything else.
Party Trick Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC: Party Trick Affinity. Genuinely impressive stage magic with no combat value whatsoever. Crowds adore it, employers do not, and Axis Cultists treat the character as touched by the goddess, which helps nothing.

Isekai'd by Mistake.name: Isekai'd by Mistake
Isekai'd by Mistake.description: You were not supposed to die. The divine intake desk was very embarrassed about it, offered you reincarnation with expedited processing as compensation, and misfiled that too. You arrived in Belzerg with modern memories, no gift, and a case number. The case remains open. You check on it. They are aware of you.
Isekai'd by Mistake.traitNarrativeEffects: ORIGIN: Isekai'd by Mistake. Reincarnated through divine clerical failure, with modern-world memories and an ongoing celestial complaints process. Divine figures recognize the case number and wince. Culture shock plus bureaucratic grievance is the comedy engine.

Isekai'd by a Minor God.name: Isekai'd by a Minor God
Isekai'd by a Minor God.description: The big goddesses were busy, so your reincarnation was handled by a minor deity: the god of lost buttons, or off-brand festivals, or the specific smell of rain on cobblestones. They were extremely nice about it. Their divine gift budget was seventeen eris. You are here anyway, and your patron cheers for you with embarrassing sincerity.
Isekai'd by a Minor God.traitNarrativeEffects: ORIGIN: Isekai'd by a Minor God. Reincarnated by an obscure, underfunded deity who takes real if useless interest in the character's career. Occasional tiny blessings arrive: exact change, dry socks, a good parking spot for the cart. Never anything useful in combat.

Farm Kid With Ambitions.name: Farm Kid With Ambitions
Farm Kid With Ambitions.description: You grew up in the breadbasket, third generation behind a plow, and decided the cabbages were a sign: if the vegetables get to fly away, so do you. Your family thinks adventuring is a phase. They pack you preserves. The preserves are, honestly, load-bearing.
Farm Kid With Ambitions.traitNarrativeEffects: ORIGIN: Farm Kid With Ambitions. Rural upbringing, practical skills, and a family that writes often and worries specifically. The character knows crops, weather, and livestock, and receives care packages that the whole party quietly depends on.

Merchant Family Black Sheep.name: Merchant Family Black Sheep
Merchant Family Black Sheep.description: Your family runs a respectable trading concern and you were supposed to be its accountant. You can price a room's contents at a glance, argue tariffs in your sleep, and none of it made you want the life, so you took your ledger skills adventuring. Your family sends quarterly letters asking when this will stop. You invoice them for postage.
Merchant Family Black Sheep.traitNarrativeEffects: ORIGIN: Merchant Family Black Sheep. Raised in commerce, fluent in haggling and contracts, adventuring against the family's wishes. The character reflexively appraises loot, negotiates everything, and dreads the quarterly letter.

Noble's Third Child.name: Noble's Third Child
Noble's Third Child.description: The heir got the title, the second got the marriage, and you got a warm handshake and a letter of introduction. Third children of Belzerg's nobility traditionally enter the church, the army, or, when nobody is watching, the guild. You kept the table manners and the fencing lessons. The allowance did not survive the trip.
Noble's Third Child.traitNarrativeEffects: ORIGIN: Noble's Third Child. Genteel upbringing, real education, no inheritance. The character code-switches between courtly polish and adventurer squalor, and other nobles cannot decide whether to bow or apologize.

Village Hero (Population 47).name: Village Hero (Population 47)
Village Hero (Population 47).description: You are the most famous adventurer your village has ever produced. You are also the only one. Back home there is a plaque, a festival day, and a bench with your name on it, commemorating the time you dealt with the thing in the well. Nobody in Axel has heard of you, your village, or the well. You mention all three anyway.
Village Hero (Population 47).traitNarrativeEffects: ORIGIN: Village Hero. Locally legendary, globally unknown. The character carries genuine small-scale heroism and enormous small-pond confidence. The gap between their reputation at home and their reception everywhere else is the running joke.

Casino Debt Refugee.name: Casino Debt Refugee
Casino Debt Refugee.description: Elroad's tables were very kind to you for one evening and then arithmetic happened. You crossed back into Belzerg with the clothes you stood in, a repayment schedule of baroque cruelty, and a new life plan: earn, hide, and never touch dice again. Two of the three are going well. Letters from a certain credit bureau keep finding you. Their courier is unreasonably good.
Casino Debt Refugee.traitNarrativeEffects: ORIGIN: Casino Debt Refugee. Fled Elroad owing serious money on structured terms. The character budgets obsessively, flinches at official-looking envelopes, and treats gambling implements like live snakes. The debt is real and patient.

Crimson Demon Village Dropout.name: Crimson Demon Village Dropout
Crimson Demon Village Dropout.description: You left the village before graduation, which by clan standards makes you a scandal, and by everyone else's standards makes you the single most employable mage on the market: full Crimson Demon talent, half the theatrics. The self-introduction instinct is still in there. You fight it. On dramatic moonlit nights, you lose.
Crimson Demon Village Dropout.traitNarrativeEffects: ORIGIN: Crimson Demon Village Dropout. Left the clan's academy early, carries the talent without the full ceremonial commitment. The suppressed dramatic instincts erupt under stress: sudden poses, title announcements, one-liners. The character is mortified afterward every time.

Former Lab Assistant.name: Former Lab Assistant
Former Lab Assistant.description: You worked for a wizard. The posting said 'research assistant, some lifting.' The lifting was cursed. After the third containment incident and the affair of the self-aware soup, you resigned by leaving a note pinned to the door with a knife, which in arcane academia is considered proper notice. You know an alarming amount about things nobody should study. You check rooms for summoning circles the way other people check for drafts.
Former Lab Assistant.traitNarrativeEffects: ORIGIN: Former Lab Assistant. Survived employment under a reckless researcher. The character has hands-on experience with dangerous magical phenomena, deep procedural paranoia, and strong opinions about proper containment. Old employer occasionally writes asking them to come back. The letters smoke slightly.

Cheat Skill: Item Box.name: Cheat Skill: Item Box
abilities: Item Box
Cheat Skill: Item Box.description: You chose the classic: an extradimensional inventory, weightless, bottomless within reason, and smug-proof. It cannot store living things, it files everything in an order only it understands, and it has made you the party's pack mule for eternity, because of course it has.
Cheat Skill: Item Box.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE GIFT: Item Box. The character can store and retrieve objects in a personal pocket dimension. The party treats them as free logistics. Retrieval order is unpredictable enough for comedy.

Divine Familiar (Mostly Useless).name: Divine Familiar (Mostly Useless)
abilities: Mostly Useless Familiar
Divine Familiar (Mostly Useless).description: You chose a divine companion animal. What arrived is small, immortal, opinionated, and of no measurable combat value: it critiques your decisions in expressive silence, eats better than you do, and is beloved by every NPC you have ever tried to negotiate with. You have run the numbers. The familiar has better social standing than you.
Divine Familiar (Mostly Useless).traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE GIFT: Divine Familiar. A small immortal creature accompanies the character: useless in battle, devastating in charm, and visibly judgmental. NPCs address it first. It has opinions and everyone but the owner can tell what they are. The familiar is a real creature present in scenes: instantiate it once as its own NPC (type familiar) at story start, with a short pet name of its own and introduced as the divine gift it is, and it persists with the character unless told to stay behind.

Cheat Skill: Minimap.name: Cheat Skill: Minimap
abilities: Minimap
Cheat Skill: Minimap.description: You chose a map that lives in the corner of your vision: position, heading, nearby life signs. It is genuinely excellent and has one flaw the divine help desk calls 'a known issue': it labels things according to its own judgment. Taverns are marked as points of interest. Your problems are marked with small skulls. Some skulls are larger than others. It will not elaborate.
Cheat Skill: Minimap.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE GIFT: Minimap. The character perceives a magical minimap: real navigation value, unsettling auto-labeling. It marks dangers with skulls of varying sizes and refuses to explain its criteria. Never wrong so far, which is worse.

Half-Finished Blessing.name: Half-Finished Blessing
abilities: Half Blessing
Half-Finished Blessing.description: The goddess was called away mid-blessing, and what you have is the first half of something magnificent. Occasionally, under conditions nobody has isolated, the blessing fires: light pours out of you, choirs tune up, and then it stops, like a sneeze that never lands. The completed version would apparently be extraordinary. The goddess keeps meaning to finish it. She is very busy.
Half-Finished Blessing.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE GIFT: Half-Finished Blessing. An incomplete divine working that sporadically almost activates: light, wind, distant choir, then nothing. The near-misses cluster at dramatically perfect moments. If it ever completes, that is a story arc, not a die roll.

Blessing of Spectacular Luck.name: Blessing of Spectacular Luck
abilities: Lucky Escape
Blessing of Spectacular Luck.description: You chose luck, and you got it, in the Eris style: coins found, rain missed, the last room at the inn. The catch is scale. Your luck is magnificent at small things and absent at large ones, so you win every raffle and no lotteries, find every dropped copper and no treasure hoards. The goddess of luck considers this a teaching method. You have not worked out the lesson.
Blessing of Spectacular Luck.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE GIFT: Spectacular Luck. Constant, reliable, comically minor good fortune. Dice, weather, seating, timing: always favorable. Anything life-changing: exempt. The pattern is absolute and the character knows it.

Ominous Sealed Power (Probably Nothing).name: Ominous Sealed Power (Probably Nothing)
abilities: Sealed Power
Ominous Sealed Power (Probably Nothing).description: There is something sealed in your right arm. Probably. It aches before storms, hums near ancient ruins, and once made a devil apologize to you unprompted. The goddess who processed your reincarnation described it, reading from a card, as 'legacy infrastructure, do not engage.' Every Crimson Demon you meet is desperately jealous.
Ominous Sealed Power (Probably Nothing).traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE GIFT: Ominous Sealed Power. An unexplained something sealed in the character's body: dramatic signals, zero confirmed function. Supernatural beings react to it with wariness or envy. Whether it is real power or divine junk storage is deliberately unresolved. Crimson Demons treat the character as royalty.

The Guild Clerk's Favorite.name: The Guild Clerk's Favorite
The Guild Clerk's Favorite.description: Somewhere along the way you did a guild receptionist a real kindness, and the receptionists' network does not forget. Your paperwork processes strangely fast. Good postings get held under the counter an extra hour. You will never see the machinery and you must never mention it.
The Guild Clerk's Favorite.traitNarrativeEffects: REPUTATION: Clerk's Favorite. Guild administrative staff quietly favor the character: faster processing, early word on good contracts, tea while waiting. The favoritism is deniable and vanishes if bragged about.

Banned From One Tavern.name: Banned From One Tavern
Banned From One Tavern.description: There is exactly one establishment in Belzerg where your face is behind the bar on a sketch with a line through it. The incident involved property damage, a misunderstanding about a pet, or a darts game that escalated; you tell it differently each time. Everywhere else serves you happily. The one ban is absolute and its story precedes you.
Banned From One Tavern.traitNarrativeEffects: REPUTATION: Banned From One Tavern. One specific establishment refuses the character service, forever, over an incident that grows in the retelling. Other adventurers know the story in mutually exclusive versions and bring it up constantly.

The Mysterious Stranger (Self-Proclaimed.name: The Mysterious Stranger (Self-Proclaimed)
The Mysterious Stranger (Self-Proclaimed.description: You arrived in town deliberately mysterious: hood up, past unspoken, meaningful silences at the bar. The problem is that Axel processes mystery as a customer service issue. The guild filed you under M. The tavern regulars have a betting pool on your backstory, posted publicly, with odds. Your mystique is regarded, universally, as a hobby.
The Mysterious Stranger (Self-Proclaimed.traitNarrativeEffects: REPUTATION: Self-Proclaimed Mystery. The character cultivates enigma; the town treats it as an endearing quirk. NPCs speculate about their past cheerfully and inaccurately, to their face. The betting pool is real and the character is not allowed to bet.

Axis Cult Signed You Up Once.name: Axis Cult Signed You Up Once
Axis Cult Signed You Up Once.description: Somewhere in Alcanretia's records, your signature exists on a trial membership you do not remember providing. The Cult considers you family. You receive newsletters. Cultists greet you as a sibling in every town, at volume, by name. The cancellation desk knows your case and has been very kind about the backlog.
Axis Cult Signed You Up Once.traitNarrativeEffects: REPUTATION: Axis Trial Member. The Axis Cult's records list the character as one of their own, and every cultist acts on it: warm greetings, newsletters, invitations to events. A greeting is one beat, never an interruption. Cancellation is pending. It has been pending a while.

Locally Famous For One Thing.name: Locally Famous For One Thing
Locally Famous For One Thing.description: You did one memorable thing, once, and it is now your entire public identity. It was probably not even the impressive thing you actually did; fame chose the weird one. Strangers quote it. Children reenact it. You could save the kingdom tomorrow and the toast at your funeral would still open with the thing.
Locally Famous For One Thing.traitNarrativeEffects: REPUTATION: One-Thing Famous. Everyone knows the character for a single incident, chosen by public whim rather than merit. Define the thing in play and never let it die. New accomplishments are absorbed into the old fame, never replacing it.

The Insurance Risk.name: The Insurance Risk
The Insurance Risk.description: Nothing you did was technically your fault, a phrase you have now said to three different assessors. Buildings near you develop problems. Carts lose wheels. The guild's actuarial office has a folder with your name on it and a small painted symbol that clerks pretend is decorative. Your premiums are a topic of regional discussion.
The Insurance Risk.traitNarrativeEffects: REPUTATION: Insurance Risk. The character trails minor disasters that are never provably their doing. Guild staff process their paperwork with tongs. Property owners get nervous. The folder exists and is growing.

Team Tactician.name: Team Tactician
Team Tactician.description: You fight with other people the way a conductor fights with an orchestra. Positions, timing, called targets: your value is the plan, adjusted live, shouted over the noise. Belzerg parties are not famous for following plans. You have adapted by planning for that too.
Team Tactician.traitNarrativeEffects: COMBAT: Team Tactician. The character directs allies mid-fight: callouts, formations, contingencies. Their plans account for their party ignoring the plans. Quietly furious when it works by accident.

Negotiate First.name: Negotiate First
Negotiate First.description: Every fight you talk your way out of is a fight you won at zero cost, and your record is honestly impressive: bandits bought off, monsters redirected, one memorable duel settled by coin toss. Belzerg being Belzerg, the talking fails constantly, but you always try, and the attempts are legend.
Negotiate First.traitNarrativeEffects: COMBAT: Negotiate First. The character opens every hostile encounter with parley: offers, bargains, appeals to self-interest, delivered even to creatures with no language. Sometimes it works, which astonishes everyone. When it fails, they fight fine and slightly offended.

Ambush Predator.name: Ambush Predator
Ambush Predator.description: Fair fights are a planning failure. You favor the opening you prepared: high ground taken an hour early, the choke point, the first strike that ends the argument before it starts. Your party calls it cowardice until it saves them, which is every time.
Ambush Predator.traitNarrativeEffects: COMBAT: Ambush Predator. The character scouts, prepares, and strikes first from advantage. Narrate the setup as craft. Straight fights annoy them on principle.

Endure and Outlast.name: Endure and Outlast
Endure and Outlast.description: You do not win fights so much as survive them harder than the other side. Guard up, feet planted, letting the enemy spend themselves against you like weather against a cliff. It is not glamorous. Cliffs are not glamorous. Cliffs are still there afterward.
Endure and Outlast.traitNarrativeEffects: COMBAT: Endure and Outlast. The character absorbs, weathers, and wins through stamina and stubbornness. Narrate their durability as inevitability. Enemies tire, despair, and make mistakes first.

The Long-Suffering Realist.name: The Long-Suffering Realist
The Long-Suffering Realist.description: Somebody in every party has to be the one who says 'this is a bad idea' before the bad idea, during the bad idea, and at the hearing afterward. It is you. You are never listened to and never wrong, and you have decided that being right constantly is its own lifestyle.
The Long-Suffering Realist.traitNarrativeEffects: SOCIAL: Long-Suffering Realist. The character predicts disasters accurately, is ignored universally, and copes with dry commentary. Their 'I said this would happen' is a catchphrase the party dreads.

The Aggressive Networker.name: The Aggressive Networker
The Aggressive Networker.description: You know a guy. You always know a guy. Every town, every trade, every social stratum: you have a name, a favor owed, or a cousin's address, collected through relentless, cheerful, borderline-alarming friendliness. Your personal ledger of contacts is your true weapon and you maintain it like a blade.
The Aggressive Networker.traitNarrativeEffects: SOCIAL: Aggressive Networker. The character befriends everyone on principle and keeps track. In any location, they plausibly 'know a guy,' subject to comedic reliability. Their contacts are real, numerous, and of wildly uneven quality.

The Professional.name: The Professional
The Professional.description: You treat adventuring as a job, because it is one: contracts read, rates confirmed, receipts filed. In a guild hall full of dreamers, showoffs, and disasters, your competence-first approach makes you deeply exotic. Rookies think you are a legend. Veterans think you are a unicorn. You think everyone should just read the contract.
The Professional.traitNarrativeEffects: SOCIAL: The Professional. The character approaches everything with workmanlike rigor: preparation, punctuality, paperwork. The surrounding chaos makes this hilarious. Their rare unprofessional moments are events.

The Shameless Flirt.name: The Shameless Flirt
The Shameless Flirt.description: You flirt like other people breathe: reflexively, universally, and without any plan for success. Barkeeps, guards, shopkeepers, one memorable lich: all receive the same warm outrageous charm. It is a social style, not a strategy, and everyone eventually realizes you are actually mostly harmless. Mostly.
The Shameless Flirt.traitNarrativeEffects: SOCIAL: Shameless Flirt. The character charms everyone as a default register, PG-13 and playful, all wink and no follow-through. NPCs react on a spectrum from delighted to invoiced. Actual sincerity, when it happens, catches them completely off guard.

The Big Sibling.name: The Big Sibling
The Big Sibling.description: Every party you join, you end up the one holding the coats, the coin purse, and the emotional infrastructure. You check people ate. You learn the rookie's name. You have carried more drunk adventurers to bed than the town watch, and your reward is that everyone brings you their problems, forever, at all hours.
The Big Sibling.traitNarrativeEffects: SOCIAL: Big Sibling. The character mothers their party and half the guild hall: practical care, gentle scolding, unshakable reliability. NPCs gravitate to them with troubles. Their own problems go chronically unmentioned, which the story should notice.

The Menace (Affectionate).name: The Menace (Affectionate)
The Menace (Affectionate).description: You are a gremlin and everyone loves you anyway. Pranks, schemes, ill-advised bets, the guild noticeboard rearranged into a haiku: your works are legion and your victims defend you. Every town needs one menace whose chaos is fundamentally kind. Axel has several. The competition is fierce.
The Menace (Affectionate).traitNarrativeEffects: SOCIAL: Affectionate Menace. The character generates constant low-grade chaos with no malice: pranks, japes, escalating bits. NPCs sigh fondly. Their loyalty, when it counts, is absolute, which is why they get away with everything.

Cannot Refuse a Dare.name: Cannot Refuse a Dare
Cannot Refuse a Dare.description: It is not pride, exactly. It is a load-bearing structural inability. The words 'bet you won't' bypass your judgment entirely and connect directly to your limbs, and everyone who has known you for a week knows it. The guild has considered a rule. The rule would just be your name.
Cannot Refuse a Dare.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: Cannot Refuse a Dare. Any framed challenge compels the character. Their party exploits it, enemies exploit it, and the results write themselves. The character insists each time was a free choice.

Pathological Cheapskate.name: Pathological Cheapskate
Pathological Cheapskate.description: You are not poor; you are principled, and the principle is that everything costs too much. You haggle for coppers, ford rivers to dodge tolls, and once ate a suspicious quest reward rather than buy dinner. The money you save is real. The consequences are also real, and the ledger of the two has never once been in your favor.
Pathological Cheapskate.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: Pathological Cheapskate. The character optimizes for cost over safety, comfort, and reason. Every avoided expense produces a larger one. The character's accounting acknowledges only the savings.

Hero Complex.name: Hero Complex
Hero Complex.description: Somebody yells for help and you are already moving: no assessment, no plan, no pause to notice it is a mimic doing the yelling. Belzerg eats sincere heroes for breakfast, and you keep volunteering for the menu. Your party has a leash budget. It is under discussion.
Hero Complex.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: Hero Complex. The character answers every cry for help instantly and uncritically. Scams, mimics, and elaborate misunderstandings result. Their sincerity is genuinely admirable, which makes it worse.

Cripplingly Gullible.name: Cripplingly Gullible
Cripplingly Gullible.description: You believe people. All people. Merchants love you, con artists retire on you, and your party has instituted a rule that you may not speak to anyone selling anything without a chaperone. The tragic part is your trust occasionally redeems somebody. It is not occasional enough to be a strategy.
Cripplingly Gullible.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: Cripplingly Gullible. The character accepts claims at face value. Purchases, promises, and obvious traps ensue. Their trust redeems an NPC just often enough to keep the flaw alive.

Dramatic to a Fault.name: Dramatic to a Fault
Dramatic to a Fault.description: Everything is a scene. Ordering breakfast has an arc. Leaving a room requires a line. You are not a Crimson Demon, which everyone finds hard to believe, and your compulsion toward maximum theater in minimum circumstances has ruined more stealth missions than any bell or bark.
Dramatic to a Fault.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: Dramatic to a Fault. The character performs everything: entrances, exits, mundane errands. Timing, lighting, and declared titles matter to them. Stealth and drama are mutually exclusive and they choose drama every time.

Cannot Hold Liquor.name: Cannot Hold Liquor
Cannot Hold Liquor.description: One drink. That is the entire dose. One tankard and you are a different, louder, more honest person with no secrets and one ambition, which changes nightly. Adventurer culture runs on taverns, so your condition is on permanent public display, and the guild hall keeps a written record of your announcements. It is bound. There are volumes.
Cannot Hold Liquor.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: Cannot Hold Liquor. A single drink transforms the character: loud, honest, ambitious, incoherent. Tavern scenes escalate reliably. The morning-after apologies are a recurring ritual with its own etiquette.

Sticky Fingers.name: Sticky Fingers
Sticky Fingers.description: You do not steal, exactly. Things simply end up on your person: interesting spoons, unattended trinkets, one entire potted plant you have no memory of acquiring. You return everything, eventually, with apologies, which is the only reason you are not in a cell. Your party pats you down before leaving anywhere nice, a ritual you find hurtful and they find necessary.
Sticky Fingers.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: Sticky Fingers. The character unconsciously pockets small objects under stress or boredom. Discoveries are mutual surprises. The returns-and-apologies circuit is a recurring social event. Play it as compulsion comedy, never real villainy.

Obsessed With Being Popular.name: Obsessed With Being Popular
Obsessed With Being Popular.description: You keep count. Friends, fans, tavern cheers, thank-you letters: all tallied, all compared, all insufficient. Somewhere out there somebody is more beloved than you and it keeps you up at night. Your kindnesses are real, your generosity is real, and your motives are a scoreboard you deny owning.
Obsessed With Being Popular.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: Popularity Obsession. The character needs to be liked, measurably, and manages their reputation like a portfolio. Genuine goodness and naked audience-chasing blur constantly. Rivals for public affection become nemeses without ever knowing it.

Writes Terrible Poetry.name: Writes Terrible Poetry
Writes Terrible Poetry.description: You compose verse about your adventures. The meter is a war crime and the rhymes are hostage situations, but the feelings are real, and you will read it aloud with zero provocation. The party has learned the warning signs: a distant look, a cleared throat, a hand reaching for the journal.
Writes Terrible Poetry.traitNarrativeEffects: QUIRK: Terrible Poet. The character memorializes events in awful heartfelt verse and shares it freely. NPC reactions range from pained politeness to genuine tears, unpredictably.

Adopts Every Stray.name: Adopts Every Stray
